chapters.title: Chapter 4151: Two Anomalies
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage, and glared angrily at the young man in black, “Get up, just see if Grandpa Dog won’t beat you to death!”
However, the young man in black didn’t look at the large black dog. Instead, he looked at Ling Han, and said, “So it’s you!”
Ling Han was already known as the Imperial Son killer, so his name naturally spread throughout the Imperial Clans.

“Humph, how preposterous. A mere lowly commoner actually dares to call himself Imperial Son killer. Today, I will let you know that a rat can only be a rat forever!” The young man in black stood up, and with a shrill whistle, that long sword suddenly left its sheath, drawing a streak of light as it fell into his hand.
“Grandson, your opponent is here!” the large black dog shouted loudly, and charged towards the young man in black.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The man and dog immediately became embroiled in a fierce battle.

Though this young man in black was standing guard here, he was not an Imperial Son. It was possible that he was only one of the members of the Imperial Clan. Though his battle prowess was extraordinary, it had completely not reached the level of Imperial Son.
With how slippery the large black dog was, how could he possibly charge forward foolishly even though he knew that he was outmatched?
Now, the large black dog’s battle prowess was extremely shocking.

It had also gained a lot of benefits from the True Dragon Abyss. Its cultivation level was steadily increasing, and had already reached the late stage of Core Formation Tier. Furthermore, he was also close to cultivating the Core Formation Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. Its battle prowess was as high as 25 Heavens, and was already one of the strongest in the Galaxy Network. Looking at the green-robed young man again, though he was at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, his battle prowess was only so-so.
The man and dog battled fiercely, and for the moment, it was hard to decide the victor.

Now that the process of probing each other had ended, they should enter into an even more intense stage. Both sides would use powerful moves, or even ultimate moves. The battle had reached a climax, and it was possible that someone would die at the slightest drop of a hat.
However, if the large black dog did the same thing, that would not be him..
“Grandson, you’re too weak. You’re really too weak. You can’t even touch a single hair on Grandpa Dog’s head. Did you not drink milk today?1”
“If you exert a little more force, you’ll be able to force Grandpa Dog to use 10% of my power!”
“Sigh, you are ugly, and this battle prowess is too horrible to look at. If Grandpa Dog was you, I would have long since castrated myself!”
“Yi, you sissy, have you long since castrated yourself?”
The large black dog unleashed verbal attacks. This was his normal attack pattern.

One mustn’t underestimate this kind of attack. It directly penetrated into one’s mind, and even if one didn’t want to listen, it was impossible. The black-robed young man was so infuriated that his face had turned livid. He began to verbally defend himself. He was definitely not an eunuch. Otherwise, if a misunderstanding spread out here, the whole universe would know, and he would become the biggest joke in the world.
However, it should be known that the large black dog cursing was based on pure instinct. There was no need for him to expend any thought or energy on this at all. How could others compare?
Thus, while the young man in black had to deal with the attacks of the large black dog, he also had to rack his brains to think of how to refute the large black dog. How could he manage that?
It wasn’t long before he became flustered and fell into a disadvantage.
“Despicable!”
“How shameless!”
“So what if he wins? He can’t convince the masses at all!”
The spectators all shook their heads. This large black dog’s strength was clearly astonishing, yet he didn’t play by the rules and used such devious methods. He was extremely shameless.

However, the large black dog didn’t care at all. His goal was to disgust as many people as he could. He continued to speak, and the more he spoke, the more the young man in black wanted to vomit blood.
This was too shameless, too despicable. How could he do this?
Peng!
In a moment of distraction, he was sent flying by the large black dog. His face was as white as a sheet, and then he wailed, throwing up blood continuously.
“Sigh, elites are so lonely!” The large black dog stood on his hind legs like a human, his front paws crossed behind his back. His iron underwear shone brightly, practically blinding to the eye.
Everyone wanted to spit at it. How could it be so despicable?
“Come with Grandpa Dog.” The large black dog crossed its front paws behind its back and started to stride up the mountain.
Ling Han and the little dragon smiled, and followed the large black dog.
When the others saw this, they hurriedly followed. Hadn’t they come here to watch the excitement?
They climbed the stairs and ascended the mountain. After walking for a while, another platform appeared ahead of them.
This place was deserted, with only a young man standing on the platform, arms crossed behind his back. There was no one around.
When Ling Han and the others walked over, this young man immediately looked over. Shua, it was as if divine light had bloomed from his eyes, possessing a frightening penetrating ability.
“Being able to come here means that your strength is not too bad.” This young man said, “I am Cao Xiong, which of you will be my opponent?”
He was not the Imperial Son either, but his abilities were much stronger than that person from before.

The large black dog’s eyes were extremely sharp, and he could tell with a single glance that he was no match for this stage. After all, he was only in the late stage of Core Formation Tier, and had not even begun to cultivate the Core Formation Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique yet. Thus, it was very normal that he was no match. Thus, he resolutely did not make a sound, and pretended that he had not heard anything.
The little azure dragon moved, and arrived on the platform. He hovered in midair, brandishing his claws and fangs, showing a dragon’s might.
“Four, Four-legged Snake?” Cao Xiong’s expression was filled with shock. This kind of low-level creature was worthy of exchanging blows with him?

The little azure dragon was enraged. Just how noble was his status? He was the son of the True Dragon, and Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters had to step aside in front of him, because he was from the first generation, a true Imperial Son!
Furthermore, the True Dragon was the most noble existence among the Divine Beasts, and you actually dare to belittle me as a four-legged snake?
There are some things that could be tolerated, but that could not!

“Hahaha!” The people in the surroundings all roared with laughter. No matter how they looked at it, this indeed looked like a four-legged snake. It actually dared to battle against an Imperial Clan member?
Whoosh! The little azure dragon moved, charging at Cao Xiong at an astonishing speed.

“What!” Cao Xiong only had time to exclaim lowly. Peng, his whole person had already been sent flying. A terrifying power instantly assailed his whole body, making him feel as if every single bone in his body had been shattered.
He had lost?

He was a member of the Imperial Clan, the strongest below the Imperial Son, an existence that could sweep aside all opposition in the Galaxy Network, and he had actually been defeated in a single move. Furthermore, he had been defeated by the hand of a four-legged snake!
“What exactly are you, four-legged snake!” After he fell onto the ground, he released a defiant exclamation. Then, with a tilt of his head, he had passed out.
The little azure dragon was enraged. ‘Holy f*ck! You actually call me a four-legged snake?!’
He leaped over, and grabbed Cao Xiong, shaking him with all his might, “This lord is a True Dragon! Dragon! You f****** repeat that for me!”
However, Cao Xiong had passed out very thoroughly, and could not be shaken awake no matter what.
Pa, pa, pa! The little azure dragon slapped Cao Xiong hard, “B@stard, wake up and apologize properly!”
Everyone inhaled sharply as they watched. This four-legged snake was so vicious that it even dared to ravage an Imperial Clan member like this. Was it trying to defy the heavens?
Ling Han immediately stepped forward to persuade him, saying, “Alright, alright. Let’s continue.”
The little azure dragon angrily tossed Cao Xiong onto the ground. After stomping on him a few more times, it finally walked up the mountain.
This time, everyone’s interest was piqued, and they began to anticipate.
This group of three was a little violent. Who knew how much commotion they would cause.
Everyone followed behind, determined to watch the whole way. A great many people had activated Galaxy Network’s live broadcast function, and were reporting in real time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4152: The little azure dragon unleashes its might
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others continued to ascend the mountain. They hadn’t walked for long, when they saw another platform appear here.
This time, it was a woman. She was dressed in a light blue long dress, and had long dark purple hair. Coupled with her snow-white, bright face, she was enchanting.

“Ling Han?” The woman swept an eye over Ling Han, and couldn’t help but sneer, “Being called the Imperial Son killer, you do indeed have some skill. The previous two pieces of trash did not manage to detain you!”

“Ugly girl, Grandpa Dragon is here!” The little azure dragon charged over, and said, “You have a sliver of the scent of a flood dragon on you. Seeing a True Dragon like Grandpa Dragon, aren’t you going to kneel down and lick my boots?”
The purple-haired woman faltered for a moment, then flew into a thunderous rage, “A mere four-legged snake, die!”
Boom, she sent out a palm strike. Her jade-like hand turned into a mountain, covered densely with seals, that pressed down on the little azure dragon.
This was an Imperial Daughter, whose power had surpassed 30 Heavens!
Reaching 30 Heavens in pure power was a threshold that only an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter could cross.
A terrifying power surged over. This was a move that was fatal.

“Yi, Grandpa Dragon is the son of a True Dragon, and with a shake of my body, why didn’t this flood dragon bloodline immediately prostrate and prostrate?” The little azure dragon casually parried, turning its head to look at Ling Han and the large black dog, its expression filled with confusion.
Logically speaking, shouldn’t all snakes and flood dragons submit upon the appearance of a True Dragon?

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Their main bloodline is the Imperial Clan, while their secondary bloodline is the flood dragon race. Thus, they’re naturally immune to a violent shake of your body.”

Though the True Dragon was the leader of the Divine Beasts, which of the Ancestral Kings of the future generations had not achieved Dao through their own efforts, and which of them was weaker than the True Dragon?
Hence, even if they were both descendants, there was naturally no qualitative difference. It was just a matter of whose cultivation level was higher, and whose battle prowess was stronger.
However, seeing that the little azure dragon could still turn around and speak so easily when facing off against the Imperial Daughter, this strength was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
“Ling Han is the Imperial Son Killer, so could it be that this four-legged snake i become the Imperial Daughter Killer?” someone said.
about to
“His abilities are truly terrifying. He’s no weaker than Ling Han!”
“The Imperial Daughter Killer lives true to his name.”
Everyone spoke one after another, and as the live broadcast spread all over the Galaxy Network, it caused heated discussions, and also caused a commotion.

The little azure dragon heard all of this, and he couldn’t help but feel enraged. Though the title of Imperial Daughter Killer was not inferior to Ling Han’s, but with the word “Daughter”, why did it feel like a kind of mockery?
“Ling Han, Grandpa Dragon wants to trade with you!” he shouted. “Grandpa Dragon will be the Imperial Son Killer, and you become the Imperial Daughter Killer.”
Ling Han merely smiled, and had absolutely no intention of replying.

The purple-haired Imperial Daughter was also enraged. She was completely ignored. “Pure Clouds Thousand Strikes!” she shouted, and struck out with both palms. Boom, boom, boom! All of a sudden, the weather changed, and heaven and earth paled in colour.
If it was not for the fact that this was the Wolf Mountain, it would probably have fallen apart by now, shattered by her terrifying power.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon humphed lightly, and said, “Mere tricks!” He didn’t even need to activate the Imperial Technique, and calmly dispersed the attack.

At present, it was not that he did not have any Imperial Techniques to use. After he was born, he had a great many Mystical Powers that had awakened with him. Those had been sealed in his mind by the True Dragon, and once it was born, they would be unsealed, and learnt by him. In the past year or so, he had also successfully learnt a few techniques. He was no longer like how he had been when he had faced Ling Han, where he could only spit in his anxiety.

Seeing how mighty the little azure dragon was, everyone felt rueful. The purple-haired woman had even used the Imperial Technique, yet was still unable to suppress this four- legged snake, which showed how terrifying this guy was.
“The Four-Legged Snake Race is about to rise.”
“That’s right. This is an extraordinarily talented prodigy. In future, even if he cannot become an Emperor, he would still be an incredibly powerful Saint.”
“Sigh, I’m really envious of the Four-Legged Snake Race. Previously, they were unknown, but now, they’re going to rise overnight.”
Everyone said. The Galaxy Network was also filled with sighs. Another race was about to step onto the stage of history.

The little azure dragon had a constipated expression. He was the son of the True Dragon, and was the leader of the Dragon Race. What Four-Legged Snake! His race had clearly been intimidating the world for a long time. Even when the Emperors had all been present, the Dragon Race had still been top-notch.
“You ignorant people, shut up!” he shouted loudly, finally getting serious.
The purple-haired Imperial Daughter was astonished. Was this the true strength of the Four- Legged Snake?
This was too terrifying!

She no longer had any thoughts of getting lucky, and immediately ignited the Imperial Bloodline. Instantly, her whole person enlarged, turning into a three hundred meter tall female giant, but her figure was still captivating, bright and enchanting.
Boom, she sent out a palm strike, and a terrifying power surged. One after another, veined patterns lit up on her arm.

Her power was around 31 Heavens, and after burning the Imperial Blood, it suddenly soared to the 39 Heavens. Then, she cast the Imperial Technique, and her battle prowess soared to 40 Heavens-it couldn’t be helped. 40 Heavens was a barrier that even burning the Imperial Blood couldn’t cross. It was as if there was a power in the heaven and earth that restrained you. You didn’t cultivate this power yourself, so it was impossible for your battle prowess to break through 40 Heavens.
Even so, the battle prowess of 40 Heavens was still incredibly terrifying. Who in the world could stop this?
The little azure dragon revealed a disdainful expression. “You haven’t even surpassed 40 Heavens yet, and you’re still qualified to fight Grandpa Dragon?”
He did not dodge or evade at all, and took each blow head-on.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Everyone was horrified to discover that the little azure dragon was facing the purple-haired Imperial Daughter head-on. Not only was it not at a disadvantage, but it was even enjoying a
slight advantage.
Hiss!
What kind of concept was this?
The battle prowess of the purple-haired Imperial Daughter was 40 Heavens, so if he could still suppress her, then wouldn’t his battle prowess surpass 40 Heavens?
Gods, this was too terrifying!
Everyone knew that the battle prowess of a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier couldn’t

surpass 40 Heavens. If they advanced any further, they would almost enter the territory of the True Self Tier. However, there was a strict barrier in martial arts, and the True Self Tier would definitely crush the Core Formation Tier. This was the truth and reality, but now? This Four- Legged Snake actually had a vague possibility of breaking this truth!
Who wouldn’t be shocked?

The stunned expressions on everyone’s faces made the little azure dragon feel very pleased. He laughed loudly, “Grandpa Dragon is the number one person in the world, invincible among his peers. In future, he will definitely become a Great Emperor. Why don’t you people
quickly kowtow?”
How showy.

Everyone was speechless. In terms of the awesomeness of natural talent, this guy was really even more freakish than Ling Han, but why was his personality so despicable? “Hey, hey, hey, what’s with your expressions?” The little azure dragon was getting irritated. Just now, they were still wearing an expression of absolute shock. Why were they now wearing
an expression of disdain?

Meanwhile, the purple-haired Imperial Daughter was about to go mad with fury. She had already used her ultimate move, yet the little azure dragon still dared to be distracted, completely ignoring her. How could she endure this?
“Die!” She summoned a spear and stabbed it at the little azure dragon.

This was a replica Imperial Weapon, and its might was incredibly powerful. However, there was a line in heaven and earth. If it was not her true strength, she couldn’t surpass 40 Heavens. Thus, it was useless even if she summoned her Spirit Tool. Her battle prowess hadn’t advanced to 41 Heavens because of this, but under her command, it was as if the spear had come to life. It could actually attack on its own, and its might was no weaker than hers.
This was like two people with battle prowess of forty Heavens were working together, so their might naturally increased greatly.

The little azure dragon had a constipated expression.
He was the son of the True Dragon, and was the leader of the Dragon Race.
What Four-Legged Snake!
His race had clearly been intimidating the world for a long time.
Even when the Emperors had all been present, the Dragon Race had still been top-notch.
“You ignorant people, shut up!” he shouted loudly, finally getting serious.
The purple-haired Imperial Daughter was astonished.
Was this the true strength of the Four- Legged Snake?
This was too terrifying!
She no longer had any thoughts of getting lucky, and immediately ignited the Imperial Bloodline.
Instantly, her whole person enlarged, turning into a three hundred meter tall female giant, but her figure was still captivating, bright and enchanting.
Boom, she sent out a palm strike, and a terrifying power surged.
One after another, veined patterns lit up on her arm.
Her power was around 31 Heavens, and after burning the Imperial Blood, it suddenly soared to the 39 Heavens.
Then, she cast the Imperial Technique, and her battle prowess soared to 40 Heavens-it couldn’t be helped.
40 Heavens was a barrier that even burning the Imperial Blood couldn’t cross.
It was as if there was a power in the heaven and earth that restrained you.
You didn’t cultivate this power yourself, so it was impossible for your battle prowess to break through 40 Heavens.
Even so, the battle prowess of 40 Heavens was still incredibly terrifying.
Who in the world could stop this?
The little azure dragon revealed a disdainful expression.
“You haven’t even surpassed 40 Heavens yet, and you’re still qualified to fight Grandpa Dragon?”
He did not dodge or evade at all, and took each blow head-on.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Everyone was horrified to discover that the little azure dragon was facing the purple-haired Imperial Daughter head-on.
Not only was it not at a disadvantage, but it was even enjoying a
slight advantage.
Hiss!
What kind of concept was this?
The battle prowess of the purple-haired Imperial Daughter was 40 Heavens, so if he could still suppress her, then wouldn’t his battle prowess surpass 40 Heavens?
Gods, this was too terrifying!
Everyone knew that the battle prowess of a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier couldn’t
surpass 40 Heavens.
If they advanced any further, they would almost enter the territory of the True Self Tier.
However, there was a strict barrier in martial arts, and the True Self Tier would definitely crush the Core Formation Tier.
This was the truth and reality, but now?
This Four- Legged Snake actually had a vague possibility of breaking this truth!
Who wouldn’t be shocked?
The stunned expressions on everyone’s faces made the little azure dragon feel very pleased.
He laughed loudly, “Grandpa Dragon is the number one person in the world, invincible among his peers.
In future, he will definitely become a Great Emperor.
Why don’t you people
quickly kowtow?”
How showy.
Everyone was speechless.
In terms of the awesomeness of natural talent, this guy was really even more freakish than Ling Han, but why was his personality so despicable?
“Hey, hey, hey, what’s with your expressions?” The little azure dragon was getting irritated.
Just now, they were still wearing an expression of absolute shock.
Why were they now wearing
an expression of disdain?
Meanwhile, the purple-haired Imperial Daughter was about to go mad with fury.
She had already used her ultimate move, yet the little azure dragon still dared to be distracted, completely ignoring her.
How could she endure this?
“Die!” She summoned a spear and stabbed it at the little azure dragon.
This was a replica Imperial Weapon, and its might was incredibly powerful.
However, there was a line in heaven and earth.
If it was not her true strength, she couldn’t surpass 40 Heavens.
Thus, it was useless even if she summoned her Spirit Tool.
Her battle prowess hadn’t advanced to 41 Heavens because of this, but under her command, it was as if the spear had come to life.
It could actually attack on its own, and its might was no weaker than hers.
This was like two people with battle prowess of forty Heavens were working together, so their might naturally increased greatly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4153: Imperial Daughter Killer
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The little azure dragon was unafraid, and its battle prowess surpassed the Imperial Daughter by one Heaven. At least three to four people were needed to make up for this. Moreover, he cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and his physique was extremely tough. Even if he was hit once or twice, it wouldn’t matter.
Otherwise, how could he have battled with Ling Han for so long?

Moreover, there was a time limit to the burning of Imperial Blood. Once it was completely ignited, the battle prowess of the purple-haired Imperial Daughter would instantly drop. If the Spirit Tool did not have enough power to activate it, then no matter how good its quality was, it would be useless.
Meanwhile, everyone was watching in a daze. Heavens, how could there possibly be such a freakish elite?
Compared to him, Ling Han was probably as far off as the horizon.
The little azure dragon was excited from the battle, and channelled the Imperial Technique to launch a powerful counterattack.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
So what if this was an Imperial Daughter? So what if she had burnt her Imperial Bloodline? So what if she wielded a replica Imperial Weapon?
The purple-haired woman was blasted back repeatedly, completely outmatched.
‘Holy motherf*cker!’
Everyone’s mouths were wide open, unable to make the slightest bit of sound.

Though this Four-Legged Snake was despicable, in a battle of equals, he should be invincible in this world, and would definitely become a Saint in future. In fact, he even had hopes of breaking through to the Imperial Path.

Peng! The purple-haired Imperial Daughter was sent flying, crashing into a mountain peak in the distance. As she fell, her figure was also rapidly shrinking. This showed that the Imperial Blood had been forcefully snuffed out.
The little azure dragon was completely victorious.
Everyone looked at him with reverent gazes. In fact, there was even a kind of fanaticism about them.
Cultivators only believed in elites. The little azure dragon already proved its strength with its abilities, deserving of reverence.
The little azure dragon also enjoyed everyone’s gazes. He chuckled, and said, “In the future, all of you can become Grandpa Dragon’s lackeys. I won’t mistreat you.”

Everyone rolled their eyes. Even though they weren’t members of Imperial Clans, all of them came from extraordinary backgrounds. They either had Saintly blood flowing in their bodies, or were disciples of the Holy Land. No matter how weak they were, they had the backing of Venerate Tier elites, so how could they recognize a Four-Legged Snake as their boss?

No matter how strong you were, or how freakish you were, it was still impossible. Everyone still had their pride. After all, the despicable nature of the Four-Legged Snake had already spread throughout the universe with the live broadcast.
Seeing everyone avoid looking at him, the little azure dragon felt like it was about to get internal injuries from anger. Why was he, the son of the True Dragon, always looked down on?
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said with a wave of his hand. He didn’t want to see the little azure dragon continue its performance.
The large black dog snickered, and walked alongside Ling Han.
The little azure dragon saw this, and hurriedly followed. “Wait for Grandpa Dragon!”
Seeing this scene, everyone was surprised.
The little azure dragon was so powerful and freakish, but it seemed to be shamelessly sticking close to Ling Han. Otherwise, it could have “shaken its body” and commanded Ling Han to stop.
Hiss, now that Ling Han had gotten such help, he was really going to soar.
Meanwhile, on the Galaxy Network, there was a commotion.

“Big news, big news, the Imperial Son Killer, Ling Han, has joined forces with the Imperial Daughter Killer, the Four-Legged Snake, and is presently climbing the Wolf Mountain, issuing a challenge to the Imperial Daughters and Imperial Sons there.”

“There is no need to mention the Imperial Son Killer. Everyone already has no shortage of understanding about him. The Imperial Daughter Killer, the Four-legged Snake, is a prodigy that has suddenly appeared out of nowhere. His strength is incomparably strong. If the two of them join forces, would they create history, and defeat all the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters?”
“There is already an Imperial Daughter that has been defeated. Everyone, please continue to follow my livestream. I will reveal the answer for all of you.”

The little azure dragon was unknown before this, but the moment he appeared, he caused a great commotion, establishing his outstanding reputation by defeating an Imperial Daughter. This caused a wave of speculation on the Galaxy Network. Who exactly was he, and how did he get together with Ling Han?
Ling Han took the lead. After this, there were no more platforms in the mountains. They directly reached the summit, and here, there were at least twenty Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters.
Baili Che, Shi Yuanzhen, Xu Jie, and... Chi Menghan!

“Ling Han!” When he saw Ling Han, Baili Che’s eyes immediately turned cold. Though his relevant memories had been severed, he had already formed an enmity with Ling Han before entering into the True Dragon Abyss, so he naturally disliked Ling Han.
However, perhaps he had suffered too much inside the True Dragon Abyss. He instinctively felt a sense of disgust towards Ling Han, wanting to kill Ling Han as much as possible.
Not only him, but even Shi Yuanzhen and Xu Jie, who clearly “hadn’t” seen Ling Han before, still felt dislike towards him. This was baffling to them.
Could it be that they had been defeated by Ling Han in the True Dragon Abyss and this left behind an inerasable mark on tje,?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Didn’t you guys want to fight me? Now I’m here.”
“You were the one who obtained the True Dragon of Fortune?” an Imperial Son asked. However, he wasn’t one of the people who had entered the True Dragon Abyss.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
That Imperial Son from before couldn’t help but laugh loudly. Then, he looked towards Baili Che and the others, “Baili Che, Xu Jie, you guys actually lost to such a lowly person?”

Many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters who had entered the True Dragon Abyss all blushed. There was the participation of the Imperial Clans, but in the end, a person that was not from an Imperial Clan was the champion. This was a slap to the face.

Baili Che humphed, and said, “Though I don’t remember the exact details of what happened at that time, how could a mere lowly commoner possibly match an Imperial Son, what more when there are so many Imperial Sons! Thus, this person must have used some kind of underhanded means.”
Ling Han shook his head. How could it be that just because he had forgotten the truth of the matter, he could simply spout nonsense?
He did not mind either. He strode out, and said, “Come, come, come. Those who are dissatisfied, just come out. I will beat you until you call me grandpa!”
When these words fell, all the Imperial Clan members all looked furious, aside from Chi Menghan.

“Ling Han, you had best leave immediately. This time, Golden Silk Moth Race’s Imperial Son has also come. His abilities are not inferior to mine!” Chi Menghan said to Ling Han through divine sense transmission.
This woman had a good heart, and did well by the time they spent in the same ship in the True Dragon Abyss.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I’ll give you two options. Firstly, I’ll challenge all of you one-on-one, and secondly, you can attack together and fight me.”
“Grandpa Dragon as well!” the little azure dragon was unwilling to be ignored, and hurriedly called out.
How arrogant!
How many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were there here? About twenty!

Though there was an insurmountable gulf between the Core Formation Tier and the True Self Tier, with so many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters combining forces to combust the Imperial Bloodline, they were probably completely capable of fighting the weakest True Self Tier elite.
Quantity made up for quality. Even if Ling Han joined forces with the Four-Legged Snake, there were only two of them, so how could they possibly be a match for them?
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but frown. She had already warned Ling Han, but why was this guy still not listening?

Pa, pa, pa! Baili Che clapped his hands, as he walked out, “Ling Han, don’t think that just because others have bestowed the title of Imperial Son Killer on you, you really think that you are superior to an Imperial Son! Let me tell you, dragons will always be dragons, and insects... will always be insects!”
“Brother Baili, I’ll leave this little bug to you,” Xu Jie said with a smile. He glanced at Ling Han with strong disdain.
“All right.” Baili Che nodded, a powerful killing intent exuding from his body.
His memories of Ling Han were still stuck on before he had entered into the True Dragon Abyss, but merely Chi Menghan’s attitude towards Ling Han was enough to fill him with killing intent.
“Die!” He leaped out, and charged towards Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4154: Over 40 Heavens
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
An Imperial Son charged over, stirring up a boundless storm.
This was the Imperial Son, a synonym for the strongest among his peers. Who could withstand this?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and raised his fist to deliver a punch.
Peng, the fist landed, and Baili Che was sent flying back at an even faster speed. He crashed heavily into the mountain wall, and his whole person had sunk into the mountain.
Thankfully, this was the Wolf Mountain. Otherwise, this whole mountain would have been sent flying.
There was complete silence. Whether it was the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, or those spectators.
This... was too inconceivable, wasn’t it?
Baili Che was the Imperial Son, and his abilities were indescribably terrifying. However, it was this prodigy that was sent flying with a single punch from Ling Han.
Heavens!

After a while, everyone exclaimed in shock. Previously, they had thought that the Four-Legged Snake was unbelievably awesome, but they had never thought that there would be someone even more ruthless.
“Core Formation Tier, consummate level!” Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up, as she said word by word.

She knew that Ling Han possessed an eight-star aptitude, which was even more outstanding than hers. Thus, once Ling Han advanced into the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, who would be able to match him in this world?

—She did not remember that Ling Han actually had a pseudo-nine-star aptitude, and now that he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, he definitely had a nine-star aptitude. In fact, he had even reached pseudo-ten-star aptitude, or a true ten-star aptitude.
“Ah!” Baili Che let out a roar, and struggled out of the mountain wall. His fighting spirit was awe-inspiring, and solidified, boiling like flames.
As the Imperial Son, he had actually been sent flying with a single punch. Just what kind of great humiliation was this?
Xiu, he charged towards Ling Han again.
Peng!
However, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han now? Tragically, he was sent flying with another punch.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and swept an eye over them, “You all had best attack together.”

All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were speechless. Baili Che had been sent flying with a single punch twice in a row. This completely proved Ling Han’s strength, and also showed the gap between Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters and Ling Han.
How was this possible?
How could a non-Imperial Clan cultivate such strength?
Hiss!
They thought of a possibility, and that was Ling Han could possibly become an Emperor in future.

In history, it was not that the Imperial Sons had always been invincible. They had also been beaten up before, and that was when the new Ancestral King was born. The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters that had been born in that era were all very unfortunate, because they would be stepped on by the future Ancestral King on their way to ascend to the throne, and could only be reduced to being the background to their brilliance.
Now that the True Dragon Abyss had opened, it meant that heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome the birth of a new Emperor.
Could it be Ling Han?
No, no, no, that was definitely impossible. He should be one of the members of the Golden Generation, destined to break the Imperial Clan’s curse of being unable to produce a Great Emperor.

“Ling! Han!” Baili Che stepped out once more. Boom, the Imperial Blood burned, and he immediately turned into a giant that was three hundred meters tall. His whole body was covered with complex veined patterns, exuding a dazzling brilliance.
At this moment, Baili Che’s confidence increased a hundredfold, because once he ignited his Imperial Blood, he was destined to be invincible.

Meanwhile, Ling Han was slightly surprised. Wasn’t it said that one would need at least several decades to recover after combusting the Imperial Blood? First, it was Lin Lang, and now it was Baili Che, and they had both broken this rule.
It could only be said that the Imperial Clans had their own methods.
“I’m going to tear you into pieces!” Baili Che roared. With a leap, he charged towards Ling Han for the third time.
Ling Han humphed coldly, and still threw a punch.
Peng!
A scene that caused one’s eyes to pop out appeared. Baili Che’s colossal figure was suddenly sent flying, landing heavily on the mountain wall.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Everyone, including the Imperial Clan members, had their mouths agape. They could not believe this at all.
Another punch sent him flying, f***!

It should be known that the present Baili Che had ignited his Imperial Bloodline, and his battle prowess had soared all the way to 40 Heavens. And he was still sent flying with a single punch. Just how strong was Ling Han’s battle prowess?
41 Heavens?
It wasn’t enough. The advantage of one Heaven could only guarantee that Ling Han would definitely win, but it was definitely impossible that he would succeed with a single punch.
This had to be the crushing advantage of three Heavens.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
The moment they thought of this terrifying number, everyone felt their scalps go numb. This was impossible and unrealistic, all right?

Even their ancestor, the Ancestral Kings that had founded the Imperial Clans, had only possessed the power of 36 to 39 Heavens when they had been at the Core Formation Tier. With the addition of the celestial technique, the Ancestral Kings could indeed break through the shackles of 40 Heavens, but at most, they could only break through to 42 Heavens.
But it should be known that these were the future Ancestral Kings.
The battle prowess of 43 Heavens was something that even the Ancestral King had been unable to match when he was young.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up. She knew that Ling Han was powerful, but she had never imagined that Ling Han could be freakish to this extent.
Furthermore... though Ling Han had advanced into the consummate level, it was clear that he had not reached the end of the Core Formation Tier yet.
Hiss!
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help but feel shocked. The battle prowess of 43 Heavens was actually not Ling Han’s limit!
Heavens, could it be that this guy was really going to perform a miracle, possessing the battle prowess of a True Self Tier elite when he was only in the Core Formation Tier?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and looked at the others, “Now, you guys should know that I’m not looking down on you guys. I’m just stating facts, right?”
His words were true, but all the Imperial Clan members still felt that they were being looked down upon.
“Are you going to fight or not?” Ling Han said with a smile. “If you’re going to fight, then go ahead and fight. If you’re not going to fight, then go ahead and give me the Iron Bull Blood Fruit.”
All the Imperial Clan members exchanged looks, not knowing what to do.

In a one-on-one battle, even if they combusted the Imperial Bloodline, they would still be no match for Ling Han. However, if they teamed up, they would indeed have a chance of winning. However, so what if they won? This Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters actually needed to team up to defeat their opponent. If this spread out, it would still become a huge joke.
Moreover, there was another possibility.
—What if they lost?
That would really be humiliating to the extreme.
“Ling Han, I’ll spar with you for three moves.” Right at this moment, a young man in embroidered robes walked out. He was extremely handsome, and had an indescribable military bearing.
“Golden Silk Moth Imperial Clan, Zhang Fang,” the youngster introduced himself.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. This was the elite that Chi Menghan had warned him to be careful of. He couldn’t help but feel intrigued. Just how strong was this Zhang Fang?
“Please,” he said, withdrawing his arrogance.

Zhang Fang didn’t dare to be careless in the slightest. He was acclaimed as a natural talent that was not inferior to the Golden Generation, and was indeed awesome. His raw power had reached 35 Heavens, but no matter how much he exploded, his battle prowess was still unable to break through the limite of 40 Heavens. Thus, when he faced Ling Han, he naturally had to face him as if he was facing a great enemy.
“He!” he exclaimed lightly, and pounced rapidly towards Ling Han.

He did not combust his Imperial Bloodline. For a prodigy like him, he was already close to the level that the Ancestral King had once been. Thus, combusting his Imperial Bloodline would not be of much use. At most, it would only increase his battle prowess by one or two Heavens.
Thus, he might as well not use it. It would be a good opportunity to show fairness.
Since that was the case, Ling Han did not use Body Art either. He only used mystical power to exchange blows with Zhang Fang.
However, his mystical power had already reached 36 Heavens. Even though he only had one more Heaven than Zhang Fang, he was still powerful.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Zhang Fang was at a complete disadvantage, completely unable to fight back.

Baili Che was the Imperial Son, and his abilities were indescribably terrifying.
However, it was this prodigy that was sent flying with a single punch from Ling Han.
Heavens!
After a while, everyone exclaimed in shock.
Previously, they had thought that the Four-Legged Snake was unbelievably awesome, but they had never thought that there would be someone even more ruthless.
“Core Formation Tier, consummate level!” Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up, as she said word by word.
She knew that Ling Han possessed an eight-star aptitude, which was even more outstanding than hers.
Thus, once Ling Han advanced into the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, who would be able to match him in this world?
—She did not remember that Ling Han actually had a pseudo-nine-star aptitude, and now that he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, he definitely had a nine-star aptitude.
In fact, he had even reached pseudo-ten-star aptitude, or a true ten-star aptitude.
“Ah!” Baili Che let out a roar, and struggled out of the mountain wall.
His fighting spirit was awe-inspiring, and solidified, boiling like flames.
As the Imperial Son, he had actually been sent flying with a single punch.
Just what kind of great humiliation was this?
Xiu, he charged towards Ling Han again.
Peng!
However, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han now?
Tragically, he was sent flying with another punch.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and swept an eye over them, “You all had best attack together.”
All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were speechless.
Baili Che had been sent flying with a single punch twice in a row.
This completely proved Ling Han’s strength, and also showed the gap between Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters and Ling Han.
How was this possible?
How could a non-Imperial Clan cultivate such strength?
Hiss!
They thought of a possibility, and that was Ling Han could possibly become an Emperor in future.
In history, it was not that the Imperial Sons had always been invincible.
They had also been beaten up before, and that was when the new Ancestral King was born.

The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters that had been born in that era were all very unfortunate, because they would be stepped on by the future Ancestral King on their way to ascend to the throne, and could only be reduced to being the background to their brilliance.
Now that the True Dragon Abyss had opened, it meant that heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome the birth of a new Emperor.
Could it be Ling Han?
No, no, no, that was definitely impossible.
He should be one of the members of the Golden Generation, destined to break the Imperial Clan’s curse of being unable to produce a Great Emperor.
“Ling!
Han!” Baili Che stepped out once more.
Boom, the Imperial Blood burned, and he immediately turned into a giant that was three hundred meters tall.
His whole body was covered with complex veined patterns, exuding a dazzling brilliance.
At this moment, Baili Che’s confidence increased a hundredfold, because once he ignited his Imperial Blood, he was destined to be invincible.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was slightly surprised.
Wasn’t it said that one would need at least several decades to recover after combusting the Imperial Blood?
First, it was Lin Lang, and now it was Baili Che, and they had both broken this rule.
It could only be said that the Imperial Clans had their own methods.
“I’m going to tear you into pieces!” Baili Che roared.
With a leap, he charged towards Ling Han for the third time.
Ling Han humphed coldly, and still threw a punch.
Peng!
A scene that caused one’s eyes to pop out appeared.
Baili Che’s colossal figure was suddenly sent flying, landing heavily on the mountain wall.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Everyone, including the Imperial Clan members, had their mouths agape.
They could not believe this at all.
Another punch sent him flying, f***!
It should be known that the present Baili Che had ignited his Imperial Bloodline, and his battle prowess had soared all the way to 40 Heavens.
And he was still sent flying with a single punch.
Just how strong was Ling Han’s battle prowess?
41 Heavens?
It wasn’t enough.
The advantage of one Heaven could only guarantee that Ling Han would definitely win, but it was definitely impossible that he would succeed with a single punch.
This had to be the crushing advantage of three Heavens.
Heavens!
Heavens!
Heavens!
The moment they thought of this terrifying number, everyone felt their scalps go numb.
This was impossible and unrealistic, all right?
Even their ancestor, the Ancestral Kings that had founded the Imperial Clans, had only possessed the power of 36 to 39 Heavens when they had been at the Core Formation Tier.
With the addition of the celestial technique, the Ancestral Kings could indeed break through the shackles of 40 Heavens, but at most, they could only break through to 42 Heavens.
But it should be known that these were the future Ancestral Kings.
The battle prowess of 43 Heavens was something that even the Ancestral King had been unable to match when he was young.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up.
She knew that Ling Han was powerful, but she had never imagined that Ling Han could be freakish to this extent.
Furthermore... though Ling Han had advanced into the consummate level, it was clear that he had not reached the end of the Core Formation Tier yet.
Hiss!
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help but feel shocked.
The battle prowess of 43 Heavens was actually not Ling Han’s limit!
Heavens, could it be that this guy was really going to perform a miracle, possessing the battle prowess of a True Self Tier elite when he was only in the Core Formation Tier?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and looked at the others, “Now, you guys should know that I’m not looking down on you guys.
I’m just stating facts, right?”
His words were true, but all the Imperial Clan members still felt that they were being looked down upon.
“Are you going to fight or not?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“If you’re going to fight, then go ahead and fight.
If you’re not going to fight, then go ahead and give me the Iron Bull Blood Fruit.”
All the Imperial Clan members exchanged looks, not knowing what to do.
In a one-on-one battle, even if they combusted the Imperial Bloodline, they would still be no match for Ling Han.
However, if they teamed up, they would indeed have a chance of winning.
However, so what if they won?
This Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters actually needed to team up to defeat their opponent.
If this spread out, it would still become a huge joke.
Moreover, there was another possibility.
—What if they lost?
That would really be humiliating to the extreme.
“Ling Han, I’ll spar with you for three moves.” Right at this moment, a young man in embroidered robes walked out.
He was extremely handsome, and had an indescribable military bearing.
“Golden Silk Moth Imperial Clan, Zhang Fang,” the youngster introduced himself.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’.
This was the elite that Chi Menghan had warned him to be careful of.
He couldn’t help but feel intrigued.
Just how strong was this Zhang Fang?
“Please,” he said, withdrawing his arrogance.
Zhang Fang didn’t dare to be careless in the slightest.
He was acclaimed as a natural talent that was not inferior to the Golden Generation, and was indeed awesome.
His raw power had reached 35 Heavens, but no matter how much he exploded, his battle prowess was still unable to break through the limite of 40 Heavens.
Thus, when he faced Ling Han, he naturally had to face him as if he was facing a great enemy.
“He!” he exclaimed lightly, and pounced rapidly towards Ling Han.
He did not combust his Imperial Bloodline.
For a prodigy like him, he was already close to the level that the Ancestral King had once been.
Thus, combusting his Imperial Bloodline would not be of much use.
At most, it would only increase his battle prowess by one or two Heavens.
Thus, he might as well not use it.
It would be a good opportunity to show fairness.
Since that was the case, Ling Han did not use Body Art either.
He only used mystical power to exchange blows with Zhang Fang.
However, his mystical power had already reached 36 Heavens.
Even though he only had one more Heaven than Zhang Fang, he was still powerful.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Zhang Fang was at a complete disadvantage, completely unable to fight back.

chapters.title: Chapter 4155: Eternal Trap
paragraphs: Peng, peng, peng! Zhang Fang felt as if the whole sky was filled with fists, as if they were multiple stars that were crashing towards him. They were as heavy as could be.
At this moment, he felt that time was incredibly long. It was clearly just three moves, so why was it not over yet?
Finally, Ling Han stopped.
Zhang Fang was breathing heavily, his face filled with shock.
He was completely outmatched!
This was the strength of the Golden Generation. It was too terrifying.
What he didn’t know was that Ling Han hadn’t used Body Art yet. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to withstand a single punch.
“Brother Ling’s might is indeed top-notch in the world.” Zhang Fang sighed, and directly took out a jade box, handing it over. “This is Iron Bull Blood Fruit.”

Ling Han stowed it away without any reservations. This was the main reason why he had come. Otherwise, just for the sake of beating up a few Imperial Sons, he would not have bothered to deliberately make this trip.
‘Hmm?’
He suddenly turned around, and looked towards where Baili Che had crashed into.
A powerful and dangerous aura was surging, making even him feel uneasy.
Baili Cheli had already crawled up. His current height was about 30 meters. This was very strange. He was far larger than a normal person, but smaller than when he was burning the Imperial Blood.
“This guy is about to break through!” someone said.
“Unwilling to admit defeat at the hands of a non-Imperial Clan, Baili Che simply decided to use the Imperial Blood as a driving force, and began his path of breakthrough.”
“To the Imperial Son, breaking through in battle is not difficult in the first place, and now with the help of the Imperial Blood, this is even more natural.”
“Although Ling Han is powerful and freakish to the extreme, comparable to the Golden Generation, if Baili Che broke through to the True Self Tier, the situation would be completely different.”
“That’s right. No matter how strong a warrior of the Core Formation Tier is, he would not be able to stand against a warrior of the True Self Tier. This is an iron rule of martial arts.”
“Furthermore, Baili Che broke through in battle, so it can still be considered a fair battle.” “This time, Ling Han is in big trouble.”
Everyone said one after another. At present, no one denied that Ling Han was freakishly strong. However, once Baili Che broke through to True Self Tier, it would be a completely different situation.

“Ling Han, you can’t defeat me. You’re but a lowly commoner, so how can you compete with the Imperial Clan?” Baili Che charged over. Boom! Boundless energy surged. His battle prowess was extremely terrifying at this moment.
Right now, he already had one foot in the True Self Tier, but he hadn’t completely crossed over yet. It could be said that he was in the pseudo-True Self Tier.
However, in the cultivation world, there was no such thing as pseudo-True Self Tier, because one would either succeed in breaking through, or fail, and would not be stuck in the middle.
Who would fight with another when breaking through?
Moreover, this process would only last for a short while, so there was no need to deliberately name it.
Boom, his attack charged over, its might soaring to the heavens. Not only had his power surpassed 40 Heavens, but Regulations also glowed, creating ripples.
True Self Tier elites could channel Regulations, and this was a qualitative difference as compared to Core Formation Tier. It was also the key to crushing them.
Hehe, True Self Tier?
Ling Han went all out, exchanging blows with Baili Che.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Everyone was shocked, because Ling Han was not at a disadvantage at all.
This was too freakish, wasn’t it? Baili Che already had one foot in True Self Tier, and could use Regulations, but was still unable to suppress Ling Han.
However, Ling Han knew that he was truly going all out.
He weakened Baili Che’s battle prowess by three Heavens, and channelled the Imperial Technique, but still could only fight Baili Che to a tie, showing that the gap in major tier was really a gulf.
Most importantly, Baili Che hadn’t completed his breakthrough yet, and his battle prowess was still increasing. Going by this trend, he would eventually surpass Ling Han.
He could not allow him to break through successfully.
Ling Han thought internally. Otherwise, he would really be outmatched.
With a thought, boom, an Earth Dragon instantly shot out from the ground.

On the way up the mountain, Ling Han did not stay idle either, and figured out the ley lines of the entire Azure Wolf Planet, and Wolf Mountain was the place where a Great Emperor had attained Dao. Not only was it a ley lines mouth, it was also abundant with Earth Qi, endlessly flowing.
This Earth Dragon shot out, as long as thirty meters, using Earth Qi as its bones, divine chains of order as its tendons, and embedded with seals, exuding the aura unique to True Self Tier.
Everyone was speechless. Baili Che hadn’t completely advanced into the True Self Tier yet, but Ling Han had already used the means of the True Self Tier. Who exactly was breaking
through?
Peng!
The Earth Dragon’s attack instantly sent Baili Che flying with a muffled groan.
This Earth Dragon was truly True Self Tier-level. Yet, Baili Che still insisted on facing it head- on. Wasn’t this an idiot?
Baili Che finally managed to struggle free after crashing into the mountain wall again. 60% of his skin had already cracked open, and blood was gushing out. He looked extremely
miserable.
And what caused his expression to change even more drastically was the fact that his breakthrough actually came to a halt after suffering such a violent blow.
This!

His current state was very awesome, enough to sweep aside all other cultivators of the Core Formation Tier. However, he could be considered half a True Self Tier cultivator. Others would not think that he was the strongest cultivator of the Core Formation Tier in history. En, the weakest True Self Tier cultivator in history was more like it.

When others broke through, they would do so in an absolutely quiet environment. However, he believed that, as an Imperial Son, and with the help of the Imperial Blood, breaking through to the True Self Tier would be as easy as the turn of a palm for him. He had never imagined that Ling Han would actually mobilize the Earth Dragon which was in True Self Tier, severely wounding him with a single strike. In fact, it had even interrupted his breakthrough.

This could be considered as going mad. At first glance, he didn’t seem to have suffered any backlash, but it was very likely that he would never be able to break through to the True Self Tier in this lifetime.
As the Imperial Son, he had at least 70% chance of becoming a Saint in the future, yet he was actually stuck at the pseudo-True Self Tier?
What a colossal joke.
Ling Han, meanwhile, was not reserved at all. With a point of his finger, another Earth Dragon appeared, and shot towards Baili Che. Meanwhile, he himself also shot out, blasting him with
the God Slaying Technique.

The disadvantage of the Earth Dragon was its lack of agility. It only had the might of the True Self Tier, and as long as one was careful enough to dodge it, even those at Core Formation Tier could dodge. However, with the addition of Ling Han, it was a completely different story. He bombarded Baili Che with attacks, sealing off the latter’s path of escape. He could only
face the Earth Dragon head-on.
How could Baili Che endure this?
Moreover, the more miserable he was now, the more likely it was that he would be eternally sealed at this level. There was really no possibility for him to advance any further.
“No!” Baili Che roared loudly. He only wanted to kill a lowly commoner, so why had he pushed himself into such a deep abyss?
Ling Han activated his eye technique and saw his condition clearly. He couldn’t help but sneer. This was truly reaping what he sowed. He couldn’t blame anyone else.
He was not the slightest bit soft-hearted, and continued to use the Earth Dragon to attack. He wanted to completely lock Baili Che’s condition, so that this guy would never be able to make
a comeback.
After a dozen over moves, Baili Che was severely wounded, and he collapsed onto the ground.
The Imperial Blood had already been expended, and had shrunk back to the size of a normal human. Meanwhile, his aura was lingering between the True Self Tier and the Core Formation
Tier, as if it had been frozen.
“It’s over, now Baili Che is really done for.”
“He may be nailed to this cultivation level for the rest of his life.”
“How pitiful. As the Imperial Son, he actually couldn’t even charge up to the True Self Tier.”
“Haha, does this count as the weakest Imperial Son in history?”
Some people shook their heads and sighed with emotion, while others made sarcastic remarks. The Imperial Clans were not on good terms with each other either. Some were even
great enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 4156: Boiling Moon Pill
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
An Imperial Son was actually crippled just like that?

This would definitely cause the Ziwei Clan to fly into a thunderous rage. Even if Baili Che wasn’t the strongest Imperial Son of their clan, and even if there was the Golden Generation, he was still beat to burst by his opponent even with the advantage of half a major tier. This would turn the Ziwei Clan into a laughing stock, a stain that would never be erased.
Most importantly, the Ziwei Imperial Clan was still unable to make things difficult for Ling Han.

This was a fair battle in full public, and it was even broadcast live to the Galaxy Network. Moreover, strictly speaking, Baili Che had the advantage of half a major tier, yet he was still crippled. Who could he blame?
If the Ziwei Imperial Clan used this to suppress Ling Han, they would become even more of a joke.

Everyone sighed in emotion. Looks like the Ziwei Clan would have to suffer this loss in silence. Even if they wanted to seek Ling Han out for revenge, they could only use a fair method. For example, after Ling Han advanced into the True Self Tier, they would then send out the corresponding elites to kill him.
The Imperial Clan was high and noble, and could do as they liked, but at the same time, they were also bound by this reputation, and had to protect the pride of the Imperial Clan at all times.
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked them to encounter Ling Han?
This freak was chillingly strong!
Everyone thought. Even if one from the Golden Generation made a move, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, would they still be a match for Ling Han?

Now, martial arts was about to usher in a grand and expansive age. The opening of the True Dragon Abyss had indeed proven that the heaven and earth was already prepared to welcome a new Emperor, and Ling Han had chosen to display freakish strength at this time. Did this mean that he was the strongest competitor for the throne?

Everyone was scheming in their minds. Becoming Emperor was too tempting. This could be considered the ultimate goal that prodigies worked hard for. Now that they had just started, there was already a freak that was had practically locked the position on the throne. Who would be able to feel mentally balanced?
‘Die!’
Killing this freak in the budding stage would mean that there would be one less powerful competitor on the Imperial Path.

Of course, none of the Imperial Clan members made a move, because they knew that they were no match for Ling Han. In fact, even if they immediately broke through to the True Self Tier, they wouldn’t be able to. Ling Han was also a Formations Grandmaster that could extract Earth Qi to face the enemy, and could completely be seen as a True Self Tier elite.
Hence, they could not be rash now.
Ling Han swept an eye over everyone, and asked with a smile, “Anyone else wants to challenge me?”
No one answered. So what if they were from Imperial Clans? In front of absolute strength, they could only bow their heads.
“Then, let’s go.” Ling Han smiled, and grabbed the little azure dragon and the large black dog. With a thought, he had already used the ley lines to teleport away.
At this time, the Imperial Clan members finally breathed a sigh of relief, their expressions all very solemn.
“This is a person who is very likely to ruin the situation!”
“At the level of the Core Formation Tier, he is already invincible.”
“We have to break through to the True Self Tier as soon as possible, or we would only be suppressed by him.”
“Let’s go. We’ll find a safe place to break through first.”

The Imperial Clan members all left one after another, and the spectators began to discuss excitedly on the Galaxy Network. As members of the spectating crowd, they naturally had the most right to speak, and enjoy the glory of being able to commentate on the battle on the Galaxy Network.

Ling Han used the ley lines to escape, and the Nine Mountains Venerate also immediately appeared. He directly tore open a spatial fissure, then brought Ling Han and the others back to the Nine Suns Planet.
He was increasingly satisfied with Ling Han’s performance. This disciple had swept aside all Imperial Sons, completely matching the invincible bearing of a future Ancestral King.
Instead, it was the little azure dragon that caused his eyes to light up. He had not thought that there was such a prodigy hidden by Ling Han’s side.
After returning to the Nine Suns Planet, the Nine Mountains Venerate asked Ling Han, “What’s the background of this Four-Legged Snake?”
The little azure dragon almost went crazy. ‘Are you guys done yet? He’s the True Dragon! True Dragon Armor! What dogf*cking Four-Legged Snake!’
“Woof, Four-legged Snake, are you secretly cursing Grandpa Dog?” the large black dog immediately said.
“How do you know?” the little azure dragon asked.
“You have an expression of constipation on your face, so you must be cursing. Then, when you glanced at Grandpa Dog, you must have cursed Grandpa Dog as well,” the large black dog said.

The little azure dragon was rendered speechless. Sure enough, this large black dog was even more despicable than him and his ability at discovering despicable characters was also terrifyingly powerful.

“He’s a primitive creature that I found in an ancient site. He calls himself a dragon,” Ling Han said with a smile. He didn’t tell the complete truth. It wasn’t that he didn’t believe the Nine Mountains Venerate, but the implications of this matter were far too great. Who knows, Lin Lang’s death might even be dug up.
Precisely because Ling Han now had a sense of belonging to the Nine Suns Holy Land, he didn’t want to drag the Nine Suns Holy Land into the enmity with the Imperial Clan.

Previously, it could only be considered a minor skirmish, but if the secret that he had killed the Imperial Son was leaked, then it was really possible that the Saint of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan would bring the Imperial Weapon over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4157: Song Youdao
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“What are you standing around for? Hurry up and go home!” Ling Han said with a smile.

Song Lan rolled her eyes at him. Why was this guy so unromantic? However, she was easily embarrassed, so she was too embarrassed to say anything. Immediately, she gave an “en”, and began packing her belongings, to return to the ancestral grounds.

Ling Han didn’t think much of it. He had only fulfilled a promise, which allowed him to keep his word, so as to avoid leaving an internal demon in his heart in the future. It was completely not because he had any ideas about Song Lan.
What depressed him was the fact that Prosperous Heaven would still come to “expiate” him every day, which made him extremely annoyed.
He simply began to cultivate in seclusion, concentrating on cultivating.
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
Ling Han had made great progress in the cultivation of Body Art and mystical power, advancing both of their raw power to 38 Heavens.
What kind of concept was this?

Merely by unleashing the might of either kind of power, he would be able to sweep aside all other cultivators of the Core Formation Tier, and if the two burst out together, his power would be able to burst out with the might of 43 Heavens.
Perhaps even if all the Great Emperors were revived, they would still be no match for Ling Han in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
“Little Han, Grandpa Dragon will teach you how to behave today!” The little azure dragon came again.

Ling Han walked out the door, and couldn’t help but smile. No wonder this guy had come again. As it turned out, his improvement was very fast, and in terms of mystical power, he had already reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
Did this guy think that he could suppress him?
“Four-Legged Snake, have you forgotten how I pummeled you time and time again?” Ling Han said with a smile.

“Pei, that was in the past!” The little azure dragon appeared to be brimming with confidence. “I was the first generation of Divine Beasts, and my cultivation level has advanced to a terrifying level. Now, I’ve already cultivated to the consummate level ofCore Formation Tier. My mystical power is soaring to 36 Heavens, and Body Art is my forte. Hehe, my power is as high as 37 Heavens, and if both explode at the same time, that would be the power of 41 Heavens.”
“Little Han, are you trembling yet? Just the burst of power alone is already the power of 41 Heavens, and if I use the celestial technique, this is definitely the power of 44 Heavens!”

This was indeed overwhelmingly awesome. It couldn’t be helped. In the Primordial Age, only the True Dragon had mastered the invincible Body Art, and now he had taught this Body Art to his descendant, so that he could cultivate it at the same time. His battle prowess naturally increased greatly, surpassing the generations of Ancestral Kings.

Of course, the higher one’s cultivation level, the smaller the weight of power in battle prowess would be. The advantage of Body Art would also become less obvious, but additionally cultivating Body Art would definitely be helpful. Otherwise, why had the True Dragon been the leader of the Divine Beasts in the past?
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “What an itch for a beating. You’re asking for a beating again.”
“Little Han, let’s battle in the sky.” The little azure dragon soared into the sky. He had been waiting for this day for a very, very long time.
Ling Han also rose into the air, clasping his hands behind his back, filled with confidence.
“Grandpa Dragon hates it when you show off,” the little azure dragon said in disgust.
“Haha, then I really enjoy this expression of displeasure and helplessness from you,” Ling Han said.

“Cut the crap and take this!” The little azure dragon charged over. He didn’t hold back at all, unleashing his full battle prowess as soon as he attacked. This was because he knew how powerful Ling Han was, so he didn’t need to worry about accidentally killing Ling Han or wounding him.
Ling Han also unleashed his power, exchanging blows with the little azure dragon.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
In just a few moves, the little azure dragon let out a loud cry.
“How is this possible?!” he exclaimed in astonishment. “Your power is actually even more powerful than Grandpa Dragon’s? This doesn’t make any sense!”

He was already at the explosive power of 41 Heavens, and even the Ancestral Kings of the past eras couldn’t compare to him. Now, however, someone was actually more powerful than him? How could he believe this?
“Four-Legged Snake, do you know who’s boss now?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Grandpa Dragon refuses to yield!” the little azure dragon said with its head held high.

The two of them battled again, but he was overwhelmed in power, and the celestial technique didn’t give him an advantage either. The little azure dragon was naturally at a disadvantage, and was thrashed by Ling Han.
The battle ended, and the little azure dragon’s face was bruised and battered. His face was filled with defiance, and he asked, “Why is your power superior to mine?”
“Because I’m more outstanding than you!” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Get lost!” The little azure dragon was deeply impacted. He was a first generation, and a descendant of the Ancestral King with the purest bloodline, had actually lost to a mortal.
“Ling Han! Ling Han! Ling Han!”
Right at this moment, a shout came from below. It seemed to be quite urgent.
‘Hmm?’

Ling Han’s figure moved, and he had already landed on the ground. There was a man standing at his door, and he looked quite young. He was filled with heroic spirit, and had a handsome appearance. Furthermore, judging by the aura he exuded, this guy was in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
“What’s the matter?” Ling Han asked.
“So you’re Ling Han?” the young man asked. He glanced at Ling Han and nodded, as if he knew Ling Han. “That’s right, you’re Ling Han.”
“Who are you?” the little azure dragon asked. He still hadn’t walked out of the shadow of failure, and his expression was filled with displeasure.
When he first saw a four-legged snake with a bruised and battered face, the man was shocked. He actually took a step back and put on a defensive stance.
This infuriated the little azure dragon, and it said to Ling Han, “It’s all your fault! You slapped Grandpa Dragon’s handsome face until it became swollen!”
“Aren’t you the one who asked for it?” Ling Han shrugged.
“Ling Han, hurry up and return with me!” The young man faltered for a moment before immediately saying to Ling Han, “It’ll be too late if you delay any longer.”
“What for, trying to snatch the bride?!” The little azure dragon didn’t have any sense of propriety when it spoke, and it would say whatever it liked.
Ling Han slapped the little azure dragon, and said to the young man, “Who exactly are you?”
Do I know you very well? From the very beginning, you are demanding that I go with you.
“Oh, my name is Song Youdao, and I’m Song Lan’s older brother.” Realization dawned on the young man, and he hurriedly introduced himself.
“Yi, your brother-in-law?” The little azure dragon looked towards Ling Han.
“Scram!” Ling Han kicked the four-legged snake aside, then said to Song Youdao, “What is it? Has Song Lan gotten into trouble?”
“En, en, en. Ling Han, hurry up and return to the clan with me. Otherwise, my sister will be marrying Mao Yuntian,” Song Youdao said.
What was going on here?
Ling Han was astonished. What did Song Lan’s marriage have to do with him?
“Don’t be anxious. Tell me clearly from beginning to end.” He waved his hand, confused by what he had just heard.
Song Youdao gathered his thoughts, and only then did he begin to speak.

As it turned out, Song Lan had returned home to deliver medicine, and very quickly, this allowed her great-grandfather, Song Qing, to recover. Initially, this was a good thing. After it was over, Song Lan should also return to the Nine Suns Holy Land to continue cultivation.

However, in the Song Clan’s galaxy, aside from them, there was another powerful clan, and that was the Mao Clan. They were also a Venerate Tier-level force that had been eyeing the Song Clan covetously all this while, wanting to swallow them up.
Song Qing had gone mad, and this gave the Mao Clan a great opportunity. They kept exerting pressure on them, forcing the Song Clan to compromise.

In the end, in order to buy more time, the Song Clan agreed to form an alliance through marriage with the Mao Clan, and the partner of this alliance was naturally the most outstanding descendant of the Song Clan, as well as the ninth greatest beauty under the galaxy, Song Lan.
This time, after Song Qing recovered, the Mao Clan further pressured them, demanding that Song Lan fulfill the betrothal contract.
