chapters.title: Chapter 4158: Snatching the bride
paragraphs: Ling Han found this strange, and said, “Since your great-grandfather has already recovered, you can naturally forcefully cancel this betrothal.”
“Sigh, brother-in-law, you don’t know!” Song Youdao patted Ling Han’s shoulder, shook his head and sighed.
Ling Han rolled his eyes. ‘Aren’t you talking too much on your own? What brother-in-law?!’

“My great-grandfather is a three-star Venerate Tier elite, while that person from the Mao Clan is a five-star Venerate Tier elite. The gap in strength is quite large,” Song Youdao explained. “In order to oppose the Mao Clan, my great-grandfather took the risk of breaking through to the four stars. I never thought that not only did he not succeed, he would even go mad.”

“But after this event, great-grandfather has also become... cowardly. He would rather send my sister away for the marriage than attempt to break through to Four-Star Venerate Tier.” Ling Han sighed. Cultivators should be fearless and attempt to break through to the peak of martial arts, but not everyone’s willpower was as strong as iron. After experiencing a dark setback, they would lose all motivation to improve, and only want to live a peaceful life. Their temperament would undergo a drastic change.

Song Lan’s great-grandfather was a typical example. Originally, he had not hesitated to take the risk of breaking through to Four-Star Venerate Tier for the sake of his clan, but after he had gone mad, and wandered in the darkness for too long, all his fighting spirit had been destroyed. Even if he recovered, he would no longer dare to become enemies with the Mao Clan, and would rather become a coward.

“Then what’s the point of looking for me?” Ling Han asked. He was only a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator, and if he encountered a True Self Tier cultivator, he would be done for. How could it be that he would be the one to snatch the bride?
“To snatch the bride!” Song Youdao said matter-of-factly.
Ling Han was speechless. Are you retarded or mentally crippled? If he went to snatch the bride, wouldn’t he be beaten to death?

“You are the disciple of Nine Suns Holy Land. Everyone knows that you are extremely favoured by Nine Mountains Venerate, and it is possible that you would be taken as a personal disciple.” Song Youdao continued, “Furthermore, there is also an opinion in our clan that thinks that we should resolutely fight with the Mao Clan, and cannot be swallowed up by them!”
“So, if you try to snatch the bride, your journey will be smooth and unhindered. You only have to bring my sister back to the Holy Land, and the Mao Clan would not dare to come and take her away.”
Er, there doesn’t seem to be much of a problem with your plan, but more importantly, why are you looking for me?
I have nothing to do with your Song Clan, and Song Lan and Ling Han are only ordinary fellow disciples.
“Er, can’t you guys send someone to deliver Song Lan over?” Ling Han asked.
“If that’s the case, then wouldn’t that be clearly making an enemy of the Mao Clan?” Song Youdao countered.
“Then should I be the scapegoat?” Ling Han countered.
“Yi, aren’t you my brother-in-law? If you don’t bear it, who will?” Song Youdao countered. F***, who is your brother-in-law?
“Can I clarify that my relationship with Song Lan is purely that of a Senior Brother and a Junior Sister?” Ling Han sighed.

Song Youdao chuckled, and said, “If it were just an ordinary Senior Brother and Junior Sister relationship, would you give Song Lan three Boiling Moon Pills? Those are Venerate Tier- level alchemical pills, and if they were sold on the Galaxy Network, they would be priceless. In fact, they could even be traded for a Venerate Tier-level precious technique!”
‘F*ck! Can’t I even be a good person?!’
Moreover, Venerate Tier-level techniques were completely beneath his notice now.
F***, it was only to prevent internal demons from appearing in the future, so how could the situation develop to this extent?

Ling Han sighed. Since he knew about this, and chose to sit by and do nothing, he would still leave behind the seed of the internal demon in his heart in future, because the cause of this matter was him, and no matter what, he could not clearly remove himself from the matter.
Sigh, how depressing.
“Alright, I’ll go with you to snatch her away,” Ling Han said. When he snatched her back, whether Song Lan would be captured by the Mao Clan in the future would have nothing to do with him.
“Snatch the bride!” Song Youdao corrected.
Snatch the bride your sister!
Ling Han cursed internally, but when he thought about it, it really was snatching his sister. There was nothing wrong about these words at all.
He became even more depressed.

How could something as lively as snatching a bride be missed out on the little azure dragon? He immediately sent a message to the large black dog-something like a connection device was naturally obtained at the first instant. Hence, these two sl*ts were in high spirits, determined to go with Ling Han.
Fine then, let’s go together.
They boarded the Transfer Formation and headed toward the Neighbouring Planet, where the Song Clan was located.
This naturally wasn’t as fast as a Venerate Tier elite tearing a rip into space. After spending more than a month, they finally arrived at the Neighbouring Planet.

The Song Clan was the ruler of Neighbouring Planet. Not only was Neighbouring Planet their private property, a considerable number of planets in the surrounding area were the same. Together with the Mao Clan, they divided up all the planets where there was life.
With Song Youdao leading the way, they were naturally unimpeded. In a short while, they had entered into the ancestral grounds of the Song Clan.

This was in the mountains, where the great formation was used to gather the power of heaven and earth, turning it into a paradise on earth. Green mountains and clear waters, flocks of white cranes, and in the various small lakes, there were ancient green carps swimming in the water. Multiple waterfalls hung in the air, and Regulations flashed.
As expected of a Venerate Tier force. Though it could not compare to the Nine Suns Holy Land, it could still be considered a treasured land for cultivation.
“Ninth Master, what took you so long?” A middle-aged man dressed as a servant approached.
“What is it?” Song Youdao asked.
“Third Young Miss is getting married today!” the middle-aged man said.
“Ah?” Song Youdao was shocked, “How could it be so soon? The wedding has been brought
forward?”
“It’s always been like this day,” the middle-aged servant replied.
“F*ck! I miscalculated the day!” Song Youdao wailed as he grabbed his head.
Ling Han and the others were all speechless. This brother was really too unreliable. He was practically screwing his sister over.

“What are we going to do now?” Song Youdao murmured. At first, he had planned to kidnap her soundlessly and flee, announcing to the public that it was Ling Han’s doing. In any case, Ling Han was in the Nine Suns Holy Land. If the Mao Clan had the ability, then go and take her
back.
However, it was already the day of the wedding, so how was Ling Han going to snatch her away?
How could the elites of the Mao Clan not come over?

To say nothing of others, just look at Mao Yuntian. He himself was a True Self Tier elite, and could suppress Ling Han with a single hand. What was the point of snatching the bride? That was simply seeking death.
Meanwhile, Ling Han cracked a smile, “Come, let’s go and attend the wedding.”
The little azure dragon and the large black dog wanted nothing more than for the whole world
to be in chaos, so they were naturally unafraid. They all jeered, wanting to go and make trouble for the wedding night.
Ling Han grabbed Song Youdao and questioned him about the details of the wedding.

Because the two great clans were separated by several planets, and were relatively far from each other, they would first hold a ceremony at the Song Clan Residence today, and enter into the bridal chamber once. Tomorrow, when they married and returned to the Mao Clan, they would hold another ceremony, and then enter into the bridal chamber again.
“Where is the bridal chamber?” Ling Han asked Song Youdao. “Hiss, you really want to cause trouble?” Song Youdao inhaled sharply.
“Didn’t you call me over to cause trouble?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“All right, we’ll do it!” Song Youdao slapped his thigh, and finally made up his mind.
They directly went to their bridal chamber. Song Youdao wanted to avoid suspicion, so he left quietly, leaving Ling Han and the others hiding in their rooms.
“I have never made trouble in the bridal chamber. It feels so exciting,” the little azure
dragon said.
“Tsk, how ignorant,” the large black dog said in disdain. “Then take a good look, and you’ll
have experience in the future.”
“Alright.” The little azure dragon nodded.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. By the looks of it, these two characters had become
addicted to screwing others over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4159: Me too
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After waiting for a while, a creak was heard, and the doors were pushed open. Three people entered.

One of them was Song Lan. She wore a floral crown on her head, a red veil covering her face, and was dressed in a bright red wedding robe. However, it was clear that her body was restrained. She was supported by two women on either side of her, and they walked all the way to the bed, then sat down.

“Song Lan, don’t be ungrateful,” a woman said. “You have to know that you are marrying Mao Family’s prodigy, Mao Yuntian. He has already advanced into True Self Tier when he is only over a hundred years old, and may have hopes of becoming a Venerate in future! If it was not for the fact that you are the ninth beauty of the galaxy, this kind of good thing would not have fallen into your hands!”

“That’s right, cousin. Mao Yuntian is a talented man, and his natural talent in cultivation is even more astonishing. He’s a wonderful husband that can’t be found easily. If you don’t want him, others would scramble over each other to obtain him,” another woman said. One played the good cop, while the other played the bad cop.
Song Lan remained silent as she struggled to get up. However, her cultivation level had been sealed, so her resistance was completely ineffective.
The two women were persuading her again. One was saying harsh words, while the other was saying good words, using both carrot and stick.
After another while, peng, the doors were pushed open, and a man walked in. He looked to be close to thirty years old, but was handsome, and had a powerful aura.
“Young Master Tian!” The two women hurriedly stood up and greeted this man respectfully.
This man was Mao Yuntian, the groom today. He was already drunk, and his steps were a little unsteady.

“Young Master Tian, we won’t disturb you guys anymore,” the two women said with a smile. They walked out the door, but one of the women said when she was closing the door, “However, if Young Master Tian is willing, we can also stay and join in on the excitement.”
Mao Yuntian’s eyes involuntarily lit up, and it was clear that he was tempted. However, after sweeping an eye over Song Lan, who was sitting on the bed, he waved his hand and said, “Get out!”

It was all right. There would be plenty of chances in future. Today, he was going to taste this delicate flower. That was the ninth beauty of the galaxy, and even the Imperial Son would be moved upon seeing her. He naturally had to taste her well, and slowly.
The two women were a little defiant, but they did not dare to be impudent, and closed the doors behind them.
“Lan Lan, it’s finally just the two of us left!” Mao Yuntian said, his voice trembling slightly.
She was the ninth beauty under the galaxy, and she was exceedingly beautiful. He had been thinking about her for a very, very long time, and today, he was finally going to get his wish.
“Ahem, sorry to interrupt,” Ling Han said. “There are more than two people here.”
What!
Mao Yuntian was given a fright. He had clearly used his divine sense to scan the surroundings, and there was only Song Lan here. Why had a voice suddenly appeared?
Meanwhile, Song Lan revealed an expression of surprise and disbelief. This was Ling Han, Ling Han!
“Who is it!” Mao Yuntian shouted.
“Don’t be excited. We’re on the same side,” Ling Han said with a smile. He removed the Void Beast hide and stepped forward.
“Grandpa Dog as well.” The large black dog also wormed out.
“And Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon was the last to arrive.
‘Holy f*ck!’

The corner of Mao Yuntian’s mouth twitched. If there was only Ling Han here, he could still accept it, but there was actually a dog and a four-legged snake. He had not sensed them at all. This was really a slap to his face.
“You’ve already caused trouble in the bridal chamber. You guys can leave now,” he said in a dark voice. He thought that Ling Han and the others were from the Song Clan.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What’s the point of just causing trouble like this?”

“What else do you guys want?” Mao Yuntian asked helplessly. Though the Mao Clan’s strength was superior to the Song Clan, the Song Clan still had a Venerate Tier elite, after all. Moreover, he was still in their territory, so he naturally had to restrain himself.
“Snatching the bride!” Ling Han said.
Mao Yuntian faltered upon hearing this. ‘I’m getting married today, yet you’re trying to steal my bride? Aren’t you trying to undermine me?’

“I’ve never seen you before... what’s your name?” His expression suddenly darkened. With his memory, it was only natural that he would not forget anything that he had seen. Ling Han’s appearance was very unfamiliar. He had never seen him among the clansmen of the Song Clan before. Moreover, he was in the Core Formation Tier, and his cultivation level was already quite high.
“Little Han, you’re only so-so. See, he doesn’t recognize you at all!” The little azure dragon took advantage of the opening to attack Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m your uncle!”
He was replying to both Mao Yuntian and the little azure dragon at the same time.
Mao Yuntian flew into a thunderous rage. He didn’t care whether Ling Han was a member of the Song Clan or not. Since Ling Han dared to insult him, there was no need for him to be polite either.
“Humph, I shall take you down!” He moved, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Just how powerful was a True Self Tier elite?

That was an existence that could see through the heaven and earth’s Regulations. He stretched out a palm, and divine chains of order entwined around it, flickering with multiple dazzling seals. Even an Imperial Son of the Core Formation Tier would not be able to withstand a single blow from such an attack.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on. He raised his right hand, and hong, an Earth Dragon immediately shot out, greeting the large hand.
Peng!

With a loud bang, the Earth Dragon greeted the large hand, and was immediately shattered. However, the second Earth Dragon had already formed, and with another block, the large hand was finally stopped. It shattered into pure energy, and returned to the heaven and earth.
Ling Han waved his hand again, and the third and fourth Earth Dragons appeared at the same time, blasting towards Mao Yuntian.
Mao Yuntian humphed coldly, and began his counterattack.

He was not someone who had just broken through to the True Self Tier. His battle prowess was much stronger than Baili Che, who was at pseudo True Self Tier. In a few moves, he had dealt with the two Earth Dragons, and once again charged towards Ling Han.
But Ling Han’s limit was controlling sixteen Earth Dragons, so what did he have to fear?
Peng, peng, peng! Mao Yuntian and the Earth Dragons clashed, and he was unable to do anything to Ling Han at all.
However, the commotion caused by this battle was too great, and naturally alerted the Song Clan.
“Who are you? How dare you come to our Song Clan to commit violence!” A cold humph rang out, and an elite of Sect Master level appeared. He stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
This was Sect Master level; this gap was really too wide.

Without another word, Ling Han picked up the large black dog and little azure dragon with one hand, and Song Lan with the other. Communicating with the ley lines, xiu, the four of them disappeared, as if they had never existed.
The Sect Master’s palm missed its target, and he couldn’t help but look surprised. Four Core Formation Tiers had actually managed to slip away right under his nose; this was too inconceivable.
“Star Steps!”
“That’s a Formations Grandmaster!”
“What, such a young Formations Grandmaster?”
“I know who he is.”
“Ling Han!”
“That’s right, it must be him. Only this guy is already a Formations Grandmaster at such a young age.”

The members of the Song Clan analyzed the situation carefully, and very soon, they had reconstructed the truth of the matter. Furthermore, Ling Han’s appearance was no secret on the Galaxy Network. They would find out immediately after investigating.
“Quick, immediately seal off the Transfer Formation. Don’t let them escape!”
“Search the entire Neighbouring Planet, and we must find him. Otherwise, what face would our Song Clan have!”
Multiple commands were issued, and the entire Neighbouring Planet was mobilized. This was the backyard of the Song Clan, so how could others be allowed to cause trouble?
The one with the worst expression was naturally Mao Yuntian.
On the wedding night, the most beautiful moment of his life, his wife was snatched from him, right in front of his eyes, and it was done by a Core Formation Tier cultivator at that!
He was furious. He wanted to kill someone.

His battle prowess was much stronger than Baili Che, who was at pseudo True Self Tier.
In a few moves, he had dealt with the two Earth Dragons, and once again charged towards Ling Han.
But Ling Han’s limit was controlling sixteen Earth Dragons, so what did he have to fear?
Peng, peng, peng!
Mao Yuntian and the Earth Dragons clashed, and he was unable to do anything to Ling Han at all.
However, the commotion caused by this battle was too great, and naturally alerted the Song Clan.
“Who are you?
How dare you come to our Song Clan to commit violence!” A cold humph rang out, and an elite of Sect Master level appeared.
He stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
This was Sect Master level; this gap was really too wide.
Without another word, Ling Han picked up the large black dog and little azure dragon with one hand, and Song Lan with the other.
Communicating with the ley lines, xiu, the four of them disappeared, as if they had never existed.
The Sect Master’s palm missed its target, and he couldn’t help but look surprised.
Four Core Formation Tiers had actually managed to slip away right under his nose; this was too inconceivable.
“Star Steps!”
“That’s a Formations Grandmaster!”
“What, such a young Formations Grandmaster?”
“I know who he is.”
“Ling Han!”
“That’s right, it must be him.
Only this guy is already a Formations Grandmaster at such a young age.”
The members of the Song Clan analyzed the situation carefully, and very soon, they had reconstructed the truth of the matter.
Furthermore, Ling Han’s appearance was no secret on the Galaxy Network.
They would find out immediately after investigating.
“Quick, immediately seal off the Transfer Formation.
Don’t let them escape!”
“Search the entire Neighbouring Planet, and we must find him.
Otherwise, what face would our Song Clan have!”
Multiple commands were issued, and the entire Neighbouring Planet was mobilized.
This was the backyard of the Song Clan, so how could others be allowed to cause trouble?
The one with the worst expression was naturally Mao Yuntian.
On the wedding night, the most beautiful moment of his life, his wife was snatched from him, right in front of his eyes, and it was done by a Core Formation Tier cultivator at that!
He was furious.
He wanted to kill someone.

chapters.title: Chapter 4160: Hidden ley lines
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han wrapped Earth Qi around the large black dog and the others as they teleported. With a flash, they appeared in a certain location.
“Ling Han!” Song Lan called out in pleasant surprise.
“Now is not the time to chat. Let’s hurry to where the Transfer Formation is located,” Ling Han said.
“That’s right. Being lovey-dovey and whatnot can wait until after we return to the Nine Suns Holy Land,” the little azure dragon said despicably.
“If you don’t speak, no one will think you’re dead!” Ling Han shot out a kick.
They rushed to the Transfer Formation. Because that place wasn’t the exit of the ley lines, they could only teleport to the nearby area before running over.
However, when they arrived, they discovered that this place was already heavily guarded.
“Sigh, looks like this path won’t work.” Ling Han withdrew his gaze.

“I’m really sorry for dragging you into this,” Song Lan said apologetically. However, the man she liked had come from far away, and he had even saved her from the hands of a powerful opponent. Naturally, she was so touched that stars were shining in her eyes.
“There’s Grandpa Dog as well,” the large black dog said, ruining the mood.
“And Grandpa Dragon.” The little azure dragon wasn’t willing to be ignored either.
Song Lan could only thank these two guys again, her pretty face flushed red with embarrassment.
“Little Han, what do we do now?” the large black dog asked. “Should we ask Grandpa Nine Mountains to come and save us?”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Does such a small matter have to alert the old man?”

“Then what do we do?” The little azure dragon also approached. “Although Grandpa Dragon’s natural talent is peerless, and I am invincible among my peers, I am at a disadvantage because I have just been born, after all. My cultivation level is limited.”
“What do we do? We’ll just take things as they come,” Ling Han said with a smile. “I’ve already informed Tang Yun’er to come and pick us up.”
This little girl was also someone who wouldn’t grow up. Even now, she was still passionate about ramming around on the shuttle, and wasn’t afraid of causing big trouble.
“Little Han, we also have to get a shuttle,” the large black dog said. “Otherwise, once the others seal off the Transfer Formation, we won’t be able to do anything.”

“That is indeed one matter.” Ling Han nodded. Without reaching the level of Sect Master, there was no way to tear a rip into space. Thus, for a journey that surpassed the level of galaxies, one would definitely need to use shuttles or Transfer Formations, “However, these warships are all controlled by powerful forces, and would not be sold at all. If one wants to get one, the difficulty level would be extremely high.”
“Unfortunately, the warship is not among the items that the Nine Suns Holy Land offers for redemption.” The large black dog shook his head and sighed.
Ling Han smiled and said, “There’s another method. As long as my formation abilities improve further, I can completely construct Transfer Formations that span galaxies.”

The large black dog and little azure dragon were both overjoyed, but after only a while, the large black dog poured cold water on them, “Even if you can construct Transfer Formations that cross galaxies, you can only set up one here. What about the Transfer Formation on the other end? How are you going to set it up on another planet?”
This was a problem.
Ling Han smiled and said, “As long as my formation abilities reach a certain standard, I’ll be able to replicate the formations here. At that time, I’ll naturally be able to leave.”
This was awesome.
“Little Han, are you really confident?” the large black dog asked.
“50%,” Ling Han replied casually. In reality, he hadn’t started studying this area of formations yet, and this was completely based on his strong self-confidence.

“Then let’s make two preparations. While waiting for Tang Yun’er to come over, we can also study formations.” The large black dog nodded. Actually, he was more expectant of the former, because this was more objective and realistic, and just by looking at Transfer Formation from afar, you can replicate it?
You can’t be that amazing, right?

Thus, they rented a courtyard in the bustling city. This was a place hidden in the city, and the Song Clan probably wouldn’t have imagined that they would be so bold. They actually didn’t flee into the mountains and forests, but hid here instead.

Ling Han studied formations techniques every day. He had already become a Formations Grandmaster for several years, but it had always been limited to Star Steps and Earth Dragons, two abilities that could be directly used in battle. Now, he began to study them systematically.
Meanwhile, the princess of the Song Clan had been kidnapped on her wedding night. This news quickly spread throughout the universe, causing heated discussions.

The reason why it was so popular was naturally because Song Lan was the ninth beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard, and the other was the “tyrant” who had snatched the bride. That was Ling Han, an extremely well-known guy. He had even crippled one of the Imperial Son, and held the well-deserved title of Imperial Son Killer.
“Haha, this Mao Yuntian is really a toad that wants to eat swan meat1! A mere Venerate Tier-level force is worthy of marrying Fairy Song?”

“Though I am also displeased with Ling Han, if I have to choose one, I would rather Fairy Song marry Ling Han, and if she marries Mao Yuntian, that would be completely like a flower stuck in cow dung.1”
“However, now that the Song Clan and Mao Clan have sealed off Neighbouring Planet, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to escape no matter how capable he is, right?”
“Though neither the Song Clan nor the Mao Clan dare to kill this disciple of the Nine Suns Holy Land, if he wants to take the beauty with him, he’s probably dreaming.”
Most people on the Galaxy Network were not optimistic about Ling Han, and thought that he was going to suffer a great loss this time — unless an elite from the Nine Suns Holy Land intervened.
However, the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t make a sound, as if it didn’t want to interfere.
True, it was a romantic affair, and it was something as unpleasant as snatching a bride at that. The Holy Land would definitely not be willing to interfere. That would be too embarrassing.

Day after day passed, yet the Mao Clan and Song Clan still hadn’t managed to find Ling Han. Meanwhile, Ling Han was steadily advancing on the path of formations, making astonishing progress every day.
He could be considered a formations prodigy, and now that his soul was strong enough, capable of matching a Spiritual Transformation Tier, his improvement was naturally fast.
“Little Han, it’s time to run.” The large black dog ran over.

In this period of time, they had already moved three times. Even if they were hidden in the bustling city, it was still inevitable that they would be searched by the Song Clan and Mao Clan. After all, the Song Clan was the ruler of this planet, and could do as they liked.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. With a single thought, he instantly teleported to another location on Neighbouring Planet.
“Yi?” Ling Han faltered slightly.
“What’s wrong? Are there pursuers?” the large black dog hurriedly asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “They’re not pursuers. I actually discovered a new ley line here.”

“What’s so strange about that? On a planet, there are tens of ley lines, and at most, there are hundreds to thousands. It’s normal for you to have missed something,” the large black dog immediately said.
Ling Han thought back for a moment, and said with absolute certainty, “That’s not right. I didn’t miss this, but it’s too well-hidden. It can’t be discovered anywhere else.”
“So what? Hurry up and study the Transfer Formation,” the little azure dragon jumped out and said.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I need to go and investigate.”
He paused, then continued, “You guys wait for me here.”
Xiu, with a flash, he had already disappeared.
“Sigh, what a stubborn guy.” The little azure dragon spread its claws helplessly.

Meanwhile, Song Lan revealed a love-struck expression. In her eyes, this was called having a personality. He would stick to the direction that he had decided on, and would not be affected by any factor.

chapters.title: Chapter 4161: Triangle!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s figure moved quickly. He traversed through the ley lines, and in a short while, he had arrived at the location of the hidden ley lines.
Yi?

Ling Han was surprised. Previously, he had only felt that this ley line was hidden, but when he came closer to take a look, he discovered that this ley line had actually suffered a massive impact, and had suffered a serious injury. That was why it was so undetectable.
Curiousness rose up in him. He wanted to know how this ley line had been severely injured, so he travelled along this ley line.
However, this ley line was heavily damaged, like a dead blood vessel. It was filled with congested blood, and it was extremely difficult to travel.

Planets also had life. The ley lines were equivalent to blood vessels, and now that the ley line was injured, it was filled with the trash produced by the planet. They were all poisonous substances, and were greatly harmful to cultivators.
The logical course of action was naturally to retreat. If the ley line was damaged, so be it. What did it have to do with him?
However, Ling Han was extremely curious. He activated the Starlight Screen and continued to advance.
So what if it was slower? There would eventually be an end to it.

This path was really difficult to travel. Ling Han frowned. The ley line was filled with poisonous substances, and it was as if they had formed a swamp, making every step extremely difficult for him. There were a few times that he had the thought of retreating, but that was only an instant. With his firm willpower, how could he give up so easily after having made his decision?
Afte travelling for a whole day, Ling Han finally arrived at the end of the ley lines after having travelled for about 10,000 km.

In the outside world, with Ling Han’s current speed of over 100 times the speed of sound, this would only take a short while, but it was different here. It was too difficult to travel, and he actually spent a day and night.
Thankfully, he had finally reached the end.
Ling Han observed, and saw that the ley line was already at its end, but there was actually a small hole at the end.
This should have been pierced through by a small thing.
Ling Han couldn’t help but think, ‘Could it be that it was this thing that pierced through this ley line and caused it serious injury?’
He began to dig up dirt and rocks, and continued onwards through this hole.
30 meters, 300 meters, 3000 meters. Ling Han ventured deeper, but he discovered that this hole was still there. He still hadn’t reached the end.
Hiss, this power was a little fierce.

Ling Han was even more curious. At that time, who had thrown that thing and smashed it onto Neighbouring Planet? Not only had it pierced through a ley line, but he had actually not reached the end yet?
‘I refuse to believe this.’

Once Ling Han’s curiosity was piqued, even nine bulls wouldn’t be able to pull him back. He continued to advance, and with the boost of strong power, it wasn’t as easy as walking on flat land here, but it was not all that difficult either.
After walking for a few more hours, he was almost at the core of the planet. Finally, he found the “culprit” that had penetrated this hole.
This was... a piece of fur?
Ling Han’s heart suddenly thumped against his chest. Could it be that this was...!
He stretched out a hand, and picked up that piece of fur. Then, he unfolded it, and a familiar seal instantly came into view.
Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram!
The third part!
Ling Han faltered for a moment before bursting into laughter.
Who would have thought that he had only come to snatch the bride, and would actually be able to obtain a corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram?

If it was not for the fact that he did not want to leave behind any internal demons, and deliberately made a trip, he probably would not have come to Neighboring Planet in this lifetime, right? Furthermore, if it was not for the fact that he was too curious, and wanted to get to the bottom of this damaged ley line after discovering it, how could he have possibly obtained this Spirit Diagram?
One sip and one peck, could it be that the heavens had decided1?
Yi, could it be that this was the effect of the True Dragon of Fortune that he had obtained?
Really, the whole process could only be described as luck. A series of coincidences that had nothing to do with intelligence.
Whatever, the most important thing was the result.

Ling Han turned around. This time, he naturally wouldn’t take the original path. He would first head to the nearest ley line, then wrap himself in Earth Qi. Xiu, he instantly appeared beside the large black dog and the others.
“How is it? Did you discover anything?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han smiled, “A very big discovery.”
“What is it?” the large black dog asked.
“Confidential.”
“F*ck!” The large black dog and little azure dragon raised their middle fingers at the same time.
Ling Han didn’t mind. He didn’t immediately begin to study the newly obtained Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, but rather continued to study formations.
“Ling, you’re screwing me over!” Tang Yun’er’s voice rang out from the connection device.
“What did I do to you?” Ling Han asked, smiling.

“This planet is under martial law, and warships are only allowed to enter and not exit. Even if I enter, I can’t possibly take you guys away,” Tang Yun’er said. “Tell me, did you screw me over and make me come for nothing!”
Ling Han smiled and said, “Alright, alright, alright. I’ll treat you to some candy when we get back. How about it?”
“Che, do you think I’m a child!” Tang Yun’er said with a humph. However, she immediately said, “You also have to give me two Celestial medicines above three stars!”
“Why don’t you go just commit robbery while you are at it!”
“Heh, I’m here to rob you. What do you say?”
“Alright, I’ll have to trouble you this time. Two Celestial medicines, and that’s it,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“They have to be at least three stars,” Tang Yun’er emphasized.
Hiss, this little girl was really not easy to fool.
“Sure, at least three stars.” Ling Han nodded.

Only then was Tang Yun’er satisfied. She stood guard at the periphery of Neighbouring Planet, and if the situation became critical, she would rush over to save them and see if she could forcefully escape.
“How is it?” the large black dog approached and asked.
“The shuttle has entered, but we can’t leave. Thus, it’s up to us now,” Ling Han said.

The large black dog couldn’t help but feel gloomy. However, it wasn’t difficult to guess the idea of using a shuttle to escape. If they really entered the sky and was intercepted by the Mao Clan and Song Clan, then Ling Han wouldn’t be able to use the Star Steps and would really be trapped. At that time, aside from using the Heavenly Dao Flames contained inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, there would definitely be no other way.
And just like that, another month later, Ling Han was filled with confidence, and said, “Come, let’s go to where the Transfer Formation is.”

Ling Han used the Star Steps to bring the three “people” to the Transfer Formation. Of course, there was a long distance between them, and if they continued forward, they probably wouldn’t be able to hide from the elites stationed here — they were Sect Master-level elites, and could easily suppress the four of them in an instant.
However, at such a far distance, Ling Han couldn’t see anything even if he activated his eye technique.
It didn’t matter. He used the Void Beast hide to go, and observed from a closer location. However, he didn’t dare to take the risk of charging into the Transfer Formation.
The Sect Master was watching from the sidelines. He was completely capable of capturing Ling Han before the Transfer Formation activated.
Two days later, Ling Han felt that it was about time, and retreated.
He had long since bought the materials to build the Transfer Formation. Now, he only needed to carve formation patterns on it.
Come.
After a mere four days, Ling Han completed the formation foundations, because he didn’t need to use his brain. He only needed to copy it.
Of course, if he wasn’t a Formations Grandmaster, he wouldn’t even be qualified to copy them.
“Come, I’m going to activate the Transfer Formation,” Ling Han said. He threw a large amount of Dao Stones into the formation. This was the energy needed to activate the Transfer Formation.
The large black dog looked at Ling Han doubtfully, “Little Han, is this reliable?”
“That’s right. Grandpa Dragon is also worried that this won’t send us into some dangerous place!” The little azure dragon’s expression was also filled with doubt.

Whatever, the most important thing was the result.
Ling Han turned around.
This time, he naturally wouldn’t take the original path.
He would first head to the nearest ley line, then wrap himself in Earth Qi.
Xiu, he instantly appeared beside the large black dog and the others.
“How is it?
Did you discover anything?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han smiled, “A very big discovery.”
“What is it?” the large black dog asked.
“Confidential.”
“F*ck!” The large black dog and little azure dragon raised their middle fingers at the same time.
Ling Han didn’t mind.
He didn’t immediately begin to study the newly obtained Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, but rather continued to study formations.
“Ling, you’re screwing me over!” Tang Yun’er’s voice rang out from the connection device.
“What did I do to you?” Ling Han asked, smiling.
“This planet is under martial law, and warships are only allowed to enter and not exit.
Even if I enter, I can’t possibly take you guys away,” Tang Yun’er said.
“Tell me, did you screw me over and make me come for nothing!”
Ling Han smiled and said, “Alright, alright, alright.
I’ll treat you to some candy when we get back.
How about it?”
“Che, do you think I’m a child!” Tang Yun’er said with a humph.
However, she immediately said, “You also have to give me two Celestial medicines above three stars!”
“Why don’t you go just commit robbery while you are at it!”
“Heh, I’m here to rob you.
What do you say?”
“Alright, I’ll have to trouble you this time.
Two Celestial medicines, and that’s it,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“They have to be at least three stars,” Tang Yun’er emphasized.
Hiss, this little girl was really not easy to fool.
“Sure, at least three stars.” Ling Han nodded.
Only then was Tang Yun’er satisfied.
She stood guard at the periphery of Neighbouring Planet, and if the situation became critical, she would rush over to save them and see if she could forcefully escape.
“How is it?” the large black dog approached and asked.
“The shuttle has entered, but we can’t leave.
Thus, it’s up to us now,” Ling Han said.
The large black dog couldn’t help but feel gloomy.
However, it wasn’t difficult to guess the idea of using a shuttle to escape.
If they really entered the sky and was intercepted by the Mao Clan and Song Clan, then Ling Han wouldn’t be able to use the Star Steps and would really be trapped.
At that time, aside from using the Heavenly Dao Flames contained inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, there would definitely be no other way.
And just like that, another month later, Ling Han was filled with confidence, and said, “Come, let’s go to where the Transfer Formation is.”
Ling Han used the Star Steps to bring the three “people” to the Transfer Formation.

Of course, there was a long distance between them, and if they continued forward, they probably wouldn’t be able to hide from the elites stationed here — they were Sect Master-level elites, and could easily suppress the four of them in an instant.
However, at such a far distance, Ling Han couldn’t see anything even if he activated his eye technique.
It didn’t matter.
He used the Void Beast hide to go, and observed from a closer location.
However, he didn’t dare to take the risk of charging into the Transfer Formation.
The Sect Master was watching from the sidelines.
He was completely capable of capturing Ling Han before the Transfer Formation activated.
Two days later, Ling Han felt that it was about time, and retreated.
He had long since bought the materials to build the Transfer Formation.
Now, he only needed to carve formation patterns on it.
Come.
After a mere four days, Ling Han completed the formation foundations, because he didn’t need to use his brain.
He only needed to copy it.
Of course, if he wasn’t a Formations Grandmaster, he wouldn’t even be qualified to copy them.
“Come, I’m going to activate the Transfer Formation,” Ling Han said.
He threw a large amount of Dao Stones into the formation.
This was the energy needed to activate the Transfer Formation.
The large black dog looked at Ling Han doubtfully, “Little Han, is this reliable?”
“That’s right.
Grandpa Dragon is also worried that this won’t send us into some dangerous place!” The little azure dragon’s expression was also filled with doubt.

chapters.title: Chapter 4162: Caught up
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

“Cut the crap and get in!” Ling Han kicked the little azure dragon and the large black dog into the Transfer Formation one by one. Meanwhile, Song Lan had a kind of blind trust in him, and had long since walked in on her own.

Ling Han also entered the Transfer Formation himself. With a thought, a white light swept past, and the four of them instantly disappeared. The formation foundations of this Transfer Formation also exploded into pieces.
This was a one-time thing in the first place, and Ling Han had no plans to let the Song Clan and Mao Clan catch up to him, trapping him again.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu! The four of them had already appeared on another planet, not far from Neighbouring Planet.
However, they had ultimately exited Neighbouring Planet.
The four of them were all overjoyed, and hurriedly began another teleportation. This was still within the territory of the Song Clan and Mao Clan, so it could not be considered safe.
After a few more teleportations, they had already left this galaxy far behind, and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Ling Han informed Tang Yun’er that they could retreat, and it was inevitable that the little girl would grumble again. Then, after they rested for a while, they continued their journey.
Right until their bodies could no longer bear it, did they stop to rest. Meanwhile, Ling Han began to study the third triangle of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.

Theoretically speaking, even Saints wouldn’t be able to comprehend the true meaning of Destructive Energy, much less him. This was something that was transcendent above Nine Star Energy. However, Ling Han possessed millions and millions of dimensions inside his body, and they actually had a mysterious resonance with the Destructive Energy. This allowed him to easily cultivate this paramount energy.
It was just like how he knew it by nature, but it had been too long, and he had forgotten about it. He could only awaken his memories through the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy.
In a mere two days, he had completely mastered this corner of the Spirit Diagram. With a shake of his fists, Destructive Energy appeared, which was a total of three times larger than before.

With a thought from Ling Han, he focused all of the Destructive Energy on his right hand. Then, he threw a punch, and instantly, a pitch-black ball of light shot out. Peng, peng, peng! It surged past, and nothing was indestructible, easily blasting a hole into the mountain range ahead of him. Then, it continued to shoot up into the sky, right until its power was exhausted. Only then did it disintegrate and return to the heaven and earth.
Hiss, how terrifying.
Thankfully, he had not used it in the inn. Otherwise, who knew how many innocent people would be implicated.

Ling Han broke into a grin. After obtaining the third triangle of the Spirit Diagram, the Destructive Energy was finally strong enough, and could be used as a single-person attack. In the past, this could only adhere to mystical power, strengthening the destructive power of mystical power, but now, it was finally strong enough to be used as a single-person attack.
Pure Destructive Energy, just how shocking was its destructive power?
Ling Han believed that if his opponent didn’t dodge and instead took it head-on, then even the True Self Tier’s shield would be unable to withstand a single blow from Destructive Energy.
In other words, the True Self Tier cultivator could completely be killed by him.

“All right, I finally have another ability to oppose the True Self Tier, and I don’t have to depend on the environment of the heaven and earth.” Ling Han nodded. Although the Earth Dragon was strong, it was still limited by the environment. For example, in the True Dragon Abyss, he couldn’t mobilize the ley lines.
“If my cultivation level advances further, and I advance my Body Art and mystical power to the peak stage of the consummate level, will my power advance into the level of the True Self Tier?”
“Even if I can’t mobilize the Regulations of heaven and earth, the Destructive Energy is more than enough to compensate.”
“Haha, I’m really looking forward to it!”

Ling Han did not stay idle. He began to study the Heavenly Dao Flames in the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Previously, he had only extracted a rudimentary form, but as his cultivation level increased, the power of the Heavenly Dao Flames was somewhat unable to keep up. Thus, he wanted to try extracting another portion of the Regulations to strengthen the Heavenly Dao Flames.
This was a path that no one was guiding, so it was extremely difficult for Ling Han to walk it. His improvement was minimal.
A month later, they returned to Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Senior Brother Ling is mighty!”
“Senior Brother Ling is so domineering!”
When they found out that Ling Han had returned, a great many disciples ran out, pulling banners and raising great flags to warmly welcome him.

Tsk, to fly into a rage for the sake of a lover, snatching the bride and seizing the beauty, in the eyes of these young and hot-blooded people who looked down on rules, it was undoubtedly an extreme individual heroism, which had deeply struck their hearts.

Many people didn’t dare to. There were too many restrictions, and now that they saw another person walk out bravely and challenge authority, it naturally attracted their resonance and even worship. Moreover, Ling Han was freakishly freakish in the first place, so who wouldn’t revere him?

Meanwhile, Song Lan was incredibly embarrassed. The fact that she had been snatched away by Ling Han had already spread throughout the whole world. In future, it would be impossible for her not to marry Ling Han even if she did not want to.
However, not only did this not make her feel annoyed or angry, she was instead filled with anticipation.

Ling Han didn’t have any self-awareness at all. He had saved her so that he wouldn’t leave behind any internal demons. Now that he had brought her back to the Nine Suns Holy Land, he naturally left without a second thought.

It wasn’t long before the news of Ling Han bringing the beauty back spread throughout the Galaxy Network. The Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t issue a gag order. Moreover, they were the Holy Land, so did they need to be wary of a Venerate Tier-level force?

This caused the Mao Clan and the Song Clan to become the biggest joke. With a Venerate Tier elite standing guard, they actually allowed a few Core Formation Tier cultivators to escape. Wasn’t that embarrassing?
“Let me tell you guys, it’s actually not that the Venerate Tier from the Song Clan is incompetent, but that he deliberately let them go.”
“Why?”

“You don’t understand. The Song Clan and the Mao Clan are arch-enemies. The reason why Fairy Song and Trash Mao married was completely for the sake of alliance through marriage. Now that Song Lan has been snatched by Ling Han, if the Mao Clan can tolerate this, how would they be able to face others in future? If they can’t, then wouldn’t they be seeking their own demise by going against the Nine Suns Holy Land?”
“Oh, so that’s how it is! Hiss, then the Song Clan is really ruthless. This move is poisonous!”
“Hehe, let’s just watch the show.”
At some point in time, another conspiracy theory had popped up on the Galaxy Network, causing the precarious relationship between the Mao Clan and the Song Clan to become even worse.
“Ling Han, someone wants to challenge you.”
On this day, Ling Han was studying the Heavenly Dao Flames when a disciple ran over and delivered a piece of news to him.

Since Ling Han defeated the Imperial Son, there were actually quite a number of people who had come to challenge Ling Han. They were all here to become famous with a single battle, and as time passed, Ling Han naturally would not take it to heart.
“Who is it?” he asked casually.
“Mao Yuntian.” The disciple revealed a strange smile.
Was he here to catch the adulterer?

Ling Han gave an ‘oh’, but wasn’t surprised, because the news that he had brought Song Lan back to the Nine Suns Holy Land had already spread to the Galaxy Network. When the Mao Clan found out, they would definitely react. However, what Ling Han didn’t expect was that Mao Yuntian would come so quickly.
...From the moment he returned to the Nine Suns Planet, it had only been seven days.
En, it must have been a Venerate Tier from the Mao Clan that had moved, and brought Mao Yuntian with him. Otherwise, it could not have possibly been so fast.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then stood up, and said, “Since he is here, let’s meet.”
He was not the type to be afraid of trouble. Furthermore, this matter also needed to be resolved.
Ling Han walked out, and when the news spread out, instantly, a great many disciples rushed out, fighting to catch a glimpse of the excitement.
This so-called jealousy over a woman was the most fun.

chapters.title: Chapter 4163: I want to duel with you
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han walked outside the Nine Suns Holy Land, and saw that Mao Yuntian was indeed standing there. His face was livid, and his expression was extremely ugly.

If it was anyone else, they would feel as uncomfortable as if they had eaten a fly. F*ck, their newlywed wife had been snatched by a man. Several months had already passed. Had he gotten sick from playing around with her?
The moment he thought of this scene, Mao Yuntian felt an urge to commit murder.
This despicable guy was only in the Core Formation Tier, and he actually kidnapped her right in front of him. Just how humiliating was that?
“Ling Han, hurry up and hand her over!” When he saw Ling Han, Mao Yuntian’s already livid face turned even worse, as if there was a grassy plain above his head1.
Now that he had met his enemy, his eyes were bloodshot with envy. This damn adulterer!

Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You’re truly childish. If I wanted to hand her over, why would I have gone to snatch her in the first place? Moreover, Junior Sister Song has arms and legs, and she’s a free person. She has her own ideas about where she wants to go, so what are you asking me for?”
“Ling Han, you have the guts to snatch the bride, but don’t have the guts to admit it?” Mao Yuntian roared in fury.
Ling Han waved a hand dismissively, “Do I need you to judge whether I have guts or not?”

Hearing these words, the disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land all laughed loudly. That’s right, Ling Han had guts. Was there any need for Mao Yuntian to judge that? He had crippled an Imperial Son, and he still had no guts?
Mao Yuntian was shaking with anger, his hands tightly clenched into fists. He wore a baleful expression as he looked at Ling Han, and said, “Ling Han, I want to duel with you!”

“You’re a major tier higher than me, and you’re also 100 years older than me. How can you have the face to duel with me?” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. This was definitely an unjust battle. No one would agree to this.

“Humph, I indeed wouldn’t bully you like this, but you snatched my beloved wife and provoked me first, so you have to bear the consequences!” Mao Yuntian shouted loudly. “Ling Han, do you dare or not?”

Right at this moment, another voice rang out, and said, “Old brothers of the Nine Suns Holy Land, it was your brat who provoked the Mao Clan first. No matter what, you have to give an explanation for this matter!”
This voice boomed, carrying a frightening might.
A Venerate Tier elite!
Obviously, this was that ancestor of the Mao Clan. Not only had he brought Mao Yuntian over, he was also exerting pressure on Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, Mao Yuntian was right. It was indeed Ling Han who had provoked him first. He had snatched his wife, so what need was there to talk about a fair battle?
—You should have thought of this kind of consequences when you were snatching the bride.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “Fine, I’ll duel with you.”

He had grasped the Star Steps, and by nature, he was already invincible. Moreover, the Earth Dragon and Destructive Energy could pose a threat to True Self Tier elites. Thus, it wasn’t that he couldn’t fight back.
A cruel expression appeared on Mao Yuntian’s face. This time, he was going to crush Ling Han into dust and destroy him completely.
“Come battle!” He strode out.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, taking his time.
“This is the standard posture for showing off. Learn from it,” the large black dog said to the little azure dragon. This was called teaching on the spot.
The little azure dragon nodded repeatedly. Though he was awesome, he had just been born, after all. There was still too much he had to learn.

“Ling Han, I have to say, you are truly freakish.” Mao Yuntian began his opening remarks, “Even the Imperial Son has been crippled by you. You are practically heaven-defying! However, you are only a Core Formation Tier, after all. No matter how strong you are, you would not be able to match a single blow from me!”
“You seem to have forgotten that I did not just block a single blow from you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Heh, times change!” Mao Yuntian shook his head, and said, “Do you think I’m unprepared after learning that you’re a Formations Grandmaster?”
He waved his hand, and instantly, a jade bowl flew into the air. As it spun, it enlarged, and only stopped when it had reached 50km in size.
This jade bowl was turned upside down, and there were multiple waterfalls of light flowing down from it, with mysterious seals circulating around it.

“This is a Ley Line Forbidding Spirit Tool!” Mao Yuntian said proudly, “It’s also created by a Formations Grandmaster, capable of suppressing ley lines! Ling Han, do you still have any hopes of getting lucky?”
“What, Ley Line Forbidding Spirit Tool?”
“It’s the Spirit Tool that seals the ley lines!”
“It’s over. If the ley lines are sealed, how would Senior Brother Ling be able to use formations?”
“He can only depend on his own strength.”
“However, if a Core Formation Tier cultivator attacks a True Self Tier cultivator, won’t he definitely lose?”

The disciples all shook their heads. Without a doubt, Ling Han would definitely suffer a great defeat. Of course, battling at their own doorstep, even if he was defeated, the elites of the Nine Suns Holy Land would definitely not just sit by and watch as Ling Han was really beaten to death by Mao Yuntian.
Ling Han was the hope of the Nine Suns Holy Land. In future, he was destined to become a Saint.
“Despairing, aren’t you?” Mao Yuntian laughed loudly, killing intent flickering in his eyes.

This Ley Line Sealing Bowl could only last for about ten minutes. After all, it was meant to seal off the ley lines of a planet, and what kind of existence were planets? This was especially the case with the Nine Suns Planet, which was equivalent to a Saint. It was only in a deep slumber. Thus, being able to seal off the ley lines for ten minutes was already enough.
It certainly wasn’t long, but for a True Self Tier cultivator to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator, wouldn’t ten minutes be enough?
He knew that theNine Suns Holy Land wouldn’t sit by and watch him kill Ling Han, so he wanted to take this chance to give Ling Han a good beating. The best scenario would be to cripple him.

In a “fair battle”, after crippling him, it would not be appropriate for the Nine Suns Holy Land to launch an attack. Just like how Ling Han had crippled Baili Che, the Ziwei Imperial Clan could only swallow this bitter fruit.

Ling Han stimulated the ley lines, and as expected, it was as if the ley lines were asleep, and could not be used at all. However, he sensitively discovered that the ley lines were slowly reviving, and would recover not long after.
This time was at most ten minutes.

Ling Han was confident in himself, and said, “In my eyes, you can’t be considered a match at all. If it wasn’t for the fact that you are one major tier higher than me, I would be able to kill you with a single punch.”
Mao Yuntian was furious. This should have been him toying around with Ling Han, making Ling Han cry and beg for mercy, but now?
Why was this guy so stubborn?
Fine, then let’s beat him up first, and see how he would still be able to laugh.
“You’re seeking death!” he shouted loudly, and swept towards Ling Han. His figure spread out, and he was like a golden Roc. Golden light flickered, as fast as lightning.
Ling Han smiled. Was this fast?
He activated the Imminent Skyline, and with a turn of his body, he was actually not the slightest bit inferior.

“Saint-level movement technique!” The Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan couldn’t help but humph. There was a massive gulf between the Venerate Tier and the Saint Tier, and that was why Ling Han was no slower than Mao Yuntian even though he was clearly only at the Core Formation Tier.
Of course, most importantly, it was still Ling Han who was too freakish. His mystical power had soared all the way to 38 Heavens, and that was why he could activate this kind of high speed.
After dodging this attack, Ling Han immediately counterattacked with the black light of illusion.
Weng, this was divine sense-level. There was no trajectory of impact, and it could be reached with a single thought.

Mao Yuntian was instantly hit. At first, he was slightly confused. After all, he was in the True Self Tier, and had surpassed Ling Han by a major tier, so his resistance was naturally strong. However, he was still unable to break free from the illusion. Instead, he was immersed in it.
—He was not an Imperial Son, capable of being immune to all negative effects.

Ling Han waved a hand dismissively, “Do I need you to judge whether I have guts or not?”
Hearing these words, the disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land all laughed loudly.
That’s right, Ling Han had guts.
Was there any need for Mao Yuntian to judge that?
He had crippled an Imperial Son, and he still had no guts?
Mao Yuntian was shaking with anger, his hands tightly clenched into fists.
He wore a baleful expression as he looked at Ling Han, and said, “Ling Han, I want to duel with you!”
“You’re a major tier higher than me, and you’re also 100 years older than me.
How can you have the face to duel with me?” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
This was definitely an unjust battle.
No one would agree to this.
“Humph, I indeed wouldn’t bully you like this, but you snatched my beloved wife and provoked me first, so you have to bear the consequences!” Mao Yuntian shouted loudly.
“Ling Han, do you dare or not?”
Right at this moment, another voice rang out, and said, “Old brothers of the Nine Suns Holy Land, it was your brat who provoked the Mao Clan first.
No matter what, you have to give an explanation for this matter!”
This voice boomed, carrying a frightening might.
A Venerate Tier elite!
Obviously, this was that ancestor of the Mao Clan.
Not only had he brought Mao Yuntian over, he was also exerting pressure on Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, Mao Yuntian was right.
It was indeed Ling Han who had provoked him first.
He had snatched his wife, so what need was there to talk about a fair battle?
—You should have thought of this kind of consequences when you were snatching the bride.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “Fine, I’ll duel with you.”
He had grasped the Star Steps, and by nature, he was already invincible.
Moreover, the Earth Dragon and Destructive Energy could pose a threat to True Self Tier elites.
Thus, it wasn’t that he couldn’t fight back.
A cruel expression appeared on Mao Yuntian’s face.
This time, he was going to crush Ling Han into dust and destroy him completely.
“Come battle!” He strode out.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, taking his time.
“This is the standard posture for showing off.
Learn from it,” the large black dog said to the little azure dragon.
This was called teaching on the spot.
The little azure dragon nodded repeatedly.
Though he was awesome, he had just been born, after all.
There was still too much he had to learn.
“Ling Han, I have to say, you are truly freakish.” Mao Yuntian began his opening remarks, “Even the Imperial Son has been crippled by you.
You are practically heaven-defying!
However, you are only a Core Formation Tier, after all.
No matter how strong you are, you would not be able to match a single blow from me!”
“You seem to have forgotten that I did not just block a single blow from you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Heh, times change!” Mao Yuntian shook his head, and said, “Do you think I’m unprepared after learning that you’re a Formations Grandmaster?”
He waved his hand, and instantly, a jade bowl flew into the air.
As it spun, it enlarged, and only stopped when it had reached 50km in size.
This jade bowl was turned upside down, and there were multiple waterfalls of light flowing down from it, with mysterious seals circulating around it.
“This is a Ley Line Forbidding Spirit Tool!” Mao Yuntian said proudly, “It’s also created by a Formations Grandmaster, capable of suppressing ley lines!
Ling Han, do you still have any hopes of getting lucky?”
“What, Ley Line Forbidding Spirit Tool?”
“It’s the Spirit Tool that seals the ley lines!”
“It’s over.
If the ley lines are sealed, how would Senior Brother Ling be able to use formations?”
“He can only depend on his own strength.”
“However, if a Core Formation Tier cultivator attacks a True Self Tier cultivator, won’t he definitely lose?”
The disciples all shook their heads.
Without a doubt, Ling Han would definitely suffer a great defeat.

Of course, battling at their own doorstep, even if he was defeated, the elites of the Nine Suns Holy Land would definitely not just sit by and watch as Ling Han was really beaten to death by Mao Yuntian.
Ling Han was the hope of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
In future, he was destined to become a Saint.
“Despairing, aren’t you?” Mao Yuntian laughed loudly, killing intent flickering in his eyes.
This Ley Line Sealing Bowl could only last for about ten minutes.
After all, it was meant to seal off the ley lines of a planet, and what kind of existence were planets?
This was especially the case with the Nine Suns Planet, which was equivalent to a Saint.
It was only in a deep slumber.
Thus, being able to seal off the ley lines for ten minutes was already enough.
It certainly wasn’t long, but for a True Self Tier cultivator to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator, wouldn’t ten minutes be enough?
He knew that theNine Suns Holy Land wouldn’t sit by and watch him kill Ling Han, so he wanted to take this chance to give Ling Han a good beating.
The best scenario would be to cripple him.
In a “fair battle”, after crippling him, it would not be appropriate for the Nine Suns Holy Land to launch an attack.
Just like how Ling Han had crippled Baili Che, the Ziwei Imperial Clan could only swallow this bitter fruit.
Ling Han stimulated the ley lines, and as expected, it was as if the ley lines were asleep, and could not be used at all.
However, he sensitively discovered that the ley lines were slowly reviving, and would recover not long after.
This time was at most ten minutes.
Ling Han was confident in himself, and said, “In my eyes, you can’t be considered a match at all.
If it wasn’t for the fact that you are one major tier higher than me, I would be able to kill you with a single punch.”
Mao Yuntian was furious.
This should have been him toying around with Ling Han, making Ling Han cry and beg for mercy, but now?
Why was this guy so stubborn?
Fine, then let’s beat him up first, and see how he would still be able to laugh.
“You’re seeking death!” he shouted loudly, and swept towards Ling Han.
His figure spread out, and he was like a golden Roc.
Golden light flickered, as fast as lightning.
Ling Han smiled.
Was this fast?
He activated the Imminent Skyline, and with a turn of his body, he was actually not the slightest bit inferior.
“Saint-level movement technique!” The Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan couldn’t help but humph.
There was a massive gulf between the Venerate Tier and the Saint Tier, and that was why Ling Han was no slower than Mao Yuntian even though he was clearly only at the Core Formation Tier.
Of course, most importantly, it was still Ling Han who was too freakish.
His mystical power had soared all the way to 38 Heavens, and that was why he could activate this kind of high speed.
After dodging this attack, Ling Han immediately counterattacked with the black light of illusion.
Weng, this was divine sense-level.
There was no trajectory of impact, and it could be reached with a single thought.
Mao Yuntian was instantly hit.
At first, he was slightly confused.
After all, he was in the True Self Tier, and had surpassed Ling Han by a major tier, so his resistance was naturally strong.
However, he was still unable to break free from the illusion.
Instead, he was immersed in it.
—He was not an Imperial Son, capable of being immune to all negative effects.

chapters.title: Chapter 4164: Embarrassed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Mao Yuntian was completely immersed in his own fantasy.
In this illusion, he had already killed Ling Han and successfully snatched back the beauty. He had truly entered into his wedding night. All of a sudden, he was elated.
Everyone could clearly see that this guy was showing an expression of ecstasy. His arms were crossed over his chest, and his behind was still nudging forwards.
“F***, he’s hard.”
“F***, this is too blinding!”
“As he fought, he actually began to fantasize, and directly became hard. What kind of person is this!”
“Pervert!”
No one dared to believe that Mao Yuntian was actually shameless to this extent.

Even if you are in the True Self Tier, and you can suppress Ling Han with one hand, it should not be to the extent that you would be so arrogant and forceful in front of everyone, right? And you are still pushing back and forth; this was too disgusting.
Everyone was speechless. This had completely refreshed their worldview.
Ling Han hadn’t expected this either. He had only used the black light of illusion to drag out the time, but he hadn’t expected that Mao Yuntian would reveal such an unbearable side of him.
He shook his head. From now onwards, this prodigy from the Mao Clan should have no face to see anyone again, right?
Right at this moment, Mao Yuntian suddenly faltered, and clarity returned to his eyes.
Heavens, what was he doing?
He hurriedly lowered his hands, but his lower body was still sticking out. For the moment, it could not be appeased. He hardened his heart, and directly bent it. All right, it was done.
“Ling, Han!” he spat out word by word, his eyes spitting fire.
He didn’t know why he was suddenly immersed in his fantasies and unable to free himself, but he could imagine that it was definitely Ling Han’s doing.
This despicable guy, what kind of great humiliation had he caused him?
How would he be able to face others in future?
“Die! Die! Die!” he roared in fury, and charged towards Ling Han. He delivered a series of palm strikes, like tsunami waves.

Divine chains of order entwined around his body, and as he delivered a palm strike, endless seals lit up. This was the strength of a True Self Tier elite, who had seen through the profound secrets of heaven and earth. He was definitely not someone that a Core Formation Tier cultivator could match.

Even if Ling Han had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and even if his physique was incredibly tough, if there was no need, he had absolutely no wish to face the attack of a True Self Tier elite head-on.
He retreated. Weng, the barrage of murderous aura surged out.
“Ah!” Mao Yuntian immediately grabbed his head and screamed in agony. He looked like he was in extreme pain.

It should be known that the strength of Ling Han’s soul was comparable to Spirit Transformation Tier. Though limited by his cultivation level, he could not unleash its full might, it was still enough to cause trouble for even the True Self Tier.
Again!

Weng, weng, weng! The murderous aura attacked him repeatedly. This was divine sense-level, and it could ignore distance and reach him with a single thought. This naturally caused Mao Yuntian to suffer greatly. There were tears of blood flowing from his eyes, making him look extremely ferocious.
Who could have imagined this?

The dignified True Self Tier cultivator didn’t even manage to touch the corner of the Core Formation Tier cultivator’s clothes, and he was actually injured to the point of crying tears of blood. Although no one knew what method Ling Han had used, it was definitely his doing.
Mao Yuntian hurriedly stimulated high-level energy, forming a shield around him. He knew that the mystical power shield couldn’t protect him.

True enough, when the murderous aura attacked again, it was instantly intercepted by high-level energy, turning into a small black figure. However, it still overcame all obstacles and charged into Mao Yuntian’s mind, making him feel as if his head was being pierced by needles, which was extremely painful.
Hiss!
This time, everyone could see clearly, and they were all stunned.

It was clearly this tiny black figure that caused Mao Yuntian to shed tears of blood, but what kind of celestial technique was that? It had such terrifying destructive power that it could easily penetrate even high-level energy!

Ling Han was also slightly surprised. That was because when he had been battling against the Imperial Son previously, they had not been able to block the barrage of murderous aura either. It was only because they had the Spirit Tool personally forged by the Ancestral King, that they were immune to all negative effects.
That’s right, the True Self Tier!

Only this cultivation level could truly stimulate the Regulations of heaven and earth, and everything was ultimately the use of Regulations. Thus, Mao Yuntian was able to resist the barrage of murderous aura to a certain extent.

“Damn it! Damn it!” Mao Yuntian was truly about to go crazy. He was a True Self Tier cultivator, but he hadn’t even made a single move, and Ling Han had already tormented him to such a miserable state. He had become hard and thrust his behind in public, and was even crying tears of blood. This was a complete joke.
He charged over. Even if his head hurt from the barrage of murderous aura, he ignored it completely. He only had one thought now, and that was to kill Ling Han.
Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline and retreated. The black light of illusion flashed again.
Mao Yuntian was once again motionless. He was dumbfounded for a moment, then suddenly laughed loudly. That was because in the illusion, he had once again killed Ling Han.
However, he was a True Self Tier cultivator, after all, and had been hit once. He soon came back to his senses.
“Y-y-you!” He was wild with rage. He had been hit again!

Everyone was also watching with twitching mouths. This was really a battle that had never been seen before. Not only had it overturned the fact that elites would definitely win, it was also incredibly laughable — Mao Yuntian was weeping tears of blood, but he was laughing like an idiot. This was very comical.

Mao Yuntian no longer had any grand words to say. His eyes were bloodshot, and he continued to launch attacks at Ling Han. Hong, hong, hong! He was a True Self Tier elite, after all. He was too strong, and with every attack, the skies would be filled with brilliance.
Ling Han unleashed the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, but even with the Ice Energy, he was still unable to withstand Mao Yuntian’s attack. It was easily dispersed.
Sigh, there was a gap of a major tier between their cultivation levels. This kind of suppression was really enough to make one speechless.

However, what he didn’t know was that the spectators were really speechless. They had never seen such a Core Formation Tier cultivator that could actually make a True Self Tier cultivator look so battered and exhausted.

In the distance, the expression of the Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan was also livid. He knew that a great many people were streaming live on the Galaxy Network, so Mao Yuntian had really made a fool of himself this time.
He wanted nothing more than to kill both Ling Han and Mao Yuntian, yet he was so calm that he didn’t move a single muscle.

Mao Yuntian made a move. It could be said that he had a legitimate reason for doing so. He was the person involved, and the victim. Even if he was a major tier higher than Ling Han, he could still challenge Ling Han. However, it was different for him. He was a Venerate, so how shameless could he be?
Moreover, if he made a move, would the elites of Nine Suns Holy Land just sit by and watch?
If they really summoned the Saint Tool, he would definitely be blasted into smithereens.
Thus, he could only watch and anticipate Mao Yuntian could explode in power.
However, Mao Yuntian’s power still hadn’t exploded yet. However, the time for the Ley Line Sealing Bowl to be effective was almost up.
Xiu, this bowl flew down from the skies, and landed on the ground.
When Mao Yuntian saw this, his expression instantly changed drastically.
He knew how powerful the Earth Dragon was. Two of them were enough to make him suffer. If that wasn’t the case, how could Ling Han have kidnapped his bride right in front of his eyes?
Now, he had to face the Earth Dragon again.
“Do you miss it?” Ling Han smiled faintly. With a flick of his finger, hong, an Earth Dragon instantly appeared majestically, appearing behind him. Then, it was the second, the third... the tenth!
In any case, he had already exposed the number of ten dragons before, so he did not mind exposing it again at all.
Mao Yuntian only felt a bitter feeling, and a string of curses raced through his mind.
F***, could you be even more freakish?
