chapters.title: Chapter 4165: Talk about how a True Self Tier would be able to kill Ling Han?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
At this moment, Mao Yuntian was filled with utter despair.
At most, he could only battle two Earth Dragons, but Ling Han summoned ten Earth Dragons in a single go. If he went head-on, he would only be overturned by the Earth Dragons.

Furthermore, Ling Han did not just possess the Earth Dragons. The barrage of murderous aura and the black light of illusion also tormented him greatly. If the three of them unleashed their might at the same time, he did not know how he would be able to withstand it.
However, the mighty True Self Tier cultivator was actually going to lose to a Core Formation Tier cultivator?
No, no, no. This guy was not only a Core Formation Tier, but also a Formations Grandmaster. Losing to a Formations Grandmaster... er, it wasn’t a humiliation.

Mao Yuntian had already begun to find an excuse for himself. It couldn’t be helped. Previously, he couldn’t do anything to Ling Han, and now the latter had even summoned ten Earth Dragons. No matter how he thought about it, there was no way he could win.
“It’s my turn now, right?” Ling Han said with a smile. The black light of illusion shot out, and Mao Yuntian immediately fell into the illusion.
Xiu, the ten Earth Dragons danced in unison, charging towards Mao Yuntian.

After being tormented by the black light of illusion so many times, Mao Yuntian naturally had a strong resistance. In an instant, he broke free, but right at this moment, ten Earth Dragons also surrounded him.
‘F*ck!’
Mao Yuntian drew out his Spirit Tool. It was a green staff, and as he swung it, peng, peng, peng, he was locked in a fierce battle with the Earth Dragons.
After paying a considerable price, he finally destroyed the ten Earth Dragons completely.
He panted heavily, appearing to be extremely tired.
Ling Han applauded, and said, “Not bad, not bad. Your abilities are gratifying. Let’s do it again!”
Boom! Another 10 Earth Dragons shot out. After such a long time, it was enough for Ling Han to once again gather enough Earth Qi.
Mao Yuntian wanted to cry. Ten?

F***, he could summon the Earth Dragons with just a snap of his fingers, but in his case, he was really clashing with them physically. The wear and tear of both sides were on two completely different levels.

If he gave up, he wouldn’t be able to defeat Ling Han at all. Of course, this was unless his strength reached a level where he could obliterate 10 Earth Dragons in one go. At that time, he could insta-kill Ling Han in a single go.
He leaped back in retreat, completely losing the courage to continue fighting.
Ling Han was disappointed, and said, “Yi, why are you running? This is a duel!”
‘Duel your sister!’

Mao Yuntian didn’t even turn around, and he had already arrived beside the Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan. No matter how harshly he was scolded, he wouldn’t challenge Ling Han again. That would truly be seeking his own humiliation.
Pa, as expected, the Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan gave him a slap, causing him to spin three times on the spot.
However, the Venerate Tier elite of the Mao Clan also knew that Mao Yuntian really couldn’t be blamed for this. Instead, it was Ling Han who was too freakish.

It could even be said that it was his poor insight that had not seen that Ling Han actually knew spiritual attack. Otherwise, if he had prepared a few spiritual defense Spirit Tools for Mao Yuntian, instead of just a Ley Line Forbidding Spirit Tool, the result would have been completely different.
By now, what else could he say?
“Farewell!” The Venerate Tier elite from the Mao Clan grabbed Mao Yuntian, tore a rip into space, and left.
Staying to seek his own humiliation?

The entire area was filled with the sounds of discussion. Who would have thought that when a True Self Tier cultivator made a move on Ling Han, not only had he failed, he had even been beaten into fleeing in a sorry state?
Not only here, but there was also a heated debate on the Galaxy Network. In fact, there was even a question that had been raised — how could a True Self Tier cultivator kill Ling Han?
“Firstly, you must have a Spirit Tool that can resist spiritual attacks.”
“Secondly, your battle prowess is either enough to crush ten Earth Dragons, or you have a Spirit Tool that can seal ley lines.”
“Thirdly, you have to cultivate a Saint-level movement technique. If you can’t even catch up to him, what else can you say?”

There were many capable people, and it wasn’t long before they came to three important conclusions. In fact, the assassins from the Battle God Palace was also involved. They used a verified account. This was the channel through which the Battle God Palace communicated with outsiders. If one wanted to find the Battle God Palace to carry out assassination, this account would be responsible for communicating.

Previously, the various forces, including the Imperial Clans, had all protested or threatened the Chang Clan and asked them to seal off the account of the Battle God Palace, but the Chang Clan ignored them completely, ensuring fairness for everyone. This was the principle of the actions of the Chang Clan’s Great Emperor when he was alive, so the Chang Clan would not change it either.
Which also meant that no matter how evil a villain was, he would still be alive and kicking on the Galaxy Network, and there was no need to worry that his hiding place would be leaked.

This was off topic. In short, this was the first time that the Galaxy Network had become so lively because they were discussing how to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and Ling Han could be considered to have set a new record.

However, as the person involved, Ling Han didn’t take it to heart at all. He was actively comprehending the Heavenly Dao Flames. If necessary, he wanted to go to the Black Moon Planet and observe the Heavenly Dao Flames from a close distance.

Additionally, he wanted to break through to the True Self Tier as soon as possible. At present, he was being targeted by too many people, and he had more or less revealed his trump cards. Once he advanced into the True Self Tier, his battle prowess would become unfathomable again. Furthermore, after he advanced into the True Self Tier, he would be able to obtain all the inheritances of Ancient Sun Saint.

Peace returned to the galaxy. In the short term, there weren’t any major events that shook the world, but peaceful days were destined not to last long. Only two months had passed, and waves had once again risen on the Galaxy Network.
The Mountain Sea Heaven had reappeared!
What was Mountain Sea Heaven?
This was not a Mystery Realm, but rather a super-large city. However, it was not on any planet, but rather a city, floating alone in the galaxy.
Every 90,000 years, the Mountain Sea Heaven would appear once, and it would last for a period of time. Then, the path would be cut off again, and it would be hidden in the universe once more.
What was so amazing about this city?
Here, Regulations materialized, and the energy of heaven and earth was incredibly dense. Cultivating here was far superior to other places.
Then was this a Holy Land for cultivating?
In theory, yes, but in truth, very few prodigies would enter, and cultivate to great accomplishment level before coming out again.
Why?
Because this city would only open once every 90,000 years, and there was a Heavenly Path through it. After the majority of people entered, they would not be able to make it back out at all.
—It should be known that Venerate Tier elites theoretically only had a lifespan of a hundred thousand years.
Thus, what did it matter that he had cultivated to great accomplishment level in the Mountain Sea Heaven? He had not even had the chance to show off his might, and had already died of old age.

Every time it opened, a large number of Sect Masters and Venerate Tier elites would enter. When the next time it opened, a few Saints would walk out, and the majority would die of old age within.

Then it would have to be said who had forged the Mountain Sea Heaven.

At most, he could only battle two Earth Dragons, but Ling Han summoned ten Earth Dragons in a single go.
If he went head-on, he would only be overturned by the Earth Dragons.
Furthermore, Ling Han did not just possess the Earth Dragons.
The barrage of murderous aura and the black light of illusion also tormented him greatly.
If the three of them unleashed their might at the same time, he did not know how he would be able to withstand it.
However, the mighty True Self Tier cultivator was actually going to lose to a Core Formation Tier cultivator?
No, no, no.
This guy was not only a Core Formation Tier, but also a Formations Grandmaster.
Losing to a Formations Grandmaster... er, it wasn’t a humiliation.
Mao Yuntian had already begun to find an excuse for himself.
It couldn’t be helped.
Previously, he couldn’t do anything to Ling Han, and now the latter had even summoned ten Earth Dragons.
No matter how he thought about it, there was no way he could win.
“It’s my turn now, right?” Ling Han said with a smile.
The black light of illusion shot out, and Mao Yuntian immediately fell into the illusion.
Xiu, the ten Earth Dragons danced in unison, charging towards Mao Yuntian.
After being tormented by the black light of illusion so many times, Mao Yuntian naturally had a strong resistance.
In an instant, he broke free, but right at this moment, ten Earth Dragons also surrounded him.
‘F*ck!’
Mao Yuntian drew out his Spirit Tool.
It was a green staff, and as he swung it, peng, peng, peng, he was locked in a fierce battle with the Earth Dragons.
After paying a considerable price, he finally destroyed the ten Earth Dragons completely.
He panted heavily, appearing to be extremely tired.
Ling Han applauded, and said, “Not bad, not bad.
Your abilities are gratifying.
Let’s do it again!”
Boom!
Another 10 Earth Dragons shot out.

Mao Yuntian wanted to cry.
Ten?
F***, he could summon the Earth Dragons with just a snap of his fingers, but in his case, he was really clashing with them physically.
The wear and tear of both sides were on two completely different levels.
If he gave up, he wouldn’t be able to defeat Ling Han at all.
Of course, this was unless his strength reached a level where he could obliterate 10 Earth Dragons in one go.
At that time, he could insta-kill Ling Han in a single go.

Staying to seek his own humiliation?

chapters.title: Chapter 4166: Mountain Sea Heaven
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s power was definitely not limited to mere legends. After him, every generation of Great Emperor would feel rueful and highly revered the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, proclaiming him as one of the most powerful Ancestral Kings in history.
Because he had spent his whole life pacifying the darkness, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor didn’t even have any descendants or heirs. All of his knowledge was buried in the Needless Mountains.
However, no one knew where the Needless Mountains were. After so many generations, it was still a mystery.

Thus, the only clue was the Mountain Sea Heaven This was the bridgehead that the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had used for battle in the past. It was equivalent to a chariot. According to rumors, when the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had died, he had once said that the Needless Mountains lay within the Mountain Sea Heaven.

Precisely because of this, every time the Mountain Sea Heaven opened, there would be countless people surging in, searching for the secret of the Needless Mountains. Of course, aside from those great elites that were determined to become Saints, the others would come out before the Mountain Sea Heaven closed, to avoid being trapped for ninety thousand years. If they did not become Saints, they would basically not be able to survive until the next time the Mountain Sea Heaven opened.
Now, the Heavenly Path had appeared, opening the great path that led to the Mountain Sea Heaven.

“Descending Heaven Holy Emperor is amazingly awesome. Although he can’t be claimed to be number one in history, he’s definitely one of the strongest Great Emperors.” The large black dog ran over. “Little Han, when are we setting off?”
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “After so many years, not a single person has found any clues. Do you think we can succeed?”
“That may not be the case. Who knows, we may be lucky?” the large black dog said.

True, just look at the inheritance of the Nine Suns Holy Land. No one had managed to find it for countless years, yet in the end, it was discovered by Ling Han. This was both due to strength, and luck.
The little azure dragon muttered, “What Descending Heaven Holy Emperor? In front of my father, he can’t even withstand a single blow.”

“All right, all right, all right,” Ling Han said with a smile. “The True Dragon is indeed the leader of the Divine Beasts, and has world-shaking abilities. However, hewas created by heaven and earth after all, and there is no process of advancing step by step towards the peak. Thus, if all the Great Emperors can be revived, I still think that the Ancestral Kings of the future generations would be slightly more powerful.”
“Grandpa Dog thinks so too.” The large black dog nodded.

“Che, you guys are too ignorant!” The little azure dragon naturally didn’t agree. In his eyes, the True Dragon had once been the leader of the Divine Beasts, and now, it was undoubtedly an Emperor among Emperors.
“Then you can just stay and watch the house,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“No, Grandpa Dragon also wants to join in on the excitement!” the little azure dragon immediately objected.

For such a grand event, as long as one could attend, they would not miss out on it. The entire Galaxy Network was discussing this matter, and some forces had even mobilized their entire clans. With more people, the possibility of finding the Needless Mountains would also be slightly higher.
The Nine Suns Holy Land also fully mobilized. A total of three Venerate Tier elites were mobilized, bringing all their disciples with them to the Mountain Sea Heaven.

And this time, three Venerate Tier elites had gone, yet there would be two Venerate Tier elites remaining there. That was because their lifespans were already running out, and they had to take a gamble in the Mountain Sea Heaven. If they became Saints, they would still be able to come out after 90,000 years. If they didn’t become Saints, then there was naturally no need to mention anything else.
“Yi, according to the Galaxy Network, there would be a great many super geniuses in the Mountain Sea Heaven,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han also learned about the Mountain Sea Heaven Heaven. He knew that this could be considered a super Holy Land, and was not the slightest bit inferior even when compared to Imperial Clans.
Why?

That was because a great many Sect Masters and Venerate Tier elites were trying to break through to Saint Tier inside. After failing, they were also dissatisfied with the fact that what they had learnt had been lost, and would search inside for natives to pass on their cultivation techniques. And if they became Saints, they would also want to take in disciples in their boredom, or even give birth to a son or daughter.
In these countless years, countless elites, just how many inheritances would be left behind?
Thus, the Mountain Sea Heaven could completely be called a super Holy Land. Sometimes, it could even produce Imperial Son-level young prodigies, dazzling an era.
Moreover, the Regulations here were solidified, and the energy was dense. Cultivating them would be half the work, but twice the effect.
Led by the three Venerate Tier elites, Ling Han and the others soon arrived outside the Mountain Sea Heaven.

In fact, even at this moment, they still couldn’t see this super large city. However, an ancient path appeared in the galaxy. As long as they followed this path, they would be able to enter the Mountain Sea Heaven.

One after another, forces arrived. Some only had three to four people, or there were hundreds or thousands of them. Their scale was astonishing. After arriving here, no one deliberately provoked them. They all stepped onto the Heavenly Path, and walked forwards.

This path was astonishingly long, and as they walked, the stars shifted, and in the space of a single step, the stars were all left behind them. It was as if time was flying, and they were rapidly passing by.
After walking for a day, a planet appeared in front of them. It was completely black in colour, and was extraordinarily huge, and one could vaguely see the towering city walls on it.

“This was once a sun,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said. “However, it was shrunk countless times by the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s great power. It solidified and transformed into something similar to an ordinary planet. However, the gravity fields on it are several thousand times stronger than ordinary planets, so you have to channel mystical power to resist at all times. Otherwise, you can only sprawl out on the ground like mud.”

Everyone was stunned. Just how terrifying were the flames of a sun? They were an existence that was equivalent to eight star high-level energy. Even Saints could only blast apart the sun, and could not come into contact with it for a long time. Only the Ancestral King would have such great power, able to cool down and solidify the sun, shrinking it countless times over, which even allow others to set foot on it.
The more they knew about the strength of the Ancestral King, the more they would feel helplessness that they could not hope to reach his height.

“All right, let’s go into the city,” another Venerate Tier said. A massive city gate appeared ahead of them, as tall as thirty thousand meters. Rather than calling it a city gate, it would be better to call it a pinnacle.

Ling Han raised his head. No wonder the Mountain Sea Heaven was called a super large city and not a planet. That was because this was indeed surrounded by the city walls, and the city walls were as tall as thirty thousand meters. Every brick was exuding an ancient aura, and it could be seen that there were many places on the city walls that were damaged, leaving behind pits and holes.
This had not been corroded by time, but had rather been left behind through battle.

When they arrived at the city gates, some people were curious, and went to bombard the city wall, but with a single blow, the city wall was completely unmoved, while they themselves flipped over a few times, and fell heavily.
This piqued the interest of many people, and they all stepped forward to test it out. In the end, no one could damage the bricks here.
Ling Han also tried it. Ordinary attacks were completely ineffective, and even if he used Destructive Energy, he only managed to damage it slightly.
“Hehe, to say nothing of you guys, even I would not be able to damage a single brick or stone here,” a Venerate Tier elite said.
What!
Everyone was dumbfounded. Even Venerate Tier elites were unable to shake the city wall here?
Ling Han was also stunned. Looking at the grooves left behind on the city wall, who had left them behind?
A Saint-level being, this was definitely a Saint-level being.
Just what had this ancient city experienced?
After sighing here for a while, they finally entered into the city. An incredibly grand and majestic ancient city appeared in front of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4167: Regulations materialize
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Mountain Sea Heaven was built on a sun that had been extinguished. Though this sun had been compressed countless times over, it was still no smaller than an ordinary planet. Furthermore, the Mountain Sea Heaven had more or less occupied the entire sun, so it could be imagined just how colossal this city was.
As far as the eye could see, there were mountains and rivers, waterfalls that hung down from the sky, and divine chains that shone like rainbows.
Of course, the most direct display was that the moment they stepped into the city gates, a great many people gave a muffled humph, and almost knelt down.
The gravity field was too strong.
Thankfully, everyone had been warned in advance. Thus, an instant later, they all spread out their mystical power shields to resist this kind of gravity field.

Ling Han naturally walked as if he were walking on flat land, because he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. His Body Art was equivalent to his cultivation level, and this bit of gravity was practically child’s play in his eyes. It should be known that a strand of his slightly disheveled hair was still sticking up, without the slightest sign of falling downwards. From this, it could be seen just how strong his physique was.

Aside from him, the little azure dragon was also fearless, but the large black dog, empress, and Hu Niu were slightly inferior. They had to put up a shield of mystical power, because their grasp of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique wasn’t deep enough, and none of them had cultivated the Core Formation Tier chapter.
However, Ling Han put up a mystical power shield and had the little azure dragon do the same.
“Why?” The little azure dragon appeared baffled.
“Don’t let others know that we are Body Arts practitioners,” Ling Han communicated through divine sense.
The little azure dragon instantly gave an ‘oh’, and said in realization, “You’re trying to trick people again, brat!”
‘F*ck! This is only a trump card, okay? What do you mean by tricking people? Do you know how to speak?’
Ling Han didn’t lower himself to his level. It was fine as long as he knew that this Four-Legged Snake had a bad mouth.
The Nine Mountains Venerate stroked his beard, and said, “If one cultivates in this environment for a long time, Body Art would be extremely powerful.”
“That’s right.” The other two Venerate Tier elites also nodded in deep agreement.

Concurrently cultivating Body Art was actually the dream of quite a number of people. However, there were really too few people that were proficient in Body Art. Furthermore, the requirements for cultivating Body Art were too high, and required all sorts of precious medicinal ingredients to cultivate, which could easily overwhelm a large force.
Of course, most importantly, there was no cultivation technique or corresponding environment.

For example, this planet, that had once been a sun, had a terrifyingly large gravity field. It was a natural Holy Land for cultivating Body Art, and in any other place, even Saints wouldn’t be able to do so.

“Unfortunately, one can only stay here for two to three years at most, and there is absolutely no time to cultivate the Body Art.” Nine Mountains Venerate shook his head as he looked at Ling Han with slight pity.
He had a very high opinion of this disciple of his. If he could also cultivate Body Art, he would definitely be even stronger.

“Let’s not talk about this. Let’s find a good place first,” the other two Venerate Tier elites said. This time, they would both stay in the Mountain Sea Heaven. They would either become Saints, or die.

In the city, Regulations materialized. The Regulations that could only be discovered after exhausting one’s spirit was laid out in front of them, and it was really too helpful for cultivating Regulations, especially from the True Self Tier onwards. Cultivating the Regulations here would really be half the work and double the effect.

However, in different regions, the Regulations manifested were different, and there was a difference in how many Regulations there were. Hence, if they could occupy a good place, that naturally would be even more beneficial.

They weren’t the first batch of people to enter this space, but it didn’t matter. In the cultivation world, there was no such thing as first come, first served. Instead, strength spoke louder than words.
When a great many small forces saw them approach, they immediately gave up their territory, and only returned after they had left. There was no need to threaten them at all.
Could it be that they were going to resist?
That would really be the calamity of the destruction of their entire clan.

If their own comprehension ability and accumulation was not enough, they would still be unable to take that step.

Body Arts!
All the techniques in the world referred to the great dao.

Though he was definitely no match, and if one cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique here, the True Self Tier, or at most the Spirit Transformation Tier, would probably be the end. After all, there was only so much gravitational force here.

Ling Han removed the mystical power shield, allowing gravity to take effect on him. However, his physique was already extremely powerful. Although gravity was astonishing, it couldn’t even affect the flow of his blood.

That was because even if they cultivated Body Art to the pinnacle here, they would only be Spirit Transformation Tier-level, at most. Moreover, the Regulations here were solidified, and cultivation was the true way to go. If one were to study the Body Art, that would really be a loss of a greater gain. It would be extremely stupid.

Even if he had really advanced into the True Self Tier, he would still need to exert a lot of effort to be able to touch a sliver of it, and it was the lowest level at that. Unlike here, where even Saint-level Regulations would appear, as if they were within easy reach.
Of course, no one would really touch it. This was Regulations, the embodiment of the Great Dao of Heaven and Earth. If one touched it without enough abilities, they would really be seeking death.
Was there any high-level energy manifestation?
Ling Han searched around, but unfortunately, there was none here, which disappointed him greatly.

In these two days, he was walking around in the Mountain Sea Heaven. It was said that the secret of Needless Mountains was buried here. Obtaining it corresponded to obtaining the treasure trove of a Great Emperor. Even Ling Han’s heart throbbed wildly.
Though he had cultivated a considerable number of Imperial Techniques, he still lacked an Imperial Scroll, and in the case of the Imperial Scroll, it was the foundation of an Imperial Clan.
Bloodline?
Hehe, bloodline could only allow an Imperial Clan member to explode for a short while. The Imperial Scroll was the true reason why the Imperial Clan was truly superior to all other forces.
To activate the Imperial Weapon, one didn’t need to rely on their bloodline to do so. Instead, they needed to rely on a technique that had the same origins as the Great Emperor.
Where did the technique come from?
Imperial Scroll.

chapters.title: Chapter 4168: Taking liberties
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Imperial Scroll was so important, and was the foundation of an Imperial Clan. No matter what, the Imperial Scroll could not possibly be taught to outsiders.

For example, many Imperial Clans had high hopes for Ling Han. In fact, they were even willing to invite Ling Han over and betroth him to a female clansman who wasn’t very important. However, Ling Han would only be able to learn the Imperial Technique in this clan, at most, but he would never be able to see the Imperial Scroll in this lifetime.

Even among the Imperial Clans, those who were not important successors were unable to cultivate the Imperial Scroll, and those clansmen that cultivated the Imperial Scroll all placed restrictions in their minds. If outsiders wanted to forcefully steal it, the restrictions would activate and damage the mind.
They would rather have their clansmen die. Even if he was the Imperial Son, he would definitely not teach the Imperial Scroll to outsiders.

Ling Han possessed a Saint-level cultivation technique, which he had inherited from the Nine Suns Saint. This was already very, very impressive, especially when it was the Nine Suns Saint. Looking at history, his strength was definitely capable of ranking in the top ten among Saints. As for the exact ranking, that was because there were too many Saints that were not of the same generation, and could not be compared.
The top ten was already impressive enough.
Compared to the Imperial Scroll, the Saint Grade cultivation technique was still slightly inferior. In the end, it could not be considered perfect.
Ling Han felt that he had already reached the pinnacle level. Thus, if he wanted to become stronger, he could only start from the cultivation technique.

It was impossible for other Imperial Clans to teach him the Imperial Scroll; even Brother Monkey couldn’t. Ling Han himself wouldn’t ask it of him, so if he wanted to obtain the Imperial Scroll, he could only start from this kind of Imperial Scroll that had no owner.
He was very proactive. Similarly, there was also the large black dog and the little azure dragon.
Why was the little azure dragon so proactive?

“Are you guys stupid? If Grandpa Dragon had an Imperial Scroll, what’s the point of looking for it!” The little azure dragon was asking for a beating the moment it opened its mouth. “My father only taught me the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, because he doesn’t have an Imperial Scroll at all!”

It was not just the True Dragon. None of the earliest Divine Beasts had passed down any Imperial Scroll, because there was only the Imperial Technique. That was because they were created by the heaven and earth, and had comprehended Dao when they were born. They had not even walked through the process of the Imperial Path themselves, so how could they possibly have an Imperial Scroll to pass on?

The fact that the True Dragon could reverse-engineer himself and create the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was already extremely awesome. Even so, there were still restrictions. One had to have the True Dragon bloodline to be able to cultivate it. Looking at the whole world, there were really not many people that qualified.
However, the Imperial Scroll was different. As long as one’s comprehension ability was high enough, and did not depend on his bloodline, anyone could cultivate it.
In comparison, it was clear which was superior.

This was also the reason why Ling Han was certain that the Great Emperors of the future generations would be stronger than those Divine Beasts in the beginning. What they had comprehended themselves would truly belong to them.

Thus, Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon all yearned for the Imperial Scroll. They walked all over the mountains and plains, searching for any clues about Needless Mountains. However, this place had existed for who knew how many years. If clues were so easy to find, wouldn’t they have been discovered long ago?
After a few days, they had gained nothing.
It couldn’t be said that way. The Regulations here were solidified, and if they saw so much, it would still have some benefits for their future cultivation.
Most importantly, there were no ley lines here.

Because this was not a real planet, but rather one that had been created by compressing a sun, Ling Han could vaguely sense that there were actually “veins” inside the sun as well. However, his present strength was too weak, and even his senses were very vague, what more when he had to communicate with them.
Was it Saint Tier?
If he became a Formation Saint, would he be able to mobilize even the “ley lines” in the sun?
This was not an exaggeration. In legends, a Formation Saint was able to use planets as the foundations for formations, and lay out a supreme great formation that could kill even Saints.
Sigh, he was thinking too far ahead.

Because he could not communicate with the ley lines, Ling Han and the others were also very careful, and did not go too far. After all, there were quite a number of forces that had their eyes on Ling Han, especially the Battle God Palace. They wanted to kill him as soon as possible. Ling Han did not want to create a chance for them.

Ling Han returned to the territory of the Nine Suns Holy Land. He planned to cultivate in seclusion for a few days, and strive to reach the end of the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier as soon as possible. Then, he would advance into the True Self Tier.
In this place, it was really a pity not to cultivate Regulations.

Because the large black dog and little azure dragon were small targets, they continued searching for clues about Needless Mountains. It could also be said that they hadn’t given up yet. After all, this involved an Imperial Scroll. To say nothing of them, it would be the same even if it was an Imperial Clan. This was something that could be used for reference.
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu’s charming voice rang out.
Ling Han shook his head. With this beautiful wife by his side, it was really impossible for him to quietly cultivate.
He stood up and walked out of the simplified room. However, he shockingly discovered that there was actually Lin Luo with Hu Niu and the empress!
“Senior Lin!” Ling Han immediately went up to greet him.
Lin Luo smiled as well, embracing Ling Han warmly.
“Yi!” Hu Niu bared her teeth, a vicious glint in her eyes — he actually dared to embrace her Ling Han. He was too despicable.
“Move your dirty hand away!” the empress said coldly, her expression proud.
Lin Luo’s expression involuntarily darkened. One looked like she wanted to devour him, while the other looked at him like he was dirt. These two beautiful wives of Ling Han were really too unique.
“Ling Han, someone’s bullying Niu!” Hu Niu pouted.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Someone actually dares to bully you? Haha, then you should have beaten him hard, right?”
“No, that guy is stronger than Niu. Thankfully, Lin Luo came, and helped to beat that despicable guy back,” Hu Niu said.
Ling Han’s expression became stern, and killing intent was already ignited in his heart.
He actually dared to bully his wife?
“What on earth is going on?” he asked the empress. If he told Hu Niu to talk about serious matters, she would often be unreliable.
The empress spoke up, and explained the whole story.

Actually, it was very simple. She and Hu Niu were roaming around, and encountered a native of the Mountain Sea Heaven. He seemed to be some second-generation young master or something, and was very arrogant, forcing the empress and Hu Niu to take off their veils. This was naturally rebuked by Hu Niu, and despised by the empress. Hence, the two sides got into a fight.

Who would’ve thought that the native was a Core Formation Tier cultivator? The two women were naturally no match for him, and it was at this moment that Lin Luo just happened to appear, forcing the native to retreat and saving the two women.
“How detestable!” Hu Niu mumbled as she listened.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He would kill such lecherous people wherever he saw them!
“Thank you, Senior Lin,” he clasped his hands and said to Lin Luo.
Lin Luo smiled and said, “There’s no need for thanks between us!”
They had all come from the Genesis World, and were truly on the same side.
Ling Han nodded, and asked, “Do you know the name of that native?”
“I don’t know. He’s so ugly, so I didn’t care what he said at all.” Hu Niu shrugged.
At this moment, Ling Han didn’t know how to complain.
“Two b*tches and that thief, come out!” However, right at this moment, shouts were heard from outside.
“Yi, it’s that ugly b@stard!” Hu Niu immediately exclaimed.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was slightly surprised. ‘F*ck! You were forced to retreat after taking liberties on the streets, yet you still dare to charge over?’
Hehe, he was really courting death!

Ling Han strode out, only to see five people standing outside the door. However, it was clear that two of them were in the lead, and they were both young men. The other three were a few steps behind, and it was clear that they were servants.

chapters.title: Chapter 4169: Hang Clan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Yi, who are you?” A young man looked at Ling Han with an astounded expression.
Judging by the voice, it was the person who had spoken just now.
In other words, he was the shameless guy who wanted to take liberties with Hu Niu and the empress.
Xiu, Ling Han finally moved.
A crisp sound was heard, and the young man was sent flying, then fell heavily onto the ground.
‘Hmm?’
The expression of the other young man changed drastically. He had actually not seen clearly how Ling Han had moved. That was really too fast, wasn’t it?

“You actually dare to hit me?” The young man who had been sent flying quickly got back to his feet. His left cheek was very swollen, and there were also spots of blood. He looked at Ling Han balefully, and did not have the fear that he should have had when his abilities were inferior. Instead, he looked extremely fierce.
Of course, it wasn’t because he could withstand it, but rather because Ling Han hadn’t used his full strength at all.
Killed in an instant? How could it be so easy!
“Now, no matter who you are, you will pay the price for this!” the young man roared.
Pa! With a flash, he was sent flying again.

The other young man still didn’t move, but his eyes were filled with fear. That was because Ling Han’s speed was too fast, so fast that he couldn’t react at all. In other words, if Ling Han made a move on him, he would definitely be unable to parry either.

“Ah—” The first young man screamed in pain. This time, Ling Han had used a little too much force, and shattered his protective shield. Furthermore, the gravity field here was terrifyingly strong, and his physique had not cultivated to the extent that he could completely resist it, so he naturally could not help but scream in pain.
At this time, the empress and the others walked out of the simple houses.
“Damn guy!” When the first young man saw the empress and Hu Niu, especially Lin Luo, the killing intent in his eyes became even fiercer.
“Brother Xian, why aren’t you attacking yet?” he called out to his companion. F***, I called you over to help, but are you just going to watch me get beaten?
That Brother Xian’s surname was Zhou, and his name was Zhou Xian. His expression was ugly, but he had no intention of making a move at all.

The other young man was called Hang Tingyuan, and in the case of the Hang Clan, there was a Venerate Tier elite keeping watch. He was only over twenty thousand years old, and had very high hopes of becoming a Saint. The strength of the Zhou Clan was much weaker. The strongest elite in the clan was only a Spirit Transformation True Lord.

Thus, even if Zhou Xian’s natural talent was higher than Hang Tingyuan’s, and his strength was also stronger, and was even addressed as Big Brother by the latter, in truth, it was Hang Tingyuan that had the dominant position in their relationship.

Hang Tingyuan had suffered a loss at the hands of Lin Luo, so he sought Zhou Xian’s help, wanting to get his pride back. However, before the main culprit had even appeared, an even more ruthless person had come, causing Zhou Xian to completely lose his temper.
He was completely outmatched, all right? Fight my a*s!
Meanwhile, Ling Han asked Zhou Xian, “Are you going to make a move?”
“Attack! Attack!” Hang Tingyuan shouted loudly.
Yet Zhou Xian shook his head extremely resolutely. Crazy, he had no wish to seek death.
“All right, then just obediently watch from the sidelines,” Ling Han said, his tone very gentle.
However, Zhou Xian felt a chill rise up from his bones. He could hear the killing intent in these words.
Thus, he couldn’t help but say, “The ancestor of the Hang Clan is a Venerate Tier elite!”
This seemed to be a reminder, but also seemed to be a warning.
Ling Han chuckled, “In terms of background, my old man is also a Venerate Tier elite, and there is more than one.”

“You dare!” Hang Tingyuan shouted loudly. When he saw Ling Han’s eyes filled with killing intent shoot towards him, all the hair on his body stood on end. However, he had been a tyrant for a long time, and even if he felt fear now, he did not have the slightest intention of backing down. Instead, he became even more frenzied, “Kneel down immediately and beg for mercy. Otherwise, I will make sure you die a tragic death.”

Ling Han sighed, “I hate it the most when others threaten me, especially for someone like you, who doesn’t have much ability to begin with. You only know how to shout at the top of your lungs like a mad dog.”
Er, it was a good thing that the large black dog had gone out. Otherwise, he would have to be careful of being bitten by the dog at night.
Xiu, with a flash of his figure, Hang Tingyuan was once again sent flying with a slap.

Hang Tingyuan screamed repeatedly. He could no longer hold up the shield of mystical power. Under the terrifying weight of gravity, he felt as if every bone in his body was cracking, ready to break or even shatter at any moment. This finally made him feel fear, his whole body trembling.
He had encountered a ruthless character, who was completely unafraid of his background.
Now that his helper couldn’t help him at all, he hurriedly said, “I forfeit! I forfeit!”
Where there is life, there is hope. As long as he managed to escape this calamity, he would immediately return home and call for reinforcements.
Humph, how could these outsiders know how deep the power of their Hang Clan was!
Peng!
However, he felt another slap land on his face, and he was heavily sent flying.
Since he dared to tease his wife, there was nothing more to say. There was only one word for it—kill him!
Ling Han was cold, and continued to wave his palms. Pa, pa, pa! In a few moments, Hang Tingyuan was beaten to death.
“Scram!” He swept an eye over Zhou Xian, his expression incredibly cold.
Zhou Xian was so scared that he fell onto the ground, but in the next instant, he hurriedly got back to his feet, as anxious as a stray dog. He hurriedly turned around and fled.
“Haha, you haven’t changed at all,” Lin Luo said with a laugh.
Ling Han also smiled, but did not take it to heart: if it was strength, he had strength, and if it was background, he did not lack background either. What was there to be afraid of?
Oh, his wife had been teased, and someone had even come to provoke him. How could it be that he would have to swallow his anger?
“However, this matter definitely won’t end so easily,” Lin Luo continued.
“En, I’ll take things as they come.” Ling Han smiled eerily.
Merely after half a day, someone came from the Hang Clan.

It wasn’t a Venerate Tier personally arriving, nor was it Sect Master, Spirit Transformation True Lord, or even True Self Tier. Instead, it was a white-robed young man, a being of the Core Formation Tier.

At first glance, this white-robed young man looked very ordinary. His feet were bare, and he appeared very rough, but with a little more attention, one would discover that there was no mystical power shield on him.
Without the mystical power shield, he could actually resist this kind of gravity field?
This only meant one thing—this guy’s Body Art was extremely powerful, at least in the level of the Core Formation Tier.
“My name is Hang Tianqiao,” the white-robed young man said calmly. “The Hang Tingyuan that you killed is my younger brother.”
“Have you come for revenge?” Ling Han asked.

“Although my brother is unbearable, the bloodline of the Hang Clan still flows in his veins. He is not someone that can be killed just because someone says so,” Hang Tianqiao said calmly. He looked at Ling Han, and killing intent was already shooting out of his eyes, “It’s very simple. A life for a life.”

Ling Han smiled, “You guys should have done your investigations, right? You know that there are a total of three Venerate Tier elites in the Nine Suns Holy Land. Thus, you guys wouldn’t dare to be rash either. You didn’t even mobilize True Self Tier elites, but rather sent out a Core Formation Tier like you, which can be considered a fair battle. In that case, even the three Venerate Tier elites of our sect wouldn’t be able to say anything.”

There was a slight change in Hang Tianqiao’s expression. Ling Han was absolutely right. Otherwise, how could there have been such a troublesome matter? The clan would have long since sent out a True Self Tier elite to capture Ling Han and bring him back to the Hang Clan, where he would be cut into eight pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 4170: Conflict
paragraphs: “Since you dare to commit murder, do you dare to battle me?” Hang Tianqiao asked coldly. It was a very stupid idea to debate whether the Hang Clan would dare or not.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “If I beat you to death, who would the Hang Clan send?”
“You can’t kill me.” Hang Tianqiao shook his head, appearing to be filled with confidence.
“Alright, then I’ll reserve a bit of anticipation,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Hang Tianqiao humphed, and said, “You’re far too conceited. You have to realize that this is the Mountain Sea Heaven!”
“What you mean is that the people of the Mountain Sea Heaven are stronger than the people outside?” Ling Han asked.

“That’s right.” Hang Tianqiao pointed at the surroundings, “Here, the heaven and earth’s energy is incredibly dense, making it half the work and double the effect when you cultivate. Furthermore, the gravity field is like a mountain, tempering yourself at all times. The Regulations materialize, and comprehending the heaven and earth’s profound mysteries is ten times, or even a hundred times easier. So, do we have a reason for not being strong?”
In this place, even a pig could become a celestial being!
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, “Are you talking about the guy that I killed with a single palm strike just now?”
“He’s nothing but a piece of trash,” Hang Tianqiao said coldly. “However, even if he’s a piece of trash, he’s still a member of our Hang Clan. It’s not up to you to kill him.”
“Sigh, so much nonsense.” Ling Han shook his head

“Heh, since you’re in such a rush to die, I’ll oblige you!” Hang Tianqiao strode towards Ling Han. In this place, the gravity fields were terrifying, and even those at the Core Formation Tier wouldn’t be able to soar into the sky. However, the ground here was incredibly firm, and attacks at the level of the Core Formation Tier couldn’t damage it at all. Thus, even if they battled on the ground, they wouldn’t cause much damage.
He had already approached, and then shot out a punch.
Ling Han stretched out his hand, his index and middle fingers forming the shape of shears. With a light pinch, the fist that Hang Tianqiao had thrown came to an abrupt stop.
‘What?’

Hang Tianqiao did not speak, but the expression on his face clearly said these words. How was this possible? Although his punch hadn’t unleashed its full might, Ling Han had stopped it with just two fingers. Just how terrifying was his power?
“Hehe, after bragging for so long, you ended up being slapped in the face. How do you feel?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Hang Tianqiao did not answer. Instead, he gave a loud shout. Boom, a majestic light burst out of the palm of his hand, turning into an ice phoenix that pounced towards Ling Han.

In the first place, he was already very close to Ling Han. Thus, this attack had arrived in front of Ling Han in a flash, practically not giving Ling Han any chance to dodge or parry. He had succeeded!
A smile appeared on Hang Tianqiao’s face. With this strike, Ling Han should be dead for sure. Hu!

However, he was shocked to see that Ling Han puffed up slightly before blowing out, easily blowing the ice phoenix into pieces. Then, the cold wind blew towards him, making him feel as if all the blood in his body had been frozen. Then, he felt nothing. It was not because the cold air had disappeared, but rather because it was too cold, and had damaged his nerves.

This was an attack that he had delivered. He naturally knew how terrifying this ice-like energy was. Though it had been blown apart by Ling Han, causing its might to decrease greatly, it could still be considered domineering. If all of this was blasted onto him, how terrifying would that be?
He hurriedly channelled his mystical power to expel the invading ice-element energy.
Ling Han shook lightly, and Hang Tianqiao was sent flying.

Hang Tianqiao also shook his body, and instantly, a large amount of shattered ice fell. He was a Body Arts cultivator, so his physique was tough. With the mystical power driving him, he soon recovered.
“I underestimated you!” He looked at Ling Han, and his expression became solemn, with a sliver of wariness.
He could not disperse his own attack so easily. Thus, Ling Han’s mystical power was definitely superior to his. However, he was only solemn and not afraid of battle, because he still had Body Art.
This was the strength of Mountain Sea Heaven cultivators, and was something that cultivators from the outside world could only envy but not reach.
“Afraid now?” Ling Han asked calmly.

Hang Tianqiao humphed, “Do you think I’m afraid of you? Hehe, you cultivators from the outside world only cultivate martial arts, yet have completely overlooked the cultivation of Body Art. You would have no idea at all, how powerful defense would be after Body Art becomes strong, and how terrifying its attack power would be!”
He gave a loud shout, and charged towards Ling Han. Peng, peng, peng! As he ran, the ground trembled madly, as if a primitive dragon elephant was running.
Xiu, as if he had turned into a streak of light, his speed was extremely fast. He actually used himself as a weapon, and crashed towards Ling Han.
This was purely taking on Ling Han head-on with his physique. My physique is as tough as Divine Metal of the same level, and I myself am a deadly weapon.
Hehe, competing with him in physique?
Ling Han laughed loudly. Fine, then let’s have a competition to see whose physique was
stronger.
He also started to run, crashing straight towards Hang Tianqiao.
Yi, are you seeking death?

Hang Tianqiao sneered internally. Ling Han’s mystical power was superior to his, so he should make full use of this advantage, pull out the distance and attack him. It should be known that Body Arts was most adept in close-quarter combat.
Fine, I’ll oblige you!
Peng!
Neither of them had any intention of dodging, so they naturally crashed into each other.

Hang Tianqiao felt as if his body of flesh and blood had crashed into an iron plate. He could clearly feel his skin rupture, his muscles tear, his blood vessels burst one after another, and his bones had also turned into pieces. In fact, his internal organs had also shattered under the
pressure.
‘Holy f*ck! This guy’s physique is actually more powerful than mine!’
Then, he lost consciousness.
Ling Han gave an ‘uh’, and with a light tremor, Hang Tianqiao was sent flying. However, the present Hang Tianqiao no longer looked human, but rather looked like he had turned into a
bloody pancake.
He was dead.
Ling Han scratched his head. This time, he really didn’t want to kill anyone, but who knew that Hang Tianqiao’s physique would be so fragile? It was shattered with a single crash.
Sigh, he was too weak.
So what if he was dead? In any case, he had already killed a member of the Hang Clan, so it did not matter if he killed one more.
News of this battle quickly spread. Though there was no Galaxy Network in the Mountain Sea Heaven, after so many years, the natives had also invented other means of communication.
Communication was not a problem.
“What, Hang Tianqiao was defeated?”
“Lost to an outsider?”
“How is this possible?”
“Although Hang Tianqiao can’t be considered a top-notch prodigy, he can still be ranked in
the top fifty on the level of the Core Formation Tier.”
“Compared to outsiders, we have also cultivated Body Art, so how could we possibly be no match for outsiders?”

The natives of Mountain Sea Heaven practically exploded in uproar. They were all unwilling to accept this result, and thought that they were the true number one force in the galaxy. Even the Imperial Clan was no match for them, and now Hang Tianqiao had been killed. This incited the public indignation of the younger generation of Mountain Sea Heaven. They all called on the few prodigies that were ranked higher to step out and suppress Ling Han, to regain the pride of Mountain Sea Heaven.

However, this was not the only conflict between outsiders and natives. Very quickly, it was revealed that a local prodigy had moved aggressively, and defeated an Imperial Son! When the news came out, it was like a stone had been thrown into a calm lake, causing an
astonishing ripple.
The Imperial Son... had actually lost?

This time, he really didn’t want to kill anyone, but who knew that Hang Tianqiao’s physique would be so fragile?
It was shattered with a single crash.
Sigh, he was too weak.
So what if he was dead?
In any case, he had already killed a member of the Hang Clan, so it did not matter if he killed one more.
News of this battle quickly spread.
Though there was no Galaxy Network in the Mountain Sea Heaven, after so many years, the natives had also invented other means of communication.
Communication was not a problem.
“What, Hang Tianqiao was defeated?”
“Lost to an outsider?”
“How is this possible?”
“Although Hang Tianqiao can’t be considered a top-notch prodigy, he can still be ranked in
the top fifty on the level of the Core Formation Tier.”
“Compared to outsiders, we have also cultivated Body Art, so how could we possibly be no match for outsiders?”
The natives of Mountain Sea Heaven practically exploded in uproar.
They were all unwilling to accept this result, and thought that they were the true number one force in the galaxy.
Even the Imperial Clan was no match for them, and now Hang Tianqiao had been killed.
This incited the public indignation of the younger generation of Mountain Sea Heaven.
They all called on the few prodigies that were ranked higher to step out and suppress Ling Han, to regain the pride of Mountain Sea Heaven.
However, this was not the only conflict between outsiders and natives.
Very quickly, it was revealed that a local prodigy had moved aggressively, and defeated an Imperial Son!
When the news came out, it was like a stone had been thrown into a calm lake, causing an
astonishing ripple.
The Imperial Son... had actually lost?

chapters.title: Chapter 4171: The Imperial Son is defeated
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han recognized this Imperial Son who had been defeated. His name was Xu Jie.

When he had been at the True Dragon Abyss, Xu Jie was also one of the few people who had obtained the Dragon Essence. He had even fought fiercely with Ling Han, and his abilities were quite impressive. He had not thought that he would actually lose at the hands of a native.

“Xu Jie’s power is about 31 Heavens, and added with the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess can reach 34 Heavens.” Ling Han murmured, “However, I believe that Xu Jie can’t possibly use the Imperial Blood. After all, it doesn’t involve benefits and life-and-death battles at present, so it’s not worth it to waste a chance to combust the Imperial Blood.”

Even if the members of Imperial Clans had a way to stimulate Imperial Blood, they would still have to pay an exorbitant price. Ling Han had heard Chi Menghan say that the blood of a Saint had to be used as a medium, and it would be a loss in terms of the bigger picture. Thus, only the Imperial Son could enjoy this kind of “benefit”.
“The person who defeated Xu Jie is called An Siyuan, and he is the third strongest elite in Core Formation Tier of the Mountain Sea Heaven.”

Ling Han found out about the situation. Being able to defeat the Imperial Son, he would become a prodigy that everyone would pay attention to no matter where he went. For example, he had only truly become famous in the galaxy from his defeat of Lin Lang onwards.

And now, the natives were also boiling over. Though Hang Tianqiao had lost, he could not be considered an elite, and what kind of concept was the Imperial Son in the outside world? A synonym for invincibility among his peers.
Thus, An Siyuan’s victory signified that he had trampled all of the prodigies of the outside world under his feet.
Was there any need to challenge Ling Han?
Of course, there was no need. Could you be as awesome as the Imperial Son?
Hehe, what a joke.

The natives here had no lack of understanding of the outside world, because the majority of them were actually the descendants left behind by generations of outsiders here. Essentially, there was not much difference.
And in the circle of outsiders, it also caused a huge commotion.
The Imperial Son had actually lost!

This was inconceivable! The synonym for invincibility among those at the same cultivation level had now suffered repeated rebuke. First, there was Ling Han, then there was the little azure dragon, and now even a native was so awesome. In future, who would be able to equate the words “invincible among those at the same cultivation level” with the words “Imperial Son”?
In order to rectify his name, an Imperial Son immediately issued a challenge to An Siyuan, and the result?
Defeat!

Hiss, there was only one Imperial Son that had lost, and it could be attributed to poor performance, poor condition, and slightly bad luck. However, two Imperial Sons had been defeated. This only meant one thing, and that was this An Siyuan was really powerful.
Not long after this had happened, a third Imperial Son moved. In the end, he had still suffered a terrible defeat.

“That An Siyuan’s mystical power is only at 24 Heavens. However, his Body Art is too terrifying. His pure physical power has already reached 31 Heavens, and when he uses his mystical power at the same time, his power can reach 33 Heavens.”
“Furthermore, Body Arts’s defense is astonishing, and the damage caused by their attacks is pitifully small.”
“That’s right. Unless you can suppress him in terms of battle prowess, it would really be difficult to succeed!”

“Damn it, before the True Self Tier, Body Arts are the most advantageous. After advancing into the True Self Tier, we’ll be able to cultivate the Regulations, which can cause double the damage to Body Arts.”
“It just has to be this cultivation level!”
After these three battles, An Siyuan’s strength was naturally clear. His abilities were practically transparent, but it was precisely because of this that people were in despair.

At the level of the Core Formation Tier, Body Arts was the most awesome. Cultivators of mystical power were unable to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth, and there was practically nothing they could do against powerful Body Arts.

For example, in the battle between Ling Han and the little azure dragon, it was clear that Ling Han had the advantage in battle prowess, but the little azure dragon merely took it head-on with its tough physique, and was only beaten black and blue. And this was still because Ling Han’s abilities were stronger. Now, An Siyuan’s battle prowess was superior to the Imperial Son, so it was naturally a complete defeat.

In the eyes of outsiders, the Mountain Sea Heaven was only a small place, pitifully small, but in such a small place, someone that could defeat the Imperial Son actually appeared. This was a great blow to everyone’s hearts.
“It should be known that An Siyuan is only the third strongest elite, so just how powerful would the second and first place be?”
“Sigh, if our Golden Generation could make a move, we would definitely let these natives know what true strength is!”
“Oh, that’s right. Don’t we still have the Imperial Son Killer, Ling Han, and the Imperial Daughter Killer, the Four-Legged Snake? Let them attack!”
A voice rang out among the outsiders, and that was to ask Ling Han and little azure dragon to move and challenge An Siyuan.
They shouted at the natives that once these two deadly power were used, whatever An Siyuan, he would immediately become a coward and hide away.

The natives naturally did not believe this. In their understanding, the most powerful among the outsiders was the Imperial Son, a synonym for invincibility among his peers. Oh, and now you have defeated three Imperial Sons, yet make up an Imperial Son Killer now. One look and they could tell that this was fake.
Oh, when he defeated Ling Han, would another Killer of Imperial Son Killers appear?
Was there no end to this?
Sore loser!

The argument between the two sides became more and more intense. In the Mountain Sea Heaven, there were also turbulent undercurrents, and it was possible that they would start fighting at any time. Furthermore, once they started fighting, it would be a group battle.
Right at this moment, the Donglin Imperial Clan suddenly hosted a banquet, inviting all the outsiders and native prodigies for tea and discuss dao.
When the news spread out, the entire Mountain Sea Heaven was in an uproar.

The current generation of the Donglin Imperial Clan was one where the yin flourishes and the yang declines1. The Imperial Daughter, Chi Menghan, claimed to be comparable to the Golden Generation, and was also the seductive beauty ranked third on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard. Thus, this banquet was definitely hosted by her. Thus, whether it was outsiders or natives, they were all overjoyed and decided to attend this banquet.
“If Celestial maiden Chi makes a move, she would be able to redeem the pride of the Imperial Clans!”
“It is said that Fairy Chi is capable of matching the Golden Generation.”
“Humph, it’s time to deal with those country bumpkins. Do they really think that they are invincible in this world?”
This was the voice of an outsider, and among the natives, it was naturally a completely different voice. They were filled with fanatical confidence in An Siyuan and the other prodigies.
“Haha, what Golden Generation? In front of Lord An, Lord Yi, and Lord Hua, they can’t even withstand a single blow.”
“I heard that this Imperial Daughter from the Donglin Imperial Clan is the third most beautiful woman on the Exquisite Leaderboard? Hehe, just let Lord An take her then.”
“If that’s really the case, who knows how red-faced with embarrassment those so-called Imperial Sons would be.”
In short, both sides were very expectant. The conflict between outsiders and natives had already accumulated to the point that it was about to explode. This was an opportunity.
Ling Han also received an invitation. The little azure dragon also received one, and the large black dog also received one.
“Haha, just see Grandpa Dog unleash his might, insta-killing everything in his way!” The large black dog shook his behind, and iron underwear was still the most eye-catching item.

It had already advanced the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to the Core Formation Tier chapter, and its cultivation level had also advanced by leaps and bounds, approaching the end of the Core Formation Tier. It was very likely that it would break through to the True Self Tier before Ling Han did.
It couldn’t be helped. Ling Han pursued absolute perfection, so his advancement would naturally be correspondingly slower.
“Old Black, it’s not that Grandpa Dragon wants to strike a blow on you, but you really can’t,” the little azure dragon said with a serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 4172: Banquet
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Woof, you actually dare to say that Grandpa Dog can’t?1.” The large black dog immediately jumped up, “You can’t, your whole family can’t. Grandpa Dog is very capable, very awesome!”
The little azure dragon was extremely detestable, and it said, “If even my entire family can’t do it, then how did Grandpa Dragon come into being?”
Ling Han’s expression darkened. There were so many unreliable “people” by his side!

“Old Black, Four-Legged Snake has a point.” He said to the large black dog, “Your mystical power is only about 35 Heavens, which is not inferior to An Siyuan. However, you have just begun to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique’s Core Formation Tier chapter, and Body Art is not of much help yet, so you are definitely no match for An Siyuan.”

One of the unique traits of the Body Art was its strong defense. Furthermore, it did not need to be maintained with mystical power. It lasted for a long time. Thus, it had an especially great advantage in battle.
The large black dog was depressed, “Why can’t we hold the banquet a few days later? Otherwise, it would be a great opportunity for Grandpa Dog to flip out!”
“You just watch the excitement,” Ling Han said.
“That’s right. Leave the fighting to Grandpa Dragon and Little Han.” The little azure dragon also added in.
The large black dog was extremely displeased. Wasn’t the purpose of cultivating such strength just to show off?

Two days passed in the blink of an eye, and it was already the day that the Donglin Imperial Clan would host a banquet at the Imperial Clan Residence. When it was close to evening, chariot after chariot headed towards the temporary base of the Donglin Imperial Clan.

Ordinary carriages couldn’t possibly travel in the Mountain Sea Heaven. The gravity fields were too terrifying, and could easily destroy everything. Thus, chariots could only be mobilized. These chariots were built for battle, so they could naturally adapt to all kinds of harsh conditions.

Ling Han and the others were poor. They lacked background, so they naturally couldn’t possess chariots. Moreover, this matter didn’t alert the Nine Suns Holy Land. Otherwise, Ling Han could borrow one from the Nine Mountains Venerate.
“It’s fine. This is called keeping a low profile.”
“Keep a low profile, and then show off. Let’s see if you’re afraid.”
The large black dog and little azure dragon consoled themselves as they watched chariot after chariot fly by.
After walking for a while, they finally arrived at the encampment of the Donglin Imperial Clan.

This was the Imperial Clan, and they were led by Saints. It was unknown whether they had brought the Imperial Weapon over as well, but the name of Imperial Clan was already powerful enough. They occupied one of the best places to cultivate. Regulations filled the skies here, and the heaven and earth energy here was indescribably dense.
There were people assigned to receive them, and the examination was very strict. Those who did not have an invitation card could forget about sneaking in.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think back to the last time he had gone to the Donglin Imperial Clan to attend the banquet. At the time, he hadn’t had an invitation, and it was Chi Mengshan who had brought him in.
Yi, why was the Donglin Imperial Clan so fond of hosting banquets? What was wrong with them?

After passing the examination, Ling Han and the others continued onwards. Because there were too many people, and it was inevitable that there would be a battle during the so-called “discussion of dao”, the venue for this banquet was naturally arranged in the open air. Only some tables and chairs were needed.

At this moment, a large number of people had already arrived. They were all in groups of three to five, communicating among themselves. However, it could be clearly seen that there was a clear separation between outsiders and natives.
“Little Han, how do you plan on showing off?” the large black dog approached and asked.
Ling Han glared at it, “Don’t just have such narrow-minded thoughts all day long.”
“Oh.” The large black dog turned around and left.
However, it had just left, when the little azure dragon approached, “Little Han, how do you plan on showing off?”
‘F*ck! Have you guys made an agreement to ask the same thing before this?’

Ling Han was rendered speechless, and he immediately found a table to sit down. He poured himself a cup of tea, and began to savor it. To be honest, he still missed the fine wine of the Donglin Imperial Clan. Why had they switched to tea this time?
It couldn’t be that he had drunk them into poverty, right?
“Is this where you are sitting?” Immediately, a voice rang out by his ear.

Ling Han turned around to look. This was a native. It wasn’t because his attire was different from the people outside, but rather because he hadn’t activated the mystical power shield. The words “Body Arts” were practically enough to explain his identity.
“What is it? Can’t I sit here?” he asked calmly.
“Humph, are you provoking?” That native asked balefully, already bringing with him a strong chill.

Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings. Oh, no wonder. There were natives all around him. This could be considered as him having entered into a wolf’s den. However, since he had already sat down, he had no plans to get up again.
“There’s no rule that states where one can sit, so I can sit wherever I want,” he said with a smile.
“That would have to depend on whether you have that kind of ability or not!” That native moved, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
However, with a wave of Ling Han’s hand, peng, the native was sent flying, lying on the ground and groaning.
“Little Han, you still say you don’t want to show off? See, Grandpa Dog has just left, and you’re already starting to act cool,” the large black dog immediately said.
“That’s right, you are so mean,” the little azure dragon also grumbled. He was also an incredibly coquettish dragon.
Ling Han sighed, and shrugged, “I really have no intention of showing off.”
“Sigh, this unintentional show-off is even more fatal!” the large black dog exclaimed ruefully.
“That’s right, that’s right!” The little azure dragon nodded in agreement.
‘Holy f*ck! These two idiots!’
Ling Han didn’t plan to pay any attention to them. However, a native had been sent flying, and this was in their territory at that. How could the other natives let the matter go?
Instantly, a large number of natives looked over. A considerable number had already stood up, and were approaching Ling Han’s table.
“It’s time for a fight!” The large black dog rubbed his paws together in excitement.
“It’s time for Grandpa Dragon to show off.” The little azure dragon was also filled with anticipation.
“You are Ling Han!” One of the natives recognized Ling Han, “The one who beat Hang Tianqiao to death!”
When these words fell, the eyes of all the natives froze, and their fury blazed even hotter.
‘F*ck! We haven’t called you for an accounting yet, yet you’ve already come to bully us?’
Ling Han’s expression became serious, and he said, “I want to make it clear that I wasn’t the one who killed Hang Tianqiao.”
He was the one who had killed himself. If he had to blame someone, he could only blame his Body Arts for not being strong enough. It was really not him who had done it.
However, in the eyes of the natives, Ling Han was clearly cowering.
This was very natural. Even the Imperial Son had lost, so what was he worth?
“Since you are cowering, you should adjust your attitude first!”
“Kneel!”
All the natives shouted. You have come to admit cowardice, but what is the meaning of sitting so boldly?

Ling Han was surprised. “What’s wrong with your brains? When did I say that I was going to cower? Could it be that not only do you guys have intelligence problems, but your ears also don’t work well?”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The natives were instantly enraged. Why was this brat’s mouth so vicious?
“Beat him up!” someone immediately shouted.
“Beat him up!” Even more people agreed.
The large black dog looked at the little azure dragon and said earnestly, “See, this is the consequence of showing off too much. You’ll be beaten.”
“En, en, en.” The little azure dragon nodded repeatedly. Showing off was a major problem.

“Everyone, the banquet is about to begin. Would you all please sit down?” A lively voice rang out, and a beautiful figure appeared in front of everyone. Her white dress could not conceal her ample and beautiful curves, causing one’s imagination to run wild.
The Imperial Daughter Chi Menghan.
