Ling Han turned around to look.
This was a native.
It wasn’t because his attire was different from the people outside, but rather because he hadn’t activated the mystical power shield.
The words “Body Arts” were practically enough to explain his identity.
“What is it?
Can’t I sit here?” he asked calmly.
“Humph, are you provoking?” That native asked balefully, already bringing with him a strong chill.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings.
Oh, no wonder.
There were natives all around him.
This could be considered as him having entered into a wolf’s den.
However, since he had already sat down, he had no plans to get up again.
“There’s no rule that states where one can sit, so I can sit wherever I want,” he said with a smile.
“That would have to depend on whether you have that kind of ability or not!” That native moved, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
However, with a wave of Ling Han’s hand, peng, the native was sent flying, lying on the ground and groaning.
“Little Han, you still say you don’t want to show off?
See, Grandpa Dog has just left, and you’re already starting to act cool,” the large black dog immediately said.
“That’s right, you are so mean,” the little azure dragon also grumbled.
He was also an incredibly coquettish dragon.
Ling Han sighed, and shrugged, “I really have no intention of showing off.”
“Sigh, this unintentional show-off is even more fatal!” the large black dog exclaimed ruefully.
“That’s right, that’s right!” The little azure dragon nodded in agreement.
‘Holy f*ck!
These two idiots!’
Ling Han didn’t plan to pay any attention to them.
However, a native had been sent flying, and this was in their territory at that.
How could the other natives let the matter go?
Instantly, a large number of natives looked over.
A considerable number had already stood up, and were approaching Ling Han’s table.
“It’s time for a fight!” The large black dog rubbed his paws together in excitement.
“It’s time for Grandpa Dragon to show off.” The little azure dragon was also filled with anticipation.
“You are Ling Han!” One of the natives recognized Ling Han, “The one who beat Hang Tianqiao to death!”
When these words fell, the eyes of all the natives froze, and their fury blazed even hotter.
‘F*ck!
We haven’t called you for an accounting yet, yet you’ve already come to bully us?’
Ling Han’s expression became serious, and he said, “I want to make it clear that I wasn’t the one who killed Hang Tianqiao.”
He was the one who had killed himself.
If he had to blame someone, he could only blame his Body Arts for not being strong enough.
It was really not him who had done it.
However, in the eyes of the natives, Ling Han was clearly cowering.
This was very natural.
Even the Imperial Son had lost, so what was he worth?
“Since you are cowering, you should adjust your attitude first!”
“Kneel!”
All the natives shouted.
You have come to admit cowardice, but what is the meaning of sitting so boldly?
Ling Han was surprised.
“What’s wrong with your brains?
When did I say that I was going to cower?
Could it be that not only do you guys have intelligence problems, but your ears also don’t work well?”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The natives were instantly enraged.
Why was this brat’s mouth so vicious?
“Beat him up!” someone immediately shouted.
“Beat him up!” Even more people agreed.
The large black dog looked at the little azure dragon and said earnestly, “See, this is the consequence of showing off too much.
You’ll be beaten.”
“En, en, en.” The little azure dragon nodded repeatedly.
Showing off was a major problem.
“Everyone, the banquet is about to begin.
Would you all please sit down?” A lively voice rang out, and a beautiful figure appeared in front of everyone.
Her white dress could not conceal her ample and beautiful curves, causing one’s imagination to run wild.
The Imperial Daughter Chi Menghan.

chapters.title: Chapter 4173: Tasting Tea and Discussing Dao
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Imperial Daughter still had a lot of face.

After all, there were only a few people who could defeat the Imperial Son. The Imperial Clan was still high and noble, and would not fall to the ground just because three Imperial Sons had lost. Furthermore, Chi Menghan was also a beauty, an exquisite seductive beauty, and could be ranked in the top three in the universe.
Faced with such a beauty, everyone would have to give her some face.

Thus, all the natives sat down, but they all frowned at Ling Han. For now, they would suppress their anger. When they “discussed dao” later, they would definitely let this guy know how powerful he was.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and continued to drink his tea.
“F*ck! You’ve become even more impressive!” the large black dog said in an exaggerated manner.
“You didn’t get a beating for showing off? How illogical!” The little azure dragon also sat at the table, poured itself some tea, and began to drink.
“En, good tea!” he said, shaking his head.
“Stop pretending,” Ling Han said with a cold chuckle.
This guy had never drunk tea at all, yet now he looked like he understood the art of tea very well.

The little azure dragon couldn’t help but fly into a humiliated rage after being exposed. If it weren’t for the fact that he couldn’t defeat Ling Han, he would definitely beat this guy up. He kept affecting his ability to show off.
On the other side, Chi Menghan, as the host, also began to host the banquet.
She was extremely charismatic, and even if she said something unimportant, everyone would nod repeatedly, not feeling bored at all.
However, the highlight of this banquet was still the “discussion of dao”. Thus, Chi Menghan didn’t beat around the bush, and soon returned to the main topic.
“Haha, I am Hu Xu. Who would like to spar with me?” A bearded man leaped out, and arrived at the empty space in front of them. It was wide enough here to support the battle of Core Formation Tiers.

—In the Mountain Sea Heaven, the ground was incredibly firm, and the damage that the Core Formation Tier cultivators could cause was limited. Furthermore, the gravity fields were terrifying, which greatly affected the speed of cultivators. Thus, there was no need for a large place for the Core Formation Tier cultivators to spar.
This bearded man was a native, and he didn’t use his mystical power as a shield, appearing very domineering.
“Let me spar with you!” An outsider leaped out, and without another word, the two of them began fighting.
The two sides exchanged blows, and the battle was extremely intense.
Those who could come here to attend the banquet, whether they were outsiders or natives, were definitely prodigy-level. Nobodies were definitely not qualified.
In the first place, this was a stage for prodigies from both sides to compete, so what was the point of letting mediocre people waste their time here?
The battle became more and more intense, but as time passed, the advantage of the natives was displayed.
They had lived here all this while, and had long since adapted to the terrifying gravity fields. Furthermore, their physiques were tough, and their defenses existed as if they were born with it.

Thus, if one couldn’t defeat them as easily as crushing dry weeds and smashing rotten wood, in a drawn-out battle, the advantage of the native’s physique being tough would become greater and greater, and ultimately, form a winning situation.
As expected, after only ten minutes of fighting, the bearded man’s advantage was fully displayed, defeating his opponent, adding another victory to the native camp.
This caused the expressions of the outsiders to become ugly.

Though neither side had sent out their trump card, every victory and defeat would affect the pride of both sides. Whoever lost would be equivalent to having suffered a slap, which was a very terrible sensation.
“Liu Ming is one of the top 10 of the Galaxy Network, yet he was defeated so quickly!”
“No one of the top 10 in the Galaxy Network should step up anymore. Even if they go up, we’ll only lose one more battle.”
“It has to be stronger.”

The Galaxy Network did not include all the young prodigies. It was not only the Imperial Clans that did not connect to the Galaxy Network. It was the same for a great many Holy Lands. Thus, there were naturally some that had “slipped through the net”. Even if they were not the Imperial Clan members, their strength had still surpassed the top ten of the Galaxy Network.
A Dao Child from a Holy Land moved, and soon defeated the bearded man, turning the tables for the outsiders.
However, another elite immediately walked out from the natives, easily defeating this Dao Child.
“Lu Feng, ranked tenth in Mountain Sea Heaven!”

This was a fierce person. Though he was inferior to An Siyuan, who had defeated the Imperial Son, the “ten great elites” had already made their move, which meant that the natives were not interested in slowly raising the level of their battle, and directly entering into this climax.
The outsiders all exchanged looks. The other side had mobilized the top ten elites, and it looked like they would have to mobilize the Imperial Sons.
“I’ll go,” a young man said calmly, walking out with his hands clasped behind his back.
“Shi Yuanzhen!” everyone exclaimed in shock. This was a genuine Imperial Son.

Ling Han glanced at him, and shook his head internally. Shi Yuanzhen and Xu Jie’s strength were not much different. He may be able to win one or two battles, but it was definitely impossible that he could defeat An Siyuan.
As expected, the Imperial Son moved, and his battle prowess was terrifying. Very soon, he had obtained a victory, and next, he had won all three battles, dazzling the eyes of the natives.
The Imperial Son was indeed powerful. No wonder he was invincible among his peers.
However, the natives were still filled with confidence, because their top three elites were completely different, each stronger than the last. Furthermore, they were not just a little bit stronger.
Xiu, a person leaped out. He had a slender figure, and his face was also extraordinarily long, looking incredibly cold.
“An Siyuan!”
“Lord An!”
Instantly, the natives howled madly, as if they had gone mad.

The outsiders had the Golden Generation, and the Mountain Sea Heaven had something similar. An Siyuan, Yi Qianhong, and Hua Youchang were members of their Golden Generation. However, there were relatively few of them,only three of them.
However, quality was more important than quantity. Three people was enough.
Shi Yuanzhen immediately looked solemn. This was a strong opponent, and he did not have the slightest chance of winning.
On the other hand, An Siyuan’s expression was relaxed. He had already defeated three Imperial Sons, so he was naturally filled with confidence.
“Please!” Shi Yuanzhen clasped his hands and said. He now had a bit more respect for powerful opponents.
Although An Siyuan was cold and aloof, he didn’t dare to act too haughtily before the Imperial Son. Instead, he clasped his hands and said, “Please!”
As his words fell, the two great prodigies began a fierce exchange of blows.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
They continued to battle, and it wasn’t long before their advantage was revealed.
An Siyuan had the upper hand.

His power was stronger, and his physique was more powerful. If there were any shortcomings, it would be celestial technique. After all, he did not have the inheritance of the great Imperial Scroll and great Imperial Technique. In this aspect, he was inferior to the Imperial Son, but if one did not reach the level of the True Self Tier in the great Imperial Scroll and Imperial Technique, it actually did not have much of an advantage over a Saint-level celestial technique.
Thus, An Siyuan had completely suppressed Shi Yuanzhen, and his advantage was not just by a little bit.
In just a few hundred moves, Shi Yuanzhen admitted defeat on his own volition. Otherwise, he would be in for a lot of trouble.
Another Imperial Son had been defeated.
Counting Xu Jie and the others from before, there were already four Imperial Sons that had been defeated, causing all the outsiders to look livid.
This was too demoralizing to their morale.
On the other hand, the natives were all exalted and proud.

“Who wants to spar next?” An Siyuan swept his gaze over the gathered masses. This time, it was a tea tasting and dao discussion, so it was naturally impossible that there would only be a single Imperial Son.
Was there anyone stronger?
“Let me try.” A young man walked out.
Golden Silk Moth Imperial Clan, Zhang Fang.
Ling Han couldn’t help but nod, and said, “In this guy’s case, he has a seventy percent chance of winning.”
“70%?” The little azure dragon was slightly surprised. He and the large black dog had both witnessed Zhang Fang’s strength. Was there such a high chance of winning?

chapters.title: Chapter 4174: Drunk on Tea
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han nodded, and said, “You guys have only seen Zhang Fang move, and have never actually battled with him, so you don’t know him very well. His original power has reached 35 Heavens, and if he channels the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess can reach 38 Heavens. This is enough to tear through An Si Yuan’s defenses.”
“Hence, if An Siyuan is only at his current level, then he would definitely be no match for Zhang Fang. The other thirty percent chance is based on An Siyuan’s trump card.”
“Without a trump card, Zhang Fang has a 100% chance of winning.”
The little azure dragon and the large black dog both nodded. Only Ling Han had fought with Zhang Fang before, so Ling Han definitely knew the situation better than them.
They were discussing spiritedly, and if they were in the area of outsiders, there would be no problem at all, but to say this among the natives... it immediately attracted a great many furious gazes.
F***, in their camp, he still dared to speak badly of An Siyuan?
“Humph, just wait and see how Lord An will unleash his might.”
“Facts speak louder than anything else. Just wait to be slapped in the face.”
“After Lord An defeats all Imperial Sons, we’ll come challenge this detestable guy.”
“All right!”
These people did not lower their voices either, and deliberately allowed Ling Han to hear them clearly.
Ling Han merely smiled, completely unconcerned.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon jumped onto the table, and said, “Remember what you’re saying now. Don’t forget to challenge Little Han later. Whoever doesn’t step out will be a b@stard!”
This kind of provocation naturally made the natives very displeased. It was just a four-legged snake, and it actually dared to shout at them.
“Kill this outsider first, then stew this Four-Legged Snake!”
As they conversed, the battle between Zhang Fang and An Siyuan had already begun.

An Siyuan was indeed powerful, with his raw power reaching as high as 33 Heavens. However, this was still inferior to Zhang Fang, and he was still a whopping three Heavens inferior to Zhang Fang’s battle prowess. Thus, he was at a disadvantage upon clashing with Zhang Fang, and he was completely suppressed. However, his powerful physique was indeed impressive. Even though he was being suppressed by an advantage of three Heavens in battle prowess, he was still able to defend with great perseverance. He didn’t collapse with a single strike.
Otherwise, if there was a gap of three Heavens in battle prowess, the result would be being insta-killed.
This result immediately silenced the natives. The gap in strength was obvious. No one could lie through their teeth, right?
An Siyuan resisted in all ways, trying to find a chance to turn the tables, but in the end, in terms of trump cards, who could match the Imperial Clan?
Thus, being suppressed by the Imperial Clan member in strength, there was definitely no hope of turning the tables.
After several dozen more exchanges, An Siyuan was already riddled with wounds. In fact, even his bones could be seen from a few of his wounds. This was an extremely harrowing sight.
He had no choice but to admit defeat. If he continued to fight, he would not just suffer superficial injuries.
Cheers instantly erupted among the outsiders when they saw An Siyuan being defeated. After defeating four Imperial Sons in a row, he had finally managed to bite off more than he could chew.
On the other hand, the expressions of the natives were extremely ugly.
But only after a while, someone called out, “Hua Youchang!”
“Lord Hua!”
“Lord Hua!”
“Lord Hua!”
The natives all roared loudly, their voices like a tsunami, wave after wave.
Hua Youchang, one of the three prodigies of the Mountain Sea Heaven, ranked above even An Siyuan.
Where was he?

Ling Han followed everyone’s gaze, and involuntarily, the corners of his mouth twitched. That was because the focus of everyone’s attention was on the table next to his. A man was presently seated and drinking tea, but one of his legs was raised onto a chair. It was bared as well, and the corner of his pants was also curled up onto his calf, revealing long black leg hair.
Er, what a rough guy.
Ling Han’s eyes moved further upwards. This bare-footed man had a thin figure, but his hands were long and black, the joints popping out like bamboo.
He held the teacup in one hand, while his other hand was rubbing his foot.
Er, what a personality.
‘Hua Youchang?’
Judging by the name, this should be a coquettish and bewitching man. The name was completely incompatible with this young man who was picking his feet1.
“Please move, Lord Hua!” A man half-knelt, and said to the man who was picking at his feet.
“Lord Hua, please move!” More people knelt down, inviting this person to battle.
Yi, this guy was really Hua Youchang.
This was too f*cking blinding.
Ling Han cursed madly in his heart. This persona was really too ruined, wasn’t it?

At this moment, Hua Youchang put down his teacup. He searched for a while, and his bare feet were stuffed into his straw sandals. He stood up, and walked forwards. However, he had only taken two steps, when peng, he collapsed.
“Oh no, Lord Hua is drunk!”
“F***, outsiders are too treacherous, to actually use such underhanded means to make Lord Hua unable to take the field!”
All the natives exclaimed in unison, all of them looking furious.
Drunk on tea?
Ling Han couldn’t help but grimace. There were too many things to complain about. For a moment, he didn’t even know where to start.

Just as everyone was about to lift Hua Youchang up, peng, those people separated like flowers scattered by a celestial maiden, and Hua Youchang had already stood up. His eyes were as red as blood, and his whole body was exuding an incredibly terrifying killing intent, causing one to shiver all over.
“Oh no, Lord Hua is extremely drunk this time. He’s gone crazy from being drunk!” someone said in a trembling voice.
“Run!”
Everyone dispersed, as if avoiding snakes and scorpions.
“Lord Hua who’s gone mad with drunkenness, his battle prowess is even three times higher than usual, and... in short, it’s too terrifying!”
Seeing this, Zhang Fang couldn’t help but humph and charge over.
There was no one in the surroundings, and Hua Youchang was a little dazed. At this moment, Zhang Fang charged over, giving him a target. He immediately shouted loudly, and charged towards Zhang Fang.
Boom!
The two prodigies exchanged a blow, instantly setting off tumultuous waves.
Ling Han’s eyes involuntarily lit up. This Hua Youchang was not bad, amazing!

He was very familiar with Zhang Fang’s strength, so it was very easy for him to deduce Hua Youchang’s strength. His original power was about 36 Heavens, and was slightly stronger than Zhang Fang. However, in terms of the celestial technique, Zhang Fang was naturally slightly superior. Thus, the two of them just happened to fight to a tie.
If they fought to a tie, that also meant that if Zhang Fang didn’t have any special methods, he would lose.
It couldn’t be helped. In a drawn-out battle, Body Arts definitely had the advantage.
However, after battling for a while longer, Ling Han discovered just how terrifying this drunk person was.

Hua Youchang’s current style of fighting completely lacked the demeanor of an elite. Though Body Arts was definitely a close-quarters battle, and he was trying his best to make full use of his advantage, he was really too extreme. Like an octopus, he entwined himself around Zhang Fang, his legs wrapped around Zhang Fang’s waist, his arms wrapped tightly around the latter’s neck. He even opened his mouth to bite at Zhang Fang’s cheek.
How could Zhang Fang deal with this?
As the Imperial Son, he had no choice but to admit defeat.
But it should be known that Hua Youchang was not aware now. Even if he admitted defeat, so what? He did not let go at all, causing Zhang Fang to cry out in pain.
Everyone was speechless. Was this the battle between prodigies that they were anticipating? This was completely a street brawl between rascals.
No wonder the expressions of the natives were so strange. A Hua Youchang that was drunk on tea was practically a pervert.

Thus, he was at a disadvantage upon clashing with Zhang Fang, and he was completely suppressed.
However, his powerful physique was indeed impressive.
Even though he was being suppressed by an advantage of three Heavens in battle prowess, he was still able to defend with great perseverance.
He didn’t collapse with a single strike.
Otherwise, if there was a gap of three Heavens in battle prowess, the result would be being insta-killed.
This result immediately silenced the natives.
The gap in strength was obvious.
No one could lie through their teeth, right?
An Siyuan resisted in all ways, trying to find a chance to turn the tables, but in the end, in terms of trump cards, who could match the Imperial Clan?
Thus, being suppressed by the Imperial Clan member in strength, there was definitely no hope of turning the tables.
After several dozen more exchanges, An Siyuan was already riddled with wounds.
In fact, even his bones could be seen from a few of his wounds.
This was an extremely harrowing sight.
He had no choice but to admit defeat.
If he continued to fight, he would not just suffer superficial injuries.
Cheers instantly erupted among the outsiders when they saw An Siyuan being defeated.
After defeating four Imperial Sons in a row, he had finally managed to bite off more than he could chew.
On the other hand, the expressions of the natives were extremely ugly.
But only after a while, someone called out, “Hua Youchang!”
“Lord Hua!”
“Lord Hua!”
“Lord Hua!”
The natives all roared loudly, their voices like a tsunami, wave after wave.
Hua Youchang, one of the three prodigies of the Mountain Sea Heaven, ranked above even An Siyuan.
Where was he?
Ling Han followed everyone’s gaze, and involuntarily, the corners of his mouth twitched.
That was because the focus of everyone’s attention was on the table next to his.
A man was presently seated and drinking tea, but one of his legs was raised onto a chair.
It was bared as well, and the corner of his pants was also curled up onto his calf, revealing long black leg hair.
Er, what a rough guy.
Ling Han’s eyes moved further upwards.
This bare-footed man had a thin figure, but his hands were long and black, the joints popping out like bamboo.
He held the teacup in one hand, while his other hand was rubbing his foot.
Er, what a personality.
‘Hua Youchang?’
Judging by the name, this should be a coquettish and bewitching man.
The name was completely incompatible with this young man who was picking his feet1.
“Please move, Lord Hua!” A man half-knelt, and said to the man who was picking at his feet.
“Lord Hua, please move!” More people knelt down, inviting this person to battle.
Yi, this guy was really Hua Youchang.
This was too f*cking blinding.
Ling Han cursed madly in his heart.
This persona was really too ruined, wasn’t it?
At this moment, Hua Youchang put down his teacup.
He searched for a while, and his bare feet were stuffed into his straw sandals.
He stood up, and walked forwards.
However, he had only taken two steps, when peng, he collapsed.
“Oh no, Lord Hua is drunk!”
“F***, outsiders are too treacherous, to actually use such underhanded means to make Lord Hua unable to take the field!”
All the natives exclaimed in unison, all of them looking furious.
Drunk on tea?
Ling Han couldn’t help but grimace.
There were too many things to complain about.
For a moment, he didn’t even know where to start.
Just as everyone was about to lift Hua Youchang up, peng, those people separated like flowers scattered by a celestial maiden, and Hua Youchang had already stood up.
His eyes were as red as blood, and his whole body was exuding an incredibly terrifying killing intent, causing one to shiver all over.
“Oh no, Lord Hua is extremely drunk this time.
He’s gone crazy from being drunk!” someone said in a trembling voice.
“Run!”
Everyone dispersed, as if avoiding snakes and scorpions.
“Lord Hua who’s gone mad with drunkenness, his battle prowess is even three times higher than usual, and... in short, it’s too terrifying!”
Seeing this, Zhang Fang couldn’t help but humph and charge over.
There was no one in the surroundings, and Hua Youchang was a little dazed.
At this moment, Zhang Fang charged over, giving him a target.
He immediately shouted loudly, and charged towards Zhang Fang.
Boom!
The two prodigies exchanged a blow, instantly setting off tumultuous waves.
Ling Han’s eyes involuntarily lit up.
This Hua Youchang was not bad, amazing!
He was very familiar with Zhang Fang’s strength, so it was very easy for him to deduce Hua Youchang’s strength.
His original power was about 36 Heavens, and was slightly stronger than Zhang Fang.
However, in terms of the celestial technique, Zhang Fang was naturally slightly superior.
Thus, the two of them just happened to fight to a tie.
If they fought to a tie, that also meant that if Zhang Fang didn’t have any special methods, he would lose.
It couldn’t be helped.
In a drawn-out battle, Body Arts definitely had the advantage.
However, after battling for a while longer, Ling Han discovered just how terrifying this drunk person was.
Hua Youchang’s current style of fighting completely lacked the demeanor of an elite.
Though Body Arts was definitely a close-quarters battle, and he was trying his best to make full use of his advantage, he was really too extreme.
Like an octopus, he entwined himself around Zhang Fang, his legs wrapped around Zhang Fang’s waist, his arms wrapped tightly around the latter’s neck.
He even opened his mouth to bite at Zhang Fang’s cheek.
How could Zhang Fang deal with this?
As the Imperial Son, he had no choice but to admit defeat.
But it should be known that Hua Youchang was not aware now.
Even if he admitted defeat, so what?
He did not let go at all, causing Zhang Fang to cry out in pain.
Everyone was speechless.
Was this the battle between prodigies that they were anticipating?
This was completely a street brawl between rascals.
No wonder the expressions of the natives were so strange.
A Hua Youchang that was drunk on tea was practically a pervert.

chapters.title: Chapter 4175: Licentious
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hua Youchang was gnawing and biting, without a shred of the bearing of an elite. He was completely a ruffian.
What was worse, he even stuffed his bare foot into Zhang Fang’s mouth, scaring the Golden Silk Moth Imperial Son so much that his face turned green, and he fled at all costs.

He was the Imperial Son, after all, and had astonishingly many tricks up his sleeve. He had really succeeded, but multiple wounds had also been left on his body, and he was in an extremely sorry state.
However, when Hua Youchang went crazy, he did not have any qualms at all. He broke out into a run and set off in pursuit of Zhang Fang.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Zhang Fang hurriedly ran, using all his strength.

Though he had cultivated an Emperor-level movement technique, so his speed should have been faster than Hua Youchang, the gravity fields here were too strong, and at the level of the Core Formation Tier, the advantage of the Imperial Technique was really not all that great. Thus, Hua Youchang’s speed was not the slightest bit inferior to his, and followed closely behind him.
One fled, while the other pursued, circling around the whole area.
This!
Originally, it should have been a competition on the level of the highest prodigy, but now, it was no different from a street brawl between ruffians and hoodlums, which was truly embarrassing.
The outcome of the battle had actually been decided, but Hua Youchang had gone mad, and pursued him relentlessly, forcing Zhang Fang to only be able to continuously flee. He could not stop at all.
Though the outsiders had ugly expressions, the natives were also feeling extremely awkward.
After another while, Hua Youchang suddenly stopped, then collapsed to the ground, snoring loudly.
Right, he had fallen into a deep slumber.
Zhang Fang finally breathed a sigh of relief, feeling something slippery on his face. It was most likely Hua Youchang’s drool, almost driving him crazy with his mysophobic nature.
Though this was a farce, it still could not change the result of the natives being stronger.

All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes turned to look at Chi Menghan. This was the strongest Imperial Daughter that was comparable to the Golden Generation. Perhaps, her battle prowess was even superior to Zhang Fang. If she made a move, she might have a chance of winning.
However, Chi Menghan acted as if she hadn’t seen anything.
What kind of joke was this? Fighting with a competitor like Hua Youchang? Being cuddled was not enough, and he was even forcefully stuffing his feet into your mouth. Are you afraid?

Sou, right at this moment, Hua Youchang suddenly stood up again, like a bamboo pole. He was a little dazed, and swept his gaze over the surroundings. Then, his eyes focused on Zhang Fang, “Come, let us have a spar.”
Spar your sister!

Zhang Fang mocked internally. The present Hua Youchang should have already woken up from his “intoxicated” state, yet had completely forgotten that he had gone “tea-crazy”. Thus, he did not remember that the two of them had already sparred, and was still provoking him.
However, even though Hua Youchang had regained consciousness, Zhang Fang still had a strong psychological trauma. He would never fight with such a competitor again.
“What is it? Are you afraid?” Hua Youchang continued to provoke him.
Zhang Fang turned a deaf ear to him. He could still smell the stench of drool on his face, making him gag.
“Lord Hua is mighty!”
“Lord Hua is awesome!”
The natives all shouted loudly, completely ignoring the feelings of outsiders.
“Is there anyone else who can fight?”
“If there’s no one who can fight, lower your head and tuck your tail between your legs. Don’t be arrogant!”
“That Imperial Daughter or whatever, come and fight with our Lord Hua. If you lose, why don’t you become Lord Hua’s wife?”
“Good, this is a good idea!”
The natives jeered one after another, causing all the outsiders’ expressions to darken, looking extremely ugly.

Chi Menghan was the Imperial Daughter, and the Imperial Clans were revered by the whole world. Additionally, Chi Menghan was ranked third on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard, so who didn’t admire her greatly?
Now, these natives were actually so insolent, publicly taking liberties with Chi Menghan. Who could tolerate this?
The problem was, which one of them could defeat Hua Youchang?
There was none!
If there wasn’t anyone, they could only shut their mouths obediently. In the cultivation world, strength was everything. If they didn’t have strength, they could only obediently take a beating.
“Little Han, it’s time for you to show off!” the large black dog egged him on.

The little azure dragon also nodded, “Originally, Grandpa Dragon wouldn’t have given such a good chance to you, but no matter how I look at it, Grandpa Dragon feels that the relations between you and that Imperial Clan woman are unclear. Thus, I will reluctantly let you have this chance to save the damsel in distress! Remember, you owe Grandpa Dragon a debt!”
“Get lost!” Ling Han sent the little azure dragon flying with a kick. What nonsense were you spouting!

“That brat!” Before Ling Han could fly into a rage, the natives in the vicinity could no longer hold themselves back. Their second strongest elite had already beaten the outsider into submission, which naturally represented their complete victory.
Now, it was time to settle the score with Ling Han.
He actually dared to kill one of their own. Humph, he was seeking death!
“Let me spar with you!” A sturdy man rushed over, and threw a punch at Ling Han.
His power was incomparably deep, and when his fist shot over, a strong wind whistled.
Ling Han didn’t dodge. Only when the other approached did he move. He also threw a punch to greet the other’s fist.
Peng!
The two fists crashed into each other, and instantly, a shockwave that was visible to the naked eye spread out. There was also light bursting forth, like lightning.
“Haha, to dare compete with Ouyang Ling in fists, where did this brat get his confidence from?”
“Ouyang is the elite ranked thirteenth. It’s said that his iron fists have been tempered in the flames of heaven. With a single punch, he can even shatter Divine Metal!”
“Heh, just wait and see this brat’s bones shatter one by one.”
The natives all laughed loudly. An outsider that cultivated mystical power actually dared to fight them head-on at close quarters? Hehe, where did he get such courage from?
However, amidst loud laughter, Ouyang Ling’s expression suddenly changed.

A large amount of cold sweat seeped out from his skin, as if a water sluice had been opened. Then, his face twisted, and his mouth opened, releasing an earth-shattering scream, “Ah—” It was long and drawn out, and did not end.
Only now did everyone see clearly. They could see that Ouyang Ling’s whole right arm was oozing blood, and there were even white bone spikes protruding from some places, looking extremely terrifying.
This, this, this, this, this, Ouyang Ling’s entire right arm had actually been shattered.

The natives were all astounded. Just now, they had still been mocking Ling Han for his stupidity. He actually dared to engage in close-quarter combat with them. This was practically courting death. But reality had proven that Ling Han was not brainless, but rather that his physique was stronger. With a single punch, he had crippled Ouyang Ling’s entire arm.
F***, who exactly was the Body Arts user here?
At this moment, the natives were completely silent, and the atmosphere was oppressive to the extreme.
On the other hand, the outsiders suddenly erupted in enthusiastic cheers, causing the mountains to reverberate.
This was too inspiring.
“As expected of the Imperial Son Killer. Impressive!”
“We should have let Ling Han fight long ago, and let these country bumpkins know how awesome we are.”
“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s start a massacre!”
Amidst such cheers, Hua Youchang’s eyes swept over, bursting with divine light, as sharp as a sharp blade.
“Interesting.” He smacked his lips, and with a sudden leap, charged towards Ling Han. “Come battle!”
Boom, he threw a punch.
Ling Han didn’t use his mystical power. Instead, he unleashed the might of his Body Art and exchanged a punch with his opponent.
Peng, the two iron fists crashed together, and waves of power surged out, turning into ripples that spread out in all directions.
Even if they were all prodigies here, they still felt pressure, and couldn’t help but retreat continuously.

chapters.title: Chapter 4176: Top elite, Yi Qianhong
paragraphs: Hua Youchang’s expression changed drastically, and he couldn’t help but stumble back a few steps. Only then did he regain his balance.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. His power was already at 35 Heavens, yet he was actually no match for Ling Han. Just how strong was this guy?
“Good!” Seeing this scene, the outsiders all cheered, incredibly excited.
Meanwhile, the natives remained silent. They were indeed outmatched.
Hua Youchang quickly regained his confidence. He bared his teeth, and revealed a smile. “I never thought that there would actually be people who cultivate the Body Art outside!”

Ling Han smiled faintly. Thankfully, he had also made a trip to the True Dragon Abyss, and had obtained the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. Otherwise, he would only be 38 Heavens in mystical power now, and though he would still suppress Heavenly Emperor, it would not be as easily as he was doing it now.
“I’m just average,” he said modestly.
“Show off!” the large black dog and little azure dragon spat at the same time.

Hua Youchang was proud, and he said, “Your mystical power shouldn’t be weak either. Thus, combined with Body Art, your power is superior to mine! However, in terms of a single power, you’re definitely no match for me! So, I’ll let you see just how terrifyingly powerful a power will be after pushing it to the pinnacle level!”
Everyone gave an ‘oh’. No wonder Ling Han’s power was so strong. As it turned out, he was cultivating both mystical power and Body Art.

Meanwhile, Xu Jie and the other Imperial Sons all wore ugly expressions. The requirement for Body Arts was too high, and it was extremely exhausting of resources. Thus, even with the wealth of the Imperial Clan, they could only allow one clansman to practice Body Arts at any one time.
This opportunity belonged to the Golden Generation. Though they were also Imperial Sons, they had no chance of obtaining Body Arts.

That’s right. With the Imperial Clan’s power, it would be no problem for them to push the Body Arts of several clansmen to the level of the Core Formation Tier at the same time. In fact, it would not be difficult for them to reach the level of Sect Master in Body Art, but the problem was, even if they reached the level of Sect Master in Body Art, what use would it be?
The requirements of the Imperial Clan were too high.
Thus, all resources were focused on a certain Imperial Son, enough to allow him to cultivate Body Art to the pinnacle level even after becoming a Saint, and truly become invincible among his peers.

Xu Jie and the others also wanted Body Arts. This could increase their battle prowess, but they could only rely on themselves to obtain resources. This naturally was far from being able to keep up with their cultivation levels. It was practically equivalent to not having cultivated Body Arts.
Now that they saw a guy that came from a humble background, who actually also cultivated Body Art, surpassing them, how could they not be envious, jealous, and hateful?

From this aspect, the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was truly awesome. Of course, cultivating this cultivation technique required one to have the True Dragon bloodline, and who knew how many people would be refused entry with just this requirement.
Hua Youchang’s body trembled, and multiple muscles popped out. He was filled with power, and mysterious seals could vaguely be seen circulating on his skin.
He crouched down, then suddenly shot out, pouncing towards Ling Han.

Body Arts were very simple. What one cultivated was the physical body, possessing endless power and a frightening physique. There were no illusory moves like celestial techniques. Oneself was a weapon, capable of flattening everything.
Hua Youchang turned himself into a human-shaped Spirit Tool, which crashed towards Ling Han.
Simple, rough, and direct.
Ling Han smiled. He also liked this kind of battle style, as it could quickly end the battle.
He also exerted force with his feet, greeting Hua Youchang’s attack.
Peng!
The two of them crashed into each other, and instantly, a mushroom-like ball of energy rose up from the ground, spreading out towards the skies and the surroundings.
This was too terrifying. This energy was filled with destructive power, and even an Imperial Son would frown at this.
Everyone hurriedly ran backwards. It was too dangerous. These two guys were both freaks. After running for a long distance, they finally stopped, and turned around to look.
With such a head-on clash, the victor would probably be decided in a few moves.

The ball of energy was slowly dispersing, and Ling Han was seen standing there completely unscathed. Meanwhile, Hua Youchang had stretched out his arms and legs, lying in the Chinese character for ‘big’.
No way!
Everyone was stunned. Just now, Hua Youchang had spoken so confidently, looking like he could defeat Ling Han, but in the end? He had lost in a single collision.
He had lost, he had definitely lost. This time, he was definitely not “drunk on tea”.
The natives were all as if they had lost both their parents. Their second strongest elite had actually lost, and he had lost in such a clean and decisive manner at that.
“Lord Ling is mighty!”
“Lord Ling is so domineering!”
Meanwhile, the outsiders were smug and extremely excited.
He had won, he had won!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and searched among the natives. In the end, he located a lanky man, “Yi Qianhong, do you dare battle me?”
Since he had already defeated the second elite, he would definitely go with the flow and defeat the top elite as well, to prevent others from jumping around and chattering endlessly
afterwards.
Why was he staring at that man?
Firstly, this person was in the camp of the natives, and secondly, he was also the only person who had maintained his composure all this while.
There was a 99% chance that he was the number one prodigy of the natives, Yi Qianhong.
As expected, the lanky man put down his teacup, and turned to look at Ling Han.
“Lord Yi!” Someone half-knelt.
“Lord Yi!” Even more natives half-knelt, their faces filled with reverence.
“Lord Yi, please battle!” they all called out, as if they were welcoming a god.
The corners of Ling Han’s mouth twitched slightly. Why did these natives like to play this kind of trick? They would kneel down at the slightest provocation to create an atmosphere.
Yi Qianhong finally stood up. His expression was calm, and he simply looked at Ling Han.
“Er, I’m not gay, so please don’t look at me with such deep affection.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively.
Anger instantly appeared on Yi Qianhong’s face, and he said, “Are you seeking death?”
“Hehe, I’m already tired of hearing such words. Let’s change to something more
meaningful,” Ling Han said with a chuckle.
“All right, I’ll oblige you!” Yi Qianhong strode towards Ling Han. Boom, all the power in his body burst forth, turning into flames that were boiling and throbbing. His aura was
astonishingly terrifying.
Even the expressions of the Imperial Sons like Zhang Fang and Imperial Daughters like Chi Menghan changed drastically at this moment.
This guy was too terrifying. His abilities were definitely heaven-defyingly powerful. “Your strength is not too bad, so I have decided to subdue you in three moves. In future, you
will become my servant!” Yi Qianhong said. He was already close enough, and shot out a
punch.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t cower, brandishing his fists in response.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Ling Han’s figure immediately slid back. His feet scraped over the ground, forcefully creating a deep groove that was as long as over thirty meters.
It should be known that this was the Mountain Sea Heaven. The structure of the ground was incredibly sturdy, which showed how terrifying the power of Yi Qianhong’s punch was.
What!

Seeing this scene, the outsiders all felt their scalps go numb. Ling Han was already so strong, yet he was still no match for Yi Qianhong. Just how strong was this guy? Meanwhile, the natives cheered to their hearts’ content. This was their number one prodigy, capable of insta-killing everything in his way.
Yi Qianhong casually retracted his fist, saying, “I forgot to tell you. I also cultivated Body Art

and mystical power at the same time. Moreover, when I was at the Cauldron Forging Tier, I completed the Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron in a natural desolate land. Thus, my mystical power has reached 36 Heavens, and my Body Art is also at 36 Heavens. Combined with the
two, my raw power has reached 42 Heavens!”
Hiss, everyone inhaled sharply.

Only then did he regain his balance.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked.
His power was already at 35 Heavens, yet he was actually no match for Ling Han.
Just how strong was this guy?
“Good!” Seeing this scene, the outsiders all cheered, incredibly excited.
Meanwhile, the natives remained silent.
They were indeed outmatched.
Hua Youchang quickly regained his confidence.
He bared his teeth, and revealed a smile.
“I never thought that there would actually be people who cultivate the Body Art outside!”
Ling Han smiled faintly.
Thankfully, he had also made a trip to the True Dragon Abyss, and had obtained the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.
Otherwise, he would only be 38 Heavens in mystical power now, and though he would still suppress Heavenly Emperor, it would not be as easily as he was doing it now.
“I’m just average,” he said modestly.
“Show off!” the large black dog and little azure dragon spat at the same time.
Hua Youchang was proud, and he said, “Your mystical power shouldn’t be weak either.
Thus, combined with Body Art, your power is superior to mine!
However, in terms of a single power, you’re definitely no match for me!
So, I’ll let you see just how terrifyingly powerful a power will be after pushing it to the pinnacle level!”
Everyone gave an ‘oh’.
No wonder Ling Han’s power was so strong.
As it turned out, he was cultivating both mystical power and Body Art.
Meanwhile, Xu Jie and the other Imperial Sons all wore ugly expressions.
The requirement for Body Arts was too high, and it was extremely exhausting of resources.
Thus, even with the wealth of the Imperial Clan, they could only allow one clansman to practice Body Arts at any one time.
This opportunity belonged to the Golden Generation.
Though they were also Imperial Sons, they had no chance of obtaining Body Arts.
That’s right.
With the Imperial Clan’s power, it would be no problem for them to push the Body Arts of several clansmen to the level of the Core Formation Tier at the same time.
In fact, it would not be difficult for them to reach the level of Sect Master in Body Art, but the problem was, even if they reached the level of Sect Master in Body Art, what use would it be?
The requirements of the Imperial Clan were too high.
Thus, all resources were focused on a certain Imperial Son, enough to allow him to cultivate Body Art to the pinnacle level even after becoming a Saint, and truly become invincible among his peers.
Xu Jie and the others also wanted Body Arts.
This could increase their battle prowess, but they could only rely on themselves to obtain resources.
This naturally was far from being able to keep up with their cultivation levels.
It was practically equivalent to not having cultivated Body Arts.
Now that they saw a guy that came from a humble background, who actually also cultivated Body Art, surpassing them, how could they not be envious, jealous, and hateful?
From this aspect, the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was truly awesome.
Of course, cultivating this cultivation technique required one to have the True Dragon bloodline, and who knew how many people would be refused entry with just this requirement.
Hua Youchang’s body trembled, and multiple muscles popped out.
He was filled with power, and mysterious seals could vaguely be seen circulating on his skin.
He crouched down, then suddenly shot out, pouncing towards Ling Han.
Body Arts were very simple.
What one cultivated was the physical body, possessing endless power and a frightening physique.
There were no illusory moves like celestial techniques.
Oneself was a weapon, capable of flattening everything.
Hua Youchang turned himself into a human-shaped Spirit Tool, which crashed towards Ling Han.
Simple, rough, and direct.
Ling Han smiled.
He also liked this kind of battle style, as it could quickly end the battle.
He also exerted force with his feet, greeting Hua Youchang’s attack.
Peng!
The two of them crashed into each other, and instantly, a mushroom-like ball of energy rose up from the ground, spreading out towards the skies and the surroundings.
This was too terrifying.
This energy was filled with destructive power, and even an Imperial Son would frown at this.
Everyone hurriedly ran backwards.
It was too dangerous.
These two guys were both freaks.
After running for a long distance, they finally stopped, and turned around to look.
With such a head-on clash, the victor would probably be decided in a few moves.
The ball of energy was slowly dispersing, and Ling Han was seen standing there completely unscathed.
Meanwhile, Hua Youchang had stretched out his arms and legs, lying in the Chinese character for ‘big’.
No way!
Everyone was stunned.
Just now, Hua Youchang had spoken so confidently, looking like he could defeat Ling Han, but in the end?
He had lost in a single collision.
He had lost, he had definitely lost.
This time, he was definitely not “drunk on tea”.
The natives were all as if they had lost both their parents.
Their second strongest elite had actually lost, and he had lost in such a clean and decisive manner at that.
“Lord Ling is mighty!”
“Lord Ling is so domineering!”
Meanwhile, the outsiders were smug and extremely excited.
He had won, he had won!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and searched among the natives.
In the end, he located a lanky man, “Yi Qianhong, do you dare battle me?”
Since he had already defeated the second elite, he would definitely go with the flow and defeat the top elite as well, to prevent others from jumping around and chattering endlessly
afterwards.
Why was he staring at that man?
Firstly, this person was in the camp of the natives, and secondly, he was also the only person who had maintained his composure all this while.
There was a 99% chance that he was the number one prodigy of the natives, Yi Qianhong.
As expected, the lanky man put down his teacup, and turned to look at Ling Han.
“Lord Yi!” Someone half-knelt.
“Lord Yi!” Even more natives half-knelt, their faces filled with reverence.
“Lord Yi, please battle!” they all called out, as if they were welcoming a god.
The corners of Ling Han’s mouth twitched slightly.
Why did these natives like to play this kind of trick?
They would kneel down at the slightest provocation to create an atmosphere.
Yi Qianhong finally stood up.
His expression was calm, and he simply looked at Ling Han.
“Er, I’m not gay, so please don’t look at me with such deep affection.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively.
Anger instantly appeared on Yi Qianhong’s face, and he said, “Are you seeking death?”
“Hehe, I’m already tired of hearing such words.
Let’s change to something more
meaningful,” Ling Han said with a chuckle.
“All right, I’ll oblige you!” Yi Qianhong strode towards Ling Han.
Boom, all the power in his body burst forth, turning into flames that were boiling and throbbing.
His aura was
astonishingly terrifying.
Even the expressions of the Imperial Sons like Zhang Fang and Imperial Daughters like Chi Menghan changed drastically at this moment.
This guy was too terrifying.
His abilities were definitely heaven-defyingly powerful.
“Your strength is not too bad, so I have decided to subdue you in three moves.
In future, you
will become my servant!” Yi Qianhong said.
He was already close enough, and shot out a
punch.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t cower, brandishing his fists in response.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Ling Han’s figure immediately slid back.
His feet scraped over the ground, forcefully creating a deep groove that was as long as over thirty meters.
It should be known that this was the Mountain Sea Heaven.
The structure of the ground was incredibly sturdy, which showed how terrifying the power of Yi Qianhong’s punch was.
What!
Seeing this scene, the outsiders all felt their scalps go numb.
Ling Han was already so strong, yet he was still no match for Yi Qianhong.
Just how strong was this guy?
Meanwhile, the natives cheered to their hearts’ content.
This was their number one prodigy, capable of insta-killing everything in his way.
Yi Qianhong casually retracted his fist, saying, “I forgot to tell you.
I also cultivated Body Art
and mystical power at the same time.
Moreover, when I was at the Cauldron Forging Tier, I completed the Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron in a natural desolate land.
Thus, my mystical power has reached 36 Heavens, and my Body Art is also at 36 Heavens.
Combined with the
two, my raw power has reached 42 Heavens!”
Hiss, everyone inhaled sharply.

chapters.title: Chapter 4177: Beaten all the same
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron was the standard trait of the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter. Without reaching this level, even the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter would be stripped of their status.

However, if one wanted to become an Emperor, they would have to rely on their own power to fuse the Nine Cauldrons into one. This was also one of the reasons why the Imperial Clans could no longer produce an Ancestral King.
But now, a native had actually relied on the help of the power of heaven and earth to complete the fusion of the Nine Cauldrons.
What kind of concept was this?
This person... had hopes of becoming an Emperor!
Moreover, the Body Art and mystical power had fused together, surpassing the power of 40 Heavens. This suppressed even the Ancestral Kings of the past.
This was truly heaven-defying!

“It’s not that terrifying. The Great Emperors all came from long ago, and lack resources and cultivation techniques, so they don’t cultivate Body Arts. Otherwise, it would be completely no issue for them to surpass 40 Heavens in power.”
“That’s right. It is said that when some Ancestral King were young, their raw power was as high as thirty-eight, or even thirty-nine Heavens, which is much higher than this native.”
“To say nothing of others, just take Golden Generation for example. All of them have cultivated Body Arts, so their power is definitely not inferior to his.”
“That’s right. If it was not for the fact that they have the potential to surpass the generations of Ancestral Kings, how could these people be worthy of being called the Golden Generation?”

Everyone sighed ruefully. None of them were willing to admit it, but they all agreed internally that Yi Qianhong should be the strongest in the current Core Formation Tier. Even Ling Han would not be able to match him.

“Being my servant, there is no need to feel aggrieved,” Yi Qianhong said calmly, as he strolled slowly towards Ling Han, “I am someone who is going to become the Ancestral King. Being able to become my servant, your name will definitely be known for all eternity. In this lifetime, what one pursues is nothing more than this.”
These words caused a great many people to humph. You are only the number one in the Core Formation Tier, but don’t forget, there was still the Golden Generation.
Yi Qianhong had already arrived in front of Ling Han. He stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han, wanting to beat this person into submission.
“Servant your sister!” Ling Han roared loudly, and also grabbed out at Yi Qianhong.
‘F*ck! I only activated Body Art, and you’re only able to suppress me by 30% in terms of power. What are you so smug about?!’
“Stubborn!” Yi Qianhong sneered, and grabbed at Ling Han’s wrist.
The two of them engaged in close-quarter combat, and it was natural that whoever was more powerful would emerge victorious.
Yi Qianhong’s expression changed drastically as soon as he placed his hand on his.
‘Holy f*ck! How is this power so powerful?’
He had not even finished the thought, when he was already brandished by Ling Han. Peng, he crashed heavily onto the ground.
Peng!
In the next second, he was once again swung around, turning 180 degrees in the air, and crashed onto the ground with the other side of his body.
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han used Yi Qianhong like a punching bag, and tossed him around madly.
‘F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone was dumbfounded.
Yi, wasn’t it agreed that he would be the strongest in the Core Formation Tier? What was going on now? Why was he being smashed madly like a dead dog!
“Have we seen wrongly?”
“No, it’s not blurred vision. Yi Qianhong is really being madly smashed by Ling Han.”

“Heavens, didn’t Yi Qianhong’s power surpass 40 heavens? This is a threshold that the Imperial Sons couldn’t cross even if they burned their Imperial Blood, and now, he is actually being trampled on like this?”
“Ling Han... is too strong!”
“He is truly the Imperial Son Killer; this is practically torturing noobs.”
After a moment of shock, everyone finally came back to their senses.
Then, there was another question. Just how strong was Ling Han?
“Yi Qianhong’s power is at 42 Heavens, so Ling Han’s power definitely surpasses his.”
“To be able to crush him so easily, he would have to be suppressed by three Heavens in power, at least!”
“F***, 45 Heavens?”
Thinking of such a terrifying number, everyone was stunned speechless.
Was this a height that living beings could reach?
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han was still throwing him around. F***, he actually dared to make him his servant; he must be blind.
The large black dog stroked his paws and praised, “Little Han is really a show-off.”
“What do you mean?” the little azure dragon humbly learnt.

“You see, Little Han deliberately pretended to be weak first, allowing the Yi brat to taste some benefits. He talked to himself, and revealed all his strength, drawing the exclamations of shock from the masses, who admitted their own inferiority. But it was at this moment that Little Han suddenly smashed the Yi brat as if he was a weakling. With such a strong contrast, how could it not shock the whole area?” The large black dog praised repeatedly.
“Oh, so this is what it means to suppress one’s desires first, and then soar.” The little azure dragon finally understood. “Raise the enemy high, then thrash him easily.”
“You’re worthy of teaching,” the large black dog said with a nod. He then looked around, and said, “Oh, that’s right. Which of you said that you wanted to challenge Little Han?”
Challenge your sister.
All the natives looked at Ling Han, who was madly smashing Yi Qianhong, and swallowed with great difficulty. They all shook their heads.
If it were them, they would definitely be smashed into a pancake in a few moves.
Ling Han smashed for a while longer, and felt bored. Then, he casually tossed Yi Qianhong aside, and walked back on his own.
There was complete silence.

Without seeing Yi Qianhong sprawled out on the ground like a dead dog, everyone had the illusion that this guy would counterattack. After all, he was a monster whose power had broken through 40 Heavens.

But even until the end, it was still so peaceful. A freakish genius whose power had exceeded 40 Heavens had been defeated just like that. This was practically a humiliation that could be nailed onto the pillar of shame.
How could they accept this?
To say nothing of the natives, even the outsiders had lost their excitement.
Ling Han was too strong, so strong that they could only look up to him but could not catch up to him.
To those who aspired to pursue the throne, this was practically a great blow.
How could they win against such a freak?

They hadn’t been born at the same time as the Golden Generation, avoiding the terror of being ruled by those prodigies. Now, however, Ling Han had suddenly appeared. His freakishness was in no way inferior to them, or perhaps even surpassed them. This was simply enough to drive them to despair.
Fighting spirit, would they still have fighting spirit in future?
Everyone’s hearts were filled with ups and downs. Only with competition would there be vigor, but Ling Han was so strong that others didn’t even have the right to compete.
“... Don’t take it to heart. Ling Han only cultivated Body Art at the same time, and that’s why his power is so strong!” Someone forcibly boosted his confidence.
“That’s right. As long as one advances into the True Self Tier, the advantage of Body Art will be greatly decreased, and the further one advances into the late stage, the less useful it would be.”
“Even if I am no match now, it doesn’t mean that I won’t be a match in the future!”

The Imperial Sons cheered each other on, barely regaining some of their confidence, but they knew that things were not as simple as they said. If Body Art was useless, why would the various Imperial Clans have to exert all their power to support a single Imperial Son?
This was very important, very important.
Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up. She knew that Ling Han was extraordinary, but she hadn’t expected him to be this powerful.
“Sister, if you don’t hurry up and make your move, Brother-in-law will really slip away,” the silver-haired lolita suddenly appeared and whispered into her ear.
Chi Menghan shot her a fierce look, but her heart couldn’t help but skip a beat.

The banquet had already progressed to this point, and no one was still in the mood to discuss dao. The strongest had already appeared, so what difference did the others have with a clown should they continue?

chapters.title: Chapter 4178: Seal unsealed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
It wasn’t long before people left one after another. More and more people left, and Chi Menghan simply announced the end of the banquet.
In any case, the purpose of the banquet had already been achieved, and that was to have the natives behave themselves, and show off the might of the Imperial Clan.
Though the results were slightly off, the natives would definitely behave much more obediently after this matter.

After returning to the encampment, Ling Han couldn’t help but feel rueful. He was only focused on venting his anger, and seemed to have used too much force, causing himself to stand at the cusp of the storm.
“Have I been too showy recently?” He reflected on himself.
“En, I have to keep a low profile in future. That would be more in line with my character.”
The large black dog and little azure dragon heard his muttering, and couldn’t help but roll their eyes.
“You are a showy person!” they said at the same time.

Ling Han continued to advance his cultivation level, while the large black dog and little azure dragon were responsible for finding the clues left behind by the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. They didn’t believe that they couldn’t find it.
Time passed quietly, and occasionally, news of an Imperial Son breaking through to the True Self Tier would be revealed.

Now, the youngest generation of Imperial Sons had more or less leaped over the threshold of the True Self Tier. This place was too suitable for cultivation, and only when they reached the True Self Tier would they be able to maximize their gains. Thus, the Imperial Sons who had long since cultivated the Core Formation Tier to the consummate level naturally had nothing to be reluctant about.
Ling Han’s improvement was also very gratifying. In this one year, he had cultivated both mystical power and physical power to the height of 40 Heavens.
What kind of concept was this?
To say nothing of two powers reaching forty Heavens, even one reaching forty Heavens was as difficult as ascending the heavens.

Take mystical power, for example. Why had Ling Han been able to cultivate to 40 Heavens? The prerequisite was that he had fused Ten Cauldrons into one. However, could there be a second person in the world that could reach this kind of height? Then, there was physical power. Though this had been passed down from the line of the True Dragon, but even if he was the son of True Dragon, the little azure dragon had just barely reached 38 Heavens.
Why couldn’t the little azure dragon reach 40 Heavens?
This was because Ling Han’s body was tempered by four stars high-level energy, while the little azure dragon’s body was tempered by three stars. The difference lay here.
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked Ling Han to have mastered the 10-star Destructive Energy?
Ling Han’s achievements were definitely unprecedented, and would never be replicated in the future.
Moreover, the combined might of two powers of 40 Heavens could allow Ling Han’s power to soar to 50 Heavens!
What kind of concept was this?

45 Heavens was the barrier between the Core Formation Tier and the True Self Tier. When power broke through to 45 Heavens, it would actually be equivalent to reaching the height of the First Heaven of the True Self Tier.
For Ling Han, his current power could already suppress some cultivators who had just entered the True Self Tier.

The True Self Tier Four Forms corresponded to the early stage of the True Self Tier, the middle stage of the True Self Tier, the late stage of the True Self Tier, and the consummate level of the True Self Tier. The early stage of the True Self Tier only had the power of three Heavens, and Ling Han had already reached this kind of height.

Of course, when a True Self Tier cultivator began to cultivate Regulations, the power of great dao was also a part of battle prowess that couldn’t be overlooked. Thus, Ling Han’s power could rival the early stage of the True Self Tier, but if he just fought head-on like that, his chances of winning were practically zero.
However, he also possessed various high-level energies, which could boost Ling Han’s astonishing destructive power, and truly allow him to stand against True Self Tier elites.
“Now, there’s 90% chance that the early stage of the True Self Tier is no match for me.”

Unfortunately, Ling Han had used alchemical pills to rapidly rush up to this cultivation level. Thus, there was a situation where his foundations were unstable, and he needed some time to stabilize them.
The large black dog and little azure dragon were also stabilizing their cultivation level. Breaking through was only a matter of time, and definitely not too long.

Instead, it was the empress and Hu Niu. They had accumulated power for a long time, and had broken through to the Core Formation Tier in a single stroke. Once again, they maintained the same cultivation level as Ling Han.
Of course, Ling Han would soon be able to break through to the True Self Tier, and the gap between the three of them would once again widen.
A considerable number of Imperial Clan elites extended an olive branch to Ling Han, wanting to take Ling Han as their son-in-law, but Ling Han naturally refused.

Firstly, Ling Han didn’t have such thoughts at all, and secondly, these Imperial Clans still hadn’t changed their lofty attitudes, thinking that taking Ling Han as a live-in son-in-law was a charity for him.

After all, becoming an Emperor was much, much too difficult. Though Ling Han was presently showing signs of being invincible among his peers, he still had the Golden Generation above him. Furthermore, the Imperial Path was arduous, and who knew how many prodigies had collapsed on their way here. Now, just to say that Ling Han would have the last laugh?
What a joke. Perhaps even the entire Golden Generation would be wiped out.
The heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome a new Emperor, but in terms of time, it may be several hundred years later, tens of thousands of years later, or even millions of years later.

The Imperial Clans had always enjoyed a lofty status. They had taken a fancy to Ling Han’s potential, and thus they had already given him a very, very high opinion of him by taking him as a live-in son-in-law.

Ling Han refused. Being thought of the Imperial Clans as not knowing what was good for him also cast a haze over his future. He had already offended the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, and now he had drawn the animosity of two great Imperial Clans. It was already a question of how long Ling Han could live, so how could he talk of becoming an Emperor?
All of this naturally wouldn’t affect Ling Han. He was still cultivating every day, stabilizing his cultivation level, and looking forward to taking the next step.
Right at this moment, a major event happened in the Mountain Sea Heaven.
A statue in the city suddenly collapsed, revealing a deep hole.
This attracted the curiosity of a great many people. It should be known that it was very possible that the secret of the Needless Mountains was hidden here!
Could it be that this secret was inside the cave?
Instantly, a great many people entered the cave to investigate. Even Venerate Tier elites were alerted, and entered the cave one after another.

Ling Han had initially wanted to go as well, but the Venerate Tier elites had all moved out, so he naturally gave up on this idea. Even if there were clues inside, so what? The Venerate Tier elites had already moved out, so did the others have a share?

However, very soon, there was feedback. The bottom of this deep cave was actually an entrance that had been sealed. However, this seal was already severely damaged, and a gap had appeared. It could allow living beings with low cultivation levels to pass through.
There were already quite a few Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier youngsters who had entered, but up until now, not one of them had come out.
As time passed, this even alerted the Saints.
Who wouldn’t be interested in the Imperial Scroll?
However, after studying it for a while, the Saints came to an astonishing conclusion. That was, this seal had been created by the Great Emperor.
Hiss, was it the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor?

This was a very natural association. This planet had been forcefully compressed from a sun by the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. It had also once been his temporary residence during his battle expeditions. Now that a Great Emperor-level seal had appeared here, who else could it be but the hand of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor?
Then was the secret of Needless Mountains really hidden here?

Though this seal was severely damaged, it had been created by the Great Emperor, after all. Even the Saint could not break it. Thus, all the great elites could only send out the younger generation to fight over it.
All of a sudden, all the cultivators below the Spirit Transformation Tier were mobilized.
That’s right. The True Self Tier elite was the upper limit of entry through the seal. If the Spirit Transformation Tiers went, they wouldn’t be able to advance the slightest bit.

Ling Han naturally moved out as well. He had the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and Lin Luo by his side. This lineup could be considered luxurious among Core Formation Tiers, but added with True Self Tier, it couldn’t be considered powerful at all.
And just like that, they set out.

“En, I have to keep a low profile in future.

This was because Ling Han’s body was tempered by four stars high-level energy, while the little azure dragon’s body was tempered by three stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 4179: Extremely Cold
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The great elites reached an agreement, allowing young people from all sides to enter the cave. The treasures they obtained would also belong to each individual. However, if it involved the secrets of Needless Mountains, they had to share it.
Otherwise, with a Saint standing guard, and even wielding an Imperial Weapon, who would be able to pass?

Ling Han’s small team arrived at the bottom of the cave. It was extremely dark here, and the gravity field was even more terrifying. The Foundation Building Tier cultivators couldn’t block it at all, and their protective shields were directly shattered.

Thus, Foundation Building cultivators couldn’t enter the cave. At least, only those at Cauldron Forging Tier could barely maintain the existence of the shield. Otherwise, if one were to face it head-on with their physical body, they could only sprawl out on the ground.

Thankfully, the empress and Hu Niu had also advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and were also slightly accomplished in Body Art. Walking here was not as easy as walking on flat ground, but it was not all that difficult either.
After walking for a long time, they finally arrived at the place where the seal was placed.

Actually, this was a great door. It was incredibly ancient, and the door was covered densely with seals that were interwoven into sheets. However, this door was damaged, revealing a hole that was big enough for two people to pass through side by side, but if one looked inside, they could only see a stretch of Primal Chaos.
“Hurry up, don’t delay others!” Ling Han was still studying it when he heard a urging voice from behind him.
Hu Niu immediately turned around, bared her teeth, and said, “You dare to be fierce to Niu’s Ling Han?”
“So what?” the person said proudly. Because Hu Niu hadn’t revealed her true appearance, he naturally wouldn’t be affected by her exquisite beauty.
However, the person beside him immediately tugged at his clothes, and whispered, “That’s Ling Han!”
Hiss, Ling Han!
The person from before immediately shut up, and even took a few steps back. What he meant was, ‘You can study it however you like, no problem.’
The strongest person in their group was only in the Core Formation Tier. Even if they teamed up, they would still be no match for Ling Han, so how could they be qualified to challenge him?

Ling Han, Lin Luo, and the large black dog were all observing. This was appraised by the Saint, and it was a Great Emperor-level seal. If they could comprehend a sliver of its profound secrets, the benefits would be boundless. Unfortunately, this was too mysterious. It was like they were reading a mysterious book, and they did not have the slightest idea.
This was more logical. If the Core Formation Tier cultivator could comprehend the profound meaning of the Great Emperor Tier, then the level of cultivation would have to be rewritten.
Thus, after studying it for a while, everyone gave up.
“Let’s go,” they said.
The group entered the hole one after another. Ling Han led the way, while the little azure dragon trailed at the back. The two of them were the strongest contestants in the team.
So cold!
Even with Ling Han’s physique, he immediately felt an extraordinary chill assault him upon entering, as if it was going to freeze him.

This was very illogical. It should be known that Ling Han’s present physique could be considered incredibly tough. He was like a human-shaped Celestial Tool, and would actually be frozen to the point that even his blood seemed to have frozen. This was naturally bizarre!
Furthermore!

Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw that there were corpses lying all around him, or even in fact beneath his feet. Though he did not recognize them, from the traces of the corpses, they should be those who had entered into this place not too long ago, yet had frozen to death.
They... were all Cauldron Forging Tiers. Because there were really too many of them, this place had become like a mass grave.
Ling Han suddenly turned around, yet shockingly discovered that there was no great door behind him.
It was completely empty.
Was this a one-way Transference Portal? Or was it because the door wasn’t completely open, so the door didn’t appear at this location?
It was all possible.
Just as he was pondering, a second person had already entered.
“Niu’s freezing to death!” Hu Niu immediately crossed her arms over her chest, her delicate body trembling.

She had just broken through to the Core Formation Tier, and although she was much stronger than the Cauldron Forging Tier, so she wouldn’t freeze to death here, the extreme cold still made her face pale.
Ling Han hurriedly pulled his beautiful wife into his arms, and opened the Starlight Screen to resist the cold.
However, this did not have much effect.
This coldness ignored his physique, and also ignored the Starlight Screen, as it directly attacked his body.
With a thought, Ling Han switched to burning the Heavenly Dao Flames.
This time, the effect was instantaneous. The coldness instantly disappeared like the ebbing tide.
“Wu, Ling Han, you’re so warm!” Hu Niu spread out her arms and legs, wrapping around Ling Han like an octopus.
Xiu, with a flash, the empress arrived.
Of course, she was also cold, but only shivered slightly. Then, from her nose, she released an indistinct moan.
The aloof and proud empress was indeed completely different from Hu Niu.
Ling Han did not say another word, and pulled this beautiful wife into his arms as well, taking her under the protection of the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Then, the large black dog, Lin Luo, and little azure dragon entered one after another.
“F*ck! What the hell? Grandpa Dog is about to be frozen into a dog!” the large black dog immediately wailed in agony.
“Yi, aren’t you a dog?” Hu Niu giggled.
“It’s too cold. Grandpa Dog’s brain has short-circuited.” The large black dog stuck out its tongue, but when it discovered that its tongue was showing signs of freezing, it hurriedly shrunk back in.
Lin Luo merely frowned. As one of the strongest Heavenly Venerable Tier elites of Genesis World, he naturally wouldn’t change his expression even if the sky collapsed.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon howled like the large black dog. His physique actually couldn’t block the coldness; this was too strange.

Next, the few people that had been following Ling Han entered one after another. There were two among them that were Cauldron Forging Tiers. The moment they entered, they were enveloped in a layer of white frost. Then, with a bang, they collapsed onto the ground, eternally accompanying the corpses around them.
It was too cold, and normal Cauldron Forging Tiers couldn’t block it at all.
Ling Han frowned, “There is no way out here. Even if we wanted to send the news back, we would not be able to!”
“Little Han, it’s too cold here. If we stay here for too long, we’ll all be in danger!” the large black dog said.

Ling Han and Lin Luo nodded. In this place, they could only rely on high-level energy to resist the cold, and high-level energy could be communicated through Spiritual Power, so there would naturally be a time when it would be exhausted. If that time came, how would they resist the cold?
“No matter what, let’s find the exit first, or which place isn’t so cold to solve the problem of survival, and then consider other things.”
“All right.”
They advanced, and there were still four people left in the team that had entered behind them. They hurriedly followed Ling Han and the others. This could greatly increase their chances of survival.
“What exactly is this place?” the large black dog asked curiously.
Ling Han also wanted to know. His physique was actually useless, and his mystical power was also useless. Even he couldn’t block the coldness. Was there such a strange place in this world?
“Could it be that this was set up by the Great Emperor?” the large black dog guessed.
If it was a Great Emperor’s power, causing his physique and mystical power to be ineffective, this naturally would be a piece of cake.

“If this is the doing of a Great Emperor, then why can the lowest star-level high-level energy resist the cold?” Ling Han had already tried it out. Even if he used one star of high-level energy, he would still be able to resist the cold.
“This...” The large black dog also felt that this didn’t make sense. “Holy f*ck! What the hell is this place?!”
The group walked for a very long time, and suddenly, a pillar of blazing flames shot up into the skies ahead of them.
Everyone exchanged looks, and hurriedly quickened their pace, heading towards that direction.
