chapters.title: Chapter 4180: Regulations are ineffective
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and the others didn’t walk far before arriving near the pile of flames.
They weren’t the first batch of people to enter, so they weren’t the first to discover the bonfire either. There were already many people gathered here.
However, when Ling Han and the others discovered the ingredients used to burn the bonfire, they couldn’t help but feel greatly shocked.
This, it was actually an arm!
Its length was around three hundred meters, and only its bones were left behind. It was the bones that were burning, releasing azure flames, illuminating the skies.
This place was too dark, and the skies were completely grey. There was no sun or moon or stars, as if it was eternal chaos.
After arriving here, they could clearly feel that the coldness had been dispersed considerably.
No wonder there were so many people gathered here. This was a supply station for life.

Ling Han could see very clearly. Those bones were covered densely with seals, and amidst the burning green flames, there was also multi-coloured light formed from Regulations. To be able to refine Regulations into one’s body, hiss, this was the body of a Saint.
F***, what kind of place was this? A Saint had actually lost an arm?

No wonder they didn’t dare to get too close, even though they were trying to keep warm. That was the corpse of a Saint, and it possessed a terrifying might. If they got too close, they would be crushed to death.
“Haha, Ling Han!” A cold laugh rang out, and Xu Jie flew over from beside the bonfire like a bird.
This guy had already broken through to the True Self Tier, and was exuding a completely different aura.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “What can I do for you?”
“I’ll spar with you!” Xu Jie directly charged over, the killing intent on his face undisguised.

Though he did not remember what had happened in the True Dragon Abyss, he had not obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, and Ling Han had obtained it. This clearly meant one thing, and that was he had not won over Ling Han. No one had seen this before, and even if they had, they would definitely not remember it. However, everyone knew this kind of deduction.
Thus, he naturally hated Ling Han.
Furthermore, now that Ling Han had made a name for himself, suppressing all Imperial Sons like them, and could even challenge the Golden Generation, how could Xu Jie not feel jealous?
He had already broken through to the True Self Tier, and Ling Han hadn’t. Thus, this was the best chance to kill Ling Han.
There was no need to make a move directly. He only had to chase him out of the vicinity of the bonfire, and he would be frozen to death.

Ling Han frowned. He was a smart person, so he had naturally guessed Xu Jie’s thoughts. However, even though he could guess it, Xu Jie had already advanced into the True Self Tier. This was also the truth, and was very troublesome to deal with.
But now that he was being bullied, if he did not counterattack, this was not Ling Han’s style either.
Fine, he would just have to see how powerful the Imperial Son would be once he advanced into the True Self Tier.
He immediately clenched his hand into a fist and swung it at Xu Jie.

Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow. Ling Han’s figure swayed, and Xu Jie also trembled. The two sides... actually tied.
‘Holy f*ck!’
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded.

It should be known that Xu Jie was a True Self Tier elite, and furthermore, he was the Imperial Son. Thus, even if he had just stepped into this cultivation level, his power was at least comparable to the peak stage of the first form of the True Self Tier.
However, Ling Han could fight him to a tie.
This, this, this, was he dreaming?

Xu Jie himself was dumbfounded. He swore that he had definitely not held back the slightest bit of power in this blow. The power of the Third Heaven of the True Self Tier had completely burst out, but he had actually only tied with Ling Han. This guy was too freakish, wasn’t he?

Boom! He threw another punch.

He channelled the Imperial Technique, extracting the Regulations of heaven and earth to boost himself, so that he could explode with tons of destructive power.
However, he had just raised his hand, when his mouth immediately gaped, revealing an expression of disbelief.
What was going on? Was this some kind of strategy?
Ling Han did not care. He leaped forwards. Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames combusted. He used the God Slaying Technique, and launched a fierce offensive at Xu Jiejie.
Xu Jie hurriedly parried. Peng, peng, peng! The two sides battled fiercely, and it was still a stalemate.

This stunned everyone, especially those who had just broken through to the True Self Tier. They clearly knew how terrifyingly powerful their abilities would be after advancing into this cultivation level.
Yet, Xu Jie had still managed to battle Ling Han to a tie. This was far too illogical.
“Xu Jie is deliberately going easy on him?”

“Impossible. He has been humiliated by Ling Han before, and he has been suppressed for so long. Now that he has turned the tables on his cultivation level, there is definitely no reason for him to miss out on this opportunity.”
“Then what’s going on?”
All of a sudden, a thought flashed through one of the Imperial Sons’ minds, and he said, “You guys try channelling the Imperial Technique.”
“What do you want?”
“I told you to give it a try, so go ahead!” the Imperial Son said. He channeled the Imperial Technique first.
The others did the same. Then, their expressions changed drastically.
“No wonder!”
“In this place, we actually can’t mobilize the Regulations of heaven and earth. Then, the advantage of the True Self Tier can’t be used at all!”
“Gasp! It’s as if heaven and earth’s Regulations don’t exist here at all!”

Everyone cried out one after another. They finally understood why Xu Jie was unable to suppress Ling Han. That was because in this place, there was absolutely no f****** way to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth. Compared to the Core Formation Tier, the True Self Tier only had an advantage in power, but in terms of power, Ling Han was not the slightest bit inferior.
Thus, Ling Han was able to fight Xu Jie to a tie.

“This, what the hell is this place!” Everyone exclaimed in shock. Even the Imperial Sons were anxious, because in this place, it was very possible that their trump cards would be rendered ineffective. For example, the Substitution Seal and Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman could only take effect by depending on the Regulations of heaven and earth.

Though Ling Han was battling fiercely, his ears were sharp, and he had also heard the discussions of these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters. Realization dawned on him. No wonder Xu Jie’s battle prowess was far below his imagination. As it turned out, he could not use the Regulations of heaven and earth.
Then I won’t be reserved!
Ling Han unleashed his might, each strike fierce and domineering.

His physique was tough, and though he was no match for the coldness of this place, he could still be effective against Xu Jie’s attacks. The battle prowess of the two of them were similar, but one was unafraid of attack, while the other had to defend with all his might. How could they be the same?
As the battle continued, Xu Jie was completely at a disadvantage.

Xu Jie’s depression and frustration could be imagined. He should have been able to easily crush Ling Han, but after he made his move, he realized that f*ck, the heavens were actually screwing him over!
Was this the benefit of obtaining the True Dragon of Fortune?
He had no choice but to retreat. Otherwise, he would suffer.
Ling Han set off in pursuit. If others wanted to bully him, there was nothing much to say. He would beat them up and kill them!

chapters.title: Chapter 4181: Strange Flower
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Stop!” A great many Imperial Sons moved, intercepting Ling Han.

If they were all in the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han wouldn’t be afraid at all. To say nothing of eight or ten Imperial Sons, even if there were a hundred of them, it wouldn’t matter. With his powerful physique and crushing power, he would be able to easily defeat all of them.

However, he couldn’t do this now. These Imperial Sons were all at the True Self Tier, and their battle prowess was no weaker than Ling Han’s. Only two of them had to join forces and they would be able to block Ling Han’s attacks.

Ling Han stopped, and did not pursue any further, because this was pointless effort. However, his eyes were like blades, sweeping over these Imperial Sons, and he asked balefully, “You guys really want to oppose me?”
These people did not stop Xu Jie when he had just made his move, but chose to interfere when Xu Jie was defeated. This was an obvious show of partiality, and were not mediating at all.
Thus, Ling Han’s heart was burning with fury.
“Ling Han, do you know what this place is?” An Imperial Son rebuked, “This is an unknown dangerous area. Everyone must work together. Otherwise, none of you will be able to leave alive!”
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Whatever you say. Since you have decided to make an enemy of me, I will remember all of you. In future, there will be a time for reckoning.”
“Ling Han, you are too arrogant!” Imperial Son Shi Yuanzhen said coldly.
“In this world, there is no one, no force that can challenge the Imperial Clan!” Another Imperial Son declared.

Ling Han smiled faintly, “What you mean is that only you guys can bully others, and definitely cannot allow others to fight back, right? You guys bully others, and that is natural, and if others fight back, that would be treason?”
The Imperial Sons did not speak, but their expressions were all proud. Their meaning could not be more obvious.
The Imperial Clan was just that high and mighty. In front of the Imperial Clan, even the members of the Holy Land were like ants.
Ling Han withdrew his gaze, and said to Lin Luo and the others, “Let’s go.”
Lin Luo, the large black dog, and the others all nodded, their expressions solemn and filled with fury.
These Imperial Clans were too arrogant and domineering, and this kind of confidence was merely because their ancestors had once produced a Great Emperor, and had been blessed by him.
They left. Though this was a place of protection, they could not possibly stay here forever. That would only be waiting for death.
However, the team that had followed them previously stayed behind. No matter how they looked at it, it was safe to stay here, and wait for others to save them.

—The Saint outside had been trying to undo the seal all this while, and though that was a Great Emperor-level seal, it was more or less worn out. They were sure that with the Saint’s abilities, he would be able to undo it not too long after.
At that time, the Saint would enter the arena. In this era when there were no Emperors in the world, how could the Saint with the Imperial Weapon not be able to sweep aside all opposition?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t force them. It wasn’t like they were building a base and forming a team, so he couldn’t be bothered to pay them any attention.
The group continued onwards. Though the environment here was dim, it was not completely dark. They could still see the path ahead of them.
They left, and not too long after, Ling Han suddenly smelt a refreshing fragrance, causing his whole person to feel excited.
“Smells good!” the little azure dragon also immediately said.
The large black dog and Lin Luo nodded in agreement. They could also smell the fragrance of the flower.
“Yi, why does Grandpa Dragon feel like this flower’s fragrance is sensed and not smelt?” the little azure dragon mumbled.
“What a joke. How could one possibly sense the fragrance of the flowers?” The large black dog immediately shook his head.
Yet a thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. He covered his nose, but the refreshing fragrance still did not disperse. He nodded, “I can indeed sense the fragrance of this flower.”
“Yi!”
Everyone was extremely curious, and they all closed their noses to make an attempt. Sure enough, this was the case.
“How strange. What kind of flower is this?”
“Let’s go take a look.”

They began to search, but the fragrance of this flower could be sensed through divine sense, so it was also very difficult to search, because it was different from the standard way one could trace smell.
However, the closer they got, the denser the fragrance of the flower became in their minds. They could still approach endlessly.
Not too long later, they finally saw a flower. It was completely snow-white, and was about the size of a bowl.
This flower was very amazing. It had no leaves, and there was only one flower blooming. There were a total of five petals, and it was exuding a soft lustre.
“Grandpa Dragon discovered it first!” the little azure dragon immediately howled, and was the first to charge out.
“F***, do you know what it means to respect your elders?” The large black dog also darted out. He naturally had to obtain this kind of treasure himself.
“Old Black, do you know what it means to cherish the young?” The little azure dragon didn’t back down either.
“Four-Legged Snake, you’re an old monster from who knows how many years ago, and you still have the face to pretend to be young?” the large black dog barked.
“Then you should respect your elders even more,” the little azure dragon said proudly.
As they fought, they continued to fly, and had already arrived at the side of that glowing white flower. They both stretched out their claws to pluck it.
Shua!
Right at this moment, a saber light flashed past, and a person charged out, attacking them at the same time.
“Old Black!” The little azure dragon kicked the large black dog aside, raising its arms to block the saber light.
Shua, a fountain of blood gushed out. The claws of the little azure dragon were already dripping with blood.
The person who attacked showed no mercy. With a twist of the blade, he once again swept towards the little azure dragon.
“Humph!” Ling Han had already charged over, and shot out a punch, which landed on the back of the saber.
Weng!
The saber trembled slightly, and was instantly swept aside.
“Motherf*cker, what the hell is this?” The little azure dragon finally had the time to look at the sneak attacker, and couldn’t help but feel shocked.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and said, “Yin soul!”

He finally understood why there was a bone-chilling cold here, and why the True Self Tier elites couldn’t draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth. The reason was very simple—this was the Netherworld!

In the Netherworld, the Regulations of heaven and earth were naturally bone-chilling, and he was also unable to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth. The Regulations of heaven and earth here were completely different.
Previously, he had entered the Netherworld in his soul form, but this time, it was his physical body, so the feeling was completely different, so he did not manage to react at the first instant.
No wonder he had sensed this flower’s fragrance with his divine sense. In the Netherworld, nothing had a physical body. They were all in soul form.
“What Yin soul? What the hell is Yin soul?” The little azure dragon blinked its eyes. Though it was an old monster from millions and millions of years ago, it was actually as naive as an infant.

“It’s a ghost!” Ling Han shouted loudly, and took the initiative to charge towards the Yin soul. This was a True Self Tier Yin soul. Its power was very strong, but it could not use the Regulations of heaven and earth. This kind of True Self Tier could only be considered a stronger Core Formation Tier at most, so Ling Han naturally did not cower.
Shua, the Yin soul brandished its saber in a slash.
Ling Han took it head-on with his fists, but this Yin soul’s power was stronger, and the saber’s blade was also extremely sharp, slashing his fists to the point that blood was beginning to seep out.

“Humph, I don’t know how many True Self Tier Yin souls I’ve killed, and I still can’t do anything to you?” he humphed lightly. Destructive Energy was activated. This could allow him to defeat the strong while he himself was weaker.
The moment this high-level energy appeared, that Yin soul immediately looked wary. Though its intelligence could only be considered half-awakened, it instinctively feared the Destructive Energy.
“I’ll send you on your way!” Ling Han unleashed a barrage of attacks, and it wasn’t long before he dealt with this Yin soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 4182: Returning to the Netherworld
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yin soul was not strong.

Even if they were at the True Self Tier, without martial arts techniques, they couldn’t draw on heaven and earth’s Regulations. They could be wounded by high-level energy. They had too many weaknesses.
However, there was probably no one else that could deal with it as easily as Ling Han.
“Going by that theory, this is Netherworld?” Lin Luo walked over. He had naturally heard Ling Han’s words just now.

Ling Han nodded and said, “This is a connection point with the Netherworld. It was sealed by the Holy Emperor using a powerful technique, but after such a long time, this seal has loosened. Going by the looks of it, it won’t be long before the seal loses its effects completely. At that time, a large number of Yin souls will penetrate deeply, and it will be inevitable that a great battle will break out.”

Everyone was solemn. They had just entered into this space, and had already encountered a True Self Tier Yin soul. Then, there would be no need for other Spirit Transformation Tier Yin souls to appear. As long as there were more True Self Tier Yin souls, they would have a hard time.
“This place is really dangerous,” Lin Luo exclaimed, but an expectant expression appeared on his face.
He had once been the strongest Heavenly Venerable Tier elite in the Genesis World. Faced with danger, he could only muster up the strength and confidence to challenge them.
“Let go, this belongs to Grandpa Dog!”
“No, it belongs to Grandpa Dragon!”
On the sidelines, the large black dog and little azure dragon were already fighting. They both wanted to snatch that peculiar flower.
Ling Han sighed. How could it be that these two guys did not have the slightest bit of awareness?
He moved, suppressing both dog and dragon, and then went to study that peculiar flower.
“I don’t know how to describe this Celestial medicine either,” Ling Han said. “This isn’t a physical body, and it’s actually just a ball of energy. It’s nourishing to the soul.”

“No wonder that Yin soul would set up an ambush here. It has probably been nurtured by this Celestial medicine for a long time, and that is why it has slowly developed intelligence,” Lin Luo said from the sidelines.

Ling Han nodded, and said, “That Yin soul seemed to realize that being slowly nurtured by the Celestial Flower, its effects are better than directly consuming it. It only charged out when we were about to harvest it. From this, it can be seen that the intelligence of this Yin soul is already quite shocking.”
“Hiss, if there are many such Celestial Flowers here, then wouldn’t there be countless Yin souls that have gained intelligence?” The large black dog approached and said.

Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, “Aside from Celestial medicines, Yin souls can also devour each other, strengthening their abilities and developing intelligence. Thus, there should be no shortage of powerful Yin souls here.”

He had entered the Netherworld with his soul before, but the most powerful Yin soul there was only Sect Master Tier-level. Furthermore, it was possible that even more powerful Yin souls were deliberately “rearing” it, nurturing it until Venerate Tier-level before eating it.

It was unknown what level the strongest Yin soul in this area was. If a Venerate Tier elite appeared... then even if the Yin soul wasn’t strong, it could still easily crush its opponents with its cultivation level.
“We have to be careful.”
“M-hm.”
When it came to a matter of life and death, even the large black dog and the little azure dragon didn’t dare to be careless. They nodded one after another, their expressions serious.
“Then, what about this flower?” the large black dog asked, licking his lips.

Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “The strength of my soul has already reached the level of Spirit Transformation Tier. This Celestial Flower doesn’t have much effect on me, so I won’t participate in the distribution. However, I think there should be no shortage of such Celestial medicines here, so why don’t we take turns?”
“Then Grandpa Dog will be the first.”
“No, Grandpa Dragon is the first!”
The two troublemakers began to fight again.
Ling Han sighed, and said, “You guys just do rock-paper-scissors.”
“Okay, okay!” Hu Niu’s interest was instantly piqued.
They played rock-paper-scissors, and Hu Niu easily won first place.
Was this the True Dragon of Fortune showing its might?

Hu Niu plucked the Celestial Flower, but there was no need for her to consume it at all. This Celestial Flower directly fused into the palm of her hand, and her spirit immediately improved greatly. In fact, she could even see it clearly from the outside. It was like a furnace, soaring straight into the heavens.
“Niu, hurry up and suppress it,” Ling Han hurriedly said.
Hu Niu nodded, and used her mystical power to wrap around it tightly, not allowing the soul light to rush out of her body.
Otherwise, the souls of living people were greatly nutritious for Yin souls. Yin souls in the distance would immediately swarm over like sharks that had smelt blood.
They had to be careful here, but they couldn’t do nothing. Moreover, there was obviously a great opportunity here. If they didn’t hurry, it would be snatched by others.
After walking for a while, as expected, they discovered another spirit-type Celestial medicine.

Three, four, five. There were really quite a lot of spirit-type Celestial medicines here, but some were True Self Tier-level, some were Cauldron Forging Tier-level, but none were Spirit Transformation Tier-level.
Aside from that, they also discovered even more corpses of Saints. They were burning fiercely, and they could chase away the cold just by being close.
In these two days, they had gathered over a hundred Celestial medicines, but not a single one was suitable for Ling Han.
Another day later, the situation finally changed.

Ling Han saw a familiar scene again. Countless Yin souls formed a long queue, and were presently advancing in the same direction. The end could not be seen with a single glance, and the length of the queue was astonishingly long.
“This is a good chance!” Lin Luo and the others were all rubbing their hands in anticipation.
They had all heard Ling Han say that killing Yin souls in the Netherworld could strengthen one’s soul.Yin and Yang could complement each other.
The Yin souls here were not strong, and were just right for sweeping through.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! They charged out, and channelled high-level energy one after another, beginning the massacre.
Yin soul didn’t have a physical body, so mystical power attacks were ineffective. Only high-level energy could cause damage to it.
However, after a period of slaughter, Lin Luo and the others all retreated, shaking their heads.
Their souls had not strengthened.
Yi, why not?
“Could it be because I entered this place as a soul the last time?” Ling Han asked.
“That might have been blocked by our physical bodies,” Lin Luo said. “Try again. The moment you kill one, release your physical body.”
They tried again, and this time, they succeeded.
“However, the physical body would also block a considerable amount of Yin soul energy,” they all said.

Ling Han smiled, and said, “You guys don’t have to worry about the conversion rate at all. There are too many Yin souls here, and they can easily send the strength of your souls to the True Self Tier, but after this, how to kill Yin souls of the True Self Tier is the real difficulty.”
They didn’t have the Destructive Energy, so it was too difficult for them to battle above their cultivation level.
“Furthermore, there are Ghost Spirit Crystals here that can increase the strength of the soul. This would be even more helpful in increasing the strength of the soul.”
“All right, let’s go find a mine!” the large black dog said.

Ling Han pondered for a moment. The situation here was more or less the same as last time. The only thing that could not be confirmed was what level of Yin soul elite possessed this territory. The stronger the boss was, the stronger the generals under his command would naturally be.
In his soul form, Ling Han was no longer restrained. Relying on the freakish intimidation of the Destructive Energy, he could just barely put up a fight against a Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul.
However, he couldn’t do that now. His soul was restrained by his physical body. His strength had clearly increased, but his ability to suppress Yin souls had instead decreased.
He explained his concerns, and everyone fell silent.
“It’s not that there’s no way,” the little azure dragon said. “We can’t resist the cold here now, not because Body Art can’t, but because we haven’t crossed the threshold of True Self Tier yet.”
“For mystical power cultivators, the True Self Tier is a barrier, but for Body Arts, isn’t it the same?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4183: The Last Accumulation
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

According to the little azure dragon, once one advanced into the True Self Tier, Body Arts could also undergo an earth-shattering change. Although it wasn’t as exaggerated as mystical power cultivators, the boiling of one’s blood and Qi meant that resisting this coldness was at least a piece of cake.
“It should be known that Yin souls are most afraid of the toughest and strongest Yang blood and Qi, so us Body Arts cultivators are the nemesis of Yin souls!”
The little azure dragon proudly said that the ancestor of Body Arts was definitely a True Dragon. Unfortunately, this was not passed on, and there was a lapse until the little azure dragon was born.
“All right, then we’ll break through to the True Self Tier first!” Ling Han nodded, then frowned. “The question is, can we break through to the True Self Tier in the Netherworld?”
Didn’t you see that those True Self Tier cultivators were unable to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth?

“It should be possible,” Lin Luo said in a low voice. “After cultivating to the end of the Core Formation Tier, shards of Regulations have already been left in our bodies. We only need to refine these Regulations, and it would be enough for us to complete that crucial leap.”
“However, this isn’t the Living Realm, after all. Thus, we’re unable to obtain the pouring of power from the heaven and earth, so it’ll definitely be slightly inferior.”
The little azure dragon continued, “That’s all right. At least in Body Art, we can still advance!”
That’s right. The Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique used high-level energy to temper the physical body, and even in the Netherworld, high-level energy could still be communicated.
Everyone reached a consensus, but breaking through a major tier wasn’t something that could be done with mere thought.

Though Ling Han, the little dragon, and the large black dog had already reached the end of the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han and the little dragon still needed some time to accumulate their power. Only the large black dog was already capable of taking that step.

However, the large black dog had just begun to cultivate the Core Formation Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. It was meaningless even if he broke through to the True Self Tier, because the Body Art couldn’t keep up.
Ling Han decided to first find the Ghost Spirit Crystal and complete his accumulation in battle.

They followed the army of Yin soul soldiers, and soon arrived at the place where the Ghost Spirit Crystals were placed, and where Yin souls were lured to kill each other. They moved, and this naturally drew out the powerful Yin soul soldiers that were on standby. They were still True Self Tier-level, but had completely developed intelligence.
After capturing this Yin soul, after a round of interrogation, this Yin soul knew nothing about the Ghost Spirit Crystal mine.
Alright, this level was too low, so it was normal that he did not know.
Everyone continued to battle. Since they had nothing else to do, they might as well nurture themselves through battle.

They wreaked havoc here, killing a great many True Self Tier-level Yin souls, and finally drew out the great monsters. Five days later, a Spirit Transformation Tier-level Yin soul appeared, and discovered them from afar. Then, it flew over and launched a fierce offensive.
The moment they exchanged blows, Ling Han felt a mountain of pressure.

In the past, he had also teamed up with Chi Menghan and they used the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together to kill a Spiritual Transformation Tier monster. Now that he was alone, even if his abilities had greatly improved, it was still not enough to fight against it.
“Retreat!” he shouted lightly, covering everyone’s retreat.

Thankfully, Destructive Energy was a great threat to any Yin soul. Even a great Yin soul of Spirit Transformation Tier didn’t dare to force him too far, but it didn’t give up, following Ling Han all the way.
This was troublesome. Bringing such a burden, there was no peace at all.
But he had already provoked him, so what else could he do?
They fought as they retreated. Thankfully, the Destructive Energy was strong enough, so the great yin soul was still extremely wary.

As time passed, Ling Han and the others were starting to struggle to hold up. This was because the coldness of this place was far too terrifying. They needed to constantly use high-level energy to resist it, and this was far too taxing on their Spiritual Power.
They had no option but to retreat to the nearest location where the corpses of the Saints lay. They needed to rest and reorganize there.

Several hours later, they arrived at their destination. This was the femur of a Saint, and was several hundred meters long. It was exuding a powerful aura unique to Saints, as if it wanted to tear apart the heavens itself.
This Saint’s bone was burning, releasing azure flames, completely expelling the coldness.
Ling Han and the others hurriedly rushed over. They were about to reach their limit.
Yi?
They discovered that the great yin soul actually stopped far away, and did not pursue them any further.
“Could it be that he doesn’t dare to come over?” the large black dog speculated.

“That should be the case.” Lin Luo nodded, “Looks like even after the Saint from the Living Realm died, a terrifying aura would still be released, which would have the effect of restraining Yin souls.”
This was a discovery that they had come across by accident. By the looks of it, not only could the corpse of a Saint resist the extreme cold, it could also deter Yin souls. It was a true sanctuary.
Everyone hurriedly rested, recovering their Spiritual Power.
This was different from mystical power. It did not come from the power of heaven and earth. One only needed to get enough rest, and would naturally recover.
A day later, Ling Han took the initiative to step out to meet this great yin soul head-on.
“Grandpa Dragon is coming too!” The little azure dragon also joined the battle.

Though the Yin soul was not strong, this was a Spiritual Transformation Tier-level monster, after all. After a short battle, Ling Han and the little azure dragon were riddled with wounds. Their physical bodies were practically ineffective against the attacks of the Yin soul, and the attacks could reach directly into their minds.
Thus, what it had wounded was their divine sense.
Thankfully, it was not heavy. They both knew their limits, and saw it as a tempering.

Unfortunately, this Yin soul was too strong, and was only suitable for Ling Han and the little azure dragon to temper themselves. If anyone else went up, their soul would definitely be destroyed at the first instant, and their physical body would be possessed.
Fighting like this, seven days later, Ling Han and little azure dragon stopped attacking.
There was no further need. In these few days of intense battles, they had already completed the accumulation of their cultivation level, and could take the next step.
The man and dragon both started to break through to the True Self Tier, and the large black dog started breaking through a day before them.

At this time, Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core had long since liquefied completely, turning into an alchemy pool, and in the alchemy pool, there were Regulations floating and sinking, totalling nine.

If he wanted to become a True Self Tier elite, he would have to use the Regulations to create the True Self, and manifest all the Regulations into the True Self. This meant that he had completed the first step of the True Self Tier.

However, the True Self Tier’s Four Forms could only be completely stabilized after four transformations. At that time, one would be able to advance to the next cultivation level, Spirit Transformation Tier.

For ordinary cultivators of the Core Formation Tier, they had only needed to inscribe the three Regulations of the True Self Tier on the Celestial Core. Thus, it was also very easy to complete the True Self, because there were very few True Selves.
Ling Han was different. He had a total of nine Regulations.
Now, there was a problem of which Regulation he should first construct.
Logically speaking, there was nothing to hesitate about. It must be the Destruction Regulation, which was the most powerful.
However, the problem was that Ling Han had never comprehended the Destruction Regulation before. This was completely because of the Power of Dimension in his body, allowing him to easily grasp it.
However, the True Self Tier was the stage when one truly began to interact with the Regulations of heaven and earth. If one wanted to comprehend the True Self Tier, what could they do?
Ling Han only hesitated for a moment, but still decided to first gnaw on a tough nut like the Destruction Regulation..
That was because he would have to touch it sooner or later. It was better to do it earlier than later. This was a kind of self-confidence.
Sometimes, confidence was really very important.
All right, he would start from Regulation of Destruction.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and extracted the Regulation of Destruction from the alchemy pool. Using this as the structure, he molded the True Self.

In these few days of intense battles, they had already completed the accumulation of their cultivation level, and could take the next step.
The man and dragon both started to break through to the True Self Tier, and the large black dog started breaking through a day before them.

At this time, Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core had long since liquefied completely, turning into an alchemy pool, and in the alchemy pool, there were Regulations floating and sinking, totalling nine.
If he wanted to become a True Self Tier elite, he would have to use the Regulations to create the True Self, and manifest all the Regulations into the True Self.
This meant that he had completed the first step of the True Self Tier.
However, the True Self Tier’s Four Forms could only be completely stabilized after four transformations.
At that time, one would be able to advance to the next cultivation level, Spirit Transformation Tier.
For ordinary cultivators of the Core Formation Tier, they had only needed to inscribe the three Regulations of the True Self Tier on the Celestial Core.
Thus, it was also very easy to complete the True Self, because there were very few True Selves.
Ling Han was different.
He had a total of nine Regulations.
Now, there was a problem of which Regulation he should first construct.
Logically speaking, there was nothing to hesitate about.
It must be the Destruction Regulation, which was the most powerful.
However, the problem was that Ling Han had never comprehended the Destruction Regulation before.
This was completely because of the Power of Dimension in his body, allowing him to easily grasp it.
However, the True Self Tier was the stage when one truly began to interact with the Regulations of heaven and earth.
If one wanted to comprehend the True Self Tier, what could they do?
Ling Han only hesitated for a moment, but still decided to first gnaw on a tough nut like the Destruction Regulation..
That was because he would have to touch it sooner or later.
It was better to do it earlier than later.
This was a kind of self-confidence.
Sometimes, confidence was really very important.
All right, he would start from Regulation of Destruction.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and extracted the Regulation of Destruction from the alchemy pool.
Using this as the structure, he molded the True Self.

chapters.title: Chapter 4184: Breaking through to the True Self Tier
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The True Self Tier was a transition to Spirit Transformation Tier.
What was Spiritual Transformation Tier?
The True Self and Spirit Transformation were like doppelgangers; they could roam the world.
Thus, the stronger the True Self Tier was, the stronger the spiritual body it manifested.

Ling Han began to construct the True Self of Destruction. He used the Regulation of Destruction as the structure, and the alchemical fluid as his blood and flesh, forming a ball of Primal Chaos that could not be seen clearly.
This was natural. The True Self had a total of four forms, and it was only when it reached the fourth form that the True Self could truly be formed.
Pa!
This ball of matter very quickly shattered, and fell into the alchemy pool.
The first attempt was declared a failure.
Ling Han naturally didn’t pay any heed to this. It would be far too easy to complete this step in a single stroke. Moreover, he was creating the True Self of Destruction.
He began to study the Regulation of Destruction. Now that he had reached this stage, he was tentatively qualified to do so.
However, the Regulation of Destruction was too mysterious.
This was a 10-star high-level energy, and even the Great Emperor had not touched it before. Though he possessed it, it was not his own power.
Thus, no matter how hard he tried, it was completely useless.

After failing several times in a row, a thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Since he had relied on the Power of Dimension in his body to cultivate Destructive Energy, could he comprehend it with the Power of Dimension in his body?
Let’s give it a try.
He stimulated the Power of Dimensions, then reconstructed the True Self of Destruction.

Skeleton formed, flesh grew, and everything was as it had been before. Then, this ‘true self’ was about to begin crumbling, but right at this moment, the Power of Dimension activated. Though it was weak, it had a miraculous effect.
The Regulation of Destruction stabilized, and no longer resisted, acting obediently.
The True Self continued to form, and everything went extremely smoothly.
It was only a day, and the True Self of Destruction had already been completed, turning into a clay figure.
The True Self Tier!

This was the first step, clay fetus. Next, he would have to strengthen the True Self of Destruction, and when it had reached the pinnacle, he would be able to create a second True Self, right until the Regulations in the alchemy pool had been completely constructed into True Selves.
In this way, the first form of the True Self was completed, and he could begin to shape it.
Weng, in Ling Han’s mind, a human figure that was shining with golden light immediately appeared. He held a slashing saber, and launched an attack at Ling Han.
It was an internal demon.
Ling Han was unafraid. He didn’t even need to use the Six Characters Bright King Curse, and activated the True Self of Destruction to greet the incoming attack.
“How dare you, you actually dare to steal such great power!” This internal demon shouted loudly, as if it was extremely furious.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and ignored him completely. The True Self of Destruction directly crashed into him.
The strength of his soul was comparable to the Spirit Transformation Tier. Killing the internal demon was naturally a piece of cake for him, and he dealt with it in a few moves.
Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes, and a streak of divine light shot out, directly illuminating heaven and earth.
Boom! A devastating aura erupted from his body, causing Lin Luo, the empress, and the others to feel suffocated.
He was now in the True Self Tier, so his aura was naturally terrifying.
“Ling Han, you’ve broken through?” Lin Luo appeared to be in disbelief.
From the Core Formation Tier to the True Self Tier, no matter how smooth the process was, it would take at least ten days, right?
‘You took care of it in a single day? What a joke!’

Ling Han was also very surprised. If he switched to using the other Regulations in the alchemy pool, then it would definitely take more than a day for him to successfully mold the True Self. No matter how freakish he was, it would still take at least five to six days.

However, the Destructive Energy was clearly the most profound, yet with the help of the Power of Dimension within his body, it easily transformed into the True Self. It was as if the heavens were helping him.

Ling Han nodded. He looked at the sky, and there was a completely different kind of comprehension. It was as if the heaven and earth had appeared in front of him in another form, as if it was within reach, allowing him to comprehend and understand.
No wonder it was said that only those at the True Self Tier could truly cultivate the Regulations of heaven and earth. So that was how it was.
“Haha, Niu’s Ling Han is really awesome!” Hu Niu laughed, and jumped into Ling Han’s arms like a kitten.
Ling Han laughed loudly. After conversing with the others for a while, he began to test out his current strength.

“Before I broke through, my power was comparable to the Third Heaven of the True Self Tier. Now... I’m about at the Sixth Heaven, which is comparable to the middle stage of the True Self Tier!” He casually threw a punch, and the mystical power was stimulated by the True Self of Destruction, causing his power to increase in a breakthrough manner.
Furthermore, this was activated by the True Self of Destruction, so it naturally had a sliver of the True Self of Destruction in it, greatly increasing its destructive power.
However, his Body Art was still stuck on the level of the Core Formation Tier.

“In this place, Regulations don’t appear, so I have no way to continue cultivating.” Ling Han nodded internally. This was the Netherworld, and he couldn’t grasp the Regulations of heaven and earth at all. Thus, his cultivation level was stuck at this level.
“However, Body Art isn’t affected!”
Ling Han began to cultivate the True Self Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. This time, he directly used Five Star Energy to temper himself.
“Wu!”

How violent was the destructive power of five-star energy? He was naturally drawing fire onto himself, and almost killed himself directly. Thankfully, he had established a strong foundation previously, and his physique was tough enough to withstand such torment.
After spending five days, Ling Han finally channeled the True Self Tier chapter fully. Instantly, multiple dragon scales appeared on the surface of his body, exuding a dragon’s might.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He was a human, so he didn’t have the slightest interest in becoming a dragon, even if this was a being with the highest status in the world.
‘All techniques are natural, so dragon scales are only a symbol,’ he thought. Then why couldn’t it be reflected in other ways?
He explored deeply, and gained repeated enlightenment.
“Haha, Grandpa Dragon has broken through!” The little azure dragon let out a loud roar. Boom! It unleashed an astonishing aura.

He took a look, and when he saw Ling Han sitting cross-legged on the ground, he thought that Ling Han was still trying to break through to the True Self Tier—previously, he had been completely engrossed, and had no idea what had happened at all—so he couldn’t help but feel proud, finally surpassing Ling Han for once.
“Ling Han broke through five days ago,” the empress said calmly. There was a proud expression on her face.
“What?!” The little azure dragon was instantly dumbfounded.
Are you joking?
“Niu’s Ling Han is much more powerful than you!” Hu Niu added insult to injury.

The little azure dragon felt a pain in its chest. Hiss, it had only been six days, and it had already completed its breakthrough. This was overwhelmingly awesome. Even if it was not number one in history, it was not that far off either.
But he was actually still inferior to Ling Han, and the gap was not just a little bit.

“Damn it!” The little azure dragon also sat down. He was going to begin cultivating the True Self Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. He didn’t believe that he would fall behind Ling Han in this area.
Another two days later, the large black dog finally completed his breakthrough and advanced into the True Self Tier.

Time flew by, and four days quickly passed. Ling Han’s body began to exude an unstable yet incredibly powerful aura, as if it had solidified. Wave after wave, it was about to push the empress, Lin Luo, and the others out.
He was now in the True Self Tier, and even the power that was unconsciously seeping out was still terrifying. The empress and the others were completely unable to resist it.
But it should be known that in the distance, there was also a great yin soul that was restless.
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu hurriedly shouted.
Ling Han shuddered, and when he came back to his senses, his aura instantly ebbed like the ebbing tide, all of it absorbed into his body.
Multiple seals appeared on the surface of his body, looking a little like dragon scales.

chapters.title: Chapter 4185: Counter Suppression
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han had succeeded.

He removed the dragon scales and replaced them with pure seals, because this was actually also an application of the energy of heaven and earth, and seals were the most primitive display. The dragon scales, on the other hand, were a kind of transformation of seals.
Thus, the appearance of dragon scales or feathers was actually not a problem. Ling Han very easily reconstructed the dragon scales, presenting them in the most primitive way.
“Aiyo!” The little azure dragon was cultivating, so it was caught off guard and instantly lost its balance.
“Who sneak attacked Grandpa Dragon!” he shouted.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Come, let’s kill the enemy!” He charged out, and took the initiative to greet that great Yin soul.
Boom, Destructive Energy surged, its might boundless.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. This was because he clearly hadn’t obtained the fourth corner of the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy. However, the might of this high-level energy had forcibly increased by a significant amount.

Indeed, his cultivation level had increased, and the level of his soul had also risen to another level. This would allow the Destructive Energy to become even stronger, but this leap shouldn’t have been as great as this, right?
In an instant, realization dawned on Ling Han.
The True Self Tier!
This was a barrier. After crossing this barrier, one would be able to use the Regulations of heaven and earth, and high-level energy could actually be categorized into this category.
Moreover, starting from the True Self Tier, he had to cultivate power, and the importance of Spiritual Power had also suddenly increased to another level.
Why?
The stronger the Spiritual Power, the more high-level energy and Regulations of heaven and earth could be mobilized!
Ling Han charged over and threw a punch.
The great yin soul returned the attack, but this caused the Destructive Energy to boil and charge towards it.
It immediately released a sharp scream on the level of divine sense, appearing to be in extreme pain.

Destructive Energy was extremely destructive to both living beings and Yin souls. Even if there was a gap of a major cultivation level, it still suffered a massive impact, and one of its arms was immediately severed.
Fortunately, the yin soul didn’t have a physical body, and its arms were only manifestations. It immediately grew a new arm, but its size suddenly shrunk by a size.
Ling Han laughed loudly. Previously, he had been extremely disheveled from being pursued by this large monster, and now, the tables had finally turned.
‘Die!’

He unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing a barrage of murderous aura, but it no longer reached with just a thought. Instead, it had taken the form of a small black figure, with obvious traces of trajectory.
The large yin soul didn’t dare to oppose him anymore, and hurriedly turned around to flee.

Ling Han was hot on his heels, and after spending some effort, he finally got rid of this large Yin soul. He released his physical body, and felt a sliver of energy surge into his body, nourishing his soul, which had a slight improvement.
It couldn’t be helped. His present physique was too tough. Not only did it prevent attacks from entering, it even treated all beneficial energy equally.
Ling Han was slightly depressed. Looks like if he wanted to improve the strength of his soul, he would have to kill a terrifyingly large number of Spirit Transformation Tier Yin souls.
Sigh!
He walked back, and shockingly discovered that the coldness here had suddenly decreased by a level.
En, it was not that the coldness had decreased, but rather that his physique had improved to another level, which had the effect of resisting the coldness.
The little azure dragon wasn’t wrong. After he advanced into the True Self Tier, the might of Body Art was further unleashed.
“Little Han, how about it, isn’t the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique awesome?” the little azure dragon said proudly.

“Impressive!” Ling Han nodded. As expected of a technique created by a Great Emperor. Perhaps only the True Dragon would be able to do so, because there was only one True Dragon in the world, and it had reached such a high level in Body Art.
The other Great Emperors wanted to create Body Arts, but they could not possibly reach this kind of height. At most, they could only have their physiques reach Saint Tier-level.
They continued to set out in search of the peculiar flower and Ghost Spirit Crystals.
At present, Ling Han had already advanced into the True Self Tier, and could even kill Spirit Transformation Tier Yin souls. He had practically no qualms, and could be invincible.
On the other hand, Ling Han was still very expectant of encountering great Yin souls of Spirit Transformation Tier, which could nourish his soul.

Ling Han no longer needed to rely on the flames burning on the corpse of the Saint to dispel the chill. The same was true for the little azure dragon. Their physiques were tough enough, but Hu Niu, the empress, and the others were still unable to do so. Every once in a while, they would have to look for the corpse of the Saint.
Two days later, they arrived at the corpse of another Saint.
This was a skull, and it was 9000 feet tall. It was like a colossal city.
“Yi!”
When they saw this skull, everyone exclaimed in surprise. That was because the bones of the Saint previously were all burning with green flames, but this one was blue in colour.
“Could it be that it wasn’t produced by the same Saint?”
“Er, perhaps it is the skull that is more special?”
Ling Han sensed for a while, and said, “It should be two Saints. The colour of these flames are different, and it should be because Regulations are different.”
“F***, then how many Saints are buried here?” The large black dog almost jumped.

This was where the Great Emperor suppressed. However, even though there was a Great Emperor, at least two Saints had still died. In fact, even the remains of the corpses had been left behind in the Netherworld.

“According to legends, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor battled all his life, not even leaving behind any descendants or heirs. From this, it can be seen just how powerful his enemies are.” Ling Han said slowly, “Perhaps, the Netherworld also has great elites, enough to give even the Ancestral King a headache!”
Everyone exchanged looks. Could it be that Netherworld beings also had Great Emperor beings?

When they thought of this possibility, everyone felt a fear that caused their hair to stand on end. Yin and Yang were opposites, and there was absolutely no possibility of coexistence. Furthermore, if the Netherworld beings were to attack under the leadership of a Great Emperor, what force in the Living Realm would be able to stop them?
“Yi, what is this?” Hu Niu bent down and picked up a bone.
This was a tortoise shell, but it was not complete. It was like a Yinyang fish, with only half of it left.
“Treasure!” The large black dog immediately snatched it over, and began to rub its paws together. However, it soon looked embarrassed and angry. Pa, it threw away the tortoise shell
This was an extremely ordinary tortoise shell.
He had been tricked!
Ling Han picked up the tortoise shell again. He activated his eye technique and looked over, but couldn’t see anything special about it.
After some thought, he still decided to put this thing away.
Yi?
He wanted to store the tortoise shell into his Spatial Spirit Tool. In any case, it didn’t take up much space, but he discovered that he couldn’t store this thing in.
An incredibly ordinary tortoise shell actually couldn’t be stored into a Spatial Tool?
Merely from this aspect, this thing was not ordinary.
Furthermore, why had this been discovered beside the bones of a Saint?

Ling Han put the tortoise shell into his pocket, and decided to study it carefully after he left. Perhaps, there were no Regulations of the Living Realm here, and that was why the tortoise shell did not show its brilliance?
The large black dog shook his head, and said, “Ha, Little Han, do you really care about this broken tortoise shell?”
Ling Han smiled and said, “It might be useful.” He didn’t reveal the truth, and he planned to share it with the others after discovering its uses.
“Rest for a while, and we’ll leave.”

They recovered for a while, and were just planning to continue onwards, when they saw a figure flying towards them from afar. His speed was extraordinarily fast, and he had not even neared them, when they already felt a great aura that could suppress heaven and earth.
“Hiss, Sect Master level!”

At present, Ling Han had already advanced into the True Self Tier, and could even kill Spirit Transformation Tier Yin souls.
He had practically no qualms, and could be invincible.
On the other hand, Ling Han was still very expectant of encountering great Yin souls of Spirit Transformation Tier, which could nourish his soul.
Ling Han no longer needed to rely on the flames burning on the corpse of the Saint to dispel the chill.
The same was true for the little azure dragon.
Their physiques were tough enough, but Hu Niu, the empress, and the others were still unable to do so.
Every once in a while, they would have to look for the corpse of the Saint.
Two days later, they arrived at the corpse of another Saint.
This was a skull, and it was 9000 feet tall.
It was like a colossal city.
“Yi!”
When they saw this skull, everyone exclaimed in surprise.
That was because the bones of the Saint previously were all burning with green flames, but this one was blue in colour.
“Could it be that it wasn’t produced by the same Saint?”
“Er, perhaps it is the skull that is more special?”
Ling Han sensed for a while, and said, “It should be two Saints.
The colour of these flames are different, and it should be because Regulations are different.”
“F***, then how many Saints are buried here?” The large black dog almost jumped.
This was where the Great Emperor suppressed.
However, even though there was a Great Emperor, at least two Saints had still died.
In fact, even the remains of the corpses had been left behind in the Netherworld.
“According to legends, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor battled all his life, not even leaving behind any descendants or heirs.
From this, it can be seen just how powerful his enemies are.” Ling Han said slowly, “Perhaps, the Netherworld also has great elites, enough to give even the Ancestral King a headache!”
Everyone exchanged looks.
Could it be that Netherworld beings also had Great Emperor beings?
When they thought of this possibility, everyone felt a fear that caused their hair to stand on end.
Yin and Yang were opposites, and there was absolutely no possibility of coexistence.
Furthermore, if the Netherworld beings were to attack under the leadership of a Great Emperor, what force in the Living Realm would be able to stop them?
“Yi, what is this?” Hu Niu bent down and picked up a bone.
This was a tortoise shell, but it was not complete.
It was like a Yinyang fish, with only half of it left.
“Treasure!” The large black dog immediately snatched it over, and began to rub its paws together.
However, it soon looked embarrassed and angry.
Pa, it threw away the tortoise shell
This was an extremely ordinary tortoise shell.
He had been tricked!
Ling Han picked up the tortoise shell again.
He activated his eye technique and looked over, but couldn’t see anything special about it.
After some thought, he still decided to put this thing away.
Yi?
He wanted to store the tortoise shell into his Spatial Spirit Tool.
In any case, it didn’t take up much space, but he discovered that he couldn’t store this thing in.
An incredibly ordinary tortoise shell actually couldn’t be stored into a Spatial Tool?
Merely from this aspect, this thing was not ordinary.
Furthermore, why had this been discovered beside the bones of a Saint?
Ling Han put the tortoise shell into his pocket, and decided to study it carefully after he left.
Perhaps, there were no Regulations of the Living Realm here, and that was why the tortoise shell did not show its brilliance?
The large black dog shook his head, and said, “Ha, Little Han, do you really care about this broken tortoise shell?”
Ling Han smiled and said, “It might be useful.” He didn’t reveal the truth, and he planned to share it with the others after discovering its uses.
“Rest for a while, and we’ll leave.”
They recovered for a while, and were just planning to continue onwards, when they saw a figure flying towards them from afar.
His speed was extraordinarily fast, and he had not even neared them, when they already felt a great aura that could suppress heaven and earth.
“Hiss, Sect Master level!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4186: A real great Yin soul
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han waited here for many days, and finally, attracted a Sect Master Yin soul.
Even if Ling Han had already advanced into the True Self Tier and possessed Destructive Energy, he still didn’t dare to face the might of a Sect Master Yin soul.

That’s right. When he was in the True Self Tier, he had already been on the same level as a Yin soul of Spirit Transformation Tier. However, at that time, he had already reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. Now, however, he was only in the early stage of the True Self Tier. The gap between them was extremely large.
This great yin soul descended. As a Sect Master, its intelligence was naturally completely awakened. Thus, the human figure it took form in was also incredibly vivid.
It looked coldly at Ling Han and the others, “It was you damn insects that killed my subordinates!”
“That’s right, it’s your Grandpa Dragon. So what? If you can, come bite Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon began to act despicable, continuously waving its claws at the great yin soul.

The large yin soul was not angered, and his expression was still cold. “The fact that you can enter into this space means that the seal is about to be unsealed. Haha, with the help of your bodies, I can go out and take a look.”
“Come on, come on!” The little azure dragon crooked a claw at him.

Meanwhile, the large black dog jeered, “Old geezer, you can tolerate that? In any case, Grandpa Dog can’t tolerate that. If it was Grandpa Dog, I would have long since beaten this Four-Legged Snake to death!”
“Don’t be reserved. Grandpa Dragon will wait for you here!” the little azure dragon continued to shout.

The large Yin soul did not act rashly, and said calmly, “I have existed for who knows how many years, and you guys want to trick me into entering into the area where the Saint’s bone is effective, and use the Saint’s bone to suppress me? Heh, you guys are really dreaming!”
“F***, even ghosts have intelligence now!” The large black dog exclaimed in shock, pretending to be surprised.

After several times of teasing, the large Yin soul finally revealed a furious expression. He was the king of this area, and had countless Yin souls under his command. Now, he was actually provoked by a few mere Core Formation Tier, and True Self Tier cultivators, so how could he not be furious?
“When I capture you, I will slowly devour your souls. At that time, you will know that death is a kind of release,” the great yin soul said calmly, still very well in control of his emotions.
“What do we do? This Yin soul won’t fall for it?” The large black dog looked towards Ling Han.
“It can’t be helped. After all, he is not an idiot.” Ling Han shrugged.
Seeing that they were still teasing him, the great yin soul’s killing intent became even stronger.

However, Ling Han and the others didn’t leave, and the great yin soul didn’t dare to charge over either. The bone of the Saint was burning the Regulations of the Living Realm, which had a terrifying destructive power against the yin souls. Even if it was at the level of Sect Master, it still didn’t dare to approach.
With a thought, it suddenly soared up. Xiu, it had flown off without a trace.
“This old b*stard is definitely lying in ambush for us in the distance,” the large black dog said.
Everyone nodded. This was obviously a plan to lure the snake out of its hole, but the problem was, were they going to stay here forever?
Unless the Saints of the Living Realm charged over, they would only be able to await death. After all, the corpse of the Saint would eventually be burnt to nothing.
“Let’s wait for two days first,” Ling Han said.
Two days passed, and there was still no sign of the great yin soul.
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower contained the Heavenly Dao Flames. It could burn even Venerate Tier elites, so a mere Sect Master was naturally no problem.
Everyone moved out. They did not continue onwards, but rather returned in the original direction.
This was the Netherworld, and the Great Emperor had already sealed a connecting point. Thus, it was impossible to find another connecting point to the Living Realm.
They had to return and wait for the seal to be unlocked. This was the only way out.
After they had walked a certain distance, xiu, a figure streaked across the skies, and then descended.
Wasn’t it that Sect Master great Yin soul from before?

“Now, where can you guys run to?” the large Yin soul asked calmly. It had deliberately allowed Ling Han and the others to walk very far before charging out. In this way, even if Ling Han and the others had some kind of trump card that could block it for a while, they would definitely not have the time to escape back to where the Saint’s corpse was.
Thus, these living beings were definitely going to die.
“It’s been too long since I’ve had a taste of a living soul!” This great Yin soul said, its eye sockets exuding a cold light.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Old rascal, I’ll give you a chance. Don’t seek death!”
“Humph, you living beings, all of you really have very cheap mouths!” The great Yin soul sneered, and attacked brazenly.
It was Sect Master-level, so what did it have to fear?
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was already hovering above his head, and once the tower opened, the Heavenly Dao Flames instantly gushed out.
“What!” The great yin soul paled in shock.

This was the Netherworld, so where did these living flames come from? Moreover, it was so terrifying. To say nothing of the fact that it was only at the level of the Sect Master, even Venerate Tier elites could only turn around and flee.
The problem was, it had charged over on its own volition, so could it make it in time to escape?
Boom, like a moth flying into a flame, it took the initiative to throw itself into the raging flames.
“Ah!” This Yin soul screamed tragically, rippling in everyone’s minds.
“You’re reaping what you sow!” the large black dog said with a sigh.

“Remember to be smarter in your next life!” the little azure dragon said. Then, it slapped its paw, and said, “Aiyo, you can’t even be a ghost anymore, so how can you have a next life! A slip of the tongue, a slip of the tongue!”

The large yin soul was already being refined in the first place, and hearing the large black dog and the little azure dragon’s ridicule, if it was a living being, it would definitely be spurting out blood at this moment.
But now, it could only wail in grief. After only a while, it was completely burnt by the Heavenly Dao Flames.
A surge of energy surged over. Everyone had absorbed a portion, and the strength of their souls had increased.
This was Sect Master-level!
“As long as there are thirty to fifty Yin souls of this level, Grandpa Dog’s soul would be able to break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier!” the large black dog said.

“I can only use Heavenly Dao Flames three more times. If a fourth comes, we’ll all die,” Ling Han said. “Moreover, a Sect Master Yin soul is as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns. There’s only one in each area, so don’t count on it.”
“Then should we follow up on our victory and sweep through this den of Yin souls?” The little azure dragon’s fighting spirit was overflowing.

Ling Han shook his head, “I keep suspecting that this is a higher level Yin soul that is rearing Venerate Tier-level Yin souls to feed on. Thus, we had best leave quickly. If we really draw out Venerate Tier-level Yin souls, even the Heavenly Dao Flames might not be able to deal with them.”
Unless the Yin soul stood there and did not dodge or evade, allowing him to burn it, how could a Venerate Tier be so easily killed?
They hurried, and headed back the way they had come.

At this moment, they could clearly feel that there was something off with the atmosphere. The heaven and earth seemed to be filled with oppression, and they had a feeling that a storm was about to come.
“Looks like after killing that Sect Master Yin soul, we really are going to draw out the great monster behind it!”
“Hurry up and flee!”

They were already fast enough, and were not far from the bonfire of the first Saint’s corpse. However, right at this moment, a terrifying aura assaulted them, and a black shadow appeared in the horizon. Even at such a far distance, it still caused their souls to throb.
Venerate Tier, this was a Venerate Tier elite.
The seal had not been opened, so the Venerate Tier elite that had appeared here must be a Yin soul elite!
Hiss!

chapters.title: Chapter 4187: Forced
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and the others hurriedly ran for their lives. They could already see the blazing flames burning on the Saint’s corpse.

In order to intimidate this super yin soul, Ling Han even summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, releasing the Heavenly Dao Flames’ aura. He was sure that with the strength of Venerate Tier, he could completely sense it.
Boom!
A cold wind blew past, and a massive palm slapped over, bringing with it an aura that could sweep aside all matter.
F***, this Venerate Tier-level great yin soul knew that it could not approach, and directly launched a long-distance attack.

With such a great distance between them, the might of the attack would definitely decrease greatly, but it could not hold up to the fact that it was Venerate Tier-level. Even if the might of its attack had decreased to Sect Master Tier-level, it was still capable of easily swatting Ling Han and the others to death.
There was nothing else that could be done. Ling Han could only release the Heavenly Dao Flames again.
Boom!
Raging flames soared into the skies, and the attack that struck over was naturally incinerated.
“Run!” Ling Han shouted. He beckoned everyone to hurriedly run towards the bonfire of Saint bone.
But it was only a few breaths, and the Heavenly Dao Flames that filled the skies had completely dispersed. Hu, another giant hand struck over, and it was still fatal.
F***, Ling Han cursed internally, and once again summoned the Heavenly Dao Flames.
This time, he could only use it again.

To be honest, Ling Han really didn’t want to use it. Something like a trump card was best used for intimidation, because once it was used, it would be gone. However, if he only used it as an intimidation tactic, it could be effective for many times.
The Heavenly Dao Flames soared into the sky, and as expected, dispersed the attack once more.
Thankfully, the bonfire of Saint bone was already right in front of them.
Everyone hurriedly quickened their pace. Shua, they rushed over.
Xiu, in the skies, that Venerate Tier Yin soul descended. It did not have any facial features, but everyone could clearly sense that they were being observed by it.
It was also afraid of the flames burning on the Saint bone, so it simply stared at them and didn’t attack again.
“Damn guy!” someone cursed softly behind Ling Han and the others.
“Hey, who are you insulting?” The large black dog was displeased, and he turned around to look.

Oh, this place was basically still the group that had first entered, but some people had still left. By now, there were about seven Imperial Sons here. At least, Ling Han had seen these seven people before. As for whether there were more, he did not know.
“What did you guys do to actually draw out such a monster!” Xu Jie asked coldly, his voice filled with interrogative intent.
The large black dog sneered, and said, “You’re nothing but a defeated opponent, yet you still have the face to speak to Grandpa Dog?”

Xu Jie’s face instantly flushed red. He very much wanted to refute these words. After all, he hadn’t been defeated by a despicable dog. However, Ling Han was smiling at him from the sidelines, causing his desire to refute to instantly die at the tip of his tongue.
Thus, even if he said such words, Ling Han only had to add a few more words, and he would still be extremely passive.
Thus, it would be better not to say anything.
“Humph! Resolve your own troubles! Don’t involve others!” Shi Yuanzhen chided coldly.
“What do you mean?” The little azure dragon was enraged.
It should be known that he was the son of the True Dragon, and in terms of “Imperial Second Generation”, no one’s status was higher than his.
“Heh, since it’s you people who caused this trouble, then please leave this place,” the Imperial Son, Guan Yuanming, said calmly. Although his tone was calm, his intentions were extremely vicious.

That was a Venerate Tier-level Yin soul. How could Imperial Sons like them not see through it? Yet they wanted Ling Han and the others to leave. Wasn’t that equivalent to sending them to their deaths?
Ling Han and the others were all enraged. Previously, they had already been expelled once, and now they were being expelled again?
This was blatantly using someone else to do their dirty work; how depraved.
Ling Han showed a cold smirk, “You guys really think that this place belongs to you, and you can do whatever you want?”

“Hehe, I was only asking you to leave. Why are you so flustered and exasperated?” Xu Jie asked with a slight smile. At this moment, he naturally felt that everything was under control, and appeared extremely calm.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I have a different suggestion. Why don’t you guys get lost?”
“Hahaha!” Those Imperial Sons all laughed loudly. This was really a great joke.

Though you, Ling Han, are freakish, you are only a Core Formation Tier, after all. At most, you would only be slightly stronger than an Imperial Son, and furthermore, this was in a special place like the Netherworld.
Just how many Imperial Sons did they have?
There were a total of nine of them!
Nine against one, just tell me, was there any reason not to win?
“Ling Han, your journey has been too smooth, so you are too arrogant!” Shi Yuanzhen shook his head, “However, you will not be so lucky this time!”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Why do I feel like the heavens are always on my side?”
“Little Han, don’t waste your breath on them. Deal with them all!” The little azure dragon waved its claws, appearing very impatient.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
The man and dragon approached the bonfire of Saint bone, both of them clasping their hands behind their backs, their aura soaring sky-high.
The large black dog stroked his beard, appearing to be quite gratified, because this was all taught by him.

“Haha, you’re really courting death!” The nine Imperial Sons all walked out. This was a rare good opportunity. As long as Ling Han was forced out of the area of the Saint bone bonfire, that terrifying great Yin soul would deal with Ling Han for them.
Without spilling a single drop of blood, it was an easy and enjoyable experience.
“Charge!” They all leaped, pouncing towards Ling Han and the little azure dragon.
“How many do you want?” the little azure dragon asked Ling Han in a show-off manner.
“I’ll take all of them!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and was already the first to speed up, greeting Shi Yuanzhen and the others.
“F***, don’t be so greedy, brat. Leave a few for Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon hurriedly increased its speed as well.
Boom!
Ling Han took the lead, already exchanging blows with the nine Imperial Sons for the first time.

A terrifying power surged. Though this was the Netherworld, and could not stimulate the Regulations, the power of the True Self Tier was still incredibly terrifying. Moreover, they were all Imperial Son-level, and their battle prowess was even stronger.
However, the nine Imperial Sons immediately looked astonished.
How was this possible?

It was a battle of nine against one, so logically speaking, they should have been able to crush Ling Han. However, after battling for a while, they discovered that Ling Han’s power was far above theirs. In fact, his power had already reached a crushing level. Moreover, even though the nine of them had teamed up, they were still no match for Ling Han. It was extremely difficult for them to block his attacks.
“True Self Tier!” they exclaimed through gritted teeth. They naturally knew why Ling Han’s battle prowess had suddenly surpassed them by so much.
This incredibly freakish guy had actually broken through.

And now, everyone was battling at the same cultivation level, and as Imperial Sons, and it was nine against one at that, they were actually still so battered and exhausted. This was practically a slap in the face.
Imperial Son? Pei!

Ling Han was calm and unhurried. In a battle of one against nine, he still had the absolute upper hand. At present, his mystical power and Body Art had both advanced into True Self Tier, and his power was as high as Sixth Heaven. Furthermore, his defense was invincible against Shi Yuanzhen and the others.

It could not be helped. Who asked that there was no way to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth here? Shi Yuanzhen and the others had only grasped the Imperial Technique, yet were completely unable to use it.
The little azure dragon also unleashed its might. Its battle prowess was only slightly inferior to Ling Han’s, and it could deal with at least three Imperial Sons.
To the Imperial Sons, his participation was equivalent to adding fuel to the fire. In the first place, they were already too busy, and now, they were even more unable to deal with the situation.
“Scram!” Ling Han was the first to grab Xu Jie. With a toss, he directly threw the latter out of the bonfire of Saint bone.
