To be honest, Ling Han really didn’t want to use it.
Something like a trump card was best used for intimidation, because once it was used, it would be gone.
However, if he only used it as an intimidation tactic, it could be effective for many times.
The Heavenly Dao Flames soared into the sky, and as expected, dispersed the attack once more.
Thankfully, the bonfire of Saint bone was already right in front of them.
Everyone hurriedly quickened their pace.
Shua, they rushed over.
Xiu, in the skies, that Venerate Tier Yin soul descended.
It did not have any facial features, but everyone could clearly sense that they were being observed by it.
It was also afraid of the flames burning on the Saint bone, so it simply stared at them and didn’t attack again.
“Damn guy!” someone cursed softly behind Ling Han and the others.
“Hey, who are you insulting?” The large black dog was displeased, and he turned around to look.
Oh, this place was basically still the group that had first entered, but some people had still left.
By now, there were about seven Imperial Sons here.
At least, Ling Han had seen these seven people before.
As for whether there were more, he did not know.
“What did you guys do to actually draw out such a monster!” Xu Jie asked coldly, his voice filled with interrogative intent.
The large black dog sneered, and said, “You’re nothing but a defeated opponent, yet you still have the face to speak to Grandpa Dog?”
Xu Jie’s face instantly flushed red.
He very much wanted to refute these words.
After all, he hadn’t been defeated by a despicable dog.
However, Ling Han was smiling at him from the sidelines, causing his desire to refute to instantly die at the tip of his tongue.
Thus, even if he said such words, Ling Han only had to add a few more words, and he would still be extremely passive.
Thus, it would be better not to say anything.
“Humph!
Resolve your own troubles!
Don’t involve others!” Shi Yuanzhen chided coldly.
“What do you mean?” The little azure dragon was enraged.
It should be known that he was the son of the True Dragon, and in terms of “Imperial Second Generation”, no one’s status was higher than his.
“Heh, since it’s you people who caused this trouble, then please leave this place,” the Imperial Son, Guan Yuanming, said calmly.
Although his tone was calm, his intentions were extremely vicious.
That was a Venerate Tier-level Yin soul.
How could Imperial Sons like them not see through it?
Yet they wanted Ling Han and the others to leave.
Wasn’t that equivalent to sending them to their deaths?
Ling Han and the others were all enraged.
Previously, they had already been expelled once, and now they were being expelled again?
This was blatantly using someone else to do their dirty work; how depraved.
Ling Han showed a cold smirk, “You guys really think that this place belongs to you, and you can do whatever you want?”
“Hehe, I was only asking you to leave.
Why are you so flustered and exasperated?” Xu Jie asked with a slight smile.
At this moment, he naturally felt that everything was under control, and appeared extremely calm.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I have a different suggestion.
Why don’t you guys get lost?”
“Hahaha!” Those Imperial Sons all laughed loudly.
This was really a great joke.
Though you, Ling Han, are freakish, you are only a Core Formation Tier, after all.
At most, you would only be slightly stronger than an Imperial Son, and furthermore, this was in a special place like the Netherworld.
Just how many Imperial Sons did they have?
There were a total of nine of them!
Nine against one, just tell me, was there any reason not to win?
“Ling Han, your journey has been too smooth, so you are too arrogant!” Shi Yuanzhen shook his head, “However, you will not be so lucky this time!”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Why do I feel like the heavens are always on my side?”
“Little Han, don’t waste your breath on them.
Deal with them all!” The little azure dragon waved its claws, appearing very impatient.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
The man and dragon approached the bonfire of Saint bone, both of them clasping their hands behind their backs, their aura soaring sky-high.
The large black dog stroked his beard, appearing to be quite gratified, because this was all taught by him.
“Haha, you’re really courting death!” The nine Imperial Sons all walked out.
This was a rare good opportunity.
As long as Ling Han was forced out of the area of the Saint bone bonfire, that terrifying great Yin soul would deal with Ling Han for them.
Without spilling a single drop of blood, it was an easy and enjoyable experience.
“Charge!” They all leaped, pouncing towards Ling Han and the little azure dragon.
“How many do you want?” the little azure dragon asked Ling Han in a show-off manner.
“I’ll take all of them!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and was already the first to speed up, greeting Shi Yuanzhen and the others.
“F***, don’t be so greedy, brat.
Leave a few for Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon hurriedly increased its speed as well.
Boom!
Ling Han took the lead, already exchanging blows with the nine Imperial Sons for the first time.
A terrifying power surged.
Though this was the Netherworld, and could not stimulate the Regulations, the power of the True Self Tier was still incredibly terrifying.
Moreover, they were all Imperial Son-level, and their battle prowess was even stronger.
However, the nine Imperial Sons immediately looked astonished.
How was this possible?
It was a battle of nine against one, so logically speaking, they should have been able to crush Ling Han.
However, after battling for a while, they discovered that Ling Han’s power was far above theirs.
In fact, his power had already reached a crushing level.
Moreover, even though the nine of them had teamed up, they were still no match for Ling Han.
It was extremely difficult for them to block his attacks.
“True Self Tier!” they exclaimed through gritted teeth.
They naturally knew why Ling Han’s battle prowess had suddenly surpassed them by so much.
This incredibly freakish guy had actually broken through.
And now, everyone was battling at the same cultivation level, and as Imperial Sons, and it was nine against one at that, they were actually still so battered and exhausted.
This was practically a slap in the face.
Imperial Son?
Pei!
Ling Han was calm and unhurried.
In a battle of one against nine, he still had the absolute upper hand.
At present, his mystical power and Body Art had both advanced into True Self Tier, and his power was as high as Sixth Heaven.
Furthermore, his defense was invincible against Shi Yuanzhen and the others.
It could not be helped.
Who asked that there was no way to draw on the Regulations of heaven and earth here?
Shi Yuanzhen and the others had only grasped the Imperial Technique, yet were completely unable to use it.
The little azure dragon also unleashed its might.
Its battle prowess was only slightly inferior to Ling Han’s, and it could deal with at least three Imperial Sons.
To the Imperial Sons, his participation was equivalent to adding fuel to the fire.
In the first place, they were already too busy, and now, they were even more unable to deal with the situation.
“Scram!” Ling Han was the first to grab Xu Jie.
With a toss, he directly threw the latter out of the bonfire of Saint bone.

chapters.title: Chapter 4188: Throw them all out
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
He would pay them back in the same coin.
Ling Han had always been one to distinguish between kindness and hatred. If you treat me well, I will treat you even better, but if you treat me badly, I will repay you a hundredfold.
They wanted to chase them away?
Heh, scram on your own first!

Xu Jie was tossed out, and he had already left the area affected by the bone flame of the Saint. Instantly, that great Yin soul that was standing upright and unmoving immediately moved. Boom, a large hand shot out, blocking out the sun and clouds.
This was a Venerate Tier-level great yin soul, so just how terrifying was its abilities?
Pa, with a palm strike, Xu Jie was turned into dust.
Yi, that’s not right!
When the power of the palm strike dispersed, Xu Jie actually appeared again.
That’s right, Substitution Seal.

As the Imperial Son, the Substitution Seal was naturally standard. However, in the Netherworld, the Regulations were different, and the Substitution Seal was also unable to take full effect. There was a trace of blood at the corner of Xu Jie’s mouth, and his face was as pale as paper.
Obviously, though he had escaped this calamity, he had also suffered serious injuries.
“Heh, pointless resistance!” The large Yin soul attacked again. So what if it was Substitution Seal? To it, it was only a matter of two more moves.
It was extremely easy for a Venerate Tier elite to kill a True Self Tier.

Xu Jie was extremely furious himself, wanting nothing more than to tear Ling Han into pieces, but in this kind of situation, how could he allow himself to have any further thoughts? Immediately, he took out a Ten Thousand Escape Talisman and tore it into shreds. Xiu, his figure flashed, and he immediately disappeared from sight.

The effects of the Escape Talisman would definitely be greatly reduced in this place, but even if he couldn’t flee ten thousand miles, he could at least flee five thousand miles. As long as he found another bonfire of Saint bone, he would still be able to escape with his life.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel like it was a pity. The Imperial Clans had deep roots, and there seemed to be as many Substitution Seals and Escape Talismans as if they were free.
However, would this make him give up?
Ling Han looked towards Shi Yuanzhen and the others. There were only eight Imperial Sons left.

As his cold eyes swept over them, Shi Yuanzhen and the others all felt a chill in their hearts. They had never imagined that not only had Ling Han advanced into True Self Tier, his abilities were enough to suppress them. Furthermore, he was so decisive and overbearing that he even dared to kill an Imperial Son.
—If it was not for the Substitution Seal and Escape Talisman, Xu Jie would definitely have died.
“Are you guys going to scram on your own, or do you want me to help you?” Ling Han asked balefully. He didn’t plan to stop here.
Shi Yuanzhen and the others almost went mad with fury. They were Imperial Sons, so when had they ever received such treatment before?
“Ling Han, you have to consider carefully. If you offend us Imperial Clans, consider if there would still be a place for you in this world!” Guan Yuanming shouted loudly.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “If I have to suppress my temperament just because I’m afraid of the Imperial Clans, what right do I have to aim for the position of Emperor?”
Hiss, this guy was so arrogant!
“Fine, you’re ruthless, you’re ruthless!” Shi Yuanzhen took out a Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman and slapped it onto his body. Xiu, he immediately disappeared without a trace.
Rather than having others attack him and then be ravaged by the Yin soul, it would be better for him to take the initiative. At least, he would be able to suffer less.
Afterwards, Guan Yuanming and the other Imperial Sons all used Escape Talismans. Before they left, they all glared angrily at Ling Han, their eyes filled with resentment.
Only Ling Han would dare to force the Imperial Sons to this extent.

The others were all looking at Ling Han with stunned expressions, fearing that Ling Han would become aroused from killing, and throw them out as well. It should be known that they did not have treasures like the Substitution Seal or the Escape Talisman.

However, Ling Han was naturally not that kind of person. He sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. He had just broken through to this cultivation level, and the upper limit had been lifted, so there was very much room for improvement.
The little azure dragon and the others didn’t attack again, and they all sat down on the ground. Right now, they could only wait for the Saint to come in and resolve the situation.
That Venerate Tier-level Yin soul was extremely patient, and just stood there without moving. If one wasn’t paying attention, one might think that it was a stone statue.
And just like that, day after day passed. Suddenly, the whole world seemed to light up for a moment. That was an indescribable feeling.

Ling Han immediately discovered that he could sense a sliver of heaven and earth’s Regulations. Though it was extremely weak, it could indeed be used. It could increase the might of celestial techniques to a certain extent.
Could it be?
“The seal has been unlocked?” Ling Han, the little azure dragon and the large black dog asked at the same time. In their group, they were the only ones who had broken through to the True Self Tier.

The Venerate Tier-level great yin soul that originally looked like a stone statue suddenly moved. It looked into the distance, and two eye sockets appeared on its face. Suddenly, two balls of light shot out, as if they could penetrate space.
“Humph, audacious Yin soul, you dare spy on me?” A cold humph directly appeared in everyone’s minds.

“Wu!” The great yin soul immediately took a few steps back. Its whole body was trembling, as if it was in an extremely unstable state, and could explode at any moment. It was greatly shocked, and without another word, directly turned around and left.
Xiu, its speed was extremely fast.
However, a large golden hand suddenly stretched over from the distance, and grabbed out at the great Yin soul at an even faster speed.
This large hand was covered densely with seals that intertwined to form a brilliant light, exuding an incomparable aura, as if the heavens had moved.
A Saint!

The large yin soul tried its best to break free, yet it was completely unable to struggle free. Even though there was only a gap of a major tier between the Venerate Tier and the Saint Tier, this barrier was like an insurmountable gulf.
“Die!” The Saint’s voice rang out again. Pa, this great Yin soul was forcibly crushed. Instantly, energy surged towards Ling Han and the others like a wave.
Even if Ling Han’s physique was astonishing, he still managed to absorb some of it. Instantly, his soul felt extremely comfortable.

The others received more benefits than he did. The one who had died was a Venerate Tier elite, and for everyone, this was extremely nutritious. Instantly, it was as if everyone was drunk, their faces completely flushed red.
Xiu, a figure appeared. He was close to three meters tall, his black skin disheveled, possessing an indescribable dominance.
“It’s Eternity Sea Saint!” Many people recognized this Saint, and they immediately fell to their knees to pay their respects.

The Eternity Sea Saint was a new Saint that had risen up more than 200,000 years ago, and had founded the Eternity Sea Holy Land. He was presently in his prime, and was in the limelight. Even if he went to the Imperial Clans, he would still be able to become a respected guest.

The Eternity Sea Saint merely nodded calmly. With his status, even in the face of the Imperial Clans, there was absolutely no need for him to restrain his temper. At his height, he was already capable of ignoring everything else.
“This place is actually the Netherworld!” he said in a low voice. “So the Holy Emperor suppressed an entrance to the Netherworld!”
“Hehe, this day has finally come!” A voice rang out slowly, lingering in everyone’s hearts.
Though these were only very ordinary words, everyone felt an endless chill rise up from the bottom of their hearts, and the temperature dropped drastically in an instant.
“Yin Saint!” The Eternity Sea Saint’s expression became serious.
“My name is Iron River!” The voice continued, “Friend, your appearance is not bad. Can you lend it to me to use?”

The Eternity Sea Saint chuckled coldly, and said, “To become a Yin Saint, you were most likely a Saint yourself! However, when a person dies, his dao is destroyed, so it’s only natural that you let go of your obsessions. It’s about time that you step on the path of rebirth!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4189: Yin Saint
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Iron River Yin Saint cackled, and said, “Who doesn’t cherish their life? Moreover, we’re all cultivators, and we’ve carefully and conscientiously cultivated for countless years. Isn’t it all for the sake of achieving immortality? To say nothing of me, even... wu!”
It came to an abrupt stop, as if it had touched some taboo.
“Iron River, get out here!” the Eternity Sea Saint shouted. “I’ll expiate you today!”
“Haha, this is the Netherworld, and you can’t use the Regulations of the Living Realm. How could I be afraid of you!” As his words fell, a slender figure appeared.
Was this really a Yin soul?
He looked benevolent, with a head of white hair, white brows and a white beard. He really did not have the slightest bit of Yin soul aura.
After becoming a Saint, would even a Yin soul’s temperament undergo a massive change?
“I shall deliver you from purgatory!” The Eternity Sea Saint charged out.

The two Saints battled. One represented the strongest of the Living Realm, while the other was the strongest of the Netherworld. Neither of them dared to hold back. Thus, the shockwaves from their attacks were boundlessly terrifying.
Thankfully, this Saint’s corpse could even disperse the aftermath of an attack, and that was why everyone had not been implicated by the aftermath in this battle between Saints..
Boom!
As soon as the two Saints exchanged blows, they were astounded. Their bodies enlarged, and they were both tens of thousands of meters tall. They were indomitable, and were boundlessly terrifying.
“Taking advantage of this opportunity, leave quickly!” Ling Han shouted lightly.
A Saint had entered the arena, which meant that the seal had already been opened. If they did not leave now, when would they be able to leave?
Everyone hurriedly broke into a run. Now, in order to save their lives, they really had to use all their strength.
Weng, another terrifying aura assaulted, sinister to the bone.
Ling Han turned around as he ran, and saw that another person had joined the battle between the two Saints. Together with the Iron River Yin Saint, they were attacking the Eternity Sea Saint.
Obviously, this was another Yin Saint.

Ling Han felt apprehensive. He had not guessed wrongly. There had always been great elites from the Netherworld paying attention to this place, while at the same time, they were also nurturing weak Yin souls. Whether it was nurturing to become subordinates, or to become food, they were strengthening their abilities, and waiting for an opportunity to attack the Living Realm.
More importantly, just how many Saints were there in the Netherworld?
At present, there were no Emperor in this world, and Saints were the deciding power.
It was useless to think about this now. He was too weak, and had no right to interfere in the matters of Saint-level power at all. Even if he used the Heavenly Dao Flames, it would be useless.

Not long after, they had already ran back to where they had entered. They saw that this place had initially been empty, but now, there was another passage, but at the end was a stretch of Primal Chaos.
Obviously, the two Realms were already connected.
“Let’s go!”
There was nothing to hesitate about. Now that even Saint-level power had appeared, minor characters like them would only be turned into ashes if they tried to forcefully approach.

Everyone entered into the passage, and the severe cold immediately began to subside. When they walked out of the passage, they saw that there was a massive stone door behind them, but previously, there was only a hole, and now, it was completely open.
They had returned to the Living Realm!
There was a powerful being standing guard here, seated like a stone statue, but after everyone came out, he opened his eyes. Instantly, an indescribable aura surged, indescribably terrifying.
This was a Saint!
“Show your Spatial Spirit Tool. I want to examine it,” the Saint said calmly.

As mentioned before, everyone could enter, and whatever they obtained could be kept to themselves. However, if they obtained the secret of the Needless Mountains, they would have to share it with others.
They had already made an agreement, so who would dare to disobey the words of a Saint?
Everyone took out their Spatial Spirit Tools, not daring to hide anything.

Ling Han was also very generous. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was his personal Spirit Tool. It had been forged with a sliver of his spiritual power, so it could be stored into his mind, so he was completely unafraid of exposing the secret of the Imperial Weapon.

There was naturally no need to mention the insight of a Saint. He did not need to touch it with his bare hands at all. With a sweep of his eyes, the contents of the Spatial Spirit Tool would be exposed. Thus, the speed of his inspection was also extremely fast. Everyone filed out, and there was practically no need for them to stop.
When Ling Han walked past, the Saint suddenly moved, and took the tortoise shell from him.
However, this Saint also couldn’t find anything special about it after observing for a short while. Thus, he casually handed it back to Ling Han.
For some reason, Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, as if he was unwilling to lose this thing.
He himself was also very curious. Could it be that this was really a treasure?
The amazing thing about this tortoise shell was that it could not be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool, but what was the use of this kind of amazing thing?

They exited the cave. This was extremely difficult, because this cave was practically perpendicular. The gravity field at the bottom could be considered terrifying, so the difficulty of climbing up could be imagined.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was unconcerned. He allowed his two beautiful wives to hug him, while he climbed up easily. In a short while, he had already climbed out.
“Ling Han, let’s play again!” Hu Niu was unsatisfied.
Er.
After arriving here, Ling Han discovered that the Regulations of heaven and earth had suddenly become rich and colorful. This was the true Living Realm.

In the Mountain Sea Heaven, Regulations solidified, and was too helpful in comprehending Dao. In a mere instant, Ling Han discovered that enlightenment had arisen, causing him to involuntarily sit down and begin cultivating.
It couldn’t be helped. He had just broken through to the True Self Tier, yet in the environment of the Netherworld, he could only be considered a pseudo-True Self Tier.
Now that he had returned to the Living Realm, and under the enlightenment, he had truly stepped through the doors of the True Self Tier.
“Don’t disturb him!” the empress rebuked Hu Niu.
Hu Niu stuck out her tongue, “Fierce woman, there will come a day when I will suppress you!”
The empress heard this, yet her expression was filled with pride. She couldn’t even be bothered to pay her any regard.

The large black dog and little azure dragon were also in desperate need of comprehending Dao again to stabilize their cultivation level. Otherwise, it was extremely likely that they would encounter a situation wherein their cultivation level would regress.
Once this kind of situation occurred, it would cause great damage to their dao foundations. In future, it would be difficult for them to climb to the peak of martial arts.
They all went into seclusion, while the empress and Hu Niu stayed behind to accompany Ling Han. He needed someone to protect him.
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked him to suddenly gain enlightenment? This kind of good opportunity couldn’t be obtained even if others begged, so he naturally couldn’t be interrupted.

Thankfully, when the large black dog went to inform the Nine Mountains Venerate, this great elite immediately rushed over, and personally stood guard for Ling Han. Though they were not Master and disciple, their relationship was superior to who knew how many Masters and disciples.
With the protection of a Venerate Tier elite, the empress and Hu Niu were naturally at ease.
He comprehended Dao for three days and three nights.

The True Self of Destruction was completely formed!
He opened his eyes with a ‘xiu’, and a smile appeared on his face. In this one period of seclusion, his power had actually increased by one Heaven.
Just three days!
It was really worth it. If he could comprehend a few more times, he would soon be able to cross over into the early stage of the True Self Tier.

The Iron River Yin Saint cackled, and said, “Who doesn’t cherish their life?
Moreover, we’re all cultivators, and we’ve carefully and conscientiously cultivated for countless years.
Isn’t it all for the sake of achieving immortality?
To say nothing of me, even... wu!”
It came to an abrupt stop, as if it had touched some taboo.
“Iron River, get out here!” the Eternity Sea Saint shouted.
“I’ll expiate you today!”
“Haha, this is the Netherworld, and you can’t use the Regulations of the Living Realm.
How could I be afraid of you!” As his words fell, a slender figure appeared.
Was this really a Yin soul?
He looked benevolent, with a head of white hair, white brows and a white beard.
He really did not have the slightest bit of Yin soul aura.
After becoming a Saint, would even a Yin soul’s temperament undergo a massive change?
“I shall deliver you from purgatory!” The Eternity Sea Saint charged out.
The two Saints battled.
One represented the strongest of the Living Realm, while the other was the strongest of the Netherworld.
Neither of them dared to hold back.
Thus, the shockwaves from their attacks were boundlessly terrifying.
Thankfully, this Saint’s corpse could even disperse the aftermath of an attack, and that was why everyone had not been implicated by the aftermath in this battle between Saints..
Boom!
As soon as the two Saints exchanged blows, they were astounded.
Their bodies enlarged, and they were both tens of thousands of meters tall.
They were indomitable, and were boundlessly terrifying.
“Taking advantage of this opportunity, leave quickly!” Ling Han shouted lightly.
A Saint had entered the arena, which meant that the seal had already been opened.
If they did not leave now, when would they be able to leave?
Everyone hurriedly broke into a run.
Now, in order to save their lives, they really had to use all their strength.
Weng, another terrifying aura assaulted, sinister to the bone.
Ling Han turned around as he ran, and saw that another person had joined the battle between the two Saints.
Together with the Iron River Yin Saint, they were attacking the Eternity Sea Saint.
Obviously, this was another Yin Saint.
Ling Han felt apprehensive.
He had not guessed wrongly.
There had always been great elites from the Netherworld paying attention to this place, while at the same time, they were also nurturing weak Yin souls.
Whether it was nurturing to become subordinates, or to become food, they were strengthening their abilities, and waiting for an opportunity to attack the Living Realm.
More importantly, just how many Saints were there in the Netherworld?
At present, there were no Emperor in this world, and Saints were the deciding power.
It was useless to think about this now.
He was too weak, and had no right to interfere in the matters of Saint-level power at all.
Even if he used the Heavenly Dao Flames, it would be useless.

They saw that this place had initially been empty, but now, there was another passage, but at the end was a stretch of Primal Chaos.
Obviously, the two Realms were already connected.

There was nothing to hesitate about.
Now that even Saint-level power had appeared, minor characters like them would only be turned into ashes if they tried to forcefully approach.
Everyone entered into the passage, and the severe cold immediately began to subside.
When they walked out of the passage, they saw that there was a massive stone door behind them, but previously, there was only a hole, and now, it was completely open.
They had returned to the Living Realm!

Instantly, an indescribable aura surged, indescribably terrifying.
This was a Saint!

They had already made an agreement, so who would dare to disobey the words of a Saint?
Everyone took out their Spatial Spirit Tools, not daring to hide anything.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was his personal Spirit Tool.

Er.

chapters.title: Chapter 4190: Counterattack from the Netherworld
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

For the moment, the battle in the Netherworld was still relatively stable. A considerable number of Saints had entered into the Netherworld, and added with a large number of Venerate Tier elites, they were completely capable of suppressing the situation.

Meanwhile, the younger generation that had entered the Netherworld had mostly withdrawn as well. By now, it was already a clash of elites, and even elites like Sect Master would find it very difficult to interfere. If the younger generation joined in on the excitement, that would completely be courting death.

Ling Han cultivated madly every day. The Regulations here were within easy reach, and for a True Self Tier cultivator, this was the best place to cultivate. Furthermore, there was a time limit for the Mountain Sea Heaven to stay open. After this, there would be no such place, so he naturally had to hurry.
Moreover, once the seal was unsealed, what if even Saints couldn’t suppress it? Then when large amounts of Yin souls rushed out, who would still dare to stay here?
Thus, every extra day he could stay here was due to good luck. He had to hurry.
After reaching the True Self Tier, Ling Han was finally able to systematically organize the celestial techniques that he had learned.

This cultivation level was a dividing line. The distance between Imperial Technique, Saint Technique Technique, and Venerate Tier Technique would suddenly increase, and the gap was not just a little bit.
Ling Han tested them one by one. He discovered that the Imperial Technique could increase his battle prowess by seven Heavens.
Seven Heavens!

This was extremely shocking, because the four minor levels of the True Self Tier cultivation level represented the difference of three Heavens in battle prowess. This Imperial Technique could actually increase one’s battle prowess by seven Heavens, directly leaping over two minor levels of the True Self Tier. This was too exaggerated.

Ling Han asked Chi Menghan for guidance, and discovered that this was still not the true might of the Imperial Technique, because the Imperial Technique could increase one’s battle prowess by nine Heavens, at most!
But why had Ling Han’s battle prowess only increased by seven Heavens?
Was it because he was not talented enough, and had not grasped the essence of the Imperial Technique?
No, this was because he had not learnt the corresponding Imperial Scroll.

The Imperial Technique could only be activated with the Imperial Scroll to unleash its full might. Furthermore, different Imperial Techniques had to be matched with the corresponding Imperial Scroll. Otherwise, there would not be any effect either.
Thus, the Imperial Scroll was the true trump card of an Imperial Clan. It was as important as the Imperial Weapon.

Ling Han went to recultivate the Saint Techniques again, and discovered that the might of the Saint Techniques could increase his battle prowess by about six Heavens. En, compared to the Imperial Technique, it was indeed much too inferior.

Looking again at the Venerate Tier Technique, it could only increase battle prowess by three Heavens. For Sect Master, it was two Heavens, one Heaven for Spirit Transformation Tier and as for the True Self Tier, er, it was completely unable to increase battle prowess, so it could only maintain its standard.
As for the precious technique of Core Formation Tier?
F***, what True Self Tier cultivator would use a cultivation technique on the level of Core Formation Tier?

In the case of high-level energies, the increase was in destructive power. This could not be directly displayed with the number of Heavens. However, if the battle prowess of two people were equal, but the high-level energies used were different. The higher level energy would definitely be the victor.
The peaceful days didn’t last for many days before the Imperial Clan members came to seek Ling Han out for an accounting.
—To actually expel the Imperial Sons into the hands of a Yin soul, this was an act of treason against the Living Realm!
The nine Imperial Clans had joined forces, demanding that the Nine Suns Holy Land hand over Ling Han.
The Nine Suns Holy Land was very strong, but faced with a colossal being like the Imperial Clan, even one clan would be hard-pressed, what more nine Clans? They were completely no match.
It was not advisable to use force, as it would only lead to severe injury. Not only would it not be able to protect Ling Han, the Nine Suns Holy Land would also be buried with him.
What could they do?
The two Venerate Tier elites who planned to cultivate in seclusion here discussed for a while, and decided to negotiate with the Imperial Clans while sending Ling Han away.
At that time, they would clap their hands and just exclaim ‘What? They didn’t know where Ling Han had gone.’
No matter how awesome your Imperial Clan is, you can’t destroy a Holy Land for no reason, right?
This kind of thing had indeed happened in history, but with the birth of a new Emperor, this kind of unruly Imperial Clan Clan would also be severely punished.
The Imperial Clan was domineering, but they also had to abide by the bottom line, and could not cross that line.
Chi Menghan went all out. She was going to ask a Saint of her clan to personally send Ling Han off.
Boom!
The entire Mountain Sea Heaven Heaven shook violently, as if the heaven and earth was about to collapse.
What was going on here?
Everyone was alarmed. Even those who had cultivated in seclusion could no longer sit still, and ran out one after another.
Multiple figures shot out of the cave that led to the Netherworld. There were great elites from the Living Realm, as well as elites from the Netherworld.
However, for a great elite of the Netherworld to appear here, what did this mean?
The great elites of the Living Realm could no longer defend, and that was why the Netherworld elites had launched a counterattack!
In just an instant, one after another, ghosts flew out of the cave entrance. They were like locusts passing through, densely packed and filling the sky.
Yin soul didn’t have a physical body, so it naturally wouldn’t be affected by gravity.
A great battle was inevitable.

“Retreat!” The Nine Mountains Venerate flew back, “There are actually as many as 37 Yin Saints in the Netherworld. In terms of numbers, they have completely overwhelmed the Living Realm. Without mobilizing the Imperial Weapon, we would not be able to suppress them at all!”
“However, the Imperial Clans didn’t bring an Imperial Weapon this time, and there’s a severe shortage of Saints in the Living Realm. It’ll take some time to call for reinforcements.”
“We can’t stay here any longer, retreat immediately!”

One after another, the forces began to retreat. Under such circumstances, there was naturally no force that could bother to make trouble for Ling Han. The most important thing now was to save their lives. Debts and whatnot could be set aside for later.
Endless Yin souls wreaked havoc. Led by the Yin Saints, they were unstoppable.

For Yin souls, living souls were the best tonic, and they also needed to borrow the bodies of living beings to be able to walk in the mortal world. Otherwise, the heaven and earth of the Living Realm would cause massive damage to them.

This was similar to how living beings would be affected by the coldness of the Netherworld when they entered the Netherworld. Yin souls were the same when they entered the Living Realm. However, they would be burned by Yang Qi, and would be incinerated into ashes if they weren’t careful.
The Nine Mountains Venerate was already aware that Ling Han had offended the nine great Imperial Clan, so he couldn’t help but feel a headache coming on.

He knew that this disciple of his was capable of causing trouble, and he knew that not only was this guy on the must-kill list of the Battle God Palace which even the Imperial Clans had a headache over, he had even gone in for a stroll, and learnt the secret technique of the Battle God Palace that would not be taught to outsiders!
However, offending the nine great Imperial Clans in one go was also a little scary.

Come to think of it, those Imperial Sons had bullied Ling Han like this, and even if it was the Nine Mountains Venerate, he wouldn’t be able to tolerate it. F***, wasn’t Ling Han’s life worth anything?

“I’ll immediately send you to the West Heavenly Realm. You keep a low profile and grow. As long as you become a Saint, you’ll have nothing to fear, and when you become an Emperor, hoho.” The Nine Mountains Venerate was filled with confidence in Ling Han. It was a sure bet that this disciple of his would become a Saint, and there was also a high chance that he would become an Emperor.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. When he had chased the nine Imperial Sons out of the bonfire of Saint bone, he had already prepared himself to flee.
Regret?

Not at all. He had never been the type to swallow his anger. Furthermore, if he could swallow this anger, his martial intent that was advancing bravely would also be affected, leaving behind a powerful setback. When he attempted to break through to the Saint Path and become an Emperor, it could possibly cause a destructive blow.
His Dao was destined that he could not compromise in matters of principle.

After some discussion, the large black dog and little azure dragon decided to leave with Ling Han. As for Hu Niu and the empress, they would continue to cultivate in the Nine Suns Holy Land. With the Nine Mountains Venerate’s help, the Imperial Clans couldn’t go too far either.
Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon were all filled with anger. The nine great Imperial Clans, just you wait!

chapters.title: Chapter 4191: Temporary retreat
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t immediately head to the West Heavenly Realm. Instead, he went to the Celestial Sea Planet first.
There was the final test left behind by the Ancient Sun Saint here. As long as one could pass this test, they would be able to obtain all of the inheritances of the Saint.
Led by the Nine Mountains Venerate, they soon arrived at the Celestial Sea Planet. Ling Han made a trip, and easily passed the test, finally obtaining all the inheritances of the Saint.
The complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, a large amount of cultivation resources, as well as four Saint Techniques.
After Ling Han memorized the cultivation technique, he asked the Nine Mountains Venerate to bring these items back to the Nine Suns Holy Land and hand them over to the empress, Hu Niu, and Lin Luo.
He needed to arm the people by his side, so that they could mature as soon as possible. In future, when they faced off against the Imperial Clans, these would be the main troops.

This was especially the case for Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, and the others. They had formed a friendship through the arduous battles in the Genesis World, and they had more so fused the Nine Cauldrons into one without relying on external power. They had hopes of becoming Emperors.

Similarly, he also allocated a large amount of cultivation resources for the Nine Mountains Venerate to bring back. If those former Seventh Tier Heavenly Venerates of the Genesis World could all mature, they would become an astonishing force.
Then, the Nine Mountains Venerate tore a rip into space and brought Ling Han, the little azure dragon and the large black dog with him, arriving at the West Heavenly Realm.
He reminded Ling Han to be careful, then returned to Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Little Han, let’s go!” the large black dog said.
“Grandpa Dragon is really angered this time. When Grandpa Dragon becomes a Saint, I’ll definitely beat up those b@stards!” The little azure dragon was also extremely furious.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He definitely couldn’t swallow this humiliation. Moreover, this could transform into boundless motivation that would help him grow even faster.
If he became a Saint, those Imperial Clans would have to be careful.

The three of them kept a very low profile, changing their appearance slightly. In any case, they had the Soul Forming Technique, and as long as one was not Saint-level, it was practically impossible to see through their disguises.
Not too many days later, a big piece of news spread out on the Galaxy Network.

The Saints of the Imperial Clans brought the Imperial Weapons and finally suppressed the Yin souls. However, what followed was a burst of Yin souls, and more and more Saint-level Yin souls appeared as if there was no end to them.
That’s right. Yin Saints were not as strong as Saints of the Living Realm, especially when they were battling in the Living Realm, but this advantage in numbers was really astonishing.

It was no wonder that when Celestial Sea Planet had a Saint on standby, he could only die together in the end, using himself to mend the heavens, sealing off the passageway of the two realms. The individual battle prowess of Yin souls was not strong, but taking into account their advantage in numbers, it was too terrifying.
When the number of Yin Saints had exceeded a thousand, even the Imperial Clans would not be able to hold on.

The Imperial Weapons couldn’t be used indefinitely, and even though they had killed many Yin Saints, even more had appeared. The Imperial Clans had no choice but to retreat, giving up the strategic location of the Mountain Sea Heaven.
However, right at this moment, the Mountain Sea Heaven suddenly closed. The Emperor Tier killing formation channeled, killing all the Yin Saints that couldn’t escape back to the Netherworld!
Hiss!
When the news spread out, it shook the world.

The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor was truly omnipotent. His schemes from who knew how many years ago had shown their might, and they had actually still been effective. He had tricked and killed several hundred Yin Saints in a single stroke. Even if there were a great many Saints in the Netherworld, this should still cause them great damage.

However, the passageway to the Netherworld had already opened, so this Great Emperor killing formation probably wouldn’t be able to stop the Netherworld for too long. Perhaps in a few dozen years, or a few hundred years, the Netherworld would reorganize themselves, and launch another strong invasion.
At that time... the Living Realm would have to face a huge test.
Ling Han merely sighed, and set this great matter aside. He was presently only a True Self Tier, so what was the point of worrying?
“Little Han, what are we going to do first?” the large black dog asked.

Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “I first want to cultivate formations, reaching the point where I can set up Transfer Formations at will. In that way, no matter how big the world is, we can still do as we please.”
“En!” The large black dog and little azure dragon both nodded.

At present, Ling Han had grasped the Star Steps, but he could only travel freely on a planet, but could not traverse the galaxy. Thus, if he took another step further, their life-saving ability would be greatly increased.
To Ling Han, this wasn’t a difficult task. After all, he had already succeeded once when he rescued Song Lan.
Now, he only needed to strengthen this ability.
They arrived at a planet. Ling Han first communicated with the ley lines, and after he gained a strong ability to protect himself, he settled down here, and began to focus on studying formations.

In the following period of time, Ling Han’s life was considerably ordinary. However, he also paid attention to the Nine Suns Holy Land’s situation on the Galaxy Network. As expected, after the problem of the Mountain Sea Heaven was temporarily resolved, the nine great Imperial Clans all had the time, and began to demand the Nine Suns Holy Land turn Ling Han over.
The Nine Suns Holy Land was quite magnanimous. They opened the mountain gates, and allowed the various Imperial Clans to search. As long as they found Ling Han, they could take him away.

This matter was still left unresolved. After all, the Nine Suns Holy Land did not offend the Imperial Clans. You, the Imperial Clans, can look down on the Holy Land, but if you speak of destroying a Holy Land for no reason, then you have to be careful that the Ancestral King would come in future to rake up old debts.
—It was not as if there had never been Imperial Clans that had disappeared in history.

However, the Nine Suns Holy Land could be let off the hook, but Ling Han had made it onto the Galaxy Network’s wanted persons list. The nine great Imperial Clans issued a bounty at the same time. Anyone who could provide information on Ling Han’s whereabouts and thus apprehend Ling Han would receive a favor from the Imperial Clans.
This was astonishing. Being able to obtain a favor from the Imperial Clan was equivalent to obtaining a life-saving golden medallion. Who dared to offend them?
Thus, the entire universe was in an uproar. Everyone was searching for Ling Han’s whereabouts.
Ling Han didn’t take this to heart. He had already changed his appearance and soul fluctuation, so the only thing that could expose his whereabouts was the Galaxy Network connection device.

Who knew if the so-called just Chang Clan would secretly make a move? After all, the Galaxy Network was created by their Clan. Thus, Ling Han disposed of the connection device, and so had the large black dog and little azure dragon. They would rather buy it again when they needed it, as it was not expensive anyways.
When one had reached the level of the True Self Tier, one would have to cultivate mystical power, and the importance of Spiritual Power would rise to another level.
How could a clay fetus advance in the direction of a stone fetus?
He would use his Spiritual Power to strengthen it, improve it, and complete the qualitative transformation.

The True Self Tier chapter of the Nine Suns Divine Scroll was mainly about cultivating Spiritual Power. The stronger the Spiritual Power, the stronger the high-level energy that could be extracted and stimulated from the Regulations of heaven and earth.
Ling Han had already cultivated the True Self of Destruction, so he could begin the next step.
Using the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning as a foundation, he created a second True Self.

This was slow. He would need to truly grasp the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, and only then would he be able to form the True Self on this basis. Otherwise, the True Self would crumble the moment it was formed, and there was absolutely no way it could be formed.
After Ling Han entered into a deep level of seclusion, this time, if he did not succeed, he would not be coming out of seclusion.
Time passed slowly, and in the blink of an eye, one and a half years had passed.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. He had finally successfully grasped the preliminary structure of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, and could begin the next step.

He extracted the Regulations of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, and used this as the skeleton.Then, he used the amazing waters of the alchemy pool as the blood and flesh, filling in this True Self.
It didn’t collapse!
Success.

chapters.title: Chapter 4192: Woodcutter
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han sighed with emotion. The higher one’s cultivation level, the harder it was to cultivate.

After a whole year and a half, he finally managed to build the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning True Self clay fetus, and this was only the early stage of the True Self Tier. There were still seven clay fetuses to build, which showed how difficult it was.
Even if everything was normal, it would take over a dozen years to complete the cultivation of the early stage of the True Self Tier.
Long, it was really a long time.

“Without the support of top-notch resources, cultivation is really too difficult.” Ling Han shook his head, and even the Holy Lands could only pour this kind of resources into one person. The Imperial Clan would be slightly more awesome, and could nurture a few people at the same time.
This could be seen from the number of Imperial Sons.

“If I was still in the Nine Suns Holy Land, I would definitely be able to get the natural treasures from time to time, but now, even if the Nine Suns Holy Land wants to give me something, I will not accept it. I have to completely sever my relations with them, to avoid implicating them.”

“Although the nine great Imperial Clans have retreated, they will definitely send people to keep an eye on the Nine Suns Holy Land and search for traces of me. If I have contact with the Nine Suns Holy Land, then the Nine Suns Holy Land will really be unable to remove from this matter.”
“Infiltrate the other Holy Lands?”

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He didn’t need to fully display his freakish abilities, but even if he could only unleash 50% of his abilities, that would be enough to sweep aside all other Dao Child cultivators. It would be very easy for him to seize the position of Dao Child.
However, how could a Holy Land easily accept a Dao Child? Wouldn’t they have to investigate his history all the way back to his ancestors from three generations ago?
“Let’s go out for a walk first.” Ling Han walked out with his hands clasped behind his back. He had cultivated in seclusion for a whole year and a half, so he also needed to adjust his emotions.

This was a farmland, and everyone was working in the fields. They would work at dawn and rest at sunset, their lives ordinary and fulfilling. There were mountains in the distance, but they weren’t tall. They were covered with verdant pine trees that spread out in stretches.
Ling Han strolled into the mountains. With a thought, he walked up the mountain.
He didn’t activate his movement technique, and he simply continued to walk forward, one step after another.
The principles of heaven and earth would sometimes be hidden within the ordinary.

He had obtained the memories of Pan Shi Ancestral King, and this Great Emperor was a rock that had attained Dao. In his previous life, he could be considered as extremely ordinary, yet he had walked out a supreme path, and the whole world revered him.
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly heard a sound, and turned around to see an old man cutting wood. It was the axe that had struck the trunk of the tree, creating a very loud sound.

This was an ordinary old man, but his body was very strong. He was dressed in coarse hemp clothing, and his hands were covered with calluses. His joints were protruding, and it was obvious that he was used to doing manual labour.
However, Ling Han only glanced at it a few times, yet he was deeply engrossed in it.

The rhythm of this old man brandishing the axe was very rhythmic. He clearly hadn’t used much power, but when he delivered a strike, he controlled this point very well, just enough to completely release the power without wasting the slightest bit.
Moreover, with a swing of the axe, and using the elasticity of the tree trunk, he only needed to exert a little force, and he would be able to rebound the axe back, which would save more power.
This was intelligence, formed through countless years of logging.
What Ling Han was deeply embroiled in was naturally not this technique of cutting trees, but rather that he had unconsciously thought of battle.

He was the strongest elite of Genesis World, but after arriving in this great world, his previous battle techniques could no longer be used, because the philosophy and method of battle were completely different.
Now that he was attracted by the old man’s action of cutting trees, he unknowingly connected the two types of battles.
He walked over, and said with a smile, “Uncle, can I help you chop for a while?”

“You?” The old man stopped, and the breath he exhaled turned into a white mist. It was still quite cold in this season, but because of his work, his whole person seemed to have been fished out of a steamer. He was exuding steam.
“Can you do it?” he asked with a smile.
“Let’s give it a try.” Ling Han nodded.
“All right.” The old man handed the axe over.
Ling Han brandished the axe. Shua, the axe slashed out, as fast as lightning. A large tree was instantly severed, and fell loudly onto the ground.
The old man revealed an astounded expression, and said, “Young man, how strong do you have to be!”

Meanwhile, Ling Han felt awkward. He hadn’t used his mystical power, yet he was still a Body Arts cultivator. With a wave of his hand, he naturally unleashed his power. Even if it was just a wisp, how difficult would it be to sever an ordinary tree?
He smiled at the old man, and began to cut again.
He was mainly experiencing that smooth and natural feeling, and felt that it was very inspirational, and his ultimate goal was to create his own technique.

Every Ancestral King would create a technique that belonged to them. It was not after they had achieved Dao, but rather before that. On the other hand, the path of achieving Dao was the process of them perfecting their own techniques.
Now, Ling Han had already stepped onto the True Self Tier, and began to cultivate the Regulations of heaven and earth. Then, he would be qualified to create his own technique.
Of course, this was not something that could be accomplished overnight, and that was why he needed to comprehend it.
His movements became smoother and smoother. He only needed to use the smallest amount of power, and he would be able to show the best effects.
The old man was resting at the side. At first, he was unconcerned, but as he watched, his eyes gradually lit up. Unfortunately, Ling Han was completely focused, and did not notice this fact.
Half a day later, there was no longer a large tree that was still standing in this mountain range.
Ling Han finally stopped. He returned the axe to the elder, and said, “Uncle, I’ll help you drag these trees home.”

“No need.” The old man shook his head, “I have already been cutting trees here for a hundred years, experiencing life, yet I was accidentally interrupted by you, brat. There is no meaning to continue staying here.”
Yi!
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Judging by the old man’s tone, he had subconsciously called over someone, but could it be that he had encountered a great elite cultivating in seclusion?

That was because he could not tell the strength of this old man at all. He should be an extremely ordinary person, but precisely because of this, if this old man was really a cultivator, his abilities would definitely be world-shaking, and only then would he be able to deceive his eyes.

“Encountering each other is fate. Sir, do you have any fated opportunity to bestow on this junior?” Ling Han immediately asked. In any case, he was thick-skinned enough, so he definitely couldn’t miss such a good opportunity.

The elder faltered upon hearing this. He hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would dare to ask him for a great opportunity. Even with his temperament that had been cultivated for tens of thousands of years, he was still astonished. Then, he burst into laughter.

“If I were tens of thousands of years old, perhaps I would want to take you as my disciple. Such high comprehension ability is really rare!” He sighed ruefully. With his insight, he naturally could tell that Ling Han was just about to walk out a path that belonged solely to him.
“Unfortunately, I’ve long since become indifferent, so I won’t delay a young man like you.”
“Go on. If we’re fated to meet again, we’ll naturally meet again.”
After saying this, the elder casually tore a rip into space. He then took a step forward, instantly vanishing from sight.
F***, tearing open a rip into space with his bare hands. This was at least an elite of the Sect Master level.

However, Ling Han had dealt with the Nine Mountains Venerate for so long, so he was naturally quite familiar with Venerate Tiers. Thus, he was certain that even a Venerate Tier wouldn’t be able to hide his aura in front of him.
Saint, that old man was a Saint!

chapters.title: Chapter 4193: Applying to be Buddha Son
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh in grief. He had seen a Saint, and he had actually failed to obtain any benefits. This was really too much of a pity.
“Strange, why didn’t I go to other places, and insist on coming here? Furthermore, why do I have to choose this planet?” Ling Han murmured, “Could it be that this is the effect of fortune?”

He had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, and when he made his choice, he would lean towards the side that was beneficial to him. Thus, he had come to this planet by accident, and by accident, had come to the mountains, where he encountered a Saint.
“Sigh, looks like my luck is still not good enough!”

Ling Han continued to walk. Because he hadn’t connected to the Galaxy Network yet, he didn’t know what had happened recently either. Thus, he went to buy a connection device and returned to find the little azure dragon and the large black dog.

He wanted to connect to the Galaxy Network to take a look. Thus, he had to first call over the little azure dragon and the large black dog. He didn’t want to suddenly attract powerful enemies and unconsciously betray the two of them.
Ling Han had never been one to screw over his teammates.
Ling Han connected to the Galaxy Network, and all the major events that had happened in the past year, as well as matters related to him were all listed.

Firstly, after over a year of cooling down, Ling Han’s popularity had already decreased. No one mentioned his freakishness anymore, because he was targeted by the nine great Imperial Clans — in truth, it was more than that. It was just that the nine great Imperial Clans had flipped out previously — who would still have a bright future ahead of them?
Ling Han was done for. Offending the Imperial Clans, no matter how they thought about it, it would only lead to death.

Of course, there were still a great many people searching for the whereabouts of Ling Han. The bounty issued by the Imperial Clans had not been withdrawn. As long as they discovered Ling Han because of the information that someone had provided, they could still win a favor from the Imperial Clans.
Thus, Ling Han had now become a rat that everyone despised.

This caused Ling Han, little azure dragon, and the large black dog to explode in fury. They clearly hadn’t done anything wrong, and everything was only for self-protection. Why did those who were being victimized have to hide here and there?
It could not be helped. Everything was due to strength.
The Imperial Clans had a Saint in their ranks, and they also had an Imperial Weapon to intimidate the world. Thus, they could act with such force.
“Motherf*cker! These b*stards!” the large black dog cursed.

Thankfully, the Nine Suns Holy Land had completely drawn a clear dividing line between them and Ling Han, and even announced that Ling Han would be expelled from the Holy Land. In this way, the nine great Imperial Clans would have nothing else to say, or use this as a reason to make trouble for the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t blame the Nine Suns Holy Land. In truth, he was the only one who owed the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Little Han, Grandpa Dog can’t take this lying down!” the large black dog said.
“Grandpa Dragon can’t tolerate it either!” the little azure dragon also said.
“En!” Ling Han nodded, “However, we can only remember this now, and grow in a low-key manner. When we become Venerates and Saints, we will definitely make these Imperial Clans pay the price!”
“Where are we going now?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han revealed a smile, and said, “I just found out on the Galaxy Network that West Heavenly Realm’s Buddhist Race is recruiting prodigies. They want to pick one of them to be Buddha Son.”
“Yi!” The large black dog immediately jumped up, “You want to become this Buddha Son?”

“Why not?” Ling Han shrugged, “Though tje Buddhist Race West Heavenly Realm is only a branch, this is still slightly stronger than Holy Lands. Thus, if I can become the Buddha Son, I would definitely be able to obtain adequate cultivation resources.”

The large black dog’s expression was strange, and he said, “The Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm, Shi Yongming, was killed by you, brat. You actually have the face to be a Buddha Son. How shameless!”
“Hehe, but Grandpa Dog likes it!”
These Imperial Clans were all overbearing and domineering. If they could take advantage of this opportunity to trick them, they could at least vent some of their anger.
“Many planets have Buddhist temples. We only need to go to one of them, and show a considerable amount of talent, and we would be sent to the headquarters of the West Heavenly Realm,” Ling Han said.
“Us?” The large black dog bared his teeth, “Grandpa Dog doesn’t want to become a monk!”
“Grandpa Dragon doesn’t want to, either. I haven’t left a descendant yet!” the little azure dragon also said hurriedly.

“F***, who said that the Buddhist Race are all monks? That’s only a branch of the Buddhist Race, and they’re called ascetic monks. The majority of Buddhist Race are like us, and there is no taboo on marriage, or carnal pleasures,” Ling Han said.
“Sigh, then I’ll reluctantly accept.” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both nodded.
Ling Han set up the Transfer Formation on his own. After the formation was activated, they instantly traversed the galaxy and arrived at Bai Hong Planet.

This was not too far away from the planet they had previously been on. It could not be helped. The resources in Ling Han’s possession only allowed him to set up this kind of Transfer Formation. If it was too far away, it could not be maintained, and would explode midway. Then, Ling Han and the others would fall out of the Void. They could appear in the vast universe, or they could be at the centre of some planet.
As for the Galaxy Network connection device, he had naturally thrown it away long ago. It was impossible that he would still keep it by his side.

The Divine Temple of the Buddhist Race was located on the Bai Hong Planet, and just like the Chang Clan, the bases of the Buddhist Race were practically scattered throughout the whole universe. In terms of scale alone, they could be regarded as the Twin Heroes of the universe alongside the Chang Clan.

Ling Han was presently disguised as an elegant young man, while the little azure dragon was an extremely beautiful green-haired little boy of about five or six years old. However, once he opened his mouth, his image was immediately ruined.
As for the large black dog, he transformed into a middle-aged man with a perverted expression.
In this way, the three of them arrived at the Divine Temple of a city.
The Buddhist Race was most skilled in spiritual attacks. Thus, they had a way of dealing with Yin souls, a way of dealing with internal demons, and a way of moving people’s hearts.
There were a great many devout believers here. With every step they took, they would kneel, and walk up the long staircase towards the Divine Temple that was located at a higher place.
Ling Han and the others appeared especially out of place. They strode forward, and the believers glared at them as they did so, as if they had sullied their sacredness.
These steps were really long. Clearly, they were meant to show off the loftiness of the Divine Temple, so that the believers would feel even more reverence.
Ling Han and the others didn’t walk too fast either. After a few minutes, they finally arrived in front of the Divine Temple.
“Do the three of you want to burn incense and pay respects to Buddha?” A young monk walked out to receive them.
The large black dog immediately said, “I’m here to apply for the position of Buddha Son!”
The young monk gave an ‘oh’, and said, “Everyone, this way please!”
He went to ask for help from an older monk, who was responsible for communicating with Ling Han and the others.

“Being a Buddha Son isn’t something that you people can become just because you want to,” the old monk said. “The lowest requirement is True Self Tier. En, if your aptitude is truly excellent, then we can also slightly lower our standards. Core Formation Tier would also be acceptable.”
Ling Han smiled and said, “The three of us meet the requirements. We’re all True Self Tiers.”
When these words fell, the old monk instantly looked reverent, because he was only a Cauldron Forging Tier.
“Please wait for a moment. I will go and seek help from Lord Chief Monk!” The old monk also ran off.

This was a relatively barren planet, so the overall level of cultivation wasn’t high. Even the Chief Monk of the Divine Temple was only a True Self Tier cultivator. He naturally could tell the cultivation levels of Ling Han and the others. After being stunned for a while, he immediately contacted his superiors to inform them about Ling Han and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 4194: Three Milk Tea Brothers
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

“Hehe, three benefactors, you guys are really fated with Buddha,” the Chief Monk said. “Today is the deadline for recruiting Buddha Sons. If you guys come a day later, you won’t be able to participate in the selection.”
Ling Han chuckled, “My luck has always been good.”
Under the arrangements of this Chief Monk, they once again stepped onto the Transfer Formation, and arrived at the Green Bird Planet.

The Green Bird Planet was a great planet in this galaxy. Its overall level of cultivation was far superior to Bai Hong Planet, and the Divine Temple here was also a level higher. All those who had been selected in this galaxy would be tested here.

The Buddhist Race was a force of Ancestral King Tier-level. Their inheritance had been passed down for who knew how many generations, and their strength was undoubted. Thus, there were really a lot of people who came to register.
This was only a small galaxy. It was said that in other galaxies, even the Dao Child of a Holy Land would participate in the selection.
The Dao Child of the Holy Land was also accepted; weren’t they afraid that he would flee after learning their techniques?
Of course not.

Because the Buddhist Race was most proficient in moving people’s hearts, and brainwashing was their strongest skill. Who cares if you are a Dao Child or whatnot? Even if the Imperial Son was here, they would still be able to make you convert to Buddhism, and never have any second thoughts.

Thus, the Buddhist Race recruited people with ease, and definitely did not care about background or whatnot. That was because in this place, anyone who had a black reputation could clear their name, and anyone with a clear reputation could also be slandered.
It was precisely because of this that Ling Han had chosen to come here. He was not afraid of others investigating his background. After all, their identities were all false.
“Wu, Little Han, this milk tea is really not bad.” The large black dog held a teacup, and was currently drinking very happily.
“Furious Rhinoceros Milk added with Mingyue Tea, and when combined, it becomes milk tea.” The little azure dragon was also drinking enthusiastically.
Ling Han sighed, and said, “Forget about the Four-Legged Snake. He’s still a kid. Your face is already covered with stubble, yet you’re still drinking milk?”
“Milk tea, not milk,” the large black dog emphasized.
“Come, you too!” The little azure dragon ordered another cup of milk tea and forced it onto Ling Han.
Fine then.

The three of them held milk tea in their hands, and waited in the plaza of the Divine Temple. There were at least several hundred people standing here, and they were all very young, but all of them were exuding a powerful aura. They were either in the True Self Tier or the Core Formation Tier.
The lowest requirement for selecting Buddha Sons this time was the True Self Tier, but if a Core Formation Tier had high aptitude, they could also be accepted as an exception.
Thus, there were a great many Core Formation Tier cultivators here, who thought that their aptitude was shocking enough, and had reached the extent of being accepted as an exception.
“Haha, with me, Yuan Dong, here, all of you can leave!” someone shouted.
“Hehe, I know who you are, Yuan Dong. To actually have the courage to say such words, I really feel ashamed for you.” Immediately, someone continued, his face filled with a cold smirk.
“Hiss, Nalan Que!” That person who called himself Yuan Dong exclaimed in shock, and fell silent.
There really were a few prodigies here. After introducing themselves, they immediately caused a commotion.
“Che, all of you are just weaklings. Once I appear, all of you have to stand aside.” The little azure dragon couldn’t help but mock. He really had a bad mouth.

He was now a beautiful little boy of about five or six years old, yet he was acting all mature and experienced. His mouth was spitting venom, and everyone couldn’t help but click their tongues in amazement.

“Hehe, which family does this child come from? Why don’t the adults of the family control him?” someone said with a laugh. They thought that the little azure dragon had only come with the others, and definitely couldn’t be a “contestant”.
“What is it? Unconvinced?” The large black dog immediately glared at him.
“So arrogant!” The Yuan Dong from before immediately jumped out. He could be considered an elite here, and only a few people had abilities superior to him.
“What is it? Unconvinced?” The large black dog immediately slanted a sideways glare at him.
“You really are defiant!” Yuan Dong leaped towards the large black dog, and shot out a palm strike, the force behind it extraordinarily strong.
The large black dog scoffed, and waved his palm in reply.
Boom!

The two of them clashed in close-quarter combat, and Yuan Dong’s proud face instantly revealed an expression of shock. They were both in the early stage of the True Self Tier, yet his power was actually much weaker than his opponent’s.
In a short while, he was sent flying.

Yuan Dong humphed, and suppressed his shock. To a True Self Tier cultivator, power was only a part of battle prowess, and its weight had already declined greatly, and the use of Regulations of the heaven and earth was the true way to go.
Your power is strong, but that does not mean that your use of the Regulations of heaven and earth is stronger than mine!

He charged out again, and communicated with the Regulations of heaven and earth. He delivered another palm strike. Boom, the celestial technique showed its might. With the Regulations entwined around it, its might increased greatly.
“Tsk, you’re showing off in front of me!” The large black dog shot out a foot. Peng! Yuan Dong was once again sent flying. He was completely outmatched.

One had to realize that the large black dog was a Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron. When he had been at the Core Formation Tier, he had also fused with the Regulations of nine Nine Star Energy. Even without channeling the Saint Technique, his battle prowess was at least at the Fifth Heaven.
This naturally was a one-sided suppression.

Seeing how Yuan Dong was dealt with so easily, everyone was greatly shocked, and the limited few that were stronger than Yuan Dong also frowned deeply. This large man looked vulgar, but his abilities were really no joke.
“Oi, oi, oi, what’s with your gazes!” The large black dog was enraged. It was enough for them to show reverence in their eyes, so why was there a hint of disdain?
“Dare I ask how I should address you, sir?” Nalan Que spoke up. He was one of the strongest elites here.
The large black dog turned around to look, and an idea came to him. He said, “We’re the Three Milk Tea Brothers!”
Pu!
Ling Han immediately spluttered. ‘F*ck, I’ll give you another chance, so you’d better say it again.’

Yet the large black dog was very pleased with himself, seeming to be very satisfied with this name, “I am the eldest, this is the second eldest, and this is the third.” He pointed first at Ling Han, and then at the little azure dragon.
Ling Han’s expression became even darker. He detested the title of second place.
However, everyone was very reverent. No matter how unreliable the name of Three Milk Tea Brothers was, strength represented everything. The large black dog was indeed very strong.
“Hehe, sorry for the long wait, benefactors.” A baldy walked over. He was wearing a bright yellow monastic robe, and the word Buddha was embroidered on the back, exuding a powerful aura.
“Treasure!” The large black dog stared at the monastic robe, his eyes shining.
“If there’s a chance, we’ll snatch it,” the little azure dragon also said.
These two guys, could it be that this was all they could do?
Ling Han shook his head. This was really worrisome.
“Please come with me.” The baldy brought them into the hall. There was a very large rock placed here.
“Yi, a testing stone?” Ling Han mumbled softly.
As expected, to take disciples, the first step was naturally to test natural talent, which was enough to eliminate 99% of people.

“This is a precious stone used to test natural talent. You guys can’t use weapons like Spirit Tool, Talisman Weapons, and so on, but you can channel any kind of precious technique to attack it. Your battle prowess will appear in the form of pillars of light. Only those who have reached five or more will be qualified to enter the next round, and go to the headquarters of the West Heavenly Realm and participate in the further selection,” the baldie said.
“Only five?” Someone immediately laughed loudly, and was the first to walk out, “Let me give it a try.”
He was filled with confidence, and thought that blasting out five pillars of light would be a piece of cake.
