However, everyone was very reverent.
No matter how unreliable the name of Three Milk Tea Brothers was, strength represented everything.
The large black dog was indeed very strong.
“Hehe, sorry for the long wait, benefactors.” A baldy walked over.
He was wearing a bright yellow monastic robe, and the word Buddha was embroidered on the back, exuding a powerful aura.
“Treasure!” The large black dog stared at the monastic robe, his eyes shining.
“If there’s a chance, we’ll snatch it,” the little azure dragon also said.
These two guys, could it be that this was all they could do?
Ling Han shook his head.
This was really worrisome.
“Please come with me.” The baldy brought them into the hall.
There was a very large rock placed here.
“Yi, a testing stone?” Ling Han mumbled softly.
As expected, to take disciples, the first step was naturally to test natural talent, which was enough to eliminate 99% of people.
“This is a precious stone used to test natural talent.
You guys can’t use weapons like Spirit Tool, Talisman Weapons, and so on, but you can channel any kind of precious technique to attack it.
Your battle prowess will appear in the form of pillars of light.
Only those who have reached five or more will be qualified to enter the next round, and go to the headquarters of the West Heavenly Realm and participate in the further selection,” the baldie said.
“Only five?” Someone immediately laughed loudly, and was the first to walk out, “Let me give it a try.”
He was filled with confidence, and thought that blasting out five pillars of light would be a piece of cake.

chapters.title: Chapter 4195: Stainless Planet
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
That person stepped forwards and delivered an attack, but in the end, only a mere three pillars of light lit up.
“What?” That person did not dare believe it, and hurriedly said, “This is not my true strength. Let me try again!”
The baldy smiled, “Everyone has three chances.”
That person didn’t dare to be careless anymore, and hurriedly concentrated on preparing. Then, he shot out another attack. The Regulations surged, turning into a dazzling light.
Peng, under this attack, there were still only three pillars of light flickering.

That person was stupefied. This was his full-power attack, but still, only three pillars of light lit up. Then, even if he exceeded his limits in the next attack, he would only be able to fire out four pillars of light, at most.
“Benefactor, are you going to give up the chance for the final attack?” the baldy asked.
That person thought for a moment, then nodded, and said, “I give up.” This was really too far away. He did not have the slightest bit of confidence.
However, he did not leave immediately. He wanted to see if there was anyone here that could shoot out five pillars of light.
Next, everyone stepped forward to test themselves, one after another, but even the person with the best natural talent only shot out four pillars of light, and not one of them could pass.
In the end, only Ling Han and the other two remained.
“The Three Milk Tea Brothers!” quite a number of people whispered. Could these three people perform a miracle?
“Let’s go, it’s our turn to show off!” The large black dog was the first to walk out.
It arrived in front of the testing stone, and delivered a palm strike. Instantly, five pillars of light rose up.
“Hiss!” Instantly, a commotion arose.
Finally, someone blasted out five pillars of light. Impressive.
The baldy’s face was also filled with joy. The seeds of the Buddha Son had appeared here, and they too had contributed, so they would be rewarded.
The large black dog delivered another palm strike. Shua, six pillars of light flashed in unison.
Everyone’s eyes widened. Six flashes of light, he had actually attained six flashes of light.

Heavens, the strongest among them had only just barely shot out four flashes of light, but this vulgar large man had actually shot out six flashes of light. Just how astonishing was the gap between them?
The large black dog was extremely pleased with himself. This was the result that he wanted.
Just as it was about to deliver another strike, blasting out seven pillars of light, it saw Ling Han shake his head slightly at it.
Er, he couldn’t show off too much.
The large black dog withdrew his hand, and walked back in an extremely arrogant manner.
However, no one spoke up to rebuke him. Instead, they were filled with respect and reverence.
In this world, as long as you had the strength to be arrogant, you could be as arrogant as you liked. Others would only revere you.
“I’m coming!” The little azure dragon jumped out.
What, this child was going to be tested as well?

Everyone was curious. Previously, they had all thought that the little azure dragon was only brought over by Ling Han and the large black dog for fun. They had not thought that this little boy was actually one of the examinees.
Peng!
The little azure dragon threw a punch, and instantly, six pillars of light lit up.
‘Holy f*ck!’

Everyone almost fainted in unison. The moment the little azure dragon attacked, they could all tell that it was a genuine True Self Tier. Furthermore, the six pillars of light were even more terrifying!
Heavens, such a small True Self Tier cultivator, his natural talent was shocking!
What kind of monster was this!
The baldy was even happier. Two seeds. This time, their Divine Temple had really done a great service.

The little azure dragon was vexed. He planned to start from three pillars of light, then five pillars of light, and then six pillars of light. In this way, there would be both a turnaround and a climax. However, if he accidentally used too much force; he had directly blasted out six pillars of light.
He didn’t attack again. He kept a low profile. They had to keep a low profile now.
After the little azure dragon walked back, Ling Han walked over and threw a light punch without accumulating any power.
Er, three flashes of light.
‘I’ve been too careful,’ Ling Han thought to himself.
Everyone shook their heads. Looks like the second eldest of the Three Milk Tea Brothers was not that strong.
“It can’t be helped. He is second eldest , so he deinitely is weak.” Someone made a sarcastic remark, feeling that if one of the three brothers was eliminated, he would feel slightly better.
“Haha!” A great many people laughed loudly.

Meanwhile, the little azure dragon lamented. This was how he wanted to show off. He wanted to first make others look down on him, and then slap them with the harsh reality. Only then would he make them drop their jaws in shock. Only then would he be perfect.
Sigh, there was still a considerable distance between him and Ling Han on the path of showing off.
Ling Han threw another punch. Peng! At this moment, five pillars of light lit up at the same time.
“F***!” Seeing this scene, everyone couldn’t help but blurt out.

As it turned out, it was not that this guy’s natural talent was inferior, but rather that he was deliberately showing off. Otherwise, how could it be possible that he would produce another two pillars of light in the next strike?
Meanwhile, Ling Han felt that this was just right. It was enough for him to pass, and there was no need for him to show off too much.
“Haha!” The baldy was all smiles. A total of three people had passed this time, and this was a great merit.

The others were all sent away, and Ling Han and the others stayed behind. They needed to rest for a while. In a few days, they would be sent to the headquarters of the Buddhist Race in the West Heavenly Realm, where they would undergo the final selection.
Time passed very quickly. In just five days, Ling Han and the others once again entered into the Transfer Formation, heading towards the headquarters of the Buddhist Race in the West Heavenly Realm.

That was on the Stainless Planet. Originally, the name of this planet was not this, but because the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm established their headquarters here, they renamed this planet.
Accompanying Ling Han and the others was an old monk. He was responsible for bringing Ling Han and the others to the headquarters of the Buddhist Race to complete the handover ceremony.

“T-the Three Milk Tea Brothers?” When he heard the old monk recite the nicknames of Ling Han and the others with a solemn expression, the person in charge of registration had a strange expression on his face.

He glanced at the little azure dragon. If they were all this kind of kids, then the name of Three Milk Tea Brothers would still fit the situation, but there was also a vulgar man and a young lad. This made him want to splutter in shock.
Especially when this old monk had a serious expression on his face, which created a strong contrast.
After completing the registration, the old monk returned, and Ling Han and the others stayed here. When the seeds from the various galaxies had all been sent over, the selection would begin.
Four days later, all the seeds had arrived.

The Stainless Planet was the headquarters of the West Heavenly Realm’s Buddha Tribe. Divine Temples were everywhere here, where the Ancestral Buddha was worshipped. The incense was flourishing, and Ling Han and the others were summoned into a divine temple by a man with black hair that reached his waist.
“My name is Shi Changtian,” the man said. He paused, then continued, “Only when one has truly gained approval, would he be able to bear the surname of Shi.”
Everyone nodded in agreement. This was the surname of the Ancestral Buddha.

“Why is the selection this time at least True Self Tier?” Shi Changtian explained. “That is because the Imperial Sons of this generation have all advanced into True Self Tier. In order to compete with these Imperial Sons, we no longer have the time to nurture them from the very beginning.”
So that was the case.

If one’s natural talent was outstanding enough, they could still relax to the level of the Core Formation Tier. After all, the Core Formation Tier was only one cultivation level away, so there was still hope of catching up.

“No matter which great clan’s heir you were previously, or the Dao Child of a great sect, now that you’re here, you’re all just ordinary members.” Shi Changtian continued, “In Buddhism, fate matters, so if you’re not fated enough, you won’t be able to stay here.”
“From today onwards, the elimination will begin.”
“There are a total of 307 of you. In this first round, only 18 people can win.”
All of a sudden, everyone exclaimed in shock. This elimination rate was really too high, wasn’t it? But upon further thought, there could only be one Buddha Son, so this was actually very normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 4196: Elimination
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
How were they going to be eliminated?
Of course, it wasn’t a battle, because there were indeed Core Formation Tiers that were outstandingly talented. If it was a battle, it would obviously be unfair to them.

Shi Changtian crossed his arms behind his back, and said, “I will now teach you a Venerate Tier-level celestial technique. The first eighteen people who have successfully cultivated it can stay behind, and as for the others... they will all be eliminated!”
He didn’t give them any time to rest. Instead, he started to act.
“This is... Kasyapa Finger!”

As he explained the details of this celestial technique, he cast the Regulations of heaven and earth. He could only describe its form, but could not outline its spirit. A celestial technique of this level could only be comprehended by oneself.
Shi Changtian only performed it once, then had everyone comprehend and learn.
He sat down in a cross-legged position on the sidelines, and had someone demonstrate in front of him after they had successfully cultivated it. He was the judge.

Everyone’s eyes were wide open just now, capturing Shi Changtian’s every move, and had also taken note of his commentary. How to communicate with the Regulations of heaven and earth was the true focus.
At this moment, a dead silence fell.
Ling Han and the others naturally began to cultivate as well. If they were to be eliminated in the first stage, that would really be funny.

Kasyapa Finger, a Venerate Tier-level technique. Even in a Holy Land, this should be considered an ultimate technique, but in this place, it was actually used as a test. Even if one was eliminated, he would at least be able to learn a Venerate Tier-level technique, which was a great profit.

Of course, Ling Han and the others were completely unconcerned. The Saint Techniques they possessed had already exceeded 10 in number, so a Venerate Tier-level technique was naturally not worthy of their notice.
In just a single day, Ling Han had already comprehended the profound secrets of the Kasyapa Finger. However, he didn’t stand up immediately. Instead, he chose to wait.
Another half day passed, and xiu, the little azure dragon stood up.
“I’ve learnt it!” he said, leaping out and practicing in front of Shi Changtian.

Meanwhile, the Dao of heaven and earth was stimulated, and entwined around his body. He tapped out a finger, which turned into a beam of light. Pu, it hit the wall, and immediately blasted out a hole. The beam of light continued to shoot out, as if it would never stop.
Shi Changtian smiled, “Not bad, not bad. You have passed.”
The little azure dragon winked at Ling Han, meaning, ‘How about it? You can’t compare to Grandpa Dragon, right?’
Ling Han simply smiled. He wasn’t such a showy person.
Another half day passed, and the large black dog also successfully cultivated the Kasyapa Finger. It was ranked second.
Then, another day later, the others succeeded one after another.
Ling Han waited until the fifteenth place to start practicing, and naturally passed the test smoothly.
In a total of five days, eighteen seeds appeared, and the others were all eliminated.

“Next, it’s still the elimination battles.” Shi Changtian said, “The rules are the same. I’ll teach you a celestial technique. You guys can comprehend it on your own. The top fifteen win, and three are eliminated. However, those who have been eliminated can choose to stay in Buddhist Race, and not become Buddha Sons. Becoming something like Guardian Deities is also a good choice.”
Without giving them too much time to think, Shi Changtian performed another new celestial technique, called Heavenly Net Kick.
This was also a Venerate Tier-level technique, but it was slightly more difficult than the Kasyapa Finger.
However, for Ling Han, this still couldn’t be considered a dilemma. In just one day, he had already mastered this leg technique.
Just like before, he did not immediately stand up. Instead, he chose to keep a low profile.

In the end, the little azure dragon was once again showy, and was the first to pass, followed by the large black dog. Ling Han waited until the twelfth place to finally step forward and obtain a spot.

Yet Shi Changtian took a second look at him, because Ling Han had not passed the first stage easily. He should be ranked last in this second stage, and it was even normal for Ling Han to be eliminated. However, Ling Han was actually ranked twelfth, which he felt was very unexpected.
Seven days later, this round of eliminations ended.

The third round of elimination was also the same. However, the precious technique was changed to Thousand Flower Fists, and the top three remained unchanged. It was still the little azure dragon that was first, the large black dog that was second, and the third was a man called Fu Quan. He was the Dao Child of a Holy Land, so his natural talent was naturally extraordinary.

Although he was always in the top three, Fu Quan’s expression didn’t look too good. He, the Dao Child of the Holy Land, was actually inferior to two unknown guys. These two people looked undependable at first glance—one was a child, while the other was vulgar.
Being suppressed by these two people, Fu Quan felt very sullen.
This time, Ling Han was ranked ninth, causing Shi Changtian to be shocked again. This test method was getting harder and harder, so why was your ranking getting higher and higher?
Show off!
Shi Changtian immediately came to a conclusion, and looked strangely at Ling Han.
If Ling Han found out, he would definitely be very depressed. He really only wanted to keep a low profile.
After three rounds of testing, there were now nine people left from the original eighteen.

“Next, it’s time to learn dharma.” Shi Changtian brought them to another Divine Temple. There were a great many monks chanting here, releasing a majestic voice that instantly cleared one’s mind, as if they had seen the Ancestral Buddha.
Ling Han discovered that this chant was extremely rhythmic, secretly matching the rhythm of Heavenly Dao.

He understood in his heart that this should be a cultivation technique similar to the Six Characters Bright King Curse, but the effects were much worse. Furthermore, it could not expel evil and brighten one’s heart. Instead, it could bewitch one’s heart, and give rise to endless admiration for the Ancestral Buddha.

If there was only one person chanting, then with the willpower of the prodigies here, they would definitely be able to resist. However, with at least several hundred monks chanting together, the effects would be huge.

He hurriedly transmitted a message to the little azure dragon and the large black dog through divine sense, telling the two “people” not to be careless. They were here to scam cultivation resources, not to really join the Buddhist Race.
In the side hall, an eminent monk came over and gave them a lecture on dharma.
This was an Arhat.
In the Buddhist Tribe, Saints were called Buddhas, Venerate Tiers were called Bodhisattva, and Sect Masters were called Arhats. Thus, this was a great elite of the Minor Advanced Tier.
He spoke eloquently, reciting scriptures, inspiring faith in others.
Ling Han kept his guard up, and sensitively discovered that this was actually brainwashing them, instilling the concept of loyalty to the Buddhist Race.

Unlike the Battle God Palace, which used cruel slaughter to numb one’s senses, right until one’s self-destruction, the Buddhist Race was much more brilliant. All of them were soul cultivator elites, and were also most skilled in influencing the soul.

It had only been a few days, and everyone’s expressions had changed. They were filled with reverence towards the Ancestral Buddha. That was a kind of worship that originated from the depths of their hearts.
Ling Han was secretly astonished, but he didn’t show it. He secretly used the Six Characters Bright King Curse to alert himself, the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
This enlightenment could dispel all negative effects.
It was a little ironic. The Six Characters Bright King Curse was originally the Buddhist Race’s Imperial Technique, but now it was used by Ling Han to resist the Buddhist Dharma.
Another seven days later, that Arhat finished his sermon, and left swiftly.
Shi Changtian appeared, and said calmly, “Follow me, the elimination continues.”

From here onwards, only one person would be eliminated each time, but the test was no longer just limited to cultivating the celestial technique. Instead, it was also a test of battle prowess. After all, the Buddha Son could not possibly stay at home all the time.
Two months passed, and the nine people became four people. Aside from Ling Han and the other two, the last person was Fu Quan.
“Little Han, something has happened. Someone has come from the Buddhist Land of the Thirty Three Heavens!”

However, the precious technique was changed to Thousand Flower Fists, and the top three remained unchanged.
It was still the little azure dragon that was first, the large black dog that was second, and the third was a man called Fu Quan.
He was the Dao Child of a Holy Land, so his natural talent was naturally extraordinary.
Although he was always in the top three, Fu Quan’s expression didn’t look too good.
He, the Dao Child of the Holy Land, was actually inferior to two unknown guys.
These two people looked undependable at first glance—one was a child, while the other was vulgar.
Being suppressed by these two people, Fu Quan felt very sullen.
This time, Ling Han was ranked ninth, causing Shi Changtian to be shocked again.
This test method was getting harder and harder, so why was your ranking getting higher and higher?
Show off!
Shi Changtian immediately came to a conclusion, and looked strangely at Ling Han.
If Ling Han found out, he would definitely be very depressed.
He really only wanted to keep a low profile.
After three rounds of testing, there were now nine people left from the original eighteen.
“Next, it’s time to learn dharma.” Shi Changtian brought them to another Divine Temple.
There were a great many monks chanting here, releasing a majestic voice that instantly cleared one’s mind, as if they had seen the Ancestral Buddha.
Ling Han discovered that this chant was extremely rhythmic, secretly matching the rhythm of Heavenly Dao.
He understood in his heart that this should be a cultivation technique similar to the Six Characters Bright King Curse, but the effects were much worse.
Furthermore, it could not expel evil and brighten one’s heart.
Instead, it could bewitch one’s heart, and give rise to endless admiration for the Ancestral Buddha.
If there was only one person chanting, then with the willpower of the prodigies here, they would definitely be able to resist.
However, with at least several hundred monks chanting together, the effects would be huge.
He hurriedly transmitted a message to the little azure dragon and the large black dog through divine sense, telling the two “people” not to be careless.
They were here to scam cultivation resources, not to really join the Buddhist Race.
In the side hall, an eminent monk came over and gave them a lecture on dharma.
This was an Arhat.
In the Buddhist Tribe, Saints were called Buddhas, Venerate Tiers were called Bodhisattva, and Sect Masters were called Arhats.
Thus, this was a great elite of the Minor Advanced Tier.
He spoke eloquently, reciting scriptures, inspiring faith in others.
Ling Han kept his guard up, and sensitively discovered that this was actually brainwashing them, instilling the concept of loyalty to the Buddhist Race.
Unlike the Battle God Palace, which used cruel slaughter to numb one’s senses, right until one’s self-destruction, the Buddhist Race was much more brilliant.
All of them were soul cultivator elites, and were also most skilled in influencing the soul.
It had only been a few days, and everyone’s expressions had changed.
They were filled with reverence towards the Ancestral Buddha.
That was a kind of worship that originated from the depths of their hearts.
Ling Han was secretly astonished, but he didn’t show it.
He secretly used the Six Characters Bright King Curse to alert himself, the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
This enlightenment could dispel all negative effects.
It was a little ironic.
The Six Characters Bright King Curse was originally the Buddhist Race’s Imperial Technique, but now it was used by Ling Han to resist the Buddhist Dharma.
Another seven days later, that Arhat finished his sermon, and left swiftly.
Shi Changtian appeared, and said calmly, “Follow me, the elimination continues.”
From here onwards, only one person would be eliminated each time, but the test was no longer just limited to cultivating the celestial technique.
Instead, it was also a test of battle prowess.
After all, the Buddha Son could not possibly stay at home all the time.
Two months passed, and the nine people became four people.
Aside from Ling Han and the other two, the last person was Fu Quan.
“Little Han, something has happened.
Someone has come from the Buddhist Land of the Thirty Three Heavens!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4197: Interference
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Buddhist Race’s true headquarters was not in this universe, but rather a small space that the Ancestral Buddha had created through supreme means. It had become the holy land of the Buddhist Race, and was called Buddhist Land.
Where was the Buddhist Land? It was only known that it was the 33 Heavens, and all other information was missing. It was as mysterious as the Battle God Palace.

Among the West, East, North and South Heavenly Realms, there were headquarters of the Buddhist Race. They were responsible for promoting the teachings of the Buddhist Race and nurturing their believers. In the millions and millions of years, they had progressed in an organized manner, and there was indeed an increasing number of Buddhist Race believers.

However, the Buddhist Land had always been mysterious. Since there were representatives in the four great Heavenly Realms, they had never appeared, as if the existence of the Buddhist Land was only a myth.
But now, someone had come from the Buddhist Land?
“Oh?” Ling Han was very intrigued, “Who is it?”
“A guy called Shi Yongyun. He’s young, but he’s extremely arrogant!” the large black dog said.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “As long as it does not affect us, who cares so much about them.”
“That’s true. We are here to con cultivation resources, not to clean up their mess.” The large black dog nodded, and did not take it to heart either.
They did not take it to heart, but not too many days later, the flames brought by Shi Yongyun had already reached them.
On this day, Ling Han and the other seeds were all cultivating together, but an uninvited guest appeared.
“Haha, since I am here, what need is there for me to select outsiders as Buddha Son?”
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han and the others all opened their eyes, and looked towards that person.
This was a young man, dressed in white monk robes, exuding an otherworldly air.
“Shi Yongyun,” the large black dog said to Ling Han and the little azure dragon through divine sense.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. By the looks of it, they didn’t want to cause any trouble. However, others wanted to cause trouble for them.
“Yongyun, watch your words!” Shi Changtian said calmly.

Shi Yongyun laughed loudly, and swept a glance over Shi Changtian, his smile gradually disappearing, “What need is there to be cautious here? I have come from the Buddhist Land, and have the right roots. Before I was even born, I have already faithfully worshipped the Ancestral Buddha, so what are these trash worth?”

“This is a matter of our West Heavenly Realm, and there is no need for you to interfere!” Shi Changtian humphed. However, while he clearly was an elite of Spirit Transformation Tier, he was still very tolerant towards Shi Yongyun, who was only in True Self Tier.
Born in the Buddhist Land, was he naturally superior to others?

Shi Yongyun shook his head, “Though the Buddhist Cloud resides deep within the thirty three Heavens, it does not mean that we would not interfere, and just sit by and watch as you subbranches lead the Buddhist Race astray, and their development is getting worse and worse!”

“Rubbish!” Shi Changtian finally couldn’t bear it any longer. The Buddhist Race of the four great Heavenly Realms could be said to be thriving, so how could this brat be allowed to make slanderous claims?
He stood up furiously, glaring furiously at Shi Yongyun. The aura of Spirit Transformation Tier circulated, making him seem as if he had turned into an angry Guardian Deity, filled with intimidation.
Yet Shi Yongyun was completely unafraid. With a wave of his hand, shua, a ray of light shot towards Shi Changtian.

This naturally could not possibly be an attack. No matter how arrogant Shi Yongyun was, he would not take the initiative to attack a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator. This was a suicidal action.
“This is Great Clouds Bodhisattva’s Buddhist decree, take a look for yourself!” Shi Yongyun said, a smile on his face, looking like he had everything under control.
Shi Changtian forcibly suppressed the fury in his heart, and unfolded the Buddhist decree. His expression involuntarily darkened.

This was indeed Great Clouds Bodhisattva’s decree. He was extremely dissatisfied with the matter of the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm getting killed, and thought that this was a great humiliation to the Buddhist Race. He commanded that the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm find the murderer as soon as possible, and deliver punishment.
Additionally, he strongly recommended Shi Yongyun as the candidate to succeed the position of Buddha Son.

Shi Changtian knew that this Shi Yongyun was Great Clouds Bodhisattva’s lay family, so it was not strange for him to write such a Buddhist decree that was filled with partiality. However, the dignified Bodhisattva actually did not sever his Seven Emotions1?

The Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm naturally had Bodhisattva as well, but when one came from the Buddhist Land, they naturally were superior to others. Who dared to ignore the Buddhist decree of the Great Clouds Bodhisattva?

“I will not make things difficult for you either. Whether it is competing for the position of Buddha Son or fighting with other Imperial Sons in future, there is only one word for it: true strength!” Shi Yongyun declared proudly, “Today, I will use strength to convince others!”
The large black dog approached, and asked, “Isn’t ‘true strength’ two words?”
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Is there something wrong with his brain?”
“En, that’s about it.” The large black dog nodded.
“Hey, don’t whisper behind Grandpa Dragon’s back!” the little azure dragon protested in displeasure.
Shi Yongyun’s eyes swept over them, and he smirked coldly, “The two of you are whispering among yourselves, do you have some kind of grudge against me?”
“I don’t have a grudge, I’m very displeased!” Fu Quan was the first to stand up.
“Very good. I like those who have objections,” Shi Yongyun said calmly. “However, after I suppress you, you naturally won’t have any objections or dissatisfaction.”
“Alright, after listening to you brag for so long, I am indeed very expectant. Just how strong are you?” Fu Quan was not the slightest bit afraid.
Shi Yongyun clasped his hands behind his back, and walked towards Fu Quan.
“Let’s battle in the sky!” Fu Quan said. If they battled here, the shockwaves would cause huge damage.
“There is no need to go to so much trouble. It is only a matter of two or three moves!” Shi Yongyun did not stop in his tracks.
“How arrogant!” Fu Quan was angered. Just how much are you looking down on me?
He cast a look at Shi Changtian, but Shi Changtian did not express anything, as if he had tacitly allowed it to happen.

The Buddhist Land was the Holy Land in the hearts of the Buddhist Race. This was an inherent advantage. Furthermore, Shi Yongyun had the Buddhist decree of a Bodhisattva on him, so Shi Changtian could not control him at all. At the very least, he would have to ask for instructions from a Bodhisattva.
“Come!” Shi Yongyun stated calmly.
Fu Quan humphed, leaped out, and charged towards Shi Yongyun.
In the first place, he was the Dao Child of a Holy Land, and usually, he would be the target of all kinds of flattery, so how could he tolerate such a lofty attitude from Shi Yongyun?
So what if you came from the Buddhist Land? I’ll beat you into submission!

“Humph, this kind of trash is worthy of competing for the position of Buddha Son. I really don’t know where he got his courage from!” Shi Yongyun shot out a palm strike, which turned into a giant golden palm. Buddhist chants could be heard in the air. He was clearly fighting for his own benefit, yet actually gave off the feeling of expiating evil.
Boom! Fu Quan instantly spat out a mouthful of blood as he stumbled back.

“Can’t even withstand a single blow,” Shi Yongyun said disdainfully, “If such a person was really allowed to become the Buddha Son, wouldn’t the whole world laugh at our Buddhist Race for having no one capable?”
Fu Quan merely coughed up blood, his face alternating between red and white, yet he was unable to refute these words.
His skills were inferior, so no matter what he said, he would only be embarrassing himself further.

However, what he had not foreseen was that as the Dao Child of the Holy Land, it was one thing for him to be no match for the Imperial Son, but why couldn’t he even defeat any random member of the Buddhist Race? Furthermore, the gap was so wide.
Shi Changtian also frowned slightly. Though the Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms was also known as the Buddhist Race, everyone knew that the true inheritance lay in the Buddhist Land.

Fu Quan had lost, so he could only depend on the other three. He hoped that they could at least withstand a few blows, and not lose too badly. Only then would he be able to ask Bodhisattva for help. Otherwise, he would definitely be harshly scolded.
“Who’s next?” Shi Yongyun’s eyes swept over Ling Han and the others, bearing a strong disdain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4198: Second
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Little brat, let me spar with you,” the large black dog said as he walked over.

Shi Yongyun’s expression darkened. They could argue, but what was the meaning of your dirty words? If this kind of person was really allowed to become the Buddha Son, then the Buddhist Race would be completely humiliated.
“Humph, who do you think you are?” He did not immediately flip out.

Coming from the Buddhist Land, he had too high an opinion of himself, and thought that unless it was the Imperial Son, there was no way he could match him. He had always had a lofty feeling of pride. In his eyes, defeating Ling Han and his group was naturally a piece of cake, and there was nothing for him to be proud of.

The reason why he had not defeated them in one go was only because he wanted to show off a bit. After all, there was nowhere for him to show off in the Buddhist Land. It was rare for him to have such an opportunity, so he naturally could not miss it.
The large black dog was amused. He pointed at himself with one hand, and said, “I’m the leader of the Three Milk Tea Brothers. You can just call me Boss.”
Boss your head1!
Shi Yongyun’s expression darkened further. F***, you dare take advantage of me?
“You are really outrageously bold, to dare to make fun of even me!” he said balefully.
“So what if I’m making fun of you? Eat sh*t!” the large black dog shouted.

Shi Yongyun finally couldn’t bear it any longer. With a loud roar, he charged towards the large black dog. Boom, the power in his entire body overflowed, forming a Buddha Halo behind his head. It was flickering with golden light, and was filled with a feeling of holiness.
However, from the looks of it, his face was filled with malevolence and killing intent.
Wasn’t this damaging his image?
Wrong, the Buddhist Race’s explanation for this was to transform into a furious Guardian Deity, subduing evils and eliminating demons.
Shi Yongyun still sent out a palm strike, which turned into a giant golden palm. Regulations entwined around it, blooming with multiple seals.
The large black dog was unafraid, and brazenly charged forwards.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows, both unleashing their full battle prowess.

True Self Tiers could control the Regulations of heaven and earth. This kind of battle was both a battle of power, and also the use of Regulations. Multiple divine chains of order appeared, and the two of them turned them into weapons, attacking each other.
Shi Changtian couldn’t help but widen his eyes, revealing an expression of disbelief.

As he saw it, though the large black dog’s natural talent in martial arts was still alright, he was too vulgar. He was really not cut out to be a Buddha Son. If it was not for the fact that the selection of Buddha Son did not specifically stipulate the issue of “image”, he would definitely be the first to eliminate the large black dog.
But now, the large black dog had given him a pleasant surprise. He was actually fighting Shi Yongyun to a stalemate, showing his powerful strength.
It should be known that Shi Yongyun was in the middle stage of the True Self Tier, and what about the large black dog? He was in the early stage of the True Self Tier!
The large black dog was still able to fight to this extent even though he was disadvantaged by a minor level. This was a clear sign of the large black dog’s natural talent in cultivation!

However, there was still a gap of a minor level between the large black dog and Shi Yongyun, after all. As the battle continued, he was already being suppressed by Shi Yongyun. Furthermore, the disadvantage was becoming greater and greater, so he had no choice but to leap back and escape from the battle.

“The victor hasn’t been decided yet, so why are you fleeing?” Shi Yongyun asked menacingly, a vicious glint in his eyes. He was already filled with killing intent, and wanted to take this opportunity to kill the large black dog. However, this vulgar middle-aged man was so cunning that he actually didn’t want to fight him head-on.

“Decided your sister!” The large black dog gave him a middle finger, and said, “You’re at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, and I’m only at the early stage. What’s the point of fighting? Why don’t you lower your own cultivation level? I won’t mind beating the sh*t out of you!”
The corner of Shi Yongyun’s mouth twitched. Just how much did this perverted middle-aged man have no bottom line, that he would dare to say anything?
“Come, Second, you go!” The large black dog nudged Ling Han.
Second, Second, Second... Ling Han’s expression darkened. This damn old Blackie, why did he have to give them a combination name? Furthermore, he was Second!

“Three Milk Tea Brothers?” Shi Yongyun murmured. He naturally remembered the large black dog saying that the large black dog was the eldest of the Three Milk Tea Brothers. Then, this guy who was called the Second was naturally one of them.
“You are this person’s Second Eldest?” He looked towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was instantly enraged. Xiu, he rushed out, brandishing his fists in a punch.
“You’re the f*cking Second!”
Peng!
This punch was too fast, and Shi Yongyun was completely unable to block it. Instantly, he sustained a heavy blow, and his whole person slid backwards.
He was both shocked and pained. This punch was really too fast, wasn’t it?
However, right at this moment, Ling Han leaped up high and threw another punch.
Peng, he hurriedly crossed his arms over his chest, blocking in front of him.
A terrifying power surged over, and he retreated continuously.
Shi Yongyun was shocked. This guy was obviously only in the early stage of the True Self Tier, just like the vulgar middle-aged man, but why was his power so strong to this extent?
Moreover, he was also dissatisfied. What right did you have to be so furious, brat? He was the one who was being beaten!
“I didn’t say wrongly. Could it be that you’re not his Second?”

Seeing him touch on a sore spot, Ling Han was naturally even more enraged. Boom, boom, boom! He brandished his fists in fury. His power was as high as Eighth Heaven, and added with the boost from the Saint Technique, his battle prowess was as high as 14 Heavens!
Where was Shi Yongyun?
Although he was at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, his power was only at the Seventh Heaven. Even if he also used the Saint Technique, his top battle prowess was only thirteen Heavens.

Moreover, the Saint Technique could increase battle prowess by six Heavens. This was the limit. The prerequisite was that one had to completely grasp the Saint Technique. Shi Yongyun did not have such high natural talent. He would only occasionally reach the battle prowess of 13 Heavens. Most of the time, he could only blast out battle prowess of 12 Heavens,
This suppression was fine for Fu Quan, and it was fine for him to defeat the large black dog, but against Ling Han, this was not enough.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
He could only be beaten. His face and body were repeatedly hit by fists, and he was in an extremely miserable state.

Meanwhile, the large black dog was amused. Up until now, Shi Yongyun still did not know how he had angered Ling Han. He deserved to be beaten. This was normal. He had come from the Buddhist Land, so who would use the word “Second” as a curseword?
“Hahaha!” The little azure dragon also burst into laughter.

Although Fu Quan felt like his anger was vented, he also felt dejected. As it turned out, the Three Milk Tea Brothers were so fierce. Moreover, it seemed like they would become stronger the younger they were, so this little boy who hadn’t made a move yet should be the most terrifying.
Thankfully, though he had previously looked down on the Three Milk Tea Brothers, he did not say it out loud. Otherwise, if they wanted to settle accounts with him, he would be in deep trouble.
However, if the Three Milk Tea Brothers were already so strong, would he still have a chance at becoming Buddha Son?

Shi Changtian was also secretly pleased as he watched. Though he could suppress Shi Yongyun single-handedly, due to his status, it was not convenient for him to make a move. After all, he was an envoy that had come from the Buddhist Land,
But Ling Han was different. Both sides were competing for the position of Buddha Son, so wasn’t a fight very normal?

“Second, Second, your whole family is Second!” Ling Han grabbed onto Shi Yongyun’s wrist, and tossed him madly like he was a punching bag. Peng, peng, peng! Though the ground of this great hall had been strengthened by elites, it could not hold up to Ling Han’s barrage of blows. The ground on either side of him caved in.
Where was Shi Yongyun?
He had already been knocked unconscious. He wasn’t a Body Arts practitioner, so his physique could only be considered normal.
“Enough!” At this moment, Shi Changtian finally spoke up to stop him.

After all, there was nowhere for him to show off in the Buddhist Land.
It was rare for him to have such an opportunity, so he naturally could not miss it.
The large black dog was amused.
He pointed at himself with one hand, and said, “I’m the leader of the Three Milk Tea Brothers.
You can just call me Boss.”
Boss your head1!
Shi Yongyun’s expression darkened further.
F***, you dare take advantage of me?
“You are really outrageously bold, to dare to make fun of even me!” he said balefully.
“So what if I’m making fun of you?
Eat sh*t!” the large black dog shouted.
Shi Yongyun finally couldn’t bear it any longer.
With a loud roar, he charged towards the large black dog.
Boom, the power in his entire body overflowed, forming a Buddha Halo behind his head.
It was flickering with golden light, and was filled with a feeling of holiness.
However, from the looks of it, his face was filled with malevolence and killing intent.
Wasn’t this damaging his image?
Wrong, the Buddhist Race’s explanation for this was to transform into a furious Guardian Deity, subduing evils and eliminating demons.
Shi Yongyun still sent out a palm strike, which turned into a giant golden palm.
Regulations entwined around it, blooming with multiple seals.
The large black dog was unafraid, and brazenly charged forwards.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows, both unleashing their full battle prowess.
True Self Tiers could control the Regulations of heaven and earth.
This kind of battle was both a battle of power, and also the use of Regulations.
Multiple divine chains of order appeared, and the two of them turned them into weapons, attacking each other.
Shi Changtian couldn’t help but widen his eyes, revealing an expression of disbelief.
As he saw it, though the large black dog’s natural talent in martial arts was still alright, he was too vulgar.
He was really not cut out to be a Buddha Son.
If it was not for the fact that the selection of Buddha Son did not specifically stipulate the issue of “image”, he would definitely be the first to eliminate the large black dog.
But now, the large black dog had given him a pleasant surprise.
He was actually fighting Shi Yongyun to a stalemate, showing his powerful strength.
It should be known that Shi Yongyun was in the middle stage of the True Self Tier, and what about the large black dog?
He was in the early stage of the True Self Tier!
The large black dog was still able to fight to this extent even though he was disadvantaged by a minor level.
This was a clear sign of the large black dog’s natural talent in cultivation!
However, there was still a gap of a minor level between the large black dog and Shi Yongyun, after all.
As the battle continued, he was already being suppressed by Shi Yongyun.
Furthermore, the disadvantage was becoming greater and greater, so he had no choice but to leap back and escape from the battle.
“The victor hasn’t been decided yet, so why are you fleeing?” Shi Yongyun asked menacingly, a vicious glint in his eyes.
He was already filled with killing intent, and wanted to take this opportunity to kill the large black dog.
However, this vulgar middle-aged man was so cunning that he actually didn’t want to fight him head-on.
“Decided your sister!” The large black dog gave him a middle finger, and said, “You’re at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, and I’m only at the early stage.
What’s the point of fighting?
Why don’t you lower your own cultivation level?
I won’t mind beating the sh*t out of you!”
The corner of Shi Yongyun’s mouth twitched.
Just how much did this perverted middle-aged man have no bottom line, that he would dare to say anything?
“Come, Second, you go!” The large black dog nudged Ling Han.
Second, Second, Second...
Ling Han’s expression darkened.
This damn old Blackie, why did he have to give them a combination name?
Furthermore, he was Second!
“Three Milk Tea Brothers?” Shi Yongyun murmured.
He naturally remembered the large black dog saying that the large black dog was the eldest of the Three Milk Tea Brothers.
Then, this guy who was called the Second was naturally one of them.
“You are this person’s Second Eldest?” He looked towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was instantly enraged.
Xiu, he rushed out, brandishing his fists in a punch.
“You’re the f*cking Second!”
Peng!
This punch was too fast, and Shi Yongyun was completely unable to block it.
Instantly, he sustained a heavy blow, and his whole person slid backwards.
He was both shocked and pained.
This punch was really too fast, wasn’t it?
However, right at this moment, Ling Han leaped up high and threw another punch.
Peng, he hurriedly crossed his arms over his chest, blocking in front of him.
A terrifying power surged over, and he retreated continuously.
Shi Yongyun was shocked.
This guy was obviously only in the early stage of the True Self Tier, just like the vulgar middle-aged man, but why was his power so strong to this extent?
Moreover, he was also dissatisfied.
What right did you have to be so furious, brat?
He was the one who was being beaten!
“I didn’t say wrongly.
Could it be that you’re not his Second?”
Seeing him touch on a sore spot, Ling Han was naturally even more enraged.
Boom, boom, boom!
He brandished his fists in fury.
His power was as high as Eighth Heaven, and added with the boost from the Saint Technique, his battle prowess was as high as 14 Heavens!
Where was Shi Yongyun?
Although he was at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, his power was only at the Seventh Heaven.
Even if he also used the Saint Technique, his top battle prowess was only thirteen Heavens.
Moreover, the Saint Technique could increase battle prowess by six Heavens.
This was the limit.
The prerequisite was that one had to completely grasp the Saint Technique.
Shi Yongyun did not have such high natural talent.
He would only occasionally reach the battle prowess of 13 Heavens.
Most of the time, he could only blast out battle prowess of 12 Heavens,
This suppression was fine for Fu Quan, and it was fine for him to defeat the large black dog, but against Ling Han, this was not enough.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
He could only be beaten.
His face and body were repeatedly hit by fists, and he was in an extremely miserable state.
Meanwhile, the large black dog was amused.
Up until now, Shi Yongyun still did not know how he had angered Ling Han.
He deserved to be beaten.
This was normal.
He had come from the Buddhist Land, so who would use the word “Second” as a curseword?
“Hahaha!” The little azure dragon also burst into laughter.
Although Fu Quan felt like his anger was vented, he also felt dejected.
As it turned out, the Three Milk Tea Brothers were so fierce.
Moreover, it seemed like they would become stronger the younger they were, so this little boy who hadn’t made a move yet should be the most terrifying.
Thankfully, though he had previously looked down on the Three Milk Tea Brothers, he did not say it out loud.
Otherwise, if they wanted to settle accounts with him, he would be in deep trouble.
However, if the Three Milk Tea Brothers were already so strong, would he still have a chance at becoming Buddha Son?
Shi Changtian was also secretly pleased as he watched.
Though he could suppress Shi Yongyun single-handedly, due to his status, it was not convenient for him to make a move.
After all, he was an envoy that had come from the Buddhist Land,
But Ling Han was different.
Both sides were competing for the position of Buddha Son, so wasn’t a fight very normal?
“Second, Second, your whole family is Second!” Ling Han grabbed onto Shi Yongyun’s wrist, and tossed him madly like he was a punching bag.
Peng, peng, peng!
Though the ground of this great hall had been strengthened by elites, it could not hold up to Ling Han’s barrage of blows.
The ground on either side of him caved in.
Where was Shi Yongyun?
He had already been knocked unconscious.
He wasn’t a Body Arts practitioner, so his physique could only be considered normal.
“Enough!” At this moment, Shi Changtian finally spoke up to stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4199: A different kind of decisive battle
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After suffering such a great defeat, Shi Yongyun naturally could not bring himself to stay any longer. He left the Stainless Planet as if he was fleeing from something.
“Judging by the way that brat looked at you before he left, it’s clear that he’s harboring a grudge against you. He’s waiting for an opportunity to exact revenge,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “We are about to become the Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm. By then, this Shi Yongyun can only come at us head-on, so what do we have to fear?”
“True.” The large black dog nodded, and relaxed.

“Oh, that’s right. Which one of us is the Buddha Son?” The little azure dragon approached. “Now that Fu Quan has retreated on his own, only the three of us are left. This Buddha Son is definitely one of us, but who’s going to be the one?”
“Grandpa Dog will do it.” The large black dog was completely shameless, “Grandpa Dog is the boss!”
“Boss your sister!” Ling Han and the little azure dragon each sent the large black dog flying with a kick.
“But to be honest, the chances of Old Black becoming a Buddha Son is not very high,” Ling Han said seriously. “It’s not that your natural talent is bad, but rather your image... tsk, tsk, tsk!”
“Pei, Grandpa Dog can’t be more noble and virtuous!” The large black dog was unconvinced. Why did people always say that he was vulgar?
En, they must be jealous of it! That must be the case.
“Four-Legged Snake, looks like we’re going to settle this with a single battle!” Ling Han said.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?!” the little azure dragon said haughtily.
They weren’t the only ones considering this problem. The higher-ups of the Buddhist Race of West Heavenly Realm were also doing the same.
After multiple rounds of selection, the Three Milk Tea Brothers had already emerged victorious. However, there could only be one Buddha Son, so who they chose was a problem.
“We’ll rule out the eldest first!” the Black Cloud Bodhisattva said.
“Alright,” Yunshu Bodhisattva nodded.
“En.” Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva also nodded.

If the large black dog saw this scene, he would definitely be extremely depressed. What was so bad about Grandpa Dog? What did they mean by ruling him out first? Could you guys give me a reason? Ah, could you guys give me a reason?
“The second and youngest are both naturally gifted prodigies,” the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva said. “These two people are both qualified to become Buddha Son.”
“Then how should we choose?” the Black Cloud Bodhisattva asked.

“Why don’t we just let them have a battle? The victor will be the Buddha Son, while the loser will still be the seed. Looking at their future accomplishments, they can become official at any time,” Yunshu Bodhisattva suggested.
“All right!”
“Agreed!”

The three Bodhisattvas were the leaders of the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm. Although there was a Buddha above them, named Haoyang, this Buddha had already lived for 110,000 years, and had long since reached the the theoretical lifespan limit of a Saint. He could die at any moment.

Thus, this Buddha had long since become a kind of symbol, a kind of intimidation. Usually, he would be constantly in seclusion, maintaining a state of suspended animation, locking in the loss of life force, so he could live a few more years.
However, he was like a living corpse. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that he was better off dead than alive.
Now that the three Bodhisattvas had decided, the matter was settled.
The entire Stainless Planet was aware that a new Buddha Son was about to be born. It would either be Ling Han or little azure dragon.
The final battle was set to take place three days later.

When the news spread out, everyone was excited. They were finally going to welcome a new Buddha Son, and the Buddha Son was a symbol, a place of sustenance for the spirit. Without the Buddha Son, they would always feel that there was something missing.
There were a considerable number of legends about the Three Milk Tea Brothers, especially the battle between Ling Han and Shi Yongyun. It was well-known, and Ling Han was completely deified.
Thus, the battle between Ling Han and the little azure dragon also attracted huge attention. In fact, even the three Bodhisattvas would attend.
Very quickly, three days had passed.

Ling Han and the little azure dragon stood on a plaza, surrounded by spectators that numbered in the millions. These were all cultivators. It was just that ordinary people didn’t have the right to come, or there would be hundreds of times more people.
Even the three Bodhisattvas were seated on the lotus platform, their expressions solemn. Behind each of their heads, there was a Buddha Halo, pure and sacred.
“Begin.” After Shi Changtian asked for instructions from the three Bodhisattvas, he announced the beginning of the final battle.
“Second, I’ve already tolerated you for a long time. Let’s have a battle today and see who’s stronger!” the little azure dragon howled.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “All right, then let’s decide the victor!”
Hearing the two of them speak so grandly, everyone was naturally even more expectant.
What kind of intense sparks would result from the clash between the two great prodigies?
“Come!”
“Come!”
Ling Han and the little azure dragon roared loudly, then charged towards the other. Xiu, their speed was extremely fast, as if they were streaks of light.
“This is truly terrifying. Merely this speed is enough to scare someone to death!”
“No wonder they could become a candidate for the Buddha Son. I concede defeat!”
“I have no choice but to admit defeat. They are supreme prodigies!”
“If this battle were to begin, it would definitely be even more intense and exciting!”
Everyone sighed ruefully. Just a glimpse was enough to know the whole picture. It was too awesome.
Xiu, xiu! Ling Han and the little azure dragon were already extremely close, and they both moved.
“Rock, paper, scissors!”
‘F*ck!’
All of a sudden, all the spectators were thrown off their feet, all of them wanting to throw up blood.
This was a battle between prodigies?
F***, what kind of battle between prodigies was this?
Rock-paper-scissors?

“As expected of the second eldest. You’re just as I thought, we both showed paper!” the little azure dragon exclaimed in admiration. “Alright, come again. This time, I’ll use my ultimate move. I’m definitely going to defeat you.”
“Come!”
The two of them moved at the same time again. Uh, both of them played rock-paper-scissors again.
“Again!”
Hu, the wind blew past, and everyone felt a wave of disgust.
You guys... can’t you guys be more dependable!
How casual was it to use rock-paper-scissors to decide the selection of Buddha Son? If this spread out, wouldn’t it become a joke in the world?
How was the Buddha Son chosen?
—Oh, through rock-paper-scissors.
How could they bring themselves to answer like this? Weren’t they afraid that they would be humiliated to the ends of the world?
Even the three Bodhisattvas’ expressions were dark. Just look, even they had personally come to the scene to express their seriousness in selecting the Buddha Son, but what was the result?
‘Please, can you guys have a good battle? Be more solemn, and more serious?’
“Rock!”
“Scissors!”
“Paper!”
Ling Han and the little azure dragon continued to gesticulate as they roared. It was extremely intense, and it was as if a bloody battle were about to begin.
The louder they shouted, the more speechless everyone became.
Fine, these two guys did not care. It was clear that they were not willing to really fight to the death.
Upon further thought, they were all slightly moved.

For the sake of the position of Buddha Son, they were sure that a great many people could even disregard their fathers and sons, right? But these two, on the other hand, had placed their brotherhood in a higher position.
Wouldn’t it be better to be so loyal?

A great many people were actually touched, and began to defend Ling Han and the little azure dragon from this angle, thinking that this was the best way. Otherwise, even if either of them won, and became the Buddha Son, it would also cause the relationship between brothers to break down.

In reality, Ling Han and the little azure dragon were completely playing around. If they were really forced into a bloody battle, who knows, they might accidentally use the techniques that they were skilled in.
There were three Venerate Tier elites here, so what if they saw through them?
Thus, they thought of using rock-paper-scissors to decide the outcome. In any case, the position of Buddha Son would fall on one of them, and the benefits would not flow into the fields of outsiders.
This had actually been misunderstood as having a close brotherhood, er...

chapters.title: Chapter 4200: Relaunching the Ranking Tournament
paragraphs: After gesturing for half a day, Ling Han and the little azure dragon finally didn’t make the same gesture.
“No, two wins in three rounds!” the little azure dragon said shamelessly.
“I’ll satisfy you.”
After a while.
“Three wins in five rounds.”
“Four wins in seven rounds!”

The little azure dragon lost more and more, and the upper limit of the “duels” was also continuously increasing. Meanwhile, the expressions of Yunshu Bodhisattva and the others were also getting uglier and uglier, as if they had all become as black as pots.
“Enough!” The Black Cloud Bodhisattva stood up abruptly, “Buddha son is the second son of the Three Milk Tea Brothers, and he is bestowed the name Shi Xinming.”
Shua, the three Bodhisattvas left at the same time, truly exploding with fury.
The spectators also threw out things like apple cores from their hands. Was this the ugliest battle in history?
Shi Changtian walked over, his expression not much better either. He forced out a smile, and said, “Congratulations, you have become the new Buddha Son!”
Ling Han smiled and said, “Then hurry up and bring me the Buddhist Race’s Imperial Technique.”
Shi Changtian rolled his eyes, “Impossible!”

“What? I, a Buddha Son, am still unable to learn the Buddhist Race’s Imperial Technique? Then how am I supposed to compete with other Imperial Sons?” Ling Han hurriedly called out. Hadn’t he infiltrated the Buddhist Race’s inner circle just to learn the Imperial Technique, or even the Imperial Scroll!
What Ling Han lacked the most now was the Imperial Scroll. This was the last piece of the puzzle that would allow him to become the strongest.

“Without a great merit, how could one possibly learn Imperial Techniques?” Shi Changtian tolerated him, and explained. After all, this was the future Buddha Son, and the signboard of the Buddhist Race of West Heavenly Realm. No matter what, he had to show some respect.
Ling Han was depressed. He had already become a Buddha Son, yet was still unable to smoothly learn the Imperial Technique. No wonder Shi Yongming had been so weak in the past.
Sigh.
Ling Han didn’t argue. In any case, it was useless.
He and the little azure dragon returned to the Divine Temple where they lived and continued to cultivate.

However, while he didn’t have any Imperial Technique, he did not lack cultivation resources. Since he had become the Buddha Son, they naturally had to nurture him with all their might. Not only did Ling Han not lack cultivation resources, but even the little azure dragon wasn’t inferior to Ling Han.
He was still a seed of the Buddha Son. If anything happened to Ling Han, he would step forward.

Although the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm couldn’t compare to the real Imperial Clan, it was still much stronger than Holy Lands. It was not difficult for them to nurture two people at the same time.
Ling Han and the little dragon naturally wouldn’t monopolize the resources. They each took out a portion to share with the large black dog, ensuring fairness.
With this endless supply of cultivation resources, Ling Han and the others improved very quickly. In half a year’s time, they were close to reaching the end of the early stage of the True Self.

In Ling Han’s mind, there were already eight clay fetuses called ‘True Self’. Although they were clay fetuses, they were all entwined by Regulations and covered with seals, appearing indescribably mighty.

“I’m still one short,” Ling Han murmured. As long as he forged another True Self, he would be able to complete the first form of the True Self. He would be able to reform the nine clay fetuses into stone fetuses, and allow his soul to undergo a qualitative change.
“My current strength?”
Ling Han casually threw a punch, and the Void vibrated-13 Heavens!
His Body Art and mystical power both reached Ninth Heaven. With the burst of both, he would reach 13 Heavens!

One had to realize that even ordinary cultivators at the consummate level of the True Self Tier would only possess a power of 12 Heavens. Ling Han had already surpassed them. Moreover, he hadn’t reached the end of the first form of the True Self yet.
“I really miss the days when I pummeled the Imperial Sons and teased the Imperial Daughters!” he mused ruefully. In these two years, he had been focused on cultivation, and it
was as if he had not fought at all, which he was very unused to.
Right at this moment, he was suddenly called over by Shi Changtian.
“Xinming!” Shi Changtian sat in meditation facing the Buddha statue. Sensing Ling Han’s arrival, he turned around and looked at Ling Han.
What?
Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to his senses. This was referring to him. His current Buddhist name was called Shi Xinming.

Shi Changtian felt a muscle twitch in his cheek. He had never seen such an ignorant Buddha Son. He coughed, and said, “Our West Heavenly Realm has chosen you as the new Buddha Son, and in the North Heavenly Realm, a new Buddha Son has also emerged.”

Ling Han knew that the original Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm had been crippled, and it seemed that it was Shi Yongming who had done it. Thus, after such a long time, it was logical that the Buddhist Race of the North Heavenly Realm would select a new Buddha Son. “Thus, the Buddhist Race of the four great Heavenly Realms plan to conduct another contest.” Shi Changtian continued, “You and Wide Clouds Heaven will go to the East Heavenly Realm, and fight forthe Buddhist Race of our West Heavenly Realm.”
Ling Han was instantly energized, and he said, “If I win, does that count as a great merit?”

No wonder Shi Yongming had been so weak in the past.

Not only did Ling Han not lack cultivation resources, but even the little azure dragon wasn’t inferior to Ling Han.
He was still a seed of the Buddha Son.
If anything happened to Ling Han, he would step forward.
Although the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm couldn’t compare to the real Imperial Clan, it was still much stronger than Holy Lands.
It was not difficult for them to nurture two people at the same time.
Ling Han and the little dragon naturally wouldn’t monopolize the resources.
They each took out a portion to share with the large black dog, ensuring fairness.

In Ling Han’s mind, there were already eight clay fetuses called ‘True Self’.

As long as he forged another True Self, he would be able to complete the first form of the True Self.
He would be able to reform the nine clay fetuses into stone fetuses, and allow his soul to undergo a qualitative change.

Ling Han casually threw a punch, and the Void vibrated-13 Heavens!
His Body Art and mystical power both reached Ninth Heaven.
With the burst of both, he would reach 13 Heavens!
One had to realize that even ordinary cultivators at the consummate level of the True Self Tier would only possess a power of 12 Heavens.
Ling Han had already surpassed them.
Moreover, he hadn’t reached the end of the first form of the True Self yet.
“I really miss the days when I pummeled the Imperial Sons and teased the Imperial Daughters!” he mused ruefully.
In these two years, he had been focused on cultivation, and it
was as if he had not fought at all, which he was very unused to.

What?

His current Buddhist name was called Shi Xinming.
